#### Step 1 - failing test

Create `app/test/unitsRepoManyByIds.test.ts`:

```ts
// unitsRepo.getManyByIds (WP1 B2a spec D2.3; plan PR5, WI9): the FULL-item
// batch reader the ranking seen set uses. Complete or nothing: a chunk whose
// request fails rethrows, keys still unread after the retries throw
// IncompleteBatchReadError - an unread unit must never read as "not on file",
// which would change a tenant card and its fingerprint. A key the table
// answered with NO row is a complete read of an absent unit.
//
// Pure: a stub DocumentClient records every BatchGetCommand and answers from a
// per-test script (the unitsRepoDisplays.test.ts idiom). The DynamoDB Local
// round trip is unitsRepoManyByIds.integration.test.ts.
import { BatchGetCommand, type BatchGetCommandInput, type DynamoDBDocumentClient } from '@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { createLogger } from '../src/lib/logger.js';
import { IncompleteBatchReadError } from '../src/repos/contactsRepo.js';
import { createUnitsRepo } from '../src/repos/unitsRepo.js';
import { createLogCapture } from './helpers/logCapture.js';
import { createFakeWorld } from './helpers/twilioWebhookHarness.js';

const TABLE = 'hc-test-x-units';

type Key = { unitId: string };
type Reply = { served: Key[]; unprocessed?: Key[] } | 'throw';

const fullUnit = (unitId: string) => ({
  unitId,
  landlordId: `ll-${unitId}`,
  status: 'available',
  beds: 2,
  rent_max: 1500,
  notes: `Notes for ${unitId}`,
  address: { line1: `${unitId} Main St`, city: 'Atlanta', state: 'GA' },
});

function stubDoc(script: (keys: Key[], call: number) => Reply = (keys) => ({ served: keys })) {
  const requests: BatchGetCommandInput[] = [];
  const doc = {
    async send(command: unknown) {
      if (!(command instanceof BatchGetCommand)) throw new Error('stub: expected a BatchGetCommand');
      requests.push(command.input);
      const keys = (command.input.RequestItems?.[TABLE]?.Keys ?? []) as Key[];
      const reply = script(keys, requests.length);
      if (reply === 'throw') throw new Error('stub: the request failed');
      return {
        Responses: { [TABLE]: reply.served.map(({ unitId }) => fullUnit(unitId)) },
        ...(reply.unprocessed !== undefined &&
          reply.unprocessed.length > 0 && { UnprocessedKeys: { [TABLE]: { Keys: reply.unprocessed } } }),
      };
    },
  };
  return { doc: doc as unknown as DynamoDBDocumentClient, requests };
}

function makeRepo(doc: DynamoDBDocumentClient) {
  const capture = createLogCapture();
  const logger = createLogger({ destination: capture.stream });
  return { units: createUnitsRepo({ doc, env: { TABLE_PREFIX: 'hc-test-x-' }, logger }), capture };
}

const keysOf = (request: BatchGetCommandInput): string[] =>
  ((request.RequestItems?.[TABLE]?.Keys ?? []) as Key[]).map((k) => k.unitId);

const unitIds = (n: number): string[] => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => `unit-${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}`);

describe('unitsRepo.getManyByIds (stub client)', () => {
  it('reads 150 distinct ids plus repeats in TWO BatchGets of 100 and 50 keys, repeats removed', async () => {
    const { doc, requests } = stubDoc();
    const { units } = makeRepo(doc);
    const distinct = unitIds(150);

    const found = await units.getManyByIds([...distinct, ...distinct.slice(0, 10)], { requireComplete: true });

    expect(requests.map((r) => keysOf(r).length)).toEqual([100, 50]);
    const sent = requests.flatMap(keysOf);
    expect(new Set(sent).size).toBe(sent.length);
    expect(found.size).toBe(150);
  });

  it('returns FULL items: no projection is sent, every stored attribute comes back', async () => {
    const { doc, requests } = stubDoc();
    const { units } = makeRepo(doc);

    const found = await units.getManyByIds(['unit-001'], { requireComplete: true });

    const entry = requests[0]!.RequestItems![TABLE]!;
    expect(entry.ProjectionExpression).toBeUndefined();
    expect(entry.ExpressionAttributeNames).toBeUndefined();
    expect(found.get('unit-001')).toEqual(fullUnit('unit-001'));
  });

  it('retries UnprocessedKeys with the SAME keys until they are read', async () => {
    const { doc, requests } = stubDoc((keys, call) =>
      call === 1 ? { served: keys.slice(0, -2), unprocessed: keys.slice(-2) } : { served: keys },
    );
    const { units, capture } = makeRepo(doc);
    const asked = unitIds(5);

    const found = await units.getManyByIds(asked, { requireComplete: true });

    expect(requests.map(keysOf)).toEqual([asked, asked.slice(-2)]);
    expect(found.size).toBe(5);
    expect(capture.atLevel(40)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('keys still unread after 4 attempts THROW IncompleteBatchReadError naming the units table; no WARN', async () => {
    const { doc, requests } = stubDoc((keys) => ({ served: keys.slice(0, -1), unprocessed: keys.slice(-1) }));
    const { units, capture } = makeRepo(doc);

    const err = await units.getManyByIds(unitIds(3), { requireComplete: true }).then(
      () => undefined,
      (e: unknown) => e,
    );

    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(IncompleteBatchReadError);
    expect(err).toMatchObject({ unprocessed: 1, requested: 3 });
    expect((err as Error).message).toMatch(/^units batch read incomplete: 1 of 3 keys unread/);
    expect(requests).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(capture.atLevel(40)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('a chunk whose request THROWS rethrows that error and reads no further chunk', async () => {
    const { doc, requests } = stubDoc((keys, call) => (call === 2 ? 'throw' : { served: keys }));
    const { units } = makeRepo(doc);

    await expect(units.getManyByIds(unitIds(250), { requireComplete: true })).rejects.toThrow(
      'stub: the request failed',
    );
    expect(requests.map((r) => keysOf(r).length)).toEqual([100, 100]);
  });

  it('a key the table answered with NO row is a complete read: absent, never a throw', async () => {
    const { doc } = stubDoc((keys) => ({ served: keys.filter((k) => k.unitId !== 'unit-001') }));
    const { units } = makeRepo(doc);

    const found = await units.getManyByIds(unitIds(3), { requireComplete: true });

    expect([...found.keys()].sort()).toEqual(['unit-000', 'unit-002']);
  });

  it('an empty id list makes NO call', async () => {
    const { doc, requests } = stubDoc();
    const { units } = makeRepo(doc);

    expect((await units.getManyByIds([], { requireComplete: true })).size).toBe(0);
    expect(requests).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('refuses to run as a best-effort read (the option is the contract)', async () => {
    const { doc, requests } = stubDoc();
    const { units } = makeRepo(doc);

    await expect(
      units.getManyByIds(['unit-001'], { requireComplete: false } as unknown as { requireComplete: true }),
    ).rejects.toThrow(/complete read only/);
    expect(requests).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('the harness fake unitsRepo.getManyByIds mirrors the repo', () => {
  it('answers full copies of the stored units; an unknown id is absent; a soft-deleted unit still answers', async () => {
    const world = createFakeWorld();
    world.units.set('unit-a', {
      unitId: 'unit-a',
      landlordId: 'll-a',
      status: 'available',
      beds: 3,
      created_at: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z',
      updated_at: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    });
    world.units.set('unit-gone', {
      unitId: 'unit-gone',
      landlordId: 'll-b',
      status: 'available',
      deleted_at: '2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z',
      created_at: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z',
      updated_at: '2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z',
    });

    const found = await world.unitsRepo.getManyByIds(['unit-a', 'unit-gone', 'unit-missing'], {
      requireComplete: true,
    });

    expect([...found.keys()].sort()).toEqual(['unit-a', 'unit-gone']);
    expect(found.get('unit-a')).toMatchObject({ beds: 3, landlordId: 'll-a' });
    found.get('unit-a')!.beds = 9;
    expect(world.units.get('unit-a')!.beds).toBe(3);
  });
});
```

Create `app/test/unitsRepoManyByIds.integration.test.ts`:

```ts
// unitsRepo.getManyByIds against DynamoDB Local (WP1 B2a spec D2.3; PR5): the
// full item round trip, a soft-deleted unit still answers, a missing id is
// absent. The stub-client cases are unitsRepoManyByIds.test.ts.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { tableName } from '../src/lib/config.js';
import { createDocumentClient, createDynamoClient } from '../src/lib/dynamo.js';
import { deleteTableIfExists, ensureTable } from '../src/lib/dynamoAdmin.js';
import { createLogger } from '../src/lib/logger.js';
import { getTableSpec } from '../src/lib/tables.js';
import { createUnitsRepo } from '../src/repos/unitsRepo.js';
import { createLogCapture } from './helpers/logCapture.js';

const endpoint = process.env.DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT ?? 'http://localhost:8000';

async function endpointReachable(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await fetch(endpoint, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1_500) });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

const reachable = await endpointReachable();
if (!reachable) {
  console.warn(`[unitsRepoManyByIds.integration] DynamoDB Local is required at ${endpoint}`);
}

describe.skipIf(!reachable)('unitsRepo.getManyByIds against DynamoDB Local', () => {
  const testEnv = { TABLE_PREFIX: `hc-test-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}-` };
  const client = createDynamoClient({ endpoint });
  const doc = createDocumentClient({ endpoint });
  const logger = createLogger({ destination: createLogCapture().stream });
  const units = createUnitsRepo({ doc, env: testEnv, logger });

  beforeAll(async () => {
    await ensureTable(client, getTableSpec('units'), tableName('units', testEnv));
  }, 120_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await deleteTableIfExists(client, tableName('units', testEnv));
    doc.destroy();
    client.destroy();
  }, 120_000);

  it('reads every stored attribute; a soft-deleted unit still answers; a missing id is absent', async () => {
    const kept = await units.create({
      landlordId: 'contact-ll-many-1',
      status: 'available',
      address: { line1: '12 Oak St', city: 'Atlanta', state: 'GA', zip: '30301' },
      beds: 2,
      baths: 1,
      rent_max: 1450,
      notes: 'Ground floor, small yard',
    });
    const removed = await units.create({
      landlordId: 'contact-ll-many-2',
      status: 'available',
      address: { line1: '9 Elm Ave', city: 'Decatur', state: 'GA' },
    });
    await units.softDelete(removed.unitId, '2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z');

    const found = await units.getManyByIds([kept.unitId, removed.unitId, 'unit-missing', kept.unitId], {
      requireComplete: true,
    });

    expect([...found.keys()].sort()).toEqual([kept.unitId, removed.unitId].sort());
    expect(found.get(kept.unitId)).toEqual(await units.getById(kept.unitId, { consistentRead: true }));
    expect(found.get(kept.unitId)).toMatchObject({ beds: 2, rent_max: 1450, notes: 'Ground floor, small yard' });
    expect(found.get(removed.unitId)!.deleted_at).toBe('2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z');
  });
});
```

#### Step 3 - implementation

3a. `app/src/repos/unitsRepo.ts`, the interface. Replace:

```ts

```

with:

```ts
  getDisplaysByIds(unitIds: string[], opts?: { requireComplete?: boolean }): Promise<Map<string, UnitDisplayItem>>;
  /**
   * Batch-read FULL unit items by primary key (WP1 B2a spec D2.3; plan PR5):
   * the ranking seen set's one read for a tenant's whole seen set. COMPLETE OR
   * NOTHING, so the option is required and only `true` is legal: 100-key
   * chunks, repeated ids removed, UnprocessedKeys retried (4 attempts, 25 ms
   * doubling); a chunk whose request fails rethrows that error, and keys still
   * unprocessed after the retries throw IncompleteBatchReadError (table
   * `units`). A key the table answered with no row is a complete read of an
   * absent unit and is simply absent from the map. Soft-deleted units answer.
   * Eventually consistent, like getById.
   */
  getManyByIds(unitIds: string[], opts: { requireComplete: true }): Promise<Map<string, UnitItem>>;
```

3b. The implementation, right after `getDisplaysByIds` (whose body stays
byte-identical). Replace:

```ts
    async update(unitId, patch) {
      // SET each supplied non-null field; REMOVE each explicit-null field (the
```

with:

```ts
    // TODO(units-contacts-batchget-walk-duplicated): a third copy of the walk - full items, complete-only.
    async getManyByIds(unitIds, opts) {
      if (opts.requireComplete !== true) {
        throw new Error('unitsRepo.getManyByIds is a complete read only: pass { requireComplete: true }');
      }
      const found = new Map<string, UnitItem>();
      // BatchGetItem REJECTS duplicate keys; callers may repeat an id.
      const uniqueIds = [...new Set(unitIds)];
      for (let i = 0; i < uniqueIds.length; i += 100) {
        let keys = uniqueIds.slice(i, i + 100).map((unitId) => ({ unitId }));
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 4 && keys.length > 0; attempt += 1) {
          if (attempt > 0) {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25 * 2 ** (attempt - 1)));
          }
          // A request that throws is an unread chunk: it propagates (complete-only).
          const response = await doc.send(new BatchGetCommand({ RequestItems: { [table]: { Keys: keys } } }));
          for (const item of (response.Responses?.[table] ?? []) as UnitItem[]) {
            found.set(item.unitId, item);
          }
          keys = (response.UnprocessedKeys?.[table]?.Keys ?? []) as Array<{ unitId: string }>;
        }
        if (keys.length > 0) {
          throw new IncompleteBatchReadError(keys.length, uniqueIds.length, 'units');
        }
      }
```

```ts
  }
```

```ts
    doc.destroy();
```

```ts
// matchesRepo (WP1 B2a spec D8, D8.1; plan PR5, WI1): the pure helpers and the
// batch walks against a stub DocumentClient - chunking, the unprocessed
// retries, the complete-only read, the legacy-row rule. The DynamoDB Local
// round trip is matchesRepo.integration.test.ts.
import {
  BatchGetCommand,
  BatchWriteCommand,
  type BatchGetCommandInput,
  type BatchWriteCommandInput,
  type DynamoDBDocumentClient,
} from '@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { createLogger } from '../src/lib/logger.js';
import { IncompleteBatchReadError } from '../src/repos/contactsRepo.js';
import {
  MATCH_SCHEMA,
  createMatchesRepo,
  decodeSnapshot,
  encodeSnapshot,
  gunzipBase64,
  gzipBase64,
  isCurrentMatchRow,
  matchPairKey,
  rankingExpiresAt,
  type MatchRow,
} from '../src/repos/matchesRepo.js';
import { createLogCapture } from './helpers/logCapture.js';

const TABLE = 'hc-test-x-matches';
const COMPUTED_AT = '2026-10-28T12:00:00.000Z';

function row(tenantId: string, unitId: string, over: Partial<MatchRow> = {}): MatchRow {
  return {
    tenantId,
    unitId,
    schema: 2,
    score: 72,
    for: [{ text: 'Voucher size fits', source: 'voucher_size' }],
    against: [{ text: 'Over the portion', source: 'rent' }],
    missing: [{ key: 'payment_standard', text: 'Payment standard' }, { text: 'Move-in date' }],
    failedRequirements: [],
    fairHousingFlags: [],
    stage: 1,
    rubricVersion: 'r1',
    examplesVersion: 'e1',
    promptFingerprint: 'a'.repeat(64),
    model: 'fake',
    runId: 'run-1',
    jobGeneration: 'gen-1',
    computedAt: COMPUTED_AT,
    anchorSide: 'unit',
    fingerprints: { tenantCard: 't'.repeat(64), unitCard: 'u'.repeat(64), pairHistory: 'p'.repeat(64) },
    inputSnapshot: encodeSnapshot({ anchor: { card: { beds: 2 } } }),
    expires_at: rankingExpiresAt(COMPUTED_AT, 180),
    ...over,
  };
}

function makeRepo(doc: DynamoDBDocumentClient) {
  const capture = createLogCapture();
  const logger = createLogger({ destination: capture.stream });
  return { matches: createMatchesRepo({ doc, env: { TABLE_PREFIX: 'hc-test-x-' }, logger }), capture };
}

/** Script: how many of a request's items to leave unprocessed (the LAST n), or a throw. */
function stubWriteDoc(script: (count: number, call: number) => number | 'throw' = () => 0) {
  const requests: BatchWriteCommandInput[] = [];
  const doc = {
    async send(command: unknown) {
      if (!(command instanceof BatchWriteCommand)) throw new Error('stub: expected a BatchWriteCommand');
      requests.push(command.input);
      const items = command.input.RequestItems?.[TABLE] ?? [];
      const reply = script(items.length, requests.length);
      if (reply === 'throw') throw new Error('stub: the request failed');
      return reply > 0 ? { UnprocessedItems: { [TABLE]: items.slice(-reply) } } : {};
    },
  };
  return { doc: doc as unknown as DynamoDBDocumentClient, requests };
}

type PairKey = { tenantId: string; unitId: string };

/** Serves `stored` rows for the asked keys, withholding the LAST n keys, or throws. */
function stubGetDoc(
  stored: Array<Record<string, unknown>>,
  script: (keys: PairKey[], call: number) => number | 'throw' = () => 0,
) {
  const requests: BatchGetCommandInput[] = [];
  const doc = {
    async send(command: unknown) {
      if (!(command instanceof BatchGetCommand)) throw new Error('stub: expected a BatchGetCommand');
      requests.push(command.input);
      const keys = (command.input.RequestItems?.[TABLE]?.Keys ?? []) as PairKey[];
      const reply = script(keys, requests.length);
      if (reply === 'throw') throw new Error('stub: the request failed');
      const served = keys.slice(0, keys.length - reply);
      const withheld = keys.slice(keys.length - reply);
      return {
        Responses: {
          [TABLE]: stored.filter((item) =>
            served.some((k) => k.tenantId === item['tenantId'] && k.unitId === item['unitId']),
          ),
        },
        ...(withheld.length > 0 && { UnprocessedKeys: { [TABLE]: { Keys: withheld } } }),
      };
    },
  };
  return { doc: doc as unknown as DynamoDBDocumentClient, requests };
}

describe('matchesRepo pure helpers', () => {
  it('the schema is 2 and the pair key is tenantId#unitId', () => {
    expect(MATCH_SCHEMA).toBe(2);
    expect(matchPairKey('contact-1', 'unit-1')).toBe('contact-1#unit-1');
  });

  it('rankingExpiresAt is the start plus the TTL in epoch seconds; a bad time throws', () => {
    expect(rankingExpiresAt(COMPUTED_AT, 180)).toBe(Math.floor(Date.parse(COMPUTED_AT) / 1000) + 180 * 86400);
    expect(() => rankingExpiresAt('not a time', 180)).toThrow(/not an ISO time/);
  });

  it('the snapshot codec round-trips JSON through gzip and base64', () => {
    const value = { anchor: { card: { beds: 2, notes: 'Line one / line two' } }, candidates: [{ handle: 'c1' }] };
    const encoded = encodeSnapshot(value);
    expect(encoded).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/);
    expect(decodeSnapshot(encoded)).toEqual(value);
    expect(gunzipBase64(gzipBase64('the batch user message'))).toBe('the batch user message');
    expect(() => encodeSnapshot(undefined)).toThrow(/not JSON/);
  });

  it('a row is current only with schema 2 (the legacy seed shape is not)', () => {
    expect(isCurrentMatchRow(row('t', 'u'))).toBe(true);
    expect(isCurrentMatchRow({ tenantId: 't', unitId: 'u', fit_score: 0.91, expires_at: 1 })).toBe(false);
    expect(isCurrentMatchRow({ tenantId: 't', unitId: 'u', schema: 1 })).toBe(false);
    expect(isCurrentMatchRow(null)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('matchesRepo.putMatches (stub client)', () => {

    const { doc, requests } = stubWriteDoc();

    expect(await matches.putMatches(rows)).toEqual({ written: 60, unwritten: [] });

    expect(requests.map((r) => r.RequestItems?.[TABLE]?.length)).toEqual([25, 25, 10]);
    expect(requests[0]!.RequestItems![TABLE]![0]).toEqual({ PutRequest: { Item: rows[0] } });
  });

    const { doc, requests } = stubWriteDoc();
    const { matches } = makeRepo(doc);

      row('contact-1', 'unit-1', { score: 10 }),
      row('contact-1', 'unit-1', { score: 90 }),
    ]);

    expect(result).toEqual({ written: 1, unwritten: [] });
    const items = requests[0]!.RequestItems![TABLE]!;
    expect(items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect((items[0]!.PutRequest!.Item as MatchRow).score).toBe(90);

  it('refuses a row that is not schema 2 before any call (a programming error, so it throws); no rows makes no call', async () => {
```

Create `app/src/repos/matchesRepo.ts`:

```ts
// WP1 B2a matches store (spec D8, D8.1; charter 10.1; plan PR5). The first
// repository on the `matches` table (lib/tables.ts: hash tenantId, range
// unitId, GSI byUnit, TTL expires_at). ONE row per tenant-property pair,
// written only by the ranking job and read by the ranking read, the Rankings
// page run detail and tests (plan WI1). Band, cap state, priority effect,
// chips and sort position are NEVER stored - all are derived on read.
//
// A row without `schema: 2` is a LEGACY row (the shape the old lean seed
// carried) and is ignored by every reader here: getPairs leaves it out of the
// map and the two lists drop it.
import { gunzipSync, gzipSync } from 'node:zlib';
import { BatchGetCommand, BatchWriteCommand, QueryCommand, type QueryCommandInput } from '@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb';
import { tableName } from '../lib/config.js';
import { getDocumentClient } from '../lib/dynamo.js';
import { logger as defaultLogger } from '../lib/logger.js';
import { IncompleteBatchReadError } from './contactsRepo.js';
import type { RepoDeps } from './conversationsRepo.js';

/** Which side a ranking was asked from; the same two values as the anchor kind. */
export type RankingAnchorKind = 'unit' | 'tenant';

export const MATCH_SCHEMA = 2;

export interface MatchReason {
  text: string;
  source: string;
}

/** A missing-input flag: a code flag carries its stable key; a model unknown has text only. */
export interface MatchMissing {
  key?: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface MatchFairHousingFlag {
  kind: 'unlawful' | 'accommodation';
  field: string;
}

export interface MatchFingerprints {
  tenantCard: string;
  unitCard: string;
  pairHistory: string;
}

export interface MatchRow {
  tenantId: string;
  unitId: string;
  schema: 2;
  score: number;
  for: MatchReason[];
  against: MatchReason[];
  missing: MatchMissing[];
  failedRequirements: string[];
  /** The pair's flags as the model returned them (spec D8). */
  fairHousingFlags: MatchFairHousingFlag[];
  stage: 1;
  rubricVersion: string;
  examplesVersion: string;
  /** sha256 of the call's system text (spec D4, D8.1). */
  promptFingerprint: string;
  /** The driver actually used: the model id, or the literal `fake` / `console` (spec D6). */
  model: string;
  runId: string;
  jobGeneration: string;
  computedAt: string;
  /** Which side's call produced the row (for the run log only). */
  anchorSide: RankingAnchorKind;
  fingerprints: MatchFingerprints;
  /** encodeSnapshot of the exact JSON the pair was scored from (spec D8.1). */
  inputSnapshot: string;
  /** Epoch seconds: rankingExpiresAt(computedAt, RANKING_PAIR_TTL_DAYS). */
  expires_at: number;
}

export interface MatchPairKey {
  tenantId: string;
  unitId: string;
}

/**
 * PR37: the outcome of one putMatches. `written` counts the distinct pairs
 * CONFIRMED written; `unwritten` names every pair NOT CONFIRMED written (in
 * the order given), so `written + unwritten.length` is the number of distinct
 * pairs. A pair of a chunk whose request threw is "not confirmed written": a
 * timeout or socket error after the commit may already have applied it.
 */
export interface MatchWriteResult {
  written: number;
  unwritten: MatchPairKey[];
}

export interface MatchesRepo {
  /**
   * BatchWrite (25 per request) of whole rows. A pair given twice is written
   * once (the last copy wins; BatchWrite rejects a request with a repeated
   * key). Unprocessed items are retried with backoff (5 attempts); items
   * still unprocessed after that, and every not-yet-confirmed row of a chunk
   * whose request THROWS (not retried; such rows are "not confirmed
   * written" - the request may have applied before the error), are REPORTED
   * in `unwritten` and the remaining chunks are still written - it NEVER
   * throws on a DynamoDB failure (PR37: rows that landed are real scores of
   * this run and stay; the caller marks only the unwritten pairs failed). It
   * throws only on a programming error: a row that is not schema 2.
   */
  putMatches(rows: MatchRow[]): Promise<MatchWriteResult>;
  /**
   * Read pairs by primary key from the BASE table, consistent (never the
   * byUnit index). Complete or nothing: an unprocessed key after 4 attempts
   * throws IncompleteBatchReadError, a failed request rethrows - an unread
   * pair never reads as "no match" (the batch-read ambiguity rule). Keyed
   * matchPairKey(tenantId, unitId); a legacy row is absent.
   */
  getPairs(keys: MatchPairKey[], opts: { requireComplete: true }): Promise<Map<string, MatchRow>>;
  /** Every current row for a unit, via byUnit (eventually consistent). The Rankings page only. */
  listByUnit(unitId: string): Promise<MatchRow[]>;
  /** Every current row for a tenant, base-table query, consistent. The Rankings page only. */
  listByTenant(tenantId: string): Promise<MatchRow[]>;
}

const BATCH_WRITE_MAX_ITEMS = 25;
const BATCH_GET_MAX_KEYS = 100;
const WRITE_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
const READ_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4;
const BACKOFF_MS = 25;

const sleep = (ms: number): Promise<void> => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

export function matchPairKey(tenantId: string, unitId: string): string {
  return `${tenantId}#${unitId}`;
}

/** True only for a schema 2 row; the legacy shape (no schema) is not current. */
export function isCurrentMatchRow(item: unknown): item is MatchRow {
  return typeof item === 'object' && item !== null && (item as { schema?: unknown }).schema === MATCH_SCHEMA;
}

/**
 * Epoch seconds `ttlDays` after `fromIso` - the TTL every ranking record
 * carries (matches, runs, pointers, jobs: RANKING_PAIR_TTL_DAYS). Throws on a
 * time that does not parse.
 */
export function rankingExpiresAt(fromIso: string, ttlDays: number): number {
  const ms = Date.parse(fromIso);
  if (!Number.isFinite(ms)) throw new Error(`rankingExpiresAt: not an ISO time: ${fromIso}`);
  return Math.floor(ms / 1000) + ttlDays * 24 * 60 * 60;
}

/** gzip then base64 (a run's `inputGzip`, the snapshot's transport). */
export function gzipBase64(text: string): string {
  return gzipSync(Buffer.from(text, 'utf8')).toString('base64');
}

export function gunzipBase64(b64: string): string {
  return gunzipSync(Buffer.from(b64, 'base64')).toString('utf8');
}

/** The input snapshot (spec D8.1): JSON, gzipped, base64-encoded. */
export function encodeSnapshot(value: unknown): string {
  const json = JSON.stringify(value);
  if (json === undefined) throw new Error('encodeSnapshot: the value is not JSON');
  return gzipBase64(json);
}

export function decodeSnapshot(b64: string): unknown {
  return JSON.parse(gunzipBase64(b64));
}

export function createMatchesRepo(deps: RepoDeps = {}): MatchesRepo {
  const doc = deps.doc ?? getDocumentClient();
  const table = tableName('matches', deps.env);
  const log = deps.logger ?? defaultLogger;

  async function queryAll(input: QueryCommandInput): Promise<MatchRow[]> {
    const rows: MatchRow[] = [];
    let start: QueryCommandInput['ExclusiveStartKey'];
    do {
      const page = await doc.send(
        new QueryCommand({ ...input, ...(start !== undefined && { ExclusiveStartKey: start }) }),
      );
      for (const item of (page.Items ?? []) as unknown[]) {
        if (isCurrentMatchRow(item)) rows.push(item);
      }
      start = page.LastEvaluatedKey;
    } while (start !== undefined);
    return rows;
  }

  return {
    async putMatches(rows) {
      for (const row of rows) {
        if (row.schema !== MATCH_SCHEMA) {
          throw new Error(`matchesRepo.putMatches writes schema ${MATCH_SCHEMA} rows only`);
        }
      }
      const byPair = new Map<string, MatchRow>();
      for (const row of rows) byPair.set(matchPairKey(row.tenantId, row.unitId), row);
      const unique = [...byPair.values()];
      const unwritten: MatchPairKey[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < unique.length; i += BATCH_WRITE_MAX_ITEMS) {
        const chunk = unique.slice(i, i + BATCH_WRITE_MAX_ITEMS);
        let requests: Array<{ PutRequest: { Item: MatchRow } }> = chunk.map((Item) => ({ PutRequest: { Item } }));
        try {
          for (let attempt = 0; attempt < WRITE_MAX_ATTEMPTS && requests.length > 0; attempt += 1) {
            if (attempt > 0) await sleep(BACKOFF_MS * 2 ** (attempt - 1));
            const response = await doc.send(new BatchWriteCommand({ RequestItems: { [table]: requests } }));
            requests = (response.UnprocessedItems?.[table] ?? []) as unknown as typeof requests;
          }
        } catch (err) {
          // A request that throws is not retried: every row of this chunk not
          // yet confirmed is reported in `unwritten` as NOT CONFIRMED written
          // (the request may have applied before the error). Counts and the
          // error only.
          log.warn({ err, chunkRows: requests.length }, 'matches: BatchWrite chunk failed');
        }
        for (const request of requests) {
          unwritten.push({ tenantId: request.PutRequest.Item.tenantId, unitId: request.PutRequest.Item.unitId });
        }
      }
      if (unwritten.length > 0) {
        // Counts only - never a contact or unit id.
        log.warn({ unwritten: unwritten.length, requested: unique.length }, 'matches: BatchWrite left rows unwritten');
      }
      const written = unique.length - unwritten.length;
      if (written > 0) log.debug({ written }, 'matches written');
      return { written, unwritten };
    },

    async getPairs(keys, opts) {
      if (opts.requireComplete !== true) {
        throw new Error('matchesRepo.getPairs is a complete read only: pass { requireComplete: true }');
      }
      const found = new Map<string, MatchRow>();
      const byPair = new Map<string, { tenantId: string; unitId: string }>();
      for (const k of keys) byPair.set(matchPairKey(k.tenantId, k.unitId), { tenantId: k.tenantId, unitId: k.unitId });
      const unique = [...byPair.values()];
      for (let i = 0; i < unique.length; i += BATCH_GET_MAX_KEYS) {
        let pending = unique.slice(i, i + BATCH_GET_MAX_KEYS);
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < READ_MAX_ATTEMPTS && pending.length > 0; attempt += 1) {
          if (attempt > 0) await sleep(BACKOFF_MS * 2 ** (attempt - 1));
          // A request that throws is an unread chunk: it propagates (complete-only).
          const response = await doc.send(
            new BatchGetCommand({ RequestItems: { [table]: { Keys: pending, ConsistentRead: true } } }),
          );
          for (const item of (response.Responses?.[table] ?? []) as unknown[]) {
            if (isCurrentMatchRow(item)) found.set(matchPairKey(item.tenantId, item.unitId), item);
          }
          pending = (response.UnprocessedKeys?.[table]?.Keys ?? []) as Array<{ tenantId: string; unitId: string }>;
        }
        if (pending.length > 0) {
          throw new IncompleteBatchReadError(pending.length, unique.length, 'matches');
        }
      }
      return found;
    },

    async listByUnit(unitId) {
      return queryAll({
        TableName: table,
        IndexName: 'byUnit',
        KeyConditionExpression: '#unitId = :unitId',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: { '#unitId': 'unitId' },
        ExpressionAttributeValues: { ':unitId': unitId },
      });
    },

    async listByTenant(tenantId) {
      return queryAll({
        TableName: table,
        KeyConditionExpression: '#tenantId = :tenantId',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: { '#tenantId': 'tenantId' },
        ExpressionAttributeValues: { ':tenantId': tenantId },
        ConsistentRead: true,
      });
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
// rankingRunsRepo, the JOB family (WP1 B2a spec D7; plan PR5). Every
// conditional write exactly as the spec states it, against DynamoDB Local so
// the engine - not a stand-in - decides the conditions, the sparse index keys
// and the list_append races.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { GetCommand } from '@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb';
import { tableName } from '../src/lib/config.js';
import { createDocumentClient, createDynamoClient } from '../src/lib/dynamo.js';
import { deleteTableIfExists, ensureTable } from '../src/lib/dynamoAdmin.js';
import { createLogger } from '../src/lib/logger.js';
import { getTableSpec } from '../src/lib/tables.js';
import { rankingExpiresAt } from '../src/repos/matchesRepo.js';
import {
  RANKING_JOBS_QUEUED_ENTITY,
  RANKING_JOBS_RUNNING_ENTITY,
  createRankingRunsRepo,
  rankingJobItemId,
  type RankingJobClaim,
  type RankingJobRecord,
  type RankingJobRef,
} from '../src/repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import { createLogCapture } from './helpers/logCapture.js';

const endpoint = process.env.DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT ?? 'http://localhost:8000';

async function endpointReachable(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await fetch(endpoint, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1_500) });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

const reachable = await endpointReachable();
if (!reachable) {
  console.warn(`[rankingRunsRepoJobs.integration] DynamoDB Local is required at ${endpoint}`);
}

const T0 = '2026-10-28T12:00:00.000Z';
const at = (ms: number, base = T0): string => new Date(Date.parse(base) + ms).toISOString();
const EXPIRES = rankingExpiresAt(T0, 180);

describe('ranking job keys', () => {
  it('rjob#<anchorKind>#<anchorId> and the two sparse index partitions', () => {
    expect(rankingJobItemId('unit', 'unit-1')).toBe('rjob#unit#unit-1');
    expect(rankingJobItemId('tenant', 'contact-1')).toBe('rjob#tenant#contact-1');
    expect(RANKING_JOBS_QUEUED_ENTITY).toBe('rankjobs#queued');
    expect(RANKING_JOBS_RUNNING_ENTITY).toBe('rankjobs#running');
  });
});

describe.skipIf(!reachable)('rankingRunsRepo job family against DynamoDB Local', () => {
  const testEnv = { TABLE_PREFIX: `hc-test-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}-` };
  const client = createDynamoClient({ endpoint });
  const doc = createDocumentClient({ endpoint });
  const logger = createLogger({ destination: createLogCapture().stream });
  const repo = createRankingRunsRepo({ doc, env: testEnv, logger });
  const table = tableName('ai_runs', testEnv);

  const anchor = (): string => `unit-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
  const gen = (): string => `gen-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;

  function claim(anchorId: string, over: Partial<RankingJobClaim> = {}): RankingJobClaim {
    return {
      anchorKind: 'unit',
      anchorId,
      generation: gen(),
      includeOlder: false,
      requestedBy: 'user-va',
      requestedAt: T0,
      requestId: 'req-press-1',
      queuedExpiresAt: at(600_000),
      expiresAt: EXPIRES,
      ...over,
    };
  }

  const ref = (job: Pick<RankingJobRecord, 'anchorKind' | 'anchorId' | 'generation'>): RankingJobRef => ({
    anchorKind: job.anchorKind,
    anchorId: job.anchorId,
    generation: job.generation,
  });

  async function raw(anchorId: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | undefined> {
    const { Item } = await doc.send(
      new GetCommand({ TableName: table, Key: { itemId: rankingJobItemId('unit', anchorId) }, ConsistentRead: true }),
    );
    return Item as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  }

  /** Queued at T0, claimed by a poller at T0 + 1 s with a 90 s lease. */
  async function running(anchorId: string): Promise<RankingJobRecord> {
    const queued = await repo.putJobClaim(claim(anchorId));
    if (!queued.ok) throw new Error('setup: the claim lost');
    const job = await repo.claimQueued(ref(queued.job), { nowIso: at(1_000), leaseExpiresAt: at(91_000) });
    if (job === undefined) throw new Error('setup: claimQueued lost');
    return job;
  }

  beforeAll(async () => {
    await ensureTable(client, getTableSpec('ai_runs'), table);
  }, 120_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await deleteTableIfExists(client, table);

    client.destroy();

  // --- the claim (the press) ---------------------------------------------------

      batchesDone: [],

      notScored: [],
      runIds: [],
      entityKey: 'rankjobs#queued',

      expires_at: EXPIRES,

    expect(result.ok && result.job).toEqual(stored);
  });

  it('no traceparent is stored when the press carried none', async () => {
    const anchorId = anchor();
    await repo.putJobClaim(claim(anchorId));
    expect(await raw(anchorId)).not.toHaveProperty('traceparent');
  });

  it('a second claim LOSES while the record is queued and unexpired; the first generation stands', async () => {
    const anchorId = anchor();
    const first = claim(anchorId);
    await repo.putJobClaim(first);

    expect(await repo.putJobClaim(claim(anchorId, { requestedAt: at(5_000) }))).toEqual({ ok: false });
    expect((await repo.getJob('unit', anchorId, { consistent: true }))!.generation).toBe(first.generation);
  });

  it('a claim WINS over a queued record past its queuedExpiresAt', async () => {
```

```ts
// WP1 B2a ranking records in the AI runs table (spec D7, D10, D11; plan PR5).
// The ranking families share `ai_runs` with the extraction run log and never
// collide with it (plan WI2):
//   rjob#<anchorKind>#<anchorId>               the ranking job, one per anchor
//   rrun#<runId>                               one ranking run per model call
//   ptr#rankings#<scope>#<startedAt>#<runId>   run pointers (global, per anchor)
//   uflag#<unitId>#<field>                     an unlawful-flag property record
// The extraction readers read run#<id> and the byEntity scopes global /
// outcome# / conversations# / contacts#, so none of these is ever returned
// by GET /api/ai-runs, its detail route or aiRunsRepo.listByEntity (pinned by
// rankingRunsExtractionLogExclusion.integration.test.ts).
//
// REPOSITORY PRIMITIVES only - each conditional write exactly as spec D7
// states it. When to claim, join, take over, renew or finish is
// services/ranking/job.ts. Every TTL is computed by the caller
// (matchesRepo.rankingExpiresAt with RANKING_PAIR_TTL_DAYS); flags carry none.
import { ConditionalCheckFailedException } from '@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb';
import {
  GetCommand,
  PutCommand,
  QueryCommand,
  UpdateCommand,
  type DynamoDBDocumentClient,
  type UpdateCommandInput,
} from '@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb';
import { tableName } from '../lib/config.js';
import { getDocumentClient } from '../lib/dynamo.js';
import { logger as defaultLogger, type Logger } from '../lib/logger.js';
import type { RepoDeps } from './conversationsRepo.js';
import type { RankingAnchorKind } from './matchesRepo.js';

interface FamilyCtx {
  doc: DynamoDBDocumentClient;
  table: string;
  log: Logger;
}

/** A conditional UpdateItem: the ALL_NEW item, or undefined when the condition failed. */
async function updateOrUndefined<T = Record<string, unknown>>(
  ctx: FamilyCtx,
  input: Omit<UpdateCommandInput, 'TableName' | 'ReturnValues'>,
): Promise<T | undefined> {
  try {
    const { Attributes } = await ctx.doc.send(
      new UpdateCommand({ ...input, TableName: ctx.table, ReturnValues: 'ALL_NEW' }),
    );
    return Attributes as unknown as T | undefined;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ConditionalCheckFailedException) return undefined;
    throw err;
  }
}

// --- The job family (spec D7) -------------------------------------------------

export const rankingJobItemId = (anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind, anchorId: string): string =>
  `rjob#${anchorKind}#${anchorId}`;
/** Sparse byEntity partitions: a queued record sorts by requestedAt, a running one by leaseExpiresAt. */
export const RANKING_JOBS_QUEUED_ENTITY = 'rankjobs#queued';
export const RANKING_JOBS_RUNNING_ENTITY = 'rankjobs#running';

export type RankingJobStatus = 'queued' | 'running' | 'done' | 'failed';

/**
 * A batch that left candidates without a new match through a FAILURE (PR42):
 * the model call (`refusal` | `parse` | `truncated` | `timeout` | `driver`),
 * or the run write or the match write (`repo`). `candidateIds` lists EXACTLY
 * the candidates that got no match: the whole batch for a failed call or run
 * write, only the not-confirmed-written pairs' candidates for a partial match
 * write (PR37). A batch may appear here AND in `batchesDone` (a partial
 * write: its other rows landed).
 */
export interface RankingFailedBatch {
  index: number;
  candidateIds: string[];
  failure: string;
}

/**
 * A candidate left unscored by something OTHER than a failure (PR13): the
 * model did not return it in a call that succeeded (`omitted`), or its reads
 * were incomplete so it was never sent (`unreadable`).
 */
export interface RankingNotScored {
  candidateId: string;
  reason: 'omitted' | 'unreadable';
}

export interface RankingJobRecord {
  itemId: string;
  anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind;
  anchorId: string;
  status: RankingJobStatus;
  generation: string;
  includeOlder: boolean;
  requestedBy: string;
  requestedAt: string;
  /** The press's request id; the job's log lines carry it (spec D7). */
  requestId: string;
  traceparent?: string;
  attempts: number;
  queuedExpiresAt: string;
  leaseExpiresAt?: string;
  poolSize?: number;
  batchCount?: number;
  batchesDone: number[];
  /** Every batch that left candidates unmatched through a failure, with exactly those candidates (PR42). */
  failedBatches: RankingFailedBatch[];
  /** Candidates unscored by something other than a failure: omitted or unreadable (PR13). */
  notScored: RankingNotScored[];
  message?: string;
  runIds: string[];
  startedAt?: string;
  finishedAt?: string;
  expires_at: number;
  /** Present only while queued or running (sparse index keys). */
  entityKey?: string;
  sortKey?: string;
}

/** Which job a write is for: the anchor plus the generation the caller holds. */
export interface RankingJobRef {
  anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind;
  anchorId: string;
  generation: string;
}

export interface RankingJobClaim {
  anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind;
  anchorId: string;
  /** A new uuid per press. */
  generation: string;
  includeOlder: boolean;
  requestedBy: string;
  /** The press time; it is also the "now" the expiry condition compares. */
  requestedAt: string;
  requestId: string;
  traceparent?: string;
  /** requestedAt + RANKING_QUEUE_EXPIRY_MS. */
  queuedExpiresAt: string;
  /** Epoch seconds: rankingExpiresAt(requestedAt, RANKING_PAIR_TTL_DAYS). */
  expiresAt: number;
}

/** One progress write; any subset. The four list fields APPEND (parallel batches). */
export interface RankingJobProgress {
  poolSize?: number;
  batchCount?: number;
  batchDone?: number;
  failedBatch?: RankingFailedBatch;
  notScored?: RankingNotScored[];
  runIds?: string[];
}

export interface RankingJobFamily {
  getJob(
    anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind,
    anchorId: string,
    opts: { consistent: boolean },
  ): Promise<RankingJobRecord | undefined>;
  /**
   * The press's claim (spec D7): ONE conditional put that succeeds when no
   * record exists, or the record is done or failed, or it is queued with
   * queuedExpiresAt <= requestedAt. Writes a fresh queued record (every old
   * field replaced) with the queued index keys.
   */
  putJobClaim(claim: RankingJobClaim): Promise<{ ok: true; job: RankingJobRecord } | { ok: false }>;
  /** Queued records, oldest requestedAt first (byEntity, eventually consistent). */
  listQueued(limit: number): Promise<RankingJobRecord[]>;
  /** Running records whose leaseExpiresAt is before `nowIso`, oldest lease first. */
  listExpiredLeases(nowIso: string, limit: number): Promise<RankingJobRecord[]>;
  /**
   * A poller claims a listed queued record: condition status = queued AND
   * generation = the listed one AND queuedExpiresAt > now; sets running,
   * startedAt, leaseExpiresAt and the running index keys.
   */
  claimQueued(
    ref: RankingJobRef,
    opts: { nowIso: string; leaseExpiresAt: string },
  ): Promise<RankingJobRecord | undefined>;
  /**
   * Takeover of a dead job (spec D7): condition running AND the listed
   * generation AND leaseExpiresAt <= now AND attempts < 1. A NEW generation,
   * attempts + 1, a fresh start and lease; the progress fields reset
   * (poolSize, batchCount, batchesDone, failedBatches, notScored, message) -
   * the job runs again from the start; runIds are kept (those runs happened,
   * IR23).
   */
  takeOver(
    ref: RankingJobRef,
    opts: { nowIso: string; newGeneration: string; leaseExpiresAt: string },
  ): Promise<RankingJobRecord | undefined>;
  /** The second expiry: running, the generation, leaseExpiresAt <= now, attempts >= 1 -> failed. */
  markLeaseFailed(ref: RankingJobRef, opts: { nowIso: string; message: string }): Promise<boolean>;
  /** Lease renewal: running AND the generation; extends leaseExpiresAt and its sort key. */
  renewLease(ref: RankingJobRef, leaseExpiresAt: string): Promise<boolean>;
  /**
   * A tick fails a queued record past its expiry: queued AND the listed
   * generation AND queuedExpiresAt <= now; removes the index keys.
   */
  markExpiredQueued(ref: RankingJobRef, opts: { nowIso: string; message: string }): Promise<boolean>;
  /** A progress write on the running generation (undefined when superseded). */
  updateJobProgress(ref: RankingJobRef, progress: RankingJobProgress): Promise<RankingJobRecord | undefined>;
  /** done or failed, on the running generation; removes the index keys. */
  finishJob(
    ref: RankingJobRef,
    outcome: { status: 'done' | 'failed'; finishedAt: string; message?: string },
  ): Promise<RankingJobRecord | undefined>;
}

function createJobFamily(ctx: FamilyCtx): RankingJobFamily {
  const { doc, table, log } = ctx;
  const keyOf = (ref: { anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind; anchorId: string }) => ({
    itemId: rankingJobItemId(ref.anchorKind, ref.anchorId),
  });

  async function queryPartition(
    entityKey: string,
    opts: { before?: string; limit: number },
  ): Promise<RankingJobRecord[]> {
    const { Items } = await doc.send(
      new QueryCommand({
        TableName: table,
        IndexName: 'byEntity',
        KeyConditionExpression: opts.before === undefined ? '#ek = :ek' : '#ek = :ek AND #sk < :before',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: { '#ek': 'entityKey', ...(opts.before !== undefined && { '#sk': 'sortKey' }) },
        ExpressionAttributeValues: { ':ek': entityKey, ...(opts.before !== undefined && { ':before': opts.before }) },
        ScanIndexForward: true,
        Limit: opts.limit,
      }),
    );
    return (Items ?? []) as RankingJobRecord[];
  }

  return {
    async getJob(anchorKind, anchorId, opts) {
      const { Item } = await doc.send(
        new GetCommand({
          TableName: table,
          Key: keyOf({ anchorKind, anchorId }),
          ...(opts.consistent && { ConsistentRead: true }),
        }),
      );
      return Item as RankingJobRecord | undefined;
    },

    async putJobClaim(claim) {
      const job: RankingJobRecord = {
        itemId: rankingJobItemId(claim.anchorKind, claim.anchorId),
        anchorKind: claim.anchorKind,
        anchorId: claim.anchorId,
        status: 'queued',
        generation: claim.generation,
        includeOlder: claim.includeOlder,
        requestedBy: claim.requestedBy,
        requestedAt: claim.requestedAt,
        requestId: claim.requestId,
        ...(claim.traceparent !== undefined && { traceparent: claim.traceparent }),
        attempts: 0,
        queuedExpiresAt: claim.queuedExpiresAt,
        batchesDone: [],
        failedBatches: [],
        notScored: [],
        runIds: [],
        entityKey: RANKING_JOBS_QUEUED_ENTITY,
        sortKey: claim.requestedAt,
        expires_at: claim.expiresAt,
      };
      try {
        await doc.send(
          new PutCommand({
            TableName: table,
            Item: job,
            ConditionExpression:
              'attribute_not_exists(#itemId) OR #status IN (:done, :failed) OR (#status = :queued AND #qexp <= :now)',
            ExpressionAttributeNames: { '#itemId': 'itemId', '#status': 'status', '#qexp': 'queuedExpiresAt' },
            ExpressionAttributeValues: {
              ':done': 'done',
              ':failed': 'failed',
              ':queued': 'queued',
              ':now': claim.requestedAt,
            },
          }),
        );
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof ConditionalCheckFailedException) return { ok: false };
        throw err;
      }
      log.debug({ anchorKind: claim.anchorKind, anchorId: claim.anchorId }, 'ranking job queued');
      return { ok: true, job };
    },

    async listQueued(limit) {
      return queryPartition(RANKING_JOBS_QUEUED_ENTITY, { limit });
    },

    async listExpiredLeases(nowIso, limit) {
      return queryPartition(RANKING_JOBS_RUNNING_ENTITY, { before: nowIso, limit });
    },

    async claimQueued(ref, opts) {
      return updateOrUndefined<RankingJobRecord>(ctx, {
        Key: keyOf(ref),
        UpdateExpression: 'SET #status = :running, #startedAt = :now, #lease = :lease, #ek = :ek, #sk = :lease',
        ConditionExpression: '#status = :queued AND #gen = :gen AND #qexp > :now',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: {
          '#status': 'status',
          '#startedAt': 'startedAt',
          '#lease': 'leaseExpiresAt',
          '#ek': 'entityKey',
          '#sk': 'sortKey',
          '#gen': 'generation',
          '#qexp': 'queuedExpiresAt',
        },
        ExpressionAttributeValues: {
          ':running': 'running',
          ':queued': 'queued',
          ':now': opts.nowIso,
          ':lease': opts.leaseExpiresAt,
          ':ek': RANKING_JOBS_RUNNING_ENTITY,
          ':gen': ref.generation,
        },
      });
    },

    async takeOver(ref, opts) {
      return updateOrUndefined<RankingJobRecord>(ctx, {
        Key: keyOf(ref),
        UpdateExpression:
          'SET #gen = :newGen, #attempts = #attempts + :one, #startedAt = :now, #lease = :lease, ' +
          '#sk = :lease, #bd = :empty, #fb = :empty, #ns = :empty REMOVE #poolSize, #batchCount, #message',
        ConditionExpression: '#status = :running AND #gen = :gen AND #lease <= :now AND #attempts < :one',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: {
          '#gen': 'generation',
          '#attempts': 'attempts',
          '#startedAt': 'startedAt',
          '#lease': 'leaseExpiresAt',
          '#sk': 'sortKey',
          '#bd': 'batchesDone',
          '#fb': 'failedBatches',
          '#ns': 'notScored',
          '#poolSize': 'poolSize',
          '#batchCount': 'batchCount',
          '#message': 'message',
          '#status': 'status',
        },
        ExpressionAttributeValues: {
          ':newGen': opts.newGeneration,
          ':one': 1,
          ':now': opts.nowIso,
          ':lease': opts.leaseExpiresAt,
          ':empty': [],
          ':running': 'running',
          ':gen': ref.generation,
        },
      });
    },

    async markLeaseFailed(ref, opts) {
      const updated = await updateOrUndefined(ctx, {
        Key: keyOf(ref),
        UpdateExpression: 'SET #status = :failed, #message = :message, #finishedAt = :now REMOVE #ek, #sk',
        ConditionExpression: '#status = :running AND #gen = :gen AND #lease <= :now AND #attempts >= :one',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: {
          '#status': 'status',
          '#message': 'message',
          '#finishedAt': 'finishedAt',
          '#ek': 'entityKey',
          '#sk': 'sortKey',
          '#gen': 'generation',
          '#lease': 'leaseExpiresAt',
          '#attempts': 'attempts',
        },
        ExpressionAttributeValues: {
          ':failed': 'failed',
          ':message': opts.message,
          ':now': opts.nowIso,
          ':running': 'running',
          ':gen': ref.generation,
          ':one': 1,
        },
      });
      return updated !== undefined;
    },

    async renewLease(ref, leaseExpiresAt) {
      const updated = await updateOrUndefined(ctx, {
        Key: keyOf(ref),
        UpdateExpression: 'SET #lease = :lease, #sk = :lease',
        ConditionExpression: '#status = :running AND #gen = :gen',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: {
          '#lease': 'leaseExpiresAt',
          '#sk': 'sortKey',
          '#status': 'status',
          '#gen': 'generation',
        },
        ExpressionAttributeValues: { ':lease': leaseExpiresAt, ':running': 'running', ':gen': ref.generation },
      });
      return updated !== undefined;
    },

    async markExpiredQueued(ref, opts) {
      const updated = await updateOrUndefined(ctx, {
        Key: keyOf(ref),
        UpdateExpression: 'SET #status = :failed, #message = :message, #finishedAt = :now REMOVE #ek, #sk',
        ConditionExpression: '#status = :queued AND #gen = :gen AND #qexp <= :now',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: {
          '#status': 'status',
          '#message': 'message',
          '#finishedAt': 'finishedAt',
          '#ek': 'entityKey',
          '#sk': 'sortKey',
          '#gen': 'generation',
          '#qexp': 'queuedExpiresAt',
        },
        ExpressionAttributeValues: {
          ':failed': 'failed',
          ':message': opts.message,
          ':now': opts.nowIso,
          ':queued': 'queued',
          ':gen': ref.generation,
        },
      });
      return updated !== undefined;
    },

    async updateJobProgress(ref, progress) {
      const sets: string[] = [];
      const names: Record<string, string> = { '#status': 'status', '#gen': 'generation' };
      const values: Record<string, unknown> = { ':running': 'running', ':gen': ref.generation };
      if (progress.poolSize !== undefined) {
        sets.push('#poolSize = :poolSize');
        names['#poolSize'] = 'poolSize';
        values[':poolSize'] = progress.poolSize;
      }
      if (progress.batchCount !== undefined) {
        sets.push('#batchCount = :batchCount');
        names['#batchCount'] = 'batchCount';
        values[':batchCount'] = progress.batchCount;
      }
      const append = (alias: string, attribute: string, value: unknown[]): void => {
        sets.push(`${alias} = list_append(if_not_exists(${alias}, :empty), :${attribute})`);
        names[alias] = attribute;
        values[`:${attribute}`] = value;
        values[':empty'] = [];
      };
      if (progress.batchDone !== undefined) append('#bd', 'batchesDone', [progress.batchDone]);
      if (progress.failedBatch !== undefined) append('#fb', 'failedBatches', [progress.failedBatch]);
      if (progress.notScored !== undefined && progress.notScored.length > 0) {
        append('#ns', 'notScored', progress.notScored);
      }
      if (progress.runIds !== undefined && progress.runIds.length > 0) append('#runIds', 'runIds', progress.runIds);
      if (sets.length === 0) throw new Error('rankingRunsRepo.updateJobProgress: empty progress');
      return updateOrUndefined<RankingJobRecord>(ctx, {
        Key: keyOf(ref),
        UpdateExpression: `SET ${sets.join(', ')}`,
        ConditionExpression: '#status = :running AND #gen = :gen',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: names,
        ExpressionAttributeValues: values,
      });
    },

    async finishJob(ref, outcome) {
      const finished = await updateOrUndefined<RankingJobRecord>(ctx, {
        Key: keyOf(ref),
        UpdateExpression:
          outcome.message === undefined
            ? 'SET #status = :status, #finishedAt = :at REMOVE #ek, #sk'
            : 'SET #status = :status, #finishedAt = :at, #message = :message REMOVE #ek, #sk',
        ConditionExpression: '#status = :running AND #gen = :gen',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: {
          '#status': 'status',
          '#finishedAt': 'finishedAt',
          '#ek': 'entityKey',
          '#sk': 'sortKey',
          '#gen': 'generation',
          ...(outcome.message !== undefined && { '#message': 'message' }),
        },
        ExpressionAttributeValues: {
          ':status': outcome.status,
          ':at': outcome.finishedAt,
          ':running': 'running',
          ':gen': ref.generation,
          ...(outcome.message !== undefined && { ':message': outcome.message }),
        },
      });
      if (finished !== undefined) {
        log.debug({ anchorKind: ref.anchorKind, anchorId: ref.anchorId, status: outcome.status }, 'ranking job finished');
      }
      return finished;
    },
  };
}

// --- The repository ---

export type RankingRunsRepo = RankingJobFamily;

export function createRankingRunsRepo(deps: RepoDeps = {}): RankingRunsRepo {
  const ctx: FamilyCtx = {
    doc: deps.doc ?? getDocumentClient(),
    table: tableName('ai_runs', deps.env),
    log: deps.logger ?? defaultLogger,
  };
  return { ...createJobFamily(ctx) };
}
```

```ts
      { handle: 'c2', candidateId: 'contact-2', display: 'Lee Roe', returned: false },
    ],
    droppedUnlawfulFlags: 0,
    environment: 'local',
    expires_at: rankingExpiresAt(startedAt, 180),
    ...over,
  };
}

describe('ranking run keys and the size guard', () => {
  it('rrun#, the pointer ids, the entity keys and the sort key', () => {
    expect(rankingRunItemId('r1')).toBe('rrun#r1');
    expect(RANKING_RUNS_GLOBAL_ENTITY).toBe('rankings#global');
    expect(rankingRunEntityKey()).toBe('rankings#global');
    expect(rankingRunEntityKey({ kind: 'unit', id: 'unit-1' })).toBe('rankings#unit#unit-1');
    expect(rankingRunEntityKey({ kind: 'tenant', id: 'contact-1' })).toBe('rankings#tenant#contact-1');
    expect(rankingRunSortKey('2026-10-28T11:00:00.000Z', 'r1')).toBe('2026-10-28T11:00:00.000Z#r1');
    expect(rankingPointerItemId('rankings#global', '2026-10-28T11:00:00.000Z', 'r1')).toBe(
      'ptr#rankings#global#2026-10-28T11:00:00.000Z#r1',
    );
  });

  it('the guard drops inputGzip and marks inputOmitted only above 350 KB', () => {
    expect(RANKING_RUN_ITEM_MAX_BYTES).toBe(350 * 1024);
    const small = { ...runInput('r-small'), itemId: 'rrun#r-small', kind: 'ranking' } as RankingRunRecord;
    expect(withRankingRunSizeGuard(small)).toBe(small);
    const big = {
      ...runInput('r-big', { inputGzip: randomBytes(300 * 1024).toString('base64') }),
      itemId: 'rrun#r-big',
      kind: 'ranking',
    } as RankingRunRecord;
    const guarded = withRankingRunSizeGuard(big);
    expect(guarded.inputOmitted).toBe(true);
    expect(guarded).not.toHaveProperty('inputGzip');
    expect(guarded.rawText).toBe(big.rawText);
  });
});

    const tenant = await repo.listRuns({ entityKey: rankingRunEntityKey({ kind: 'tenant', id: 'contact-list' }) });
    expect(tenant.entries.map((e) => e.runId)).toEqual([c]);

    }

    const page1 = await repo.listRuns({ entityKey, limit: 2 });
    expect(page1.entries.map((e) => e.runId)).toEqual(newestFirst.slice(0, 2));
    expect(page1.nextCursor).toBe(page1.entries[1]!.sortKey);

    const page2 = await repo.listRuns({ entityKey, limit: 2, cursor: page1.nextCursor });
    expect(page2.entries.map((e) => e.runId)).toEqual(newestFirst.slice(2, 4));
    const page3 = await repo.listRuns({ entityKey, limit: 2, cursor: page2.nextCursor });
    expect(page3.entries.map((e) => e.runId)).toEqual(newestFirst.slice(4));
    expect(page3.nextCursor).toBeUndefined();

    const ranged = await repo.listRuns({ entityKey, limit: 2, from: '2026-10-21', to: '2026-10-21', cursor: page1.nextCursor });
    expect(ranged.entries.map((e) => e.runId)).toEqual(newestFirst.slice(2, 4));

    const id = runId();
    const startedAt = '2026-10-22T09:00:00.000Z';
    const entityKey = rankingRunEntityKey({ kind: 'unit', id: 'unit-gone' });
    await doc.send(
      new PutCommand({
        TableName: table,

    const listed = await repo.listRuns({ entityKey });
    expect(listed.entries).toEqual([{ runId: id, sortKey: rankingRunSortKey(startedAt, id), expired: true }]);
    // Expired by TTL is not "unread": the page is not incomplete.
    expect(listed.incomplete).toBeUndefined();
    expect(await repo.listRuns({ entityKey, from: '2026-10-23', to: '2026-10-22' })).toEqual({ entries: [] });
  });

  it('listRuns reads SUMMARIES only - never rawText, inputGzip, handles or results (PR34)', async () => {
    const id = runId();
    await repo.putRun(runInput(id, { anchorId: 'unit-summary', startedAt: '2026-10-23T09:00:00.000Z' }));

    const page = await repo.listRuns({ entityKey: rankingRunEntityKey({ kind: 'unit', id: 'unit-summary' }) });

    const entry = page.entries[0]!;
    if (entry.expired) throw new Error('expected a live entry');
    // The fixture carries no failure and no message, so those two are absent.
    expect(Object.keys(entry.run).sort()).toEqual(
      RANKING_RUN_SUMMARY_FIELDS.filter((field) => field !== 'failure' && field !== 'message').sort(),
    );
    expect(entry.run).toMatchObject({
      runId: id,
      kind: 'ranking',
      costUsd: 0,
      usage: { inputTokens: 1200, outputTokens: 300 },
      environment: 'local',
      outcome: 'scored',
    });
    for (const heavy of ['rawText', 'inputGzip', 'handles', 'results', 'promptFingerprint']) {
      expect(entry.run, heavy).not.toHaveProperty(heavy);
    }
    expect(page.incomplete).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

Create `app/test/rankingRunsRepoListing.test.ts` (the stub-client half of
PR34 - DynamoDB Local cannot be made to leave keys unprocessed on demand):

```ts
// rankingRunsRepo.listRuns against a stub DocumentClient (WP1 B2a PR34): the
// summary projection on every BatchGet, the unprocessed retries, and an
// unread run reported - an `unavailable` entry plus `incomplete: true` on the
// page - never silently dropped from the runs list or the cost totals.
import {
  BatchGetCommand,
  QueryCommand,
  type BatchGetCommandInput,
  type DynamoDBDocumentClient,
} from '@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { createLogger } from '../src/lib/logger.js';
import {
  RANKING_RUN_SUMMARY_FIELDS,
  createRankingRunsRepo,
  rankingRunEntityKey,
  rankingRunSortKey,
} from '../src/repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import { createLogCapture } from './helpers/logCapture.js';

const TABLE = 'hc-test-x-ai_runs';
const ENTITY = rankingRunEntityKey();
const STARTED = '2026-10-28T11:00:00.000Z';

type Key = { itemId: string };

/** One Query page of pointers for `runIds`, then BatchGets answered by `withhold` (keys left unprocessed). */
function stubDoc(runIds: string[], withhold: (keys: Key[], call: number) => number) {
  const batchRequests: BatchGetCommandInput[] = [];
  const doc = {
    async send(command: unknown) {
      if (command instanceof QueryCommand) {
        return {
          Items: runIds.map((runId) => ({
            itemId: `ptr#${ENTITY}#${rankingRunSortKey(STARTED, runId)}`,
            entityKey: ENTITY,
            sortKey: rankingRunSortKey(STARTED, runId),
            runId,
          })),
        };
      }
      if (command instanceof BatchGetCommand) {
        batchRequests.push(command.input);
        const keys = (command.input.RequestItems?.[TABLE]?.Keys ?? []) as Key[];
        const n = withhold(keys, batchRequests.length);
        const served = keys.slice(0, keys.length - n);
        const left = keys.slice(keys.length - n);
        return {
          Responses: {
            [TABLE]: served.map((k) => ({ runId: k.itemId.slice('rrun#'.length), kind: 'ranking', costUsd: 0.01 })),
          },
          ...(left.length > 0 && { UnprocessedKeys: { [TABLE]: { Keys: left } } }),
        };
      }
      throw new Error('stub: unexpected command');
    },
  };
  return { doc: doc as unknown as DynamoDBDocumentClient, batchRequests };
}

function makeRepo(doc: DynamoDBDocumentClient) {
  const capture = createLogCapture();
  const logger = createLogger({ destination: capture.stream });
  return { repo: createRankingRunsRepo({ doc, env: { TABLE_PREFIX: 'hc-test-x-' }, logger }), capture };
}

describe('rankingRunsRepo.listRuns (stub client; PR34)', () => {
  it('every BatchGet projects exactly the summary fields, through aliases', async () => {
    const { doc, batchRequests } = stubDoc(['r1', 'r2'], () => 0);
    const { repo } = makeRepo(doc);

    await repo.listRuns({ entityKey: ENTITY });

    for (const request of batchRequests) {
      const entry = request.RequestItems![TABLE]!;
      const tokens = String(entry.ProjectionExpression)
        .split(',')
        .map((token) => token.trim());
      expect(tokens.every((token) => token.startsWith('#'))).toBe(true);
      expect(tokens.map((token) => entry.ExpressionAttributeNames?.[token]).sort()).toEqual(
        [...RANKING_RUN_SUMMARY_FIELDS].sort(),
      );
    }
    for (const heavy of ['rawText', 'inputGzip', 'handles', 'results']) {
      expect(RANKING_RUN_SUMMARY_FIELDS as readonly string[]).not.toContain(heavy);
    }
  });

  it('unprocessed keys are retried; a healed read is complete', async () => {
    const { doc, batchRequests } = stubDoc(['r1', 'r2', 'r3'], (_keys, call) => (call === 1 ? 2 : 0));
    const { repo } = makeRepo(doc);

    const page = await repo.listRuns({ entityKey: ENTITY });

    expect(batchRequests).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(page.entries.every((e) => !e.expired)).toBe(true);
    expect(page.incomplete).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('a run still unread after 4 attempts is an unavailable entry and the page says incomplete', async () => {
    const { doc, batchRequests } = stubDoc(['r1', 'r2', 'r3'], (keys) => (keys.length > 0 ? 1 : 0));
    const { repo, capture } = makeRepo(doc);

    const page = await repo.listRuns({ entityKey: ENTITY });

    expect(batchRequests).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(page.incomplete).toBe(true);
    const unread = page.entries.filter((e) => e.expired);
    expect(unread).toEqual([
      { runId: 'r3', sortKey: rankingRunSortKey(STARTED, 'r3'), expired: true, unavailable: true },
    ]);
    expect(page.entries.filter((e) => !e.expired)).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(capture.atLevel(40)).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});
```
