```ts
// --- The run and pointer family (spec D11) ---------------------------------------

export const rankingRunItemId = (runId: string): string => `rrun#${runId}`;
const runIdOfRankingItemId = (itemId: string): string => itemId.slice('rrun#'.length);
export const RANKING_RUNS_GLOBAL_ENTITY = 'rankings#global';
/** The run listing's pointer partition: global, or one anchor's. */
export function rankingRunEntityKey(anchor?: { kind: RankingAnchorKind; id: string }): string {
  return anchor === undefined ? RANKING_RUNS_GLOBAL_ENTITY : `rankings#${anchor.kind}#${anchor.id}`;
}
export function rankingRunSortKey(startedAt: string, runId: string): string {
  return `${startedAt}#${runId}`;
}
export const rankingPointerItemId = (entityKey: string, startedAt: string, runId: string): string =>
  `ptr#${entityKey}#${rankingRunSortKey(startedAt, runId)}`;

/** A run item over this size drops its inputGzip (spec D11's 350 KB guard; DynamoDB caps an item at 400 KB). */
export const RANKING_RUN_ITEM_MAX_BYTES = 350 * 1024;
export const RANKING_RUN_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 25;
const RUN_BATCH_GET_MAX_KEYS = 100;
const RUN_READ_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4;
const RUN_BACKOFF_MS = 25;
/** The highest sort-key suffix: a `to` day covers every time on that day. */
const SORT_KEY_CEILING = String.fromCharCode(0xffff);

const sleep = (ms: number): Promise<void> => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

export type RankingDirection = 'tenants_for_property' | 'properties_for_tenant';
export type RankingRunFailure = 'refusal' | 'parse' | 'truncated' | 'timeout' | 'driver';

export interface RankingRunUsage {
  inputTokens: number;
  outputTokens: number;
  cacheReadInputTokens?: number;
}

/** A handle as sent: `c<n>` with its candidate id and display (name or label). */
export interface RankingRunHandle {
  handle: string;
  candidateId: string;
  display: string;
}

/**
 * THIS run's own parsed output for one candidate sent (spec D11; IR3, IR19,
 * PR14), never the current match. A candidate the model did not return is
 * recorded with `returned: false` and NO score (charter 7.4: a default or
 * guessed score is never written); the scored fields are present only when
 * `returned` is true.
 */
export interface RankingRunResult {
  handle: string;
  candidateId: string;
  /** The display (name or label) as sent. */
  display: string;
  returned: boolean;
  score?: number;
  for?: MatchReason[];
  against?: MatchReason[];
  unknowns?: string[];
  /** The pair's MERGED missing list (code flags, then the model's unknowns; spec D3). */
  missing?: MatchMissing[];
  failedRequirements?: string[];
  fairHousingFlags?: MatchFairHousingFlag[];
  /** The cap as computed when the run finished, from its own output and the flags open then. */
  cappedAtRun?: { capped: boolean; capReason: 'requirement not met' | null };
}

export interface RankingRunRecord {
  itemId: string;
  runId: string;
  kind: 'ranking';
  anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind;
  anchorId: string;
  direction: RankingDirection;
  jobGeneration: string;
  batchIndex: number;
  candidateCount: number;
  driver: 'anthropic' | 'console' | 'fake';
  model: string;
  rubricVersion: string;
  examplesVersion: string;
  promptFingerprint: string;
  usage?: RankingRunUsage;
  costUsd: number;
  latencyMs: number;
  startedAt: string;
  finishedAt: string;
  outcome: 'scored' | 'failed';
  failure?: RankingRunFailure;
  message?: string;
  rawText?: string;
  /** gzipBase64 of the batch's user message; dropped by the 350 KB guard. */
  inputGzip?: string;
  inputOmitted?: true;
  handles: RankingRunHandle[];
  results: RankingRunResult[];
  /** Set by markMatchesWritten after the batch's match write; absent = the write did not finish. */
  matchesWritten?: { count: number; at: string };
  droppedUnlawfulFlags: number;
  /** The deployment's environment name (config.appEnv). */
  environment: string;
  /** rankingExpiresAt(startedAt, RANKING_PAIR_TTL_DAYS). */
  expires_at: number;
}

export type RankingRunRecordInput = Omit<RankingRunRecord, 'itemId' | 'kind' | 'inputOmitted' | 'matchesWritten'>;

export interface RankingRunPointer {
  itemId: string;
  entityKey: string;
  sortKey: string;
  runId: string;
  expires_at: number;
}

/**
 * PR34: the ONLY attributes a listing reads (the runs list and the cost
 * totals). Never `rawText`, `inputGzip`, `handles` or `results` - only getRun
 * reads the whole item.
 */
export const RANKING_RUN_SUMMARY_FIELDS = [
  'runId',
  'kind',
  'anchorKind',
  'anchorId',
  'direction',
  'jobGeneration',
  'batchIndex',
  'candidateCount',
  'driver',
  'model',
  'usage',
  'costUsd',
  'latencyMs',
  'startedAt',
  'finishedAt',
  'outcome',
  'failure',
  'message',
  'environment',
] as const satisfies ReadonlyArray<keyof RankingRunRecord>;

export type RankingRunSummary = Pick<RankingRunRecord, (typeof RANKING_RUN_SUMMARY_FIELDS)[number]>;

/**
 * A listing entry. A pointer whose run is gone (TTL lag) reads expired; one
 * whose run could not be read after the retries reads expired with
 * `unavailable` - and the page then says `incomplete: true` (PR34).
 */
export type RankingRunListEntry =
  | { runId: string; sortKey: string; expired: false; run: RankingRunSummary }
  | { runId: string; sortKey: string; expired: true; unavailable?: true };

export interface RankingRunListPage {
  entries: RankingRunListEntry[];
  nextCursor?: string;
  /** PR34: present (true) only when a run of this page stayed unread after the retries. */
  incomplete?: true;
}

export interface ListRankingRunsOptions {
  /** rankingRunEntityKey() or rankingRunEntityKey({ kind, id }). */
  entityKey: string;
  /** Inclusive day bounds, YYYY-MM-DD, compared against the sort key. */
  from?: string;
  to?: string;
  /** The last sortKey already returned (exclusive). */
  cursor?: string;
  limit?: number;
}

export function rankingRunItemBytes(record: object): number {
  return Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(record), 'utf8');
}

/** Spec D11: an item that would exceed 350 KB keeps everything but inputGzip, marked inputOmitted. */
export function withRankingRunSizeGuard(record: RankingRunRecord): RankingRunRecord {
  if (record.inputGzip === undefined || rankingRunItemBytes(record) <= RANKING_RUN_ITEM_MAX_BYTES) return record;
  const { inputGzip: _dropped, ...rest } = record;
  return { ...rest, inputOmitted: true };
}

export interface RankingRunFamily {
  /**
   * The run and its two pointers (rankings#global and the anchor's) in ONE
   * transaction; the run put is conditioned on a new id. Applies the 350 KB
   * guard and returns the record as stored.
   */
  putRun(input: RankingRunRecordInput): Promise<RankingRunRecord>;
  /** The second write of a run (spec D11), conditioned on the run existing. */
  markMatchesWritten(runId: string, written: { count: number; at: string }): Promise<boolean>;
  getRun(runId: string): Promise<RankingRunRecord | undefined>;
  /**
   * Pointers newest first, then ONE BatchGet of the rrun# items PROJECTED to
   * RANKING_RUN_SUMMARY_FIELDS (PR34). A run still unread after 4 attempts is
   * an `unavailable` entry and the page carries `incomplete: true` - never a
   * silent drop. Used by the runs list and the cost totals.
   */
  listRuns(opts: ListRankingRunsOptions): Promise<RankingRunListPage>;
}

/** The summary projection, every name aliased (several are reserved words). */
const SUMMARY_PROJECTION = {
  ProjectionExpression: RANKING_RUN_SUMMARY_FIELDS.map((_field, i) => `#f${i}`).join(', '),
  ExpressionAttributeNames: Object.fromEntries(RANKING_RUN_SUMMARY_FIELDS.map((field, i) => [`#f${i}`, field])),
};

function createRunFamily(ctx: FamilyCtx): RankingRunFamily {
  const { doc, table, log } = ctx;

  async function batchGetRuns(runIds: string[]): Promise<{ found: Map<string, RankingRunSummary>; unread: Set<string> }> {
    const found = new Map<string, RankingRunSummary>();
    const unread = new Set<string>();
    const unique = [...new Set(runIds)];
    for (let i = 0; i < unique.length; i += RUN_BATCH_GET_MAX_KEYS) {
      let keys = unique.slice(i, i + RUN_BATCH_GET_MAX_KEYS).map((runId) => ({ itemId: rankingRunItemId(runId) }));
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < RUN_READ_MAX_ATTEMPTS && keys.length > 0; attempt += 1) {
        if (attempt > 0) await sleep(RUN_BACKOFF_MS * 2 ** (attempt - 1));
        const response = await doc.send(
          new BatchGetCommand({ RequestItems: { [table]: { Keys: keys, ...SUMMARY_PROJECTION } } }),
        );
        for (const item of (response.Responses?.[table] ?? []) as RankingRunSummary[]) found.set(item.runId, item);
        keys = (response.UnprocessedKeys?.[table]?.Keys ?? []) as Array<{ itemId: string }>;
      }
      for (const k of keys) unread.add(runIdOfRankingItemId(k.itemId));
    }
    if (unread.size > 0) {
      log.warn({ unread: unread.size }, 'ranking runs: BatchGet left keys unprocessed after retries');
    }
    return { found, unread };
  }

  return {
    async putRun(input) {
      const record = withRankingRunSizeGuard({ ...input, itemId: rankingRunItemId(input.runId), kind: 'ranking' });
      const sortKey = rankingRunSortKey(input.startedAt, input.runId);
      const pointers: RankingRunPointer[] = [
        rankingRunEntityKey(),
        rankingRunEntityKey({ kind: input.anchorKind, id: input.anchorId }),
      ].map((entityKey) => ({
        itemId: rankingPointerItemId(entityKey, input.startedAt, input.runId),
        entityKey,
        sortKey,
        runId: input.runId,
        expires_at: input.expires_at,
      }));
      await doc.send(
        new TransactWriteCommand({
          TransactItems: [
            {
              Put: {
                TableName: table,
                Item: record,
                ConditionExpression: 'attribute_not_exists(#itemId)',
                ExpressionAttributeNames: { '#itemId': 'itemId' },
              },
            },
            ...pointers.map((Item) => ({ Put: { TableName: table, Item } })),
          ],
        }),
      );
      log.debug(
        { runId: input.runId, outcome: input.outcome, inputOmitted: record.inputOmitted === true },
        'ranking run recorded',
      );
      return record;
    },

    async markMatchesWritten(runId, written) {
      const updated = await updateOrUndefined(ctx, {
        Key: { itemId: rankingRunItemId(runId) },
        UpdateExpression: 'SET #mw = :mw',
        ConditionExpression: 'attribute_exists(#itemId)',
        ExpressionAttributeNames: { '#mw': 'matchesWritten', '#itemId': 'itemId' },
        ExpressionAttributeValues: { ':mw': { count: written.count, at: written.at } },
      });
      return updated !== undefined;
    },

    async getRun(runId) {
      const { Item } = await doc.send(new GetCommand({ TableName: table, Key: { itemId: rankingRunItemId(runId) } }));
      return Item as RankingRunRecord | undefined;
    },

    async listRuns(opts) {
      const limit = opts.limit ?? RANKING_RUN_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;
      // ONE sort-key condition only (a KeyConditionExpression takes at most
      // one): the cursor and the `to` ceiling both bound the top, so the upper
      // bound is their lexicographic min (the aiRunsRepo.listByEntity rule).
      const toCeiling = opts.to !== undefined ? `${opts.to}${SORT_KEY_CEILING}` : undefined;
      const upper =
        opts.cursor !== undefined && (toCeiling === undefined || opts.cursor <= toCeiling)
          ? { value: opts.cursor, exclusive: true }
          : toCeiling !== undefined
            ? { value: toCeiling, exclusive: false }
            : undefined;
      // An inverted range matches nothing; DynamoDB would reject the BETWEEN.
      if (opts.from !== undefined && upper !== undefined && opts.from > upper.value) return { entries: [] };
      const sortCondition =
        upper !== undefined && opts.from !== undefined
          ? '#sk BETWEEN :lower AND :upper'
          : upper !== undefined
            ? upper.exclusive
              ? '#sk < :upper'
              : '#sk <= :upper'
            : opts.from !== undefined
              ? '#sk >= :lower'
              : undefined;
      // BETWEEN is inclusive: with an exclusive cursor as its top, over-fetch by
      // one and drop the boundary row (sort keys are unique).
      const trimsBoundary = sortCondition === '#sk BETWEEN :lower AND :upper' && upper !== undefined && upper.exclusive;
      const page = await doc.send(
        new QueryCommand({
          TableName: table,
          IndexName: 'byEntity',
          KeyConditionExpression: sortCondition === undefined ? '#ek = :ek' : `#ek = :ek AND ${sortCondition}`,
          ExpressionAttributeNames: { '#ek': 'entityKey', ...(sortCondition !== undefined && { '#sk': 'sortKey' }) },
          ExpressionAttributeValues: {
            ':ek': opts.entityKey,
            ...(upper !== undefined && { ':upper': upper.value }),
            ...(opts.from !== undefined && { ':lower': opts.from }),
          },
          ScanIndexForward: false,
          Limit: trimsBoundary ? limit + 1 : limit,
        }),
      );
      const items = (page.Items ?? []) as RankingRunPointer[];
      const kept = trimsBoundary && upper !== undefined ? items.filter((p) => p.sortKey < upper.value) : items;
      const hasMore = kept.length > limit || page.LastEvaluatedKey !== undefined;
      const pointers = kept.slice(0, limit);
      if (pointers.length === 0) return { entries: [] };
      const { found, unread } = await batchGetRuns(pointers.map((p) => p.runId));
      const entries: RankingRunListEntry[] = pointers.map((p) => {
        const run = found.get(p.runId);
        if (run !== undefined) return { runId: p.runId, sortKey: p.sortKey, expired: false, run };
        return unread.has(p.runId)
          ? { runId: p.runId, sortKey: p.sortKey, expired: true, unavailable: true }
          : { runId: p.runId, sortKey: p.sortKey, expired: true };
      });
      const last = entries[entries.length - 1];
      const nextCursor = entries.length === limit && hasMore && last !== undefined ? last.sortKey : undefined;
      return {
        entries,
        ...(nextCursor !== undefined && { nextCursor }),
        ...(unread.size > 0 && { incomplete: true as const }),
      };
    },
  };
}
```

#### Step 3 - implementation

In `app/src/repos/rankingRunsRepo.ts`, replace:

```ts
// --- The repository ---

export type RankingRunsRepo = RankingJobFamily & RankingRunFamily;
```

with:

```ts
// --- The unlawful-flag family (spec D10) ------------------------------------------

export const unlawfulFlagItemId = (unitId: string, field: string): string => `uflag#${unitId}#${field}`;
export const unlawfulFlagEntityKey = (unitId: string): string => `uflags#${unitId}`;

export interface UnlawfulFlagRecord {
  itemId: string;
  unitId: string;
  /** A property card field, or its `landlord:<key>` twin (switch on). */
  field: string;
  /** sha256 of the field's trimmed text when raised. */
  textHash: string;
  /** The model's reason naming the field, else the default sentence (spec D10). */
  reason: string;
  runId: string;
  raisedAt: string;
  entityKey: string;
  sortKey: string;
  /** Reserved for B4's admin Dismiss; nothing in B2a writes them. */
  dismissedAt?: string;
  dismissedBy?: string;
  textAtDismiss?: string;
}

export type UnlawfulFlagInput = Pick<UnlawfulFlagRecord, 'unitId' | 'field' | 'textHash' | 'reason' | 'runId' | 'raisedAt'>;

export interface RankingFlagFamily {
  /**
   * Write the flag unless one is OPEN for that property and field: condition
   * attribute_not_exists OR stored textHash <> the given (current) hash. An
   * open flag keeps its first raising run (false); a closed one is replaced
   * whole (true). No TTL.
   */
  putFlagIfAbsentOrClosed(flag: UnlawfulFlagInput): Promise<boolean>;
  /** Every flag record of the unit (open or closed - the read decides), by field. */
  getOpenCandidateFlags(unitId: string): Promise<UnlawfulFlagRecord[]>;
}

function createFlagFamily(ctx: FamilyCtx): RankingFlagFamily {
  const { doc, table } = ctx;
  return {
    async putFlagIfAbsentOrClosed(flag) {
      const item: UnlawfulFlagRecord = {
        itemId: unlawfulFlagItemId(flag.unitId, flag.field),
        unitId: flag.unitId,
        field: flag.field,
        textHash: flag.textHash,
        reason: flag.reason,
        runId: flag.runId,
        raisedAt: flag.raisedAt,
        entityKey: unlawfulFlagEntityKey(flag.unitId),
        sortKey: flag.field,
      };
      try {
        await doc.send(
          new PutCommand({
            TableName: table,
            Item: item,
            ConditionExpression: 'attribute_not_exists(#itemId) OR #textHash <> :textHash',
            ExpressionAttributeNames: { '#itemId': 'itemId', '#textHash': 'textHash' },
            ExpressionAttributeValues: { ':textHash': flag.textHash },
          }),
        );
        return true;
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof ConditionalCheckFailedException) return false;
        throw err;
      }
    },

    async getOpenCandidateFlags(unitId) {
      const flags: UnlawfulFlagRecord[] = [];
      let start: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
      do {
        const page = await doc.send(
          new QueryCommand({
            TableName: table,
            IndexName: 'byEntity',
            KeyConditionExpression: '#ek = :ek',
            ExpressionAttributeNames: { '#ek': 'entityKey' },
            ExpressionAttributeValues: { ':ek': unlawfulFlagEntityKey(unitId) },
            ScanIndexForward: true,
            ...(start !== undefined && { ExclusiveStartKey: start }),
          }),
        );
        flags.push(...((page.Items ?? []) as UnlawfulFlagRecord[]));
        start = page.LastEvaluatedKey;
      } while (start !== undefined);
      return flags;
    },
  };
}

// --- The repository ---

export type RankingRunsRepo = RankingJobFamily & RankingRunFamily & RankingFlagFamily;
```

and replace:

```ts
  return { ...createJobFamily(ctx), ...createRunFamily(ctx) };
```

with:

```ts
  return { ...createJobFamily(ctx), ...createRunFamily(ctx), ...createFlagFamily(ctx) };
```

Where flags are read (PR17): NOT in S3. `assembleRanking` reads no unlawful
flag record. S6's `readRanking` reads them (`rankingRunsRepo.getOpenCandidateFlags`)
for the properties in view after `assembleRanking` returns; a property
anchor's own flag read failing is S6's 503, a candidate property's is that
candidate's `unverified` (PR17). S5's job reads them when it computes
`cappedAtRun`.

### Scope

Plan section 2 row S3; rulings PR2 (file ownership), PR3 (names), PR5 (the
two S2 repo primitives), PR6 (`completeness` on the B1 list), PR7 (one
card definition); watch items WI4, WI8, WI11, WI12, WI20. Spec D1 (pool), D2.1-D2.5
(cards, the registries, properties seen, the attach step, the
classification test, pair history), D3 (completeness), D13 (fingerprints).

S3 builds, all under `app/src/services/ranking/`: `types.ts`, `cardFields.ts`,
`pairHistory.ts`, `seenSet.ts`, `seenFeedback.ts`, `pool.ts`, `cards.ts`,
`completeness.ts`, `fingerprints.ts`, `assemble.ts`; the test helper
`app/test/helpers/rankingFixtures.ts`; eleven test files; and the widening of
`app/test/tenantMatchingInputsReaders.test.ts` (WI8).

`assemble.ts` is the ONE gatherer the job (S5) and the read (S6) call: it
computes the pool, reads every candidate's card inputs with bounded
concurrency (`rankingReadConcurrency`), builds the anchor card and every
candidate card (with missing flags), the pair history, the three
fingerprints, the `propertyFacts` of each pair's property and the `homes`
map of every listed seen home (with its full property card). A candidate
whose OWN reads fail is returned in place with `unverified: true`; a failure
of the anchor's own reads fails the whole result (`anchor_unreadable`), and
an unverified candidate never makes `assembleRanking` throw (PR17). It
reads no flag record (S6 and S5 do). `assemble.ts` also owns the deps
builder `createAssembleDeps`, `loadPropertyFacts` and the display rule
(`tenantDisplay` / `propertyDisplay`) (IR7, IR9); `pool.ts` owns the ONE
anchor-exists rule (`readRankingAnchor`, PR21), the window's recency
instant (`poolRecencyAt`, IR8), the read's sort instant (`sortRecencyAt`,
FB19) and the one voucher-size normalizer (`unitVoucherSizes` /
`recordedVoucherSizes`, FB20); `cardFields.ts` is the one home of the
card-field constants S4 imports (PR33).

S3 does NOT build: handles, `homesSeen`, the prompt or any model call (S4);
the cap and bands (S4 `cap.ts`, `bands.ts`, consuming `propertyFacts`); the
job, the match / run / flag writes, the job's "N tenants could not be read"
message or the input snapshot (S5, consuming `AssembleResult`); the read's
out-of-date reasons, sort, `notScored` and the 503 (S6, consuming
`AssembleResult`); the drivers (S4); any route, page or e2e (S6, S7). It
adds no config variable (S2 owns `lib/config.ts`) and no repo function (S2
owns `unitsRepo.getManyByIds` and `placementsRepo.hasActivePlacementForOtherTenant`,
PR5).

Before S3.1: S2 is merged into the branch (its config fields, the two repo
primitives and the list's `completeness` are used here). App vitest runs
from `W:/tmp/wp1-b2-ranking-engine/app`. Every S3 test file is PURE (no
DynamoDB, no network; the repos are in-memory fakes from
`app/test/helpers/rankingFixtures.ts`), so its red/green steps may run with
`ALLOW_SKIP_DYNAMO_TESTS=1`; that is never a gate. If `env | grep '^AWS_'`
shows an exported key, prefix with `env -u AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID -u AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`.

### Contradictions

C1. Spec D1 cites the send-time authority compare at
audienceResolution.ts:144-147. Those lines are `housingAuthorityOf` (the
trim); the compare itself is app/src/services/audienceResolution.ts:204-210
(`authorities.has(housingAuthority)`, trimmed, exact). The sendable tests
are :197-199 as cited. Resolution: none needed; the pool's widening (case
and spacing folded through `normalizeOrgText`) is as the spec says.

C2. Spec D2.4 names "the units PATCH `WRITABLE_FIELDS`" in routes/units.ts.
It lives in app/src/lib/unitFields.ts:60-165, is NOT exported, and every key
in it is a declared `UnitItem` key. Resolution: the classification test reads
it by source-text scan (with the tombstones at :177), as it does for every
other writer.

C3. Spec D2.4 source 2 assumes writers "import (or ... pin by a source-text
scan)" their key lists. None is exported: the contacts parsers
(app/src/routes/contacts.ts:577 `parseTriageBody`, :880 `parseCreateBody`,
with `applyConsentFields` at :343 and `parseVoucherExpirationDate` at :386
inside the scanned range), the importer (app/src/lib/import/apply.ts:1106
`upsertContact`, :1468 `upsertUnit`) and public sign-up
(app/src/routes/public.ts:617-645 the `contacts.create` literal, :684 the
`housing_fair_welcomed` update). Resolution: S3.1's test scans each source
range with fixed patterns, asserts every key found is classified (or is a
named non-attribute: the address sub-keys, `contactName`, the two
`*_expected_updated_at` guards), and asserts a minimum known set per writer
so a scan that silently finds nothing fails. The patterns were run against
main @404e039d while drafting; the expected minimum sets below are what they
find there.

C4. The seed worlds carry two tenant attributes the spec's lists do not
name: `move_in_date` (placed matrix tenants, app/src/lib/seed/matrix.ts:542)
and `caseworker` (a lean tenant; the spec excludes it as other people).
Resolution: `caseworker` is excluded as the spec says; `move_in_date` is
EXCLUDED with reason "unclassified at B2a" (spec D2.1's default), pinned by
`unclassifiedKeys` in S3.1, and listed in the S3 report for the handback.
No unit attribute is unclassified.

C5. Spec D2.3 gives a placeholder label only for a unit a complete read
shows missing. `propertyLabel` (app/src/lib/propertyLabel.ts:58-66) also
answers `undefined` for a unit whose address has no line 1 or city - every
seed unit stores a plain-string address (app/src/lib/seed/lean.ts:225, :248;
cast.ts:483), and legacy dev units may too. Resolution: such a home is
listed under `NO_ADDRESS_LABEL` ("a property with no address on file"); the
attach step uses only a REAL label (`attachLabel`), so no Notes line ever
attaches to a placeholder. RULED (PR23): this copy, no attach.

C6. Spec D1 says any record can be the anchor and ranking is never refused
for the anchor's state, and D12 answers 404 "anchor not found". Neither says
what a soft-deleted record, or a contact anchor that is not a tenant, is.
`getById` returns soft-deleted records (contactsRepo.ts:1393,
unitsRepo.ts:1284). Resolution: a soft-deleted anchor, a missing one, and a
`tenant`-kind anchor whose contact type is not `tenant` are
`anchor_not_found`. RULED (PR21): exactly this, in ONE exported function,
`readRankingAnchor` (pool.ts), which `computePool` calls and S5's claim
calls through `rankingAnchorExists`.

C7. Spec D3 lists property `pets` as missing when "none of `no_pets`, `pets`,
`pet_fee`" is recorded and is silent on landlord defaults; D2.1 says a
landlord default counts as recorded for the cap. Resolution: with the
landlord switch on, a landlord-default Pets item satisfies the `pets` flag
(the model sees it on the card). RULED (PR23): as drafted.

C8. PR3's `AssembleResult` sketch gives each candidate `card, missing,
pairHistory, fingerprints, propertyFacts` unconditionally; an unverified
candidate has none of them (its reads failed). Resolution: `AssembledCandidate`
is a union on `unverified` (published above); the unverified arm carries
`null` for each, except `propertyFacts`, which a property anchor still knows
(the anchor's).

C9. The tenant card is "no record id" (spec D2.2), yet each properties-seen
entry must point at its home's card, which the call writes once by handle
(spec D4). Resolution (IR17, PR20): `tenantCard` writes the home's `unitId`
under the key `home`; S4's prompt replaces every `home` value before
anything is sent ("anchor" for the property anchor, the `c` handle of a
candidate in the call, else the `h` handle in `homesSeen`), and S5's input
snapshot records the replaced form. The fingerprint never reads
`propertiesSeen`, so `home` never affects one.

C10. Pool order is not defined by the spec ("in pool order"). Resolution:
candidates are sorted by record id ascending (`contactId` / `unitId`), so
batches and handles are deterministic for the same pool.

### Assembly rulings applied (PR12-PR28, interface reconciliation)

- IR7: `display` is a `string` on the anchor and every candidate -
  `tenantDisplay` (name, else contactId) and `propertyDisplay` (label, else
  `NO_ADDRESS_LABEL`), exported from `assemble.ts` (S3.11).
- IR8, as amended by FB19: `poolRecencyAt(contact)` in `pool.ts` is the
  WINDOW's rule (`inPoolWindow` calls it); the read's tie order is spec D9's
  `sortRecencyAt(contact)` (last heard from, else created_at, no import
  exception), which S6 calls on `candidate.record` (S3.4). No
  `sortRecencyAt` FIELD on a candidate.
- IR9: `createAssembleDeps` and `loadPropertyFacts` in `assemble.ts`, with
  unit tests (S3.11). IR10/IR11 need no S3 change (`PropertyFacts` stays in
  `cards.ts`; `AssembledAnchor.propertyFacts` stays `PropertyFacts | null`).
- IR17 / PR20: the properties-seen key is `home` (S3.7, the tests, the
  shapes).
- IR28 / PR20: the anchor-handle recommendation is replaced by PR20's rule
  (a seen home that is the property anchor is `home: "anchor"`).
- PR17: unchanged behavior, now pinned for tours too (S3.11): a candidate's
  failed card, sends or tours read is `unverified`, never a throw; only the
  anchor's own reads give `anchor_unreadable`. Flags are not read in S3.
- PR21: `readRankingAnchor` / `rankingAnchorExists` in `pool.ts` (S3.5);
  `computePool` uses it. S5 drops its own `rankingAnchorExists` and imports
  this one.
- PR23: both placeholder copies and the landlord-default pets rule stand as
  drafted (C5, C7).
- PR24: a WI18 miss may be fixed in `assemble.ts`, `seenSet.ts` or
  `pairHistory.ts` by S6, which names each change in its report.

```ts
// WP1 B2a S3.1 (spec D2.1, D2.4; charter 6.1; plan PR3, WI4): classification
// as code. Fails when a stored attribute of a tenant contact or a unit is
// neither included nor excluded, read from the three sources spec D2.4 names:
// 1. the TYPE level - cardFields.ts writes each registry literal
//    `satisfies Record<declared keys + untyped keys, CardFieldUse>`, so a new
//    declared attribute fails `npm run typecheck` (S3.12 Step 2). No runtime
//    test can see that, and this file holds no type pin (one would be a
//    tautology: the registry key types contain the declared keys by
//    construction);
// 2. the WRITERS' keys - none of the writers exports its list, so each is read
//    by a source-text scan (the tenantMatchingInputsReaders idiom); every key
//    found must be classified, and each scan must find a known minimum so a
//    pattern that silently matches nothing fails;
// 3. the SEED WORLDS - every tenant and unit attribute of the lean and full
//    profiles.
// Pure: it reads source files and builds the seed rows in memory.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { REQUIREMENT_LANDLORD_KEYS, REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS } from '../src/lib/requirements.js';

import { PROVENANCE_FIELDS } from '../src/services/extraction/schema.js';
import {
  EXCLUDED_REQUIREMENT_KEYS,
  LANDLORD_DEFAULT_KEYS,
  LANDLORD_FIELD_PREFIX,
  PROPERTY_CARD_FIELDS,
  PROPERTY_FREE_TEXT_FIELDS,
  RANKED_REQUIREMENT_KEYS,
  TENANT_CARD_FIELDS,
  UNCLASSIFIED_REASON,
  includedFields,
  landlordTwin,
  matchingInputCardFields,
  requirementItemOfField,
  unclassifiedKeys,
  type CardFieldUse,
} from '../src/services/ranking/cardFields.js';

type Row = Record<string, unknown>;
type Tables = Readonly<Record<string, readonly Row[]>>;

// matrix and live are now-relative; a fixed instant makes them deterministic
// (the seedTenantMatchingInputs.test.ts idiom).
const FIXED_NOW = new Date('2026-07-01T12:00:00.000Z');
const LEAN: readonly Tables[] = [SEED];
const FULL: readonly Tables[] = [SEED, castItems(), matrixItems(FIXED_NOW), buildLiveStaticItems(FIXED_NOW)];

const TENANT: Readonly<Record<string, CardFieldUse>> = TENANT_CARD_FIELDS;
const PROPERTY: Readonly<Record<string, CardFieldUse>> = PROPERTY_CARD_FIELDS;

const SRC = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', 'src');
const KEY = '[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*';

function source(...parts: string[]): string {
  return readFileSync(path.join(SRC, ...parts), 'utf8');
}

/** The text from `start` up to (not including) the first `end` after it. */
function slice(text: string, start: string, end: string | RegExp): string {
  const from = text.indexOf(start);
  if (from === -1) throw new Error(`anchor not found: ${start}`);
  const rest = text.slice(from + start.length);
  const to = typeof end === 'string' ? rest.indexOf(end) : rest.search(end);
  if (to === -1) throw new Error(`end anchor not found after: ${start}`);
  return text.slice(from, from + start.length + to);
}

function captures(text: string, pattern: RegExp): string[] {
  return [...text.matchAll(pattern)].map((m) => m[1] as string);
}

function withoutLineComments(text: string): string {
  return text
    .split('\n')
    .map((line) => line.replace(/\/\/.*$/, ''))
    .join('\n');
}

function unique(keys: readonly string[]): string[] {
  return [...new Set(keys)].sort();
}

/** Keys a writer's source names that are not stored attributes. */
const NOT_ATTRIBUTES = new Set([
  // address sub-keys (the parser walks line1..zip inside `address`)
  'line1',
  'line2',
  'city',
  'state',
  'zip',
  // the "First Last - N Bed" convenience string, parsed into names
  'contactName',
  // stale-save guards, never stored (spec 3.9; D14.3)
  'staff_notes_expected_updated_at',
  'notes_expected_updated_at',
]);

function unclassifiedIn(keys: readonly string[], registry: Readonly<Record<string, CardFieldUse>>): string[] {
  return keys.filter((key) => !NOT_ATTRIBUTES.has(key) && !Object.hasOwn(registry, key));
}

function attributesOf(layers: readonly Tables[], table: string, keep: (row: Row) => boolean): string[] {
  const keys = new Set<string>();
  for (const tables of layers) {
    for (const row of tables[table] ?? []) {
      if (!keep(row)) continue;
      for (const key of Object.keys(row)) keys.add(key);
    }
  }
  return [...keys].sort();
}

const isTenantRow = (row: Row): boolean => row['type'] === 'tenant';
const anyRow = (): boolean => true;

    expect(unclassifiedIn(keys, TENANT)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('the units PATCH WRITABLE_FIELDS and its tombstones (lib/unitFields.ts)', () => {
    const fields = source('lib', 'unitFields.ts');
    const writable = slice(fields, 'const WRITABLE_FIELDS: Record<string, FieldKind> = {', '\n};');
    const keys = unique([
      ...writable.split('\n').flatMap((line) => captures(line, new RegExp(`^\\s*(${KEY}): '`, 'g'))),
      ...captures(slice(fields, 'const TOMBSTONED_FIELDS = new Set([', '])'), new RegExp(`'(${KEY})'`, 'g')),
    ]);
    expect(keys).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining(['address', 'beds', 'lif', 'priority', 'media', 'propertyId', 'washer_dryer', 'jurisdiction', 'accepted_programs']),
    );
    expect(unclassifiedIn(keys, PROPERTY)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('seed-world attributes are classified (spec D2.4 source 3)', () => {
  it.each([
    ['lean', LEAN],
    ['full', FULL],
  ] as const)('%s: every tenant attribute', (_name, layers) => {

  ] as const)('%s: every unit attribute', (_name, layers) => {

  });

    expect(attributesOf(FULL, 'contacts', isTenantRow)).toContain('move_in_date');
    expect(TENANT['move_in_date']).toEqual({ use: 'exclude', reason: UNCLASSIFIED_REASON });
    expect(unclassifiedKeys(TENANT)).toEqual(['move_in_date']);
    expect(unclassifiedKeys(PROPERTY)).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
// B1 spec D1: "Every reader iterates the list; no reader names the four." The
// extraction-side readers are pinned here TEXTUALLY (the
// autoRoutingEligibleSingleSource.test.ts idiom): none of these files may
// spell a tenant matching input key. A green run is evidence, not proof - a
// reader that re-derives the four some other way is the reviewer's to catch.
// The contacts parsers and the dashboard surfaces are S1's (its own tests).
//
// WP1 B2a (spec D2.1; plan WI8): the scan also reads EVERY .ts file in
// services/ranking/ - listed at run time, so a file a later slice adds is
// scanned the moment it exists - except examples.ts, whose synthetic cards use
// the labels (the ONE exemption). The ranking drivers live in adapters/ and
// are scanned once they exist (B2a S4 creates them); the fake driver finds its
// inputs through the list, never a spelled key.
import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS } from '../src/lib/tenantMatchingInputs.js';

const SRC = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', 'src');
const READERS = [
  ['services', 'extraction', 'apply.ts'],
  ['services', 'extraction', 'schema.ts'],
  ['services', 'extraction', 'prompt.ts'],
  ['services', 'extraction', 'runTypes.ts'],
  ['services', 'extraction', 'decisions.ts'],
  ['services', 'suggestionResolution.ts'],
  ['jobs', 'extraction.ts'],
  ['jobs', 'journalSweep.ts'],
  ['adapters', 'extraction.ts'],
  ['adapters', 'extractionFake.ts'],
].map((parts) => path.join(SRC, ...parts));

const RANKING_DIR = path.join(SRC, 'services', 'ranking');
/** spec D2.1: the one exemption - synthetic worked examples that use the labels. */
const RANKING_EXEMPT = new Set(['examples.ts']);
const RANKING_READERS = readdirSync(RANKING_DIR)
  .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.ts') && !RANKING_EXEMPT.has(name))
  .sort()
  .map((name) => path.join(RANKING_DIR, name));
const RANKING_DRIVERS = [
  ['adapters', 'ranking.ts'],
  ['adapters', 'rankingFake.ts'],
]
  .map((parts) => path.join(SRC, ...parts))
  .filter((file) => existsSync(file));

describe('the extraction and ranking readers iterate the tenant matching inputs list (B1 spec D1; B2a WI8)', () => {
  it('no extraction or ranking reader spells a tenant matching input key', () => {
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    for (const file of [...READERS, ...RANKING_READERS, ...RANKING_DRIVERS]) {
      const source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
      for (const { key } of TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS) {
        if (source.includes(key)) offenders.push(`${path.relative(SRC, file)}: ${key}`);
      }
    }
    expect(offenders, `iterate TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS instead:\n${offenders.join('\n')}`).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('the list really is the four (the pin is not vacuous)', () => {
    expect(TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS).toHaveLength(4);
  });

  it('the ranking directory is scanned, examples.ts alone exempt (WI8)', () => {
    const names = RANKING_READERS.map((file) => path.basename(file));
    expect(names).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['cardFields.ts', 'types.ts']));
    expect(names).not.toContain('examples.ts');
  });
});
```

```ts
// WP1 B2a ranking engine - the shared shapes (spec
// docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-wp1-b2a-ranking-engine-design.md; plan
// PR3). A LEAF: it imports nothing, so every ranking module, the drivers in
// app/src/adapters and the scripts share it without a cycle. Persisted record
// shapes live in their repos (matchesRepo, rankingRunsRepo), never here.

/** Which side of the ranking the anchor is on: a property (`unit`) or a tenant. */
export type AnchorKind = 'unit' | 'tenant';

export interface AnchorRef {
  kind: AnchorKind;
  id: string;
}

/** Spec D1: why the anchor would not itself be in a pool. Never refuses a ranking. */
export type AnchorNote = 'not_searching' | 'not_sendable' | 'not_available';

/** A card: a plain JSON object in registry key order (spec D2.2). */
export type Card = Record<string, unknown>;

/** Spec D3: one completeness gap - a stable key and its staff label. */
export interface MissingFlag {
  key: string;
  label: string;
}

/** Spec D2.3: the ONLY tour facts that reach a card, a pair history or a fingerprint. */
export interface TourProjection {
  status: string;
  outcome: string | null;
  scheduledAt: string | null;
}

/** One counted send of a pair: its instant and whether it was a send or a flyer sign-up. */
export interface SendFact {
  at: string;
  kind: 'sent' | 'signed_up';
}

/** Spec D2.5 (charter 6.3): this tenant and this property only, from stored facts. */
export interface PairHistory {
  sends: SendFact[];
  declined: { by: string; at: string } | null;
  tours: TourProjection[];
  daysSinceLastSend: number | null;
}

/** Spec D13: the three fingerprints a match stores. */
export interface CardFingerprints {
  tenantCard: string;
  unitCard: string;
  pairHistory: string;
}

export type Direction = 'tenants_for_property' | 'properties_for_tenant';

/** Spec D1: a property's recorded authorities mapped through the organization list. */
export interface AuthorityMapping {
  mapped: string[];
  unmapped: string[];
}
```

```ts
// WP1 B2a (spec D2.1, D2.4; charter 6.1; plan PR3, WI4, WI8): classification as
// code. TENANT_CARD_FIELDS and PROPERTY_CARD_FIELDS name EVERY stored attribute
// of a tenant contact and of a unit, each `include` (with a label) or `exclude`
// (with a short charter citation). cards.ts copies only `include` keys, so an
// attribute nobody classified never reaches the model: an allowlist at runtime
// (charter 6.1). app/test/rankingCardFields.test.ts fails when a declared
// attribute, a writer's key or a seed-world attribute is in neither list.
//
// The tenant matching inputs (B1) are added by MAPPING over
// TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS - this file never spells their keys (B1's reader test

// The property card is keyed by attribute name, because the output schema's

export type KnownKeys<T> = keyof {
  [K in keyof T as string extends K ? never : number extends K ? never : symbol extends K ? never : K]: T[K];
};

export type CardFieldUse =
  | { readonly use: 'include'; readonly label: string; readonly cardKey?: string }
  | { readonly use: 'exclude'; readonly reason: string };

export type IncludedField = Extract<CardFieldUse, { use: 'include' }>;

/** Spec D2.1: the reason on an attribute no decision names; listed in the handback. */
export const UNCLASSIFIED_REASON = 'unclassified at B2a';

const REASON = {
  ids: 'ids and references (charter 6.1)',
  contactPoints: 'phone numbers and email addresses (charter 6.1)',
  income: 'income (A1; charter 6.1)',

  timestamp: 'a timestamp; only created reaches a card (charter 6.1)',
  recency: 'replaced by the last heard from bucket (charter 9.1)',
  disability: 'can stand in for a disability (spec D2.1)',
  signup: 'public sign-up bookkeeping; a flyer sign-up reaches the card through properties seen (spec D2.1)',

function include(label: string): CardFieldUse {
  return { use: 'include', label };
}

function exclude(reason: string): CardFieldUse {

}

/** Tenant attributes the stores carry that ContactItem does not declare (it has an index signature). */

export type TenantCardKey = TenantBaseKey | TenantMatchingInputKey | `${TenantMatchingInputKey}_source`;

/** Unit attributes the stores carry that UnitItem does not declare. */

  // Seen in the seed worlds, named by no decision (spec D2.1 default).

} satisfies Record<TenantBaseKey, CardFieldUse>;

/**
 * Spec D2.1 (FB3): the matching-input entries of the tenant registry, from a
 * list. An entry whose source is `field` is included under its list label;
 * any other source keeps the fact in the Notes box, which the card already
 * carries, so its stored attribute is excluded. Every `<key>_source`
 * provenance key is excluded. Exported so the test can feed a list holding a
 * `notes` entry.
 */
export function matchingInputCardFields(
  inputs: readonly Pick<TenantMatchingInput, 'key' | 'label' | 'source'>[],
): Record<string, CardFieldUse> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    inputs.flatMap((input): [string, CardFieldUse][] => [
      [
        input.key,
        input.source === 'field' ? { use: 'include', label: input.label, cardKey: input.label } : exclude(REASON.inNotes),
      ],
      [`${input.key}_source`, exclude(REASON.provenance)],
    ]),
  );
}

const TENANT_MATCHING_INPUT_FIELDS = matchingInputCardFields(TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS) as Record<
  TenantMatchingInputKey | `${TenantMatchingInputKey}_source`,
  CardFieldUse
>;

export const TENANT_CARD_FIELDS: Readonly<Record<TenantCardKey, CardFieldUse>> = Object.freeze({
  ...TENANT_BASE_FIELDS,
  ...TENANT_MATCHING_INPUT_FIELDS,
});

export const PROPERTY_CARD_FIELDS: Readonly<Record<PropertyCardKey, CardFieldUse>> = Object.freeze({
  // Included (spec D2.1), in card order.
  address: include('Address'),
  status: include('Status'),

  deposit_flexible: include('Deposit flexible'),
  deposit_notes: include('Deposit notes'),
  no_pets: include('No pets'),
  pets: include('Pets (details)'),
  pet_fee: include('Pet fee'),
  no_evictions_on_program: include('No evictions while on the program'),
  evictions_notes: include('Evictions (details)'),
  qualifications: include('Qualifications'),
  lease_terms: include('Lease terms'),
  tour_type: include('Tour type'),
  tour_process: include('Tour process'),
  application_process: include('Application process'),
  notes: include('Notes'),
  created_at: include('Created'),
  // Excluded (spec D2.1).
  unitId: exclude(REASON.ids),
  landlordId: exclude(REASON.ids),
  propertyId: exclude(REASON.ids),
  priority: exclude(REASON.priority),
  credit_requirements: exclude(REASON.creditIncome),
  income_requirements: exclude(REASON.creditIncome),
  lif: exclude(REASON.lif),
  contacts: exclude(REASON.people),
  primary_contact: exclude(REASON.people),
  media: exclude(REASON.media),
  listing_link: exclude(REASON.media),
  video_url: exclude(REASON.media),
  status_source: exclude(REASON.provenance),
  requirement_sources: exclude(REASON.provenance),
  jurisdiction: exclude(REASON.legacy),
  accepted_programs: exclude(REASON.legacy),
  bedrooms: exclude(REASON.legacy),
  bathrooms: exclude(REASON.legacy),
  imported_from: exclude(REASON.imports),
  imported_at: exclude(REASON.imports),
  imported_landlord_name: exclude(REASON.imports),

  updated_at: exclude(REASON.timestamp),
  voucher_size_accepted: exclude(REASON.derived),
  accepted_authorities: exclude(REASON.derived),
} satisfies Record<PropertyCardKey, CardFieldUse>);

/** Never on a card and never reported failed (A1, charter 7.2). */
export const EXCLUDED_REQUIREMENT_KEYS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze(['credit_requirements', 'income_requirements']);

/** The requirement keys a card may carry, in registry order (spec D5's requirement enum). */
export const RANKED_REQUIREMENT_KEYS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze(
  REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS.filter((key) => !EXCLUDED_REQUIREMENT_KEYS.includes(key)),
);

/** Spec D5: the free-text property fields - the only fields an unlawful flag may name. */
export const PROPERTY_FREE_TEXT_FIELDS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze([
  'notes',
  'lease_terms',
  'application_process',
  'qualifications',
  'evictions_notes',
  'pets',
  'pet_fee',
  'deposit_notes',
  'tour_process',
  'utilities',
  'accessibility',
]);

/** Spec D5: a landlord default's field is named `landlord:<key>` (switch on). */
export const LANDLORD_FIELD_PREFIX = 'landlord:';

/** PR33: a key's landlord-default twin, `landlord:<key>`. */
export function landlordTwin(key: string): string {
  return `${LANDLORD_FIELD_PREFIX}${key}`;
}

/** PR33: the keys a card's landlord defaults may carry - the ranked requirement keys and the landlord contact's notes. */
export const LANDLORD_DEFAULT_KEYS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze([...RANKED_REQUIREMENT_KEYS, 'notes']);

/**
 * PR29 / PR33: the requirement ITEM a card field belongs to - a ranked unit
 * requirement key, or its `landlord:` twin - from the requirements registry
 * (lib/requirements.ts itemOfUnitKey). The keys of one item (no_pets, pets,
 * pet_fee) group together, which is how capOf matches an accommodation or an
 * unlawful flag on any key of the item. Undefined for credit, income and
 * every non-requirement field.
 */
export function requirementItemOfField(field: string): RequirementItemId | undefined {
  const key = field.startsWith(LANDLORD_FIELD_PREFIX) ? field.slice(LANDLORD_FIELD_PREFIX.length) : field;
  if (!RANKED_REQUIREMENT_KEYS.includes(key)) return undefined;
  return itemOfUnitKey(key)?.id;
}

/** The included entries, in registry order. */
export function includedFields(registry: Readonly<Record<string, CardFieldUse>>): [string, IncludedField][] {
  const out: [string, IncludedField][] = [];
  for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(registry)) {
    if (entry.use === 'include') out.push([key, entry]);
  }
  return out;
}

/** The attributes excluded only because no decision names them (spec D2.1: listed in the handback). */
export function unclassifiedKeys(registry: Readonly<Record<string, CardFieldUse>>): string[] {
  return Object.entries(registry)
    .filter(([, entry]) => entry.use === 'exclude' && entry.reason === UNCLASSIFIED_REASON)
    .map(([key]) => key);
}
```

```ts
// WP1 B2a S3 (plan section 7): records and an in-memory world for the ranking
// suites. The fakes implement EXACTLY the repo methods services/ranking/pool.ts
// and assemble.ts call (their deps are Pick types), behaving as the repos do:
// listByType / listByStatus page (two items a page here, so every walk
// pages) and hide soft-deleted rows; listByContact returns only LISTED rows
// (counted and carrying sentAt, listingSendsRepo isListed); getManyByIds
// answers the ids it found and, with requireComplete, THROWS
// IncompleteBatchReadError for an id in `incompleteIds` (keys left
// unprocessed after the retries). Made-up people and addresses only; no
// DynamoDB, no network.
import { createLogger } from '../../src/lib/logger.js';
import type { OrgEntry } from '../../src/lib/orgNames.js';
import {
  IncompleteBatchReadError,
  type ContactItem,
  type ContactType,
  type ContactsPage,
  type ListContactsOpts,
} from '../../src/repos/contactsRepo.js';
import type { ListingSendItem, ShareLedgerEntry } from '../../src/repos/listingSendsRepo.js';
import type { OrgListItem } from '../../src/repos/orgListRepo.js';
import type { TourItem } from '../../src/repos/toursRepo.js';
import type { ListUnitsOpts, UnitItem, UnitsPage } from '../../src/repos/unitsRepo.js';
import { ATLANTA, AUGUSTA, DCA, STEP_UP, VASH } from './orgFixtures.js';

export const NOW = new Date('2026-10-28T12:00:00.000Z');
export const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
/** The org fixtures: AHA is a spelling Atlanta and Augusta share (ambiguous). */
export const ORG_ENTRIES: readonly OrgEntry[] = [ATLANTA, AUGUSTA, DCA, VASH, STEP_UP];

/** ISO instant `days` before NOW (a negative value is after NOW). */
export function daysAgo(days: number): string {
  return new Date(NOW.getTime() - days * DAY_MS).toISOString();
}

/** A searching, sendable, consented tenant of voucher size 2 with the Atlanta authority, heard from 3 days ago. */
export function tenant(contactId: string, extra: Partial<ContactItem> = {}): ContactItem {
  return {
    contactId,
    type: 'tenant',
    status: 'searching',
    phone: '+14045550100',
    firstName: 'Pat',
    lastName: contactId,
    voucherSize: 2,
    housingAuthority: ATLANTA.name,
    consent_method: 'verbal_phone',
    created_at: daysAgo(40),
    last_heard_from_at: daysAgo(3),
    ...extra,
  };
}

/** An available 2-bed unit accepting the Atlanta authority, labeled `<unitId> Main St, Decatur`. */
export function unit(unitId: string, extra: Partial<UnitItem> = {}): UnitItem {
  return {
    unitId,
    landlordId: 'contact-landlord-1',
    status: 'available',
    address: { line1: `${unitId} Main St`, city: 'Decatur', state: 'GA', zip: '30030' },
    beds: 2,
    accepted_authorities: [ATLANTA.name],
    rent_min: 1400,
    rent_max: 1500,
    created_at: daysAgo(60),
    ...extra,
  };
}

/** A listed listing_sends row with one counted share per entry (`key` defaults to a broadcast id; FLYER_SHARE_KEY for a sign-up). */
export function sendRow(
  unitId: string,
  contactId: string,
  shares: readonly { at: string; key?: string }[],
  extra: Partial<ListingSendItem> = {},
): ListingSendItem {
  const entries: Record<string, ShareLedgerEntry> = {};
  shares.forEach((share, index) => {
    entries[share.key ?? `bcast-${index + 1}`] = {
      attempt: `${share.at}#a${index + 1}`,
      state: 'counted',
      by: 'acceptance',
      countedAt: share.at,
    };
  });
  const instants = shares.map((share) => share.at).sort();
  const latest = instants[instants.length - 1];
  return {
    unitId,
    contactId,
    via: 'broadcast',
    created_at: instants[0] ?? NOW.toISOString(),
    updated_at: latest ?? NOW.toISOString(),
    counted: true,
    shares: entries,
    ...(latest !== undefined && { sentAt: latest }),
    ...extra,
  };
}

/** A legacy row: no share memory, `sentAt` only (reads as counted). */
export function legacySendRow(unitId: string, contactId: string, sentAt: string, extra: Partial<ListingSendItem> = {}): ListingSendItem {
  return { unitId, contactId, via: 'individual', sentAt, created_at: sentAt, updated_at: sentAt, ...extra };
}

/** A scheduled landlord-led tour created 5 days ago for 2 days ahead. */
export function tourRow(tourId: string, tenantId: string, unitId: string, extra: Partial<TourItem> = {}): TourItem {
  return {
    tourId,
    tenantId,
    unitId,
    _schedPartition: 'tours',
    tourType: 'landlord_led',
    status: 'scheduled',
    scheduledAt: daysAgo(-2),
    createdAt: daysAgo(5),
    updatedAt: daysAgo(5),
    ...extra,
  };
}

/** The ranking config fields the pool and the gatherer read (AppConfig names, plan PR4). */
export interface RankingTestConfig {
  rankingPoolWindowDays: number;
  rankingMaxPool: number;
  rankingReadConcurrency: number;
  rankingSeenMax: number;
  rankingLandlordCard: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_TEST_CONFIG: RankingTestConfig = Object.freeze({
  rankingPoolWindowDays: 90,
  rankingMaxPool: 300,
  rankingReadConcurrency: 4,
  rankingSeenMax: 8,
  rankingLandlordCard: false,
});

export interface WorldSeed {
  contacts?: readonly ContactItem[];
  units?: readonly UnitItem[];
  sends?: readonly ListingSendItem[];
  tours?: readonly TourItem[];
  /** Active placements: the unit is committed to `tenantId`. */
  activePlacements?: readonly { unitId: string; tenantId: string }[];
  orgEntries?: readonly OrgEntry[];
  config?: Partial<RankingTestConfig>;
}

function isGone(row: { deleted_at?: unknown }): boolean {
  return typeof row.deleted_at === 'string' && row.deleted_at.length > 0;
}

function page<T>(rows: readonly T[], opts: { limit?: number; exclusiveStartKey?: Record<string, unknown> }): { items: T[]; lastEvaluatedKey?: Record<string, unknown> } {
  const raw = opts.exclusiveStartKey?.['offset'];
  const start = typeof raw === 'number' ? raw : 0;
  const size = Math.min(opts.limit ?? 2, 2);
  const next = start + size;
  return { items: rows.slice(start, next), ...(next < rows.length && { lastEvaluatedKey: { offset: next } }) };
}

const sleep = (ms: number): Promise<void> => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

/** An in-memory world: mutate `state` to stage a case, read `calls` to assert what was read. */
export function rankingWorld(seed: WorldSeed = {}) {
  const state = {
    contacts: new Map((seed.contacts ?? []).map((c) => [c.contactId, c] as const)),
    units: new Map((seed.units ?? []).map((u) => [u.unitId, u] as const)),
    sends: [...(seed.sends ?? [])],
    tours: [...(seed.tours ?? [])],
    activePlacements: [...(seed.activePlacements ?? [])],
    orgEntries: [...(seed.orgEntries ?? ORG_ENTRIES)],
    /** Ids (unit or contact) a requireComplete batch read cannot finish. */
    incompleteIds: new Set<string>(),
    /** Contact ids whose listByContact throws. */
    failingSendReads: new Set<string>(),
    /** Tenant ids whose listByTenant throws. */
    failingTourReads: new Set<string>(),
    orgListFails: false,
    /** true: the list fakes hand back soft-deleted rows too (the pool's belt). */
    leakDeletedInLists: false,
    /** A delay inside every listByContact, so concurrency can be observed. */
    sendReadDelayMs: 0,
  };
  const calls = {
    placementChecks: [] as [string, string][],
    listByContact: [] as string[],
    unitBatchReads: [] as string[][],
    contactBatchReads: [] as string[][],
    inFlightSendReads: 0,
    maxInFlightSendReads: 0,
  };
  const config: RankingTestConfig = { ...DEFAULT_TEST_CONFIG, ...seed.config };

  const deps = {
    contacts: {
      async getById(contactId: string): Promise<ContactItem | undefined> {
        return state.contacts.get(contactId);
      },
      async listByType(type: ContactType, opts: ListContactsOpts = {}): Promise<ContactsPage> {
        const rows = [...state.contacts.values()].filter(
          (c) => c.type === type && (opts.status === undefined || c.status === opts.status) && (state.leakDeletedInLists || !isGone(c)),
        );
        return page(rows, opts);
      },
      async getManyByIds(ids: string[], opts?: { requireComplete?: boolean }): Promise<Map<string, ContactItem>> {
        calls.contactBatchReads.push([...ids]);
        if (opts?.requireComplete === true && ids.some((id) => state.incompleteIds.has(id))) {
          throw new IncompleteBatchReadError(1, ids.length);
        }
        const out = new Map<string, ContactItem>();
        for (const id of ids) {
          const found = state.contacts.get(id);
          if (found !== undefined && !state.incompleteIds.has(id)) out.set(id, found);
        }
        return out;
      },
    },
    units: {
      async getById(unitId: string): Promise<UnitItem | undefined> {
        return state.units.get(unitId);
      },
      async listByStatus(status: string, opts: ListUnitsOpts = {}): Promise<UnitsPage> {
        const rows = [...state.units.values()].filter((u) => u.status === status && (state.leakDeletedInLists || !isGone(u)));
        return page(rows, opts);
      },
      async getManyByIds(ids: string[], opts?: { requireComplete?: boolean }): Promise<Map<string, UnitItem>> {
        calls.unitBatchReads.push([...ids]);
        if (opts?.requireComplete === true && ids.some((id) => state.incompleteIds.has(id))) {
          throw new IncompleteBatchReadError(1, ids.length, 'units');
        }
        const out = new Map<string, UnitItem>();
        for (const id of ids) {
          const found = state.units.get(id);
          if (found !== undefined && !state.incompleteIds.has(id)) out.set(id, found);
        }
        return out;
      },
    },
    placements: {
      async hasActivePlacementForOtherTenant(unitId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<boolean> {
        calls.placementChecks.push([unitId, tenantId]);
        return state.activePlacements.some((p) => p.unitId === unitId && p.tenantId !== tenantId);
      },
    },
    listingSends: {
      async listByContact(contactId: string): Promise<ListingSendItem[]> {
        calls.listByContact.push(contactId);
        calls.inFlightSendReads += 1;
        calls.maxInFlightSendReads = Math.max(calls.maxInFlightSendReads, calls.inFlightSendReads);
        try {
          if (state.sendReadDelayMs > 0) await sleep(state.sendReadDelayMs);
          if (state.failingSendReads.has(contactId)) throw new Error('listByContact failed');
          return state.sends.filter((r) => r.contactId === contactId && r.counted !== false && typeof r.sentAt === 'string');
        } finally {
          calls.inFlightSendReads -= 1;
        }
      },
    },
    tours: {
      async listByTenant(tenantId: string): Promise<TourItem[]> {
        if (state.failingTourReads.has(tenantId)) throw new Error('listByTenant failed');
        return state.tours.filter((t) => t.tenantId === tenantId);
      },
    },
    orgNames: {
      async read(): Promise<OrgListItem> {
        if (state.orgListFails) throw new Error('organization list read failed');
        return { settingId: 'org-list', version: 1, entries: [...state.orgEntries] };
      },
    },
    config,
    logger: createLogger({ level: 'silent' }),
  };
  return { state, calls, deps };
}
```

```ts
// WP1 B2a (spec D2.3, D2.5; charter 6.3): the stored facts of ONE
// tenant-property pair - every counted send with its kind, the declined
// record, the tours (as the TOUR PROJECTION) and the days since the last send.
// Built from the stored listing_sends row and tours, NEVER from the derived
// outcome (lib/listingSendOutcome.ts), which flips on a new text or send and
// lets a re-send hide a decline the model must still see.
//
// tourProjection is the ONE place a tour becomes card facts: roster, reminder
// and bookkeeping fields change with no outcome, so they never reach a card, a
// pair history or a fingerprint.
import { FLYER_SHARE_KEY } from '../../lib/shareLedgerKeys.js';
import type { ListingSendItem } from '../../repos/listingSendsRepo.js';
import type { TourItem } from '../../repos/toursRepo.js';
import type { SeenHome } from './seenSet.js';
import type { PairHistory, SendFact, TourProjection } from './types.js';

export const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

/** Epoch ms of a non-empty ISO string; undefined when absent or unparseable. */
export function instantMs(value: unknown): number | undefined {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length === 0) return undefined;
  const ms = Date.parse(value);
  return Number.isFinite(ms) ? ms : undefined;
}

function compareFacts(a: SendFact, b: SendFact): number {
  const byTime = (instantMs(a.at) ?? 0) - (instantMs(b.at) ?? 0);
  if (byTime !== 0) return byTime;
  return a.kind < b.kind ? -1 : a.kind > b.kind ? 1 : 0;
}

/**
 * Every counted send of the pair, oldest first: one fact per share entry whose
 * state is `counted` and that carries its instant - the `flyer` entry is the
 * tenant's own sign-up (`signed_up`), any other a send. A row whose shares
 * yield nothing (a legacy row with no share memory) falls back to `sentAt`.
 */
export function sendFactsOf(row: ListingSendItem): SendFact[] {
  const facts: SendFact[] = [];
  const shares = row.shares;
  if (shares !== undefined && shares !== null && typeof shares === 'object') {
    for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(shares)) {
      if (entry.state !== 'counted' || typeof entry.countedAt !== 'string') continue;
      facts.push({ at: entry.countedAt, kind: key === FLYER_SHARE_KEY ? 'signed_up' : 'sent' });
    }
  }
  if (facts.length === 0 && typeof row.sentAt === 'string') facts.push({ at: row.sentAt, kind: 'sent' });
  return facts.sort(compareFacts);
}

/** The stored decline as `{ by, at }` (the staff id never leaves the row); null when none. */
export function declinedOf(row: ListingSendItem | undefined): { by: string; at: string } | null {
  const declined = row?.declined;
  if (declined === undefined || declined === null) return null;
  if (typeof declined.at !== 'string' || typeof declined.by !== 'string') return null;
  return { by: declined.by, at: declined.at };
}

/** Spec D2.3: status, outcome and scheduled time - nothing else of a tour. */
export function tourProjection(tour: TourItem): TourProjection {
  return {
    status: String(tour.status),
    outcome: typeof tour.outcome === 'string' ? tour.outcome : null,
    scheduledAt: typeof tour.scheduledAt === 'string' ? tour.scheduledAt : null,
  };
}

/** Whole days from `iso` to `now`, never negative; null when there is no instant. */
export function daysSince(iso: string | null, now: Date): number | null {
  const at = instantMs(iso);
  if (at === undefined) return null;
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor((now.getTime() - at) / DAY_MS));
}

/** Spec D2.5: the pair's history from its seen-set entry; a pair never sent or toured has an empty one. */
export function pairHistoryOf(home: SeenHome | undefined, now: Date): PairHistory {
  if (home === undefined) return { sends: [], declined: null, tours: [], daysSinceLastSend: null };
  return {
    sends: home.sends.map((send) => ({ ...send })),
    declined: home.declined === null ? null : { ...home.declined },
    tours: home.tours.map((tour) => ({ ...tour })),
    daysSinceLastSend: daysSince(home.lastSendAt, now),
  };
}
```

```ts
// WP1 B2a (spec D2.3; charter 6.2): the SEEN SET - every property a tenant was
// sent (each listed listing_sends row, a flyer sign-up included) or toured,
// UNBOUNDED. The attach step (seenFeedback.ts) and the tenant fingerprint
// (fingerprints.ts) work over all of it; only the card's propertiesSeen list
// is bounded (cards.ts, RANKING_SEEN_MAX).
//
// The units come from ONE complete batch read for the whole set
// (unitsRepo.getManyByIds with requireComplete - assemble.ts): a unit absent
// from a COMPLETE read does not exist and is listed under MISSING_UNIT_LABEL,
// keeping its sends, decline and tours. A soft-deleted unit is still read and
// listed like any other. A unit whose address yields no label (no line 1 or
// city; a legacy string address) is listed under NO_ADDRESS_LABEL. Only a REAL
// label (`attachLabel`) ever attaches a Notes line.
import { propertyLabel } from '../../lib/propertyLabel.js';
import type { ListingSendItem } from '../../repos/listingSendsRepo.js';
import type { TourItem } from '../../repos/toursRepo.js';
import type { UnitItem } from '../../repos/unitsRepo.js';
import { declinedOf, instantMs, sendFactsOf, tourProjection } from './pairHistory.js';
import type { SendFact, TourProjection } from './types.js';

export const MISSING_UNIT_LABEL = 'a property no longer on file';
export const NO_ADDRESS_LABEL = 'a property with no address on file';

export interface SeenHome {
  unitId: string;
  /** null: a COMPLETE read found no such unit. */
  unit: UnitItem | null;
  /** What the card shows: the property label, else a placeholder. */
  label: string;
  /** The real property label, the only text the attach step matches; undefined for a placeholder. */
  attachLabel: string | undefined;
  /** Every counted send, oldest first. */
  sends: SendFact[];
  lastSendAt: string | null;
  declined: { by: string; at: string } | null;
  /** Tour projections, in tour creation order. */
  tours: TourProjection[];
  /** The newest of the decline, the last send and each tour's creation and scheduled time. */
  activityAt: string | null;
}

export interface SeenSetInput {
  sends: readonly ListingSendItem[];
  tours: readonly TourItem[];
  units: ReadonlyMap<string, UnitItem>;
}

function compareText(a: string, b: string): number {
  return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
}

/** Every unit id the sends and tours name, once each, ascending. */
export function seenUnitIds(sends: readonly ListingSendItem[], tours: readonly TourItem[]): string[] {
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of sends) if (typeof row.unitId === 'string' && row.unitId.length > 0) ids.add(row.unitId);
  for (const tour of tours) if (typeof tour.unitId === 'string' && tour.unitId.length > 0) ids.add(tour.unitId);
  return [...ids].sort(compareText);
}

/** The latest of the given instants (as written), or null when none parses. */
function latestOf(values: readonly (string | null | undefined)[]): string | null {
  let best: { at: string; ms: number } | null = null;
  for (const value of values) {
    const ms = instantMs(value);
    if (ms === undefined || typeof value !== 'string') continue;
    if (best === null || ms > best.ms) best = { at: value, ms };
  }
  return best === null ? null : best.at;
}

/** Spec D2.3: one entry per seen property, by unit id. */
export function buildSeenSet(input: SeenSetInput): SeenHome[] {
  const rowByUnit = new Map<string, ListingSendItem>();
  for (const row of input.sends) if (!rowByUnit.has(row.unitId)) rowByUnit.set(row.unitId, row);
  const toursByUnit = new Map<string, TourItem[]>();
  for (const tour of input.tours) {
    const list = toursByUnit.get(tour.unitId) ?? [];
    list.push(tour);
    toursByUnit.set(tour.unitId, list);
  }
  return seenUnitIds(input.sends, input.tours).map((unitId): SeenHome => {
    const unit = input.units.get(unitId) ?? null;
    const realLabel = unit === null ? undefined : propertyLabel(unit);
    const row = rowByUnit.get(unitId);
    const sends = row === undefined ? [] : sendFactsOf(row);
    const tours = [...(toursByUnit.get(unitId) ?? [])].sort(
      (a, b) => compareText(a.createdAt, b.createdAt) || compareText(a.tourId, b.tourId),
    );
    const declined = declinedOf(row);
    const lastSendAt = latestOf(sends.map((send) => send.at));
    return {
      unitId,
      unit,
      label: unit === null ? MISSING_UNIT_LABEL : (realLabel ?? NO_ADDRESS_LABEL),
      attachLabel: realLabel,
      sends,
      lastSendAt,
      declined,
      tours: tours.map(tourProjection),
      activityAt: latestOf([declined?.at, lastSendAt, ...tours.flatMap((tour) => [tour.createdAt, tour.scheduledAt])]),
    };
  });
}
```

```ts
// WP1 B2a (spec D2.3; charter 6.2 and item 8; Q1): THE ATTACH STEP, alone in
// this module so WP3 can delete it (docs/issues/wp3-property-feedback-redesign.md:
// pairing feedback with a property by its label in Notes text is a stopgap).
// It splits the Notes box into physical lines; a line that labelMatches the
// label of any property in the (unbounded) seen set goes under that property
// - under each it names - and leaves the card's notes; every other line stays
// and bears on every property. Whole lines move, staff-typed lines included
// (Q1). No other polish: no abbreviation folding, no date parsing of the
// `[Auto - <date>]` prefix (it has no year; age comes from stored dates).
// cards.ts decides which entries are LISTED and returns an unlisted entry's
// lines to the notes.
import { labelMatches } from '../../lib/propertyLabel.js';

export interface AttachedLine {
  /** The physical line, trimmed. */
  text: string;
  /** Every seen home whose label it names, in the order given; [] = a general line. */
  unitIds: string[];
}

/**
 * The physical lines of a Notes box: split on CR LF, CR, LF, U+2028 and
 * U+2029 (by character code, so no separator is typed into source), each
 * trimmed, blank lines dropped. A non-string box has none.
 */
export function noteLines(notes: unknown): string[] {
  if (typeof notes !== 'string') return [];
  const lines: string[] = [];
  let current = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < notes.length; i += 1) {
    const code = notes.charCodeAt(i);
    if (code === 0x0d || code === 0x0a || code === 0x2028 || code === 0x2029) {
      lines.push(current);
      current = '';
      if (code === 0x0d && notes.charCodeAt(i + 1) === 0x0a) i += 1;
      continue;
    }
    current += notes.charAt(i);
  }
  lines.push(current);
  return lines.map((line) => line.trim()).filter((line) => line.length > 0);
}

/** Spec D2.3: each line with the seen homes it names. A home with no label is never named. */
export function attachFeedback(
  notes: unknown,
  homes: readonly { unitId: string; label: string | undefined }[],
): AttachedLine[] {
  return noteLines(notes).map((text) => ({
    text,
    unitIds: homes
      .filter((home) => home.label !== undefined && labelMatches(text, home.label))
      .map((home) => home.unitId),
  }));
}
```

```ts
describe('mapWithConcurrency - bounded reads', () => {
  it('keeps the input order and runs at most `limit` at once', async () => {
    let inFlight = 0;
    let most = 0;
    const out = await mapWithConcurrency([5, 1, 3, 2, 4], 2, async (n) => {
      inFlight += 1;
      most = Math.max(most, inFlight);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, n));
      inFlight -= 1;
      return n * 10;
    });
    expect(out).toEqual([50, 10, 30, 20, 40]);
    expect(most).toBe(2);
  });

  it('an empty list does nothing', async () => {
    expect(await mapWithConcurrency([], 4, async () => 1)).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

#### Step 3 - implementation

Create `app/src/services/ranking/pool.ts`:

```ts
// WP1 B2a (spec D1; charter 5; plan PR3, WI20): THE pool - the eligibility
// fences and nothing else. Computed when called: by the ranking job when it
// runs (the pool scored is the pool at run time) and by the ranking read, both
// through assemble.ts. The rules are exported pure functions (the cards and
// the tests reuse them); computePool reads only through its injected deps.
//
// - Voucher size: a property's sizes come only from acceptedVoucherSizes,
//   clamped to 0-4 and de-duplicated as the composer prefill does
//   (bedroomSizesOfFilter), compared with the server twin voucherSizeMatches,
//   so 4 means 4 or more.
// - Housing authority: each recorded name is mapped with the EXISTING server
//   rule, checkScalarWrite(entries, 'audience_filter', name, undefined); none
//   recorded or none mapped limits nothing; some mapped limits to those, the
//   tenant's authority compared with case and spacing folded (normalizeOrgText
//   on both sides, never fuzzy). A deliberate widening of the send-time
//   filter's exact compare (services/audienceResolution.ts).
// - Sendable: not opted out, not unreachable, has a phone (the three tests
//   audienceResolution applies). SMS consent is NOT a rule.
// - Window (property anchor only): last heard from within
//   RANKING_POOL_WINDOW_DAYS, else created_at, except a contact carrying
//   imported_from, which never uses that fallback; lifted by includeOlder.
import { bedroomSizesOfFilter, voucherSizeMatches } from '../../lib/blastAudienceRules.js';
import { checkScalarWrite, normalizeOrgText, type OrgEntry } from '../../lib/orgNames.js';
import { acceptedVoucherSizes } from '../../lib/unitFields.js';
import type { ContactItem } from '../../repos/contactsRepo.js';
import type { UnitItem } from '../../repos/unitsRepo.js';
import { DAY_MS, instantMs } from './pairHistory.js';
import type { AnchorNote, AuthorityMapping } from './types.js';

/** Spec D1: each recorded name mapped by the server rule; mapped and unmapped de-duplicated in property order. */
export function mapAuthorities(entries: readonly OrgEntry[], names: readonly string[]): AuthorityMapping {
  const mapped: string[] = [];
  const unmapped: string[] = [];
  for (const raw of names) {
    if (typeof raw !== 'string') continue;
    const text = raw.trim();
    if (text === '') continue;
    const check = checkScalarWrite(entries, 'audience_filter', text, undefined);
    if (check.ok && check.value !== null) {
      if (!mapped.includes(check.value)) mapped.push(check.value);
    } else if (!unmapped.includes(text)) {
      unmapped.push(text);
    }
  }
  return { mapped, unmapped };
}

/**
 * THE voucher-size normalizer (FB20) for the pool, the card and the
 * completeness pass: acceptedVoucherSizes, then whole sizes 0 and up,
 * clamped to 4 (4 means 4 or more), de-duplicated, ascending - exactly the
 * composer prefill (bedroomSizesOfFilter). [] takes every size.
 */
export function unitVoucherSizes(unit: Pick<UnitItem, 'voucher_size_accepted' | 'beds'>): number[] {
  return bedroomSizesOfFilter({ bedroomSizes: acceptedVoucherSizes(unit) });
}

/** The RECORDED sizes only, through the same normalizer (a size inferred from beds is not recorded). */
export function recordedVoucherSizes(unit: Pick<UnitItem, 'voucher_size_accepted'>): number[] {
  return unitVoucherSizes({ voucher_size_accepted: unit.voucher_size_accepted });
}

/** A tenant's voucher size, a whole number, else undefined. */
export function tenantVoucherSize(contact: ContactItem): number | undefined {
  const size = contact['voucherSize'];
  return typeof size === 'number' && Number.isInteger(size) ? size : undefined;
}

/** Spec D1: true when the property's mapped authorities admit the tenant's. */
export function authorityAllows(mapping: AuthorityMapping, tenantAuthority: unknown): boolean {
  if (mapping.mapped.length === 0) return true;
  if (typeof tenantAuthority !== 'string') return false;
  const folded = normalizeOrgText(tenantAuthority);
  if (folded === '') return false;
  return mapping.mapped.some((name) => normalizeOrgText(name) === folded);
}

/** Not opted out, not unreachable, has a phone. */
export function isSendable(contact: ContactItem): boolean {
  return (
    contact.sms_opt_out !== true &&
    contact.sms_unreachable !== true &&
    typeof contact.phone === 'string' &&
    contact.phone.length > 0
  );
}

/**
 * Spec D1 / charter 5 (IR8): the instant the pool WINDOW counts from - last
 * heard from, else created_at unless the contact carries imported_from (that
 * fallback is never used for an import); null when neither applies.
 * inPoolWindow calls it. The read's tie order uses sortRecencyAt instead
 * (spec D9 has no import exception; FB19).
 */
export function poolRecencyAt(contact: ContactItem): string | null {
  const heard = contact.last_heard_from_at;
  if (typeof heard === 'string' && instantMs(heard) !== undefined) return heard;
  if (contact['imported_from'] !== undefined) return null;
  const created = contact.created_at;
  return typeof created === 'string' && instantMs(created) !== undefined ? created : null;
}

/**
 * Spec D9 (FB19): the property-anchor tie order's instant - last heard from,
 * falling back to created_at, WITH NO import exception (that exception is
 * D1's window rule, poolRecencyAt). Null when neither parses. S6 sorts by it
 * on candidate.record.
 */
export function sortRecencyAt(contact: ContactItem): string | null {
  const heard = contact.last_heard_from_at;
  if (typeof heard === 'string' && instantMs(heard) !== undefined) return heard;
  const created = contact.created_at;
  return typeof created === 'string' && instantMs(created) !== undefined ? created : null;
}

/** Spec D1 recency: poolRecencyAt within the window (inclusive). */
export function inPoolWindow(contact: ContactItem, now: Date, windowDays: number): boolean {
  const basis = instantMs(poolRecencyAt(contact));
  if (basis === undefined) return false;
  return now.getTime() - basis <= windowDays * DAY_MS;
}

/** Spec D1: a tenant anchor that would not itself be in a pool says why. */
export function tenantAnchorNotes(contact: ContactItem): AnchorNote[] {
  const notes: AnchorNote[] = [];
  if (contact.status !== 'searching') notes.push('not_searching');
  if (!isSendable(contact)) notes.push('not_sendable');
  return notes;
}

/** Spec D1: a property anchor that is not available says so. */
export function unitAnchorNotes(unit: Pick<UnitItem, 'status'>): AnchorNote[] {
  return unit.status === 'available' ? [] : ['not_available'];
}

/** Runs `fn` over `items` with at most `limit` in flight; results in input order. */
export async function mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  items: readonly T[],
  limit: number,
  fn: (item: T, index: number) => Promise<R>,
): Promise<R[]> {
  const results = new Array<R>(items.length);
  let next = 0;
  const width = Math.max(1, Math.min(limit, items.length));
  const workers = Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next;
      next += 1;
      results[index] = await fn(items[index] as T, index);
    }
  });
  await Promise.all(workers);
  return results;
}
```
