```ts
// WP1 B2a spec D6: the ranking driver interface. No SDK import here: the
// services and the job depend on this interface; only adapters/ranking.ts
// imports @anthropic-ai/sdk. RankingCall is a DISCRIMINATED result that
// never throws, as ExtractionCall is: meta (model, raw text, usage, latency)
// is assembled first and returned on every path. Type-only imports: the
// effort levels and the supported models are config's (S2, lib/config.ts).
import type { ParsedRanking } from './parse.js';
import type { RankingBatchInput } from './prompt.js';

export type { RankingEffort } from '../../lib/config.js';
export type { RankingBatchInput } from './prompt.js';

export type RankingDriverKind = 'anthropic' | 'console' | 'fake';

export type RankingFailure = 'refusal' | 'parse' | 'truncated' | 'timeout' | 'driver';

export interface RankingUsage {
  inputTokens: number;
  outputTokens: number;
  /** Recorded when the response carries it (prompt caching is off; charter 14). */
  cacheReadInputTokens?: number;
}

export interface RankingCallMeta {
  driver: RankingDriverKind;
  /** The model actually used: the model id for anthropic, the literal 'fake' or 'console' otherwise (spec D6). */
  model: string;
  /** The batch's promptFingerprint. Every S4 driver sets it; optional so a stub meta type-checks (plan C12). */
  promptFingerprint?: string;
  /** The response text verbatim, pre-parse (the fake's own JSON). PII by design: never logged. */
  rawText?: string;
  usage?: RankingUsage;
  latencyMs: number;
}

export type RankingCall =
  | { ok: true; meta: RankingCallMeta; output: ParsedRanking }
  | { ok: false; meta: RankingCallMeta; failure: RankingFailure; message: string };

export interface RankingDriver {
  readonly kind: RankingDriverKind;
  rankBatch(input: RankingBatchInput): Promise<RankingCall>;
}
```

3b. Create `app/src/adapters/rankingFake.ts`:

```ts
// WP1 B2a spec D6, plan PR8: the fake and console ranking drivers share ONE
// rules module (this file). No network. Both are REFUSED under
// NODE_ENV=production (lib/config.ts, S2): either would write made-up scores
// into a real matches store (charter 7.4).
//
// FAKE RULES (deterministic, from the cards): start at 70; minus 25 for each
// failed check the fake can read structurally - the property's rent
// (final_rent, else rent_min, else rent_max) above the tenant's maximum
// portion; a recorded No pets with non-empty tenant pets text
// (failedRequirements no_pets); a recorded no_evictions_on_program with
// non-empty tenant evictions text (failedRequirements
// no_evictions_on_program) - plus 10 when the tenant's area preference text
// appears in the property's area or address; clamped to 0-100; one reason
// per rule fired. Voucher size never fails: a pool cannot hold that pair.
//
// The two tenant matching inputs are found THROUGH THE LIST (plan WI8): the
// maximum portion is the one `kind: 'dollars'` entry, the area preference
// the one `kind: 'text'` entry marked for completeness; the card keys both
// by their label. This file spells no input key.
//
// SEAMS (dev/test only): an anchor or candidate card whose `notes` holds
// [fake:fail-batch] makes every batch holding it fail ('driver'); a
// candidate whose notes hold [fake:omit] is left out of the output; a
// property whose notes hold [fake:unlawful:<field>] gets an unlawful flag on
// <field> for every pair. The output goes through the PRODUCTION parser, so
// every parse rule (the unlawful free-text rule included) applies.
//
// The console driver (local development only) logs counts and sizes only -
// never a name, an address or Notes text, the extraction console driver's
// rule - then scores with the same rules and seams, stamping model
// 'console', so local dev without a key still ranks.
import { logger as defaultLogger, type Logger } from '../lib/logger.js';
import { TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS } from '../lib/tenantMatchingInputs.js';
import type { RankingBatchInput, RankingCall, RankingCallMeta, RankingDriver } from '../services/ranking/driverTypes.js';
import { parseRankingText } from '../services/ranking/parse.js';
import type { Card } from '../services/ranking/types.js';

export const FAKE_BASE_SCORE = 70;
export const FAKE_RULE_PENALTY = 25;
export const FAKE_AREA_BONUS = 10;
export const FAKE_SEAM_FAIL_BATCH = '[fake:fail-batch]';
export const FAKE_SEAM_OMIT = '[fake:omit]';
const FAKE_SEAM_UNLAWFUL = /\[fake:unlawful:([a-z_]+(?::[a-z_]+)?)\]/g;

export interface FakeInputLabels {
  maxPortion: string;
  area: string;
}

/**
 * The card labels of the two inputs the fake reads, found through
 * TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS. Throws when the list no longer has exactly one
 * dollars entry and one text entry marked for completeness. R2F12: called in
 * the fake and console driver CONSTRUCTORS - never at module load (the
 * production worker imports this module through adapters/ranking.ts and must
 * not crash for a driver production refuses) and never inside rankBatch
 * (which must not throw, FB27).
 */
export function fakeInputLabels(): Readonly<FakeInputLabels> {
  const dollars = TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS.filter((entry) => entry.kind === 'dollars');
  const area = TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS.filter((entry) => entry.kind === 'text' && entry.completeness);
  if (dollars.length !== 1 || area.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
      `rankingFake: expected one dollars entry and one text entry marked for completeness in TENANT_MATCHING_INPUTS, found ${dollars.length} and ${area.length}`,
    );
  }
  return Object.freeze({ maxPortion: dollars[0]!.label, area: area[0]!.label });
}

function textOf(value: unknown): string {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
}

function addressText(value: unknown): string {
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
  if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object') {
    return Object.values(value as Record<string, unknown>).filter((part): part is string => typeof part === 'string').join(' ');
  }
  return '';
}

function rentOf(property: Card): number | undefined {
  for (const key of ['final_rent', 'rent_min', 'rent_max']) {
    const value = property[key];
    if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
  }
  return undefined;
}

interface FakeReason {
  text: string;
  source: string;
}

interface FakeEntry {
  candidateId: string;
  score: number;
  for: FakeReason[];
  against: FakeReason[];
  unknowns: string[];
  failedRequirements: string[];
  fairHousingFlags: Array<{ kind: 'unlawful'; field: string }>;
}

function fakePairEntry(handle: string, tenant: Card, property: Card, labels: Readonly<FakeInputLabels>): FakeEntry {
  let score = FAKE_BASE_SCORE;
  const forReasons: FakeReason[] = [];
  const against: FakeReason[] = [];
  const failedRequirements: string[] = [];
  const rent = rentOf(property);
  const maxPortion = tenant[labels.maxPortion];
  if (rent !== undefined && typeof maxPortion === 'number' && rent > maxPortion) {
    score -= FAKE_RULE_PENALTY;
    against.push({ text: 'rent above max portion', source: 'rent' });
  }
  if (property['no_pets'] === true && textOf(tenant['pets']).length > 0) {
    score -= FAKE_RULE_PENALTY;
    against.push({ text: 'no pets, has pets', source: 'pets' });
    failedRequirements.push('no_pets');
  }
  if (property['no_evictions_on_program'] === true && textOf(tenant['evictions']).length > 0) {
    score -= FAKE_RULE_PENALTY;
    against.push({ text: 'eviction history', source: 'evictions' });
    failedRequirements.push('no_evictions_on_program');
  }
  const area = textOf(tenant[labels.area]).toLowerCase();
  if (area.length > 0) {
    const where = `${textOf(property['area'])} ${addressText(property['address'])}`.toLowerCase();
    if (where.includes(area)) {
      score += FAKE_AREA_BONUS;
      forReasons.push({ text: 'in preferred area', source: 'area' });
    }
  }
  const fairHousingFlags = [...textOf(property['notes']).matchAll(FAKE_SEAM_UNLAWFUL)].map((match) => ({
    kind: 'unlawful' as const,
    field: match[1]!,
  }));
  return {
    candidateId: handle,
    score: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, score)),
    for: forReasons,
    against,
    unknowns: [],
    failedRequirements,
    fairHousingFlags,
  };
}

function fakeRankingText(
  input: RankingBatchInput,
  labels: Readonly<FakeInputLabels>,
): { ok: true; text: string } | { ok: false; message: string } {
  const anchor = input.wire.anchor.card;
  const failing = [anchor, ...input.wire.candidates.map((c) => c.card)].some((card) => textOf(card['notes']).includes(FAKE_SEAM_FAIL_BATCH));
  if (failing) return { ok: false, message: `fake ranking driver: ${FAKE_SEAM_FAIL_BATCH} seam` };
  const entries: FakeEntry[] = [];
  for (const candidate of input.wire.candidates) {
    if (textOf(candidate.card['notes']).includes(FAKE_SEAM_OMIT)) continue;
    const tenant = input.direction === 'tenants_for_property' ? candidate.card : anchor;
    const property = input.direction === 'tenants_for_property' ? anchor : candidate.card;
    entries.push(fakePairEntry(candidate.handle, tenant, property, labels));
  }
  return { ok: true, text: JSON.stringify({ candidates: entries }) };
}

async function rankWithFakeRules(
  input: RankingBatchInput,
  driver: 'fake' | 'console',
  now: () => number,
  labels: Readonly<FakeInputLabels>,
): Promise<RankingCall> {
  const started = now();
  const meta: RankingCallMeta = { driver, model: driver, promptFingerprint: input.promptFingerprint, latencyMs: 0 };
  const built = fakeRankingText(input, labels);
  if (!built.ok) {
    meta.latencyMs = now() - started;
    return { ok: false, meta, failure: 'driver', message: built.message };
  }
  meta.rawText = built.text;
  const parsed = parseRankingText(built.text, {
    handles: input.handles.map((h) => h.handle),
    freeTextByHandle: input.freeTextByHandle,
    landlordCard: input.landlordCard,
  });
  meta.latencyMs = now() - started;
  return parsed.ok ? { ok: true, meta, output: parsed.value } : { ok: false, meta, failure: 'parse', message: parsed.message };
}

export class FakeRankingDriver implements RankingDriver {
  readonly kind = 'fake' as const;
  private readonly now: () => number;
  private readonly labels: Readonly<FakeInputLabels>;

  constructor(opts: { now?: () => number } = {}) {
    this.now = opts.now ?? Date.now;
    this.labels = fakeInputLabels();
  }

  rankBatch(input: RankingBatchInput): Promise<RankingCall> {
    return rankWithFakeRules(input, 'fake', this.now, this.labels);
  }
}

export class ConsoleRankingDriver implements RankingDriver {
  readonly kind = 'console' as const;
  private readonly log: Logger;
  private readonly now: () => number;
  private readonly labels: Readonly<FakeInputLabels>;

  constructor(opts: { logger?: Logger; now?: () => number } = {}) {
    this.log = opts.logger ?? defaultLogger;
    this.now = opts.now ?? Date.now;
    this.labels = fakeInputLabels();
  }

  rankBatch(input: RankingBatchInput): Promise<RankingCall> {
    // Counts and sizes only: never a name, an address or Notes text.
    this.log.info(
      {
        batchIndex: input.batchIndex,
        candidates: input.wire.candidates.length,
        homesSeen: input.wire.homesSeen.length,
        userChars: input.user.length,
      },
      'console ranking driver: scoring with the fake rules (offline)',
    );
    return rankWithFakeRules(input, 'console', this.now, this.labels);
  }
}
```

```ts
// the supported-model refusal and the factory.
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { describe, expect, it, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';

const sdk = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  reply: {} as unknown,
  throwError: undefined as unknown,
  lastRequest: undefined as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
  lastOptions: undefined as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
  constructed: [] as Array<Record<string, unknown>>,
  calls: 0,
}));

vi.mock('@anthropic-ai/sdk', () => {
  class StubTimeoutError extends Error {}
  class StubAnthropic {
    static APIConnectionTimeoutError = StubTimeoutError;
    readonly messages = {
      create: async (params: Record<string, unknown>, options: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> => {
        sdk.calls += 1;
        sdk.lastRequest = params;
        sdk.lastOptions = options;
        if (sdk.throwError !== undefined) throw sdk.throwError;
        return sdk.reply;
      },
    };
    constructor(opts: Record<string, unknown>) {
      sdk.constructed.push(opts);
    }
  }
  return { default: StubAnthropic };
});

const { createRankingDriver, isSupportedRankingModel } = await import('../src/adapters/ranking.js');
const SdkStub = (await import('@anthropic-ai/sdk')).default as unknown as { APIConnectionTimeoutError: new (m: string) => Error };
import { RANKING_SUPPORTED_MODELS } from '../src/lib/config.js';
import { createLogger } from '../src/lib/logger.js';
import { buildRankingBatch } from '../src/services/ranking/prompt.js';
import { rankingSchema } from '../src/services/ranking/schema.js';
import { createLogCapture } from './helpers/logCapture.js';
import { propertyCardFixture, tenantCardFixture, tenantsForPropertySource } from './helpers/rankingBatchFixture.js';

const KEY = 'sk-test-not-a-real-key';
type Settings = Parameters<typeof createRankingDriver>[0];
const base: Settings = {
  rankingDriver: 'anthropic',
  aiRankingModel: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
  rankingEffort: 'low',
  rankingMaxOutputTokens: 16000,
  rankingCallTimeoutMs: 120000,
  anthropicApiKey: KEY,
  anthropicApiBaseUrl: undefined,
};

function batch(landlordCard = false) {
  return buildRankingBatch(tenantsForPropertySource(
    [tenantCardFixture({ firstName: 'Zelda', notes: 'Private note text' }), tenantCardFixture()],
    propertyCardFixture(),
    { landlordCard },
  ));
}

function answer(text: string, over: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    stop_reason: 'end_turn',
    usage: { input_tokens: 1200, output_tokens: 300, cache_read_input_tokens: 0 },
    content: [{ type: 'thinking', thinking: '', signature: 'sig' }, { type: 'text', text }],
    ...over,
  };
}

const goodText = JSON.stringify({
  candidates: [
    { candidateId: 'c1', score: 81, for: [{ text: 'near work', source: 'area' }], against: [], unknowns: [], failedRequirements: [], fairHousingFlags: [] },
    { candidateId: 'c2', score: 40, for: [], against: [], unknowns: [], failedRequirements: [], fairHousingFlags: [] },
  ],
});

beforeEach(() => {
  sdk.reply = answer(goodText);
  sdk.throwError = undefined;
  sdk.lastRequest = undefined;
  sdk.lastOptions = undefined;
  sdk.constructed = [];
  sdk.calls = 0;
});

describe('the request (spec D6)', () => {
  it('is exactly the spec request: adaptive thinking, effort and the json_schema format, no fallback', async () => {
    const b = batch();
    await createRankingDriver(base).rankBatch(b);
    expect(sdk.lastRequest).toEqual({
      model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
      max_tokens: 16000,
      thinking: { type: 'adaptive' },
      output_config: { effort: 'low', format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: rankingSchema({ landlordCard: false }) } },
      system: b.system,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: b.user }],
    });
    expect(sdk.lastRequest).not.toHaveProperty('fallbacks');
    expect(sdk.lastRequest).not.toHaveProperty('betas');
  });

  it('sends the per-request timeout and maxRetries 1', async () => {
    await createRankingDriver({ ...base, rankingCallTimeoutMs: 45000 }).rankBatch(batch());
    expect(sdk.lastOptions).toEqual({ timeout: 45000, maxRetries: 1 });
  });

  it('uses the landlord-on schema for a landlord-on batch, and the configured model and effort', async () => {
    await createRankingDriver({ ...base, aiRankingModel: 'claude-opus-5-5', rankingEffort: 'medium', rankingMaxOutputTokens: 8000 }).rankBatch(batch(true));
    expect(sdk.lastRequest).toMatchObject({
      model: 'claude-opus-5-5',
      max_tokens: 8000,
      output_config: { effort: 'medium', format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: rankingSchema({ landlordCard: true }) } },
    });
  });

  it('constructs the client with the key, and the base URL only when given', () => {
    createRankingDriver(base);
    createRankingDriver({ ...base, anthropicApiBaseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:9999' });
    expect(sdk.constructed).toEqual([{ apiKey: KEY }, { apiKey: KEY, baseURL: 'http://127.0.0.1:9999' }]);
  });
});

describe('a good answer', () => {
  it('parses through the production parser and carries meta: model, fingerprint, raw text, usage, latency', async () => {
    const times = [5000, 5420];
    const b = batch();
    const call = await createRankingDriver(base, undefined, { now: () => times.shift()! }).rankBatch(b);
    expect(call.ok).toBe(true);
    if (!call.ok) return;
    expect(call.meta).toEqual({
      driver: 'anthropic',
      model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
      promptFingerprint: b.promptFingerprint,
      rawText: goodText,
      usage: { inputTokens: 1200, outputTokens: 300, cacheReadInputTokens: 0 },
      latencyMs: 420,
    });
    expect(call.output.byHandle.get('c1')!.score).toBe(81);
  });

  it('omits cacheReadInputTokens when the response does not carry it', async () => {
    sdk.reply = answer(goodText, { usage: { input_tokens: 10, output_tokens: 5, cache_read_input_tokens: null } });
    const call = await createRankingDriver(base).rankBatch(batch());
    expect(call.meta.usage).toEqual({ inputTokens: 10, outputTokens: 5 });
  });

  it('logs counts only (never card text)', async () => {
    const capture = createLogCapture();
    await createRankingDriver(base, createLogger({ level: 'info', destination: capture.stream })).rankBatch(batch());
    expect(capture.lines).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(capture.lines[0]).toMatchObject({ msg: 'anthropic ranking usage', candidates: 2, inputTokens: 1200, outputTokens: 300 });
    const logged = JSON.stringify(capture.lines);
    for (const secret of ['Zelda', 'Private note text', 'near work']) expect(logged).not.toContain(secret);
  });
});

describe('the failure mapping (never a throw)', () => {
  it('a timeout (after the one retry) is failure timeout', async () => {
    sdk.throwError = new SdkStub.APIConnectionTimeoutError('Request timed out.');
    const call = await createRankingDriver(base).rankBatch(batch());
    expect(call).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failure: 'timeout', message: 'Anthropic ranking call timed out after 120000 ms (one retry included)' });
  });

  it('any other SDK error is failure driver with its message', async () => {
    sdk.throwError = new Error('400 invalid_request_error: grammar too large');
    const call = await createRankingDriver(base).rankBatch(batch());
    expect(call).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failure: 'driver', message: '400 invalid_request_error: grammar too large' });
    expect(call.meta.usage).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('stop_reason refusal is failure refusal, usage still stamped', async () => {
    sdk.reply = answer('', { stop_reason: 'refusal' });
    const call = await createRankingDriver(base).rankBatch(batch());
    expect(call).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failure: 'refusal', message: 'Anthropic declined to rank this batch (stop_reason: refusal)' });
    expect(call.meta.usage).toEqual({ inputTokens: 1200, outputTokens: 300, cacheReadInputTokens: 0 });
  });

  it('stop_reason max_tokens is failure truncated with the partial text', async () => {
    sdk.reply = answer('{"candidates":[{"candidateId":"c1"', { stop_reason: 'max_tokens', usage: { input_tokens: 9, output_tokens: 16000 } });
    const call = await createRankingDriver(base).rankBatch(batch());
    expect(call).toMatchObject({
      ok: false,
      failure: 'truncated',
      message: 'Anthropic ranking hit the 16000-token output cap (thinking included) (16000 output tokens) and returned an incomplete response (stop_reason: max_tokens)',
    });
    expect(call.meta.rawText).toBe('{"candidates":[{"candidateId":"c1"');
  });

  it('no usage, no content list or no text block is failure driver', async () => {
    sdk.reply = { stop_reason: 'end_turn', content: [{ type: 'text', text: goodText }] };
    expect(await createRankingDriver(base).rankBatch(batch())).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failure: 'driver', message: 'Anthropic ranking response carried no usage counts' });
    sdk.reply = { stop_reason: 'end_turn', usage: { input_tokens: 1, output_tokens: 1 } };
    expect(await createRankingDriver(base).rankBatch(batch())).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failure: 'driver', message: 'Anthropic ranking response contained no content blocks' });
    sdk.reply = answer('', { content: [{ type: 'thinking', thinking: '', signature: 's' }] });
    expect(await createRankingDriver(base).rankBatch(batch())).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failure: 'driver', message: 'Anthropic ranking response contained no text block' });
  });

  it('unparseable text is failure parse, the raw text kept', async () => {
    sdk.reply = answer('not json at all');
    const call = await createRankingDriver(base).rankBatch(batch());
    expect(call).toMatchObject({ ok: false, failure: 'parse', message: 'ranking output is not valid JSON' });
    expect(call.meta.rawText).toBe('not json at all');
  });
});

describe('createRankingDriver', () => {
  it('selects each kind; fake and console ignore the model and need no key', () => {
    expect(createRankingDriver(base).kind).toBe('anthropic');
    expect(createRankingDriver({ ...base, rankingDriver: 'fake', aiRankingModel: 'anything', anthropicApiKey: undefined }).kind).toBe('fake');
    expect(createRankingDriver({ ...base, rankingDriver: 'console', aiRankingModel: 'anything', anthropicApiKey: undefined }).kind).toBe('console');
  });

  it('re-asserts config\'s supported set: an unsupported model is refused (config refuses it at startup too, S2)', () => {
    for (const model of ['claude-haiku-5-5', 'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', '']) {
      expect(isSupportedRankingModel(model)).toBe(false);
      expect(() => createRankingDriver({ ...base, aiRankingModel: model })).toThrow(/AI_RANKING_MODEL must be one of claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-opus-5-5/);
    }
    for (const model of RANKING_SUPPORTED_MODELS) expect(isSupportedRankingModel(model)).toBe(true);
    expect([...RANKING_SUPPORTED_MODELS]).toEqual(['claude-sonnet-5-5', 'claude-opus-5-5']);
  });

  it('refuses the anthropic driver without a key', () => {
    expect(() => createRankingDriver({ ...base, anthropicApiKey: undefined })).toThrow(/requires an apiKey/);
    expect(() => createRankingDriver({ ...base, anthropicApiKey: '' })).toThrow(/requires an apiKey/);
  });

  it('makes no call until rankBatch', () => {
    createRankingDriver(base);
    expect(sdk.calls).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

#### Step 3 - implementation

Create `app/src/adapters/ranking.ts`:

```ts
// WP1 B2a spec D6: the ranking driver factory and the anthropic ranking
// driver - the ONLY new Anthropic SDK import site (adapter rule; services
// depend on services/ranking/driverTypes.ts). Fake and console drivers live
// in rankingFake.ts (one rules module, plan PR8).
//
// THE REQUEST: model = AI_RANKING_MODEL; max_tokens =
// RANKING_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS (thinking tokens count against it);
// thinking: { type: 'adaptive' }; output_config: { effort: RANKING_EFFORT,
// format: { type: 'json_schema', schema } }; request options timeout =
// RANKING_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS and maxRetries 1, so one call's wall clock stays
// bounded (at twice the timeout: the SDK retries a timed-out call once).
// NO server-side refusal fallback: a fallback would score some pairs on
// another model, breaking "one model per ranking" and the version rule
// (charter 10.3); a refusal is a failed batch.
//
// THE THINKING TRAP: extraction pins thinking OFF per model
// (adapters/extraction.ts thinkingOff); ranking runs adaptive thinking with
// an effort, which only the models in RANKING_SUPPORTED_MODELS take. Any
// other model is refused here; the driver is built at boot (S5), so the
// refusal stops startup.
import Anthropic from '@anthropic-ai/sdk';
import { RANKING_SUPPORTED_MODELS, type AppConfig } from '../lib/config.js';
import { logger as defaultLogger, type Logger } from '../lib/logger.js';
import type {
  RankingBatchInput,
  RankingCall,
  RankingCallMeta,
  RankingDriver,
  RankingEffort,
} from '../services/ranking/driverTypes.js';
import { parseRankingText } from '../services/ranking/parse.js';
import { rankingSchema } from '../services/ranking/schema.js';
import { ConsoleRankingDriver, FakeRankingDriver } from './rankingFake.js';

/** Spec D6: one SDK retry, so a call's wall clock is bounded. */
export const RANKING_MAX_RETRIES = 1;

export function isSupportedRankingModel(model: string): boolean {
  return RANKING_SUPPORTED_MODELS.includes(model);
}

interface AnthropicRankingOptions {
  apiKey: string;
  apiBaseUrl?: string;
  model: string;
  effort: RankingEffort;
  maxOutputTokens: number;
  callTimeoutMs: number;
  logger?: Logger;
  now?: () => number;
}

class AnthropicRankingDriver implements RankingDriver {
  readonly kind = 'anthropic' as const;
  private readonly client: Anthropic;
  private readonly model: string;
  private readonly effort: RankingEffort;
  private readonly maxOutputTokens: number;
  private readonly callTimeoutMs: number;
  private readonly log: Logger;
  private readonly now: () => number;

  constructor(opts: AnthropicRankingOptions) {
    this.client = new Anthropic({ apiKey: opts.apiKey, ...(opts.apiBaseUrl ? { baseURL: opts.apiBaseUrl } : {}) });
    this.model = opts.model;
    this.effort = opts.effort;
    this.maxOutputTokens = opts.maxOutputTokens;
    this.callTimeoutMs = opts.callTimeoutMs;
    this.log = opts.logger ?? defaultLogger;
    this.now = opts.now ?? Date.now;
  }

  async rankBatch(input: RankingBatchInput): Promise<RankingCall> {
    const started = this.now();
    // Meta is assembled FIRST and returned on every path (as extraction).
    const meta: RankingCallMeta = { driver: 'anthropic', model: this.model, promptFingerprint: input.promptFingerprint, latencyMs: 0 };
    let message: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof this.client.messages.create>>;
    try {
      message = await this.client.messages.create(
        {
          model: this.model,
          max_tokens: this.maxOutputTokens,
          thinking: { type: 'adaptive' },
          output_config: {
            effort: this.effort,
            format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: rankingSchema({ landlordCard: input.landlordCard }) },
          },
          system: input.system,
          messages: [{ role: 'user', content: input.user }],
        },
        { timeout: this.callTimeoutMs, maxRetries: RANKING_MAX_RETRIES },
      );
    } catch (err) {
      meta.latencyMs = this.now() - started;
      if (err instanceof Anthropic.APIConnectionTimeoutError) {
        return {
          ok: false, meta, failure: 'timeout',
          message: `Anthropic ranking call timed out after ${this.callTimeoutMs} ms (one retry included)`,
        };
      }
      return { ok: false, meta, failure: 'driver', message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
    }
    meta.latencyMs = this.now() - started;
    // Defensive reading, as AnthropicExtractionDriver.extract: a response
    // missing what its type promises is a 'driver' failure, never a TypeError.
    const usage: typeof message.usage | undefined = message?.usage;
    const usageOk = typeof usage?.input_tokens === 'number' && typeof usage.output_tokens === 'number';
    if (usageOk) {
      const cacheRead: unknown = usage.cache_read_input_tokens;
      meta.usage = {
        inputTokens: usage.input_tokens,
        outputTokens: usage.output_tokens,
        ...(typeof cacheRead === 'number' ? { cacheReadInputTokens: cacheRead } : {}),
      };
      // Counts only - never card text (PII).
      this.log.info(
        {
          batchIndex: input.batchIndex,
          candidates: input.wire.candidates.length,
          inputTokens: usage.input_tokens,
          outputTokens: usage.output_tokens,
        },
        'anthropic ranking usage',
      );
    }
    // A refusal is classified before the usage guard (a pre-output decline
    // may carry no counts), as extraction does.
    if (message?.stop_reason === 'refusal') {
      return { ok: false, meta, failure: 'refusal', message: 'Anthropic declined to rank this batch (stop_reason: refusal)' };
    }
    if (message?.stop_reason === 'max_tokens') {
      const partial = Array.isArray(message.content)
        ? message.content.find((block): block is Extract<typeof block, { type: 'text' }> => block.type === 'text')
        : undefined;
      if (partial !== undefined) meta.rawText = partial.text;
      const spent = meta.usage?.outputTokens;
      return {
        ok: false, meta, failure: 'truncated',
        message:
          `Anthropic ranking hit the ${this.maxOutputTokens}-token output cap (thinking included)` +
          (spent === undefined ? '' : ` (${spent} output tokens)`) +
          ' and returned an incomplete response (stop_reason: max_tokens)',
      };
    }
    if (!usageOk) {
      return { ok: false, meta, failure: 'driver', message: 'Anthropic ranking response carried no usage counts' };
    }
    const content: typeof message.content | undefined = message.content;
    if (!Array.isArray(content)) {
      return { ok: false, meta, failure: 'driver', message: 'Anthropic ranking response contained no content blocks' };
    }
    const textBlock = content.find((block): block is Extract<typeof block, { type: 'text' }> => block.type === 'text');
    if (!textBlock) {
      return { ok: false, meta, failure: 'driver', message: 'Anthropic ranking response contained no text block' };
    }
    meta.rawText = textBlock.text;
    const parsed = parseRankingText(textBlock.text, {
      handles: input.handles.map((h) => h.handle),
      freeTextByHandle: input.freeTextByHandle,
      landlordCard: input.landlordCard,
    });
    return parsed.ok ? { ok: true, meta, output: parsed.value } : { ok: false, meta, failure: 'parse', message: parsed.message };
  }
}

/** The config fields the driver reads, by their AppConfig names (S5 passes `config` itself). */
export type RankingDriverSettings = Pick<
  AppConfig,
  | 'rankingDriver'
  | 'aiRankingModel'
  | 'rankingEffort'
  | 'rankingMaxOutputTokens'
  | 'rankingCallTimeoutMs'
  | 'anthropicApiKey'
  | 'anthropicApiBaseUrl'
>;

/**
 * The ranking driver for these settings. Startup already refuses an
 * unsupported or unpriced model (lib/config.ts, S2); the anthropic arm
 * RE-ASSERTS the supported set for callers that build settings without
 * loadConfig (the counterfactual script), and refuses a missing key.
 */
export function createRankingDriver(
  settings: RankingDriverSettings,
  logger?: Logger,
  opts: { now?: () => number } = {},
): RankingDriver {
  switch (settings.rankingDriver) {
    case 'fake':
      return new FakeRankingDriver({ now: opts.now });
    case 'console':
      return new ConsoleRankingDriver({ logger, now: opts.now });
    case 'anthropic': {
      if (!isSupportedRankingModel(settings.aiRankingModel)) {
        throw new Error(
          `AI_RANKING_MODEL must be one of ${RANKING_SUPPORTED_MODELS.join(', ')} ` +
            `(the models that run adaptive thinking with an effort), got: ${settings.aiRankingModel}`,
        );
      }
      if (!settings.anthropicApiKey) {
        throw new Error('createRankingDriver: driver "anthropic" requires an apiKey (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)');
      }
      return new AnthropicRankingDriver({
        apiKey: settings.anthropicApiKey,
        apiBaseUrl: settings.anthropicApiBaseUrl,
        model: settings.aiRankingModel,
        effort: settings.rankingEffort,
        maxOutputTokens: settings.rankingMaxOutputTokens,
        callTimeoutMs: settings.rankingCallTimeoutMs,
        logger,
        now: opts.now,
      });
    }
    default: {
      const exhaustive: never = settings.rankingDriver;
      throw new Error(`createRankingDriver: unknown driver ${String(exhaustive)}`);
    }
  }
}
```

Note (plan C7, FB24): if `npm run typecheck` reports `effort`, an effort
level, `'adaptive'` or `APIConnectionTimeoutError` against the installed
SDK's types, STOP and report it as a finding that quotes the exact tsc
error (file, line and message); do not cast. If it reports `cache_read_input_tokens` missing on the
usage type, keep the `unknown` read above (it already compiles either way).

```
**Changing a structured-output schema.** The API compiles `EXTRACTION_SCHEMA` (and the probe's
```

new:
```
**Changing a structured-output schema.** The API compiles `EXTRACTION_SCHEMA`, the probe's
`GRADER_SCHEMA` and the ranking schema (`app/src/services/ranking/schema.ts`, WP1 B2a) into a grammar
with a size limit no offline test can see: past it, EVERY call fails 400 "The compiled grammar is too
large". WP1 B1 hit it (twelve named field objects failed, eight compiled), which is why `fields` is one
list of `{ field, op, value, reason }` entries. The ranking schema has five object nodes (the root, the
candidate, the reason used for and against, the flag), and `app/test/rankingSchema.test.ts` fails offline
if an edit adds a sixth, an optional key or a numeric or length bound. Its flag-field enum grows with
`RANKING_LANDLORD_CARD` (18 fields off, 32 on), so the check compiles it in BOTH states. After any
schema change, run `npx tsx app/scripts/extraction-schema-compile-check.ts --model claude-sonnet-5-5`
with the TESTING key - five tiny calls (a control, the extraction schema, the grader schema, the ranking
schema with the landlord card switch off and on); it exits 1 when one fails to compile. The check sends
through the extraction client with thinking off; the ranking request itself (adaptive thinking, effort)
is proven by the counterfactual check, whose every call would fail on a schema that does not compile.
A change to the ranking schema's ENUMS (a source, a requirement key - `REQUIREMENT_UNIT_KEYS` flows into
them - or a flag field) also bumps `RUBRIC_VERSION` (`app/src/services/ranking/rubric.ts`): the
version is what marks every stored match out of date, and the prompt fingerprint each ranking run
records (sha256 over the system text and the schema sent) changes with it. Re-run the counterfactual
check after such a change. The compile check CANNOT validate `claude-opus-5-5`: it compiles through
extraction's thinking-off client and that model takes no thinking-off form (the grammar limit is per
model), so an opus ranking model is validated only by the counterfactual check's run on it.
```

### Task S4.11 - Version pins: the bytes the model sees are tied to their versions (PR32, R2F3)

Goal: PR32 as tightened by R2F3 - the pins cover the BYTES AS SENT, never a
re-sorted serialization: sha256 of `RUBRIC_TEXT`, of the framing strings
(`PROMPT_FRAMING`: the direction lines, the instruction line, `INPUT:`, the
examples heading, the `EXAMPLE n:` prefix, `OUTPUT:`) and of both schemas
as the SDK sends them (`JSON.stringify`, insertion order) beside
`RUBRIC_VERSION`; of the rendered examples text (`renderExamplesText()`)
beside `EXAMPLES_VERSION`; and of the whole rendered system text
(`buildRankingSystemPrompt()`) beside the version pair. A change without a
bump fails with a message naming the version to bump. Bumping is Cameron's
decision (a new version marks every stored match out of date, spec D9); the
builder never bumps a version to make this test pass.

Files:
- Test: create `app/test/rankingVersionPins.test.ts`

#### Step 1 - failing test

Create `app/test/rankingVersionPins.test.ts` exactly as below. The six
`'PIN-ME'` values are the deliberate RED; Step 3 replaces each with the hex
the print command gives.

```ts
// WP1 B2a PR32 / R2F3: the bytes the model sees are tied to the versions
// every match records. Each pin hashes text EXACTLY AS SENT (no re-sorted
// serialization): the rubric, the framing strings and both schemas pin to
// RUBRIC_VERSION, the rendered worked examples to EXAMPLES_VERSION, and the
// whole rendered system text to the pair. If one of these fails, the prompt
// changed: ask Cameron to bump the named version (it marks every stored match
// out of date, spec D9), then add the new version's pin here. Never update a
// pin under an unchanged version.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { EXAMPLES_VERSION } from '../src/services/ranking/examples.js';
import { PROMPT_FRAMING, buildRankingSystemPrompt, renderExamplesText } from '../src/services/ranking/prompt.js';
import { RUBRIC_TEXT, RUBRIC_VERSION } from '../src/services/ranking/rubric.js';
import { rankingSchema } from '../src/services/ranking/schema.js';

const RUBRIC_PINS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = { r1: 'PIN-ME' };
const FRAMING_PINS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = { r1: 'PIN-ME' };
const SCHEMA_PINS: Readonly<Record<string, { off: string; on: string }>> = { r1: { off: 'PIN-ME', on: 'PIN-ME' } };
const EXAMPLES_PINS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = { e1: 'PIN-ME' };
const SYSTEM_PINS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = { 'r1/e1': 'PIN-ME' };

const sha256 = (text: string): string => createHash('sha256').update(text, 'utf8').digest('hex');

describe('the prompt bytes are pinned to their versions (PR32, R2F3)', () => {
  it('RUBRIC_TEXT matches its RUBRIC_VERSION pin', () => {
    expect(sha256(RUBRIC_TEXT), `RUBRIC_TEXT changed: bump RUBRIC_VERSION (now ${RUBRIC_VERSION}) and add its pin`).toBe(RUBRIC_PINS[RUBRIC_VERSION]);
  });

  it('the framing strings (direction lines, instruction, INPUT:, examples heading, EXAMPLE n:, OUTPUT:) match their RUBRIC_VERSION pin', () => {
    expect(sha256(JSON.stringify(PROMPT_FRAMING)), `the prompt framing changed: bump RUBRIC_VERSION (now ${RUBRIC_VERSION}) and add its pin`).toBe(FRAMING_PINS[RUBRIC_VERSION]);
  });

  it('the ranking schema as sent, landlord switch off and on, matches its RUBRIC_VERSION pins', () => {
    const pins = SCHEMA_PINS[RUBRIC_VERSION];
    expect(pins, `no schema pins for ${RUBRIC_VERSION}: add them beside the rubric pin`).toBeDefined();
    expect(sha256(JSON.stringify(rankingSchema({ landlordCard: false }))), `the ranking schema (switch off) changed: bump RUBRIC_VERSION (now ${RUBRIC_VERSION}) and add its pins`).toBe(pins?.off);
    expect(sha256(JSON.stringify(rankingSchema({ landlordCard: true }))), `the ranking schema (switch on) changed: bump RUBRIC_VERSION (now ${RUBRIC_VERSION}) and add its pins`).toBe(pins?.on);
  });

  it('the rendered worked examples match their EXAMPLES_VERSION pin', () => {
    expect(sha256(renderExamplesText()), `the worked examples as rendered changed: bump EXAMPLES_VERSION (now ${EXAMPLES_VERSION}) and add its pin`).toBe(EXAMPLES_PINS[EXAMPLES_VERSION]);
  });

  it('the whole rendered system text matches the pin of its version pair', () => {
    const pair = `${RUBRIC_VERSION}/${EXAMPLES_VERSION}`;
    expect(sha256(buildRankingSystemPrompt()), `the system text changed: bump RUBRIC_VERSION or EXAMPLES_VERSION (whichever part changed; now ${pair}) and add the pin`).toBe(SYSTEM_PINS[pair]);
  });
});
```

S5 builds the ranking JOB, server side, end to end on the fake driver:

- `ranking.updated` (spec D12, event half): `RankingUpdatedEvent` in
  `AppEventMap` and `ALL_APP_EVENTS` (`app/src/lib/events.ts`), the SSE
  handler's listener pair in `app/src/routes/api.ts` (`GET /api/events`),
  and the worker-to-app bridge, which needs NO code (it iterates
  `APP_EVENT_NAMES`, `app/src/lib/eventBridge.ts:45`; the app side validates
  against the same list, `app/src/routes/internal.ts:34`) - only the pinned
  name count in `app/test/eventBridge.test.ts` moves.
- `app/src/services/ranking/flags.ts` (spec D10): the text hash, the OPEN
  check S6 uses, the reason pick, the job-wide merge across batches.
- `app/src/services/ranking/job.ts` (spec D7): the press's claim
  (`claimRanking`: S2's conditional `putJobClaim`, read, retry once, join,
  409), the job view with derived `expired` and the `notScored` list
  (PR13), the in-process job slots, `rankAnchor` (lease renewal every
  lease/3, the generation check, the pool, unreadable candidates, batches
  in pool order with `RANKING_BATCH_CONCURRENCY`, never throws, a pool of
  zero) and `runDueRankings` (queue expiry and its mark-failed step, claims,
  takeover once, the second expiry through `markLeaseFailed`, the
  in-process `RANKING_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS` counter under overlapping ticks,
  the FRESH `runWithContext` carrying the press's `requestId` and
  `traceparent`).
- `app/src/services/ranking/runBatch.ts` (spec D7 batch, D8 writes and the
  D8.1 snapshot, D10 raising): one batch's prompt (with `batchIndex` and
  `landlordCard`, PR19), model call, run record, match rows,
  `matchesWritten` (`{ count, at }`, PR15), flag writes, progress (with
  `notScored` for omitted candidates, PR13) and event.
- `app/src/services/ranking/runLog.ts` (spec D11): the ranking run input -
  every field, `results[]` with the merged `missing` (PR14) and
  `cappedAtRun` from `capOf`, cost, `environment`; S2's `putRun` adds the
  key, the kind and the 350 KB guard (IR29).
- `app/src/services/ranking/jobWiring.ts` (PR27): the one deps builder the
  worker and the dev tick share.
- `app/src/worker.ts`: the ranking poll through the worker's `startPoll`
  wrapper, always started except under `RANKING_WORKER_POLL=off`.
- `app/src/routes/dev.ts`: `POST /__dev/ranking/tick`.
- `scripts/e2e-session.mjs`: `RANKING_DRIVER=fake` and
  `RANKING_WORKER_POLL=off` in the `childEnv` both children inherit.
- Test helpers (PR27) `app/test/helpers/rankingJobFixtures.ts` and
  `app/test/helpers/rankingRunsFake.ts` (S6 reuses both).

S5 does NOT build: the rank / read / job endpoints, roles and rate limit
(S6); the read and its derivations (S6); the admin runs / run detail / cost
API (S6); `EventStreamProvider` and every dashboard surface (S7); every e2e
spec (S7, PR9); the repositories (S2); the gatherer, the anchor-exists rule
and `mapWithConcurrency` (S3, PR21); the prompt, drivers, parse, cap, bands,
cost (S4); config and its production refusals (S2); docs and env examples
(S8).

### 9.1 Contradictions (spec or plan head vs the tree) and the resolution used

1. Spec D7 "its own `startPoll('ranking', ...)` in worker.ts": the tree has
   TWO `startPoll`s - the module function `app/src/jobs/pollLoop.ts:55` and
   worker.ts's local wrapper bound to the shared interval
   (`app/src/worker.ts:292-298`). The draft calls the wrapper, as the
   extraction poll does (`app/src/worker.ts:508`): the ranking poll runs on
   `WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS` with `bootContext` as its base. Ticks are an
   unref'd `setInterval` that never awaits (`app/src/jobs/pollLoop.ts:63-76`).
2. Spec D7 "the limit is an in-process counter ... incremented on a
   successful claim": with overlapping ticks, counting only after the awaited
   conditional claim lets two ticks both see a free slot. The draft RESERVES
   a slot before the claim and releases it when the claim loses; settled,
   the counter equals the jobs this process runs. Same bound, enforced.
3. The SSE handler is the `GET /events` route inside `createApiRouter`
   (`app/src/routes/api.ts:2731-2847`), one hand-written listener pair per
   event. S5 edits that block only (PR27).
4. `app/test/eventBridge.test.ts:42-44` pins `APP_EVENT_NAMES` at 10; the
   new event makes it 11 (PR27).
5. The event's `batchesDone` is a COUNT of finished batches (scored or
   failed: distinct indexes over the record's `batchesDone` and
   `failedBatches`); the record keeps the lists (IR27, S7 types it a number).
6. Not-scored candidates outside a failed call (PR13): an omitted candidate
   and an unreadable one go to the record's `notScored` list
   (`{ candidateId, reason: 'omitted' | 'unreadable' }`); `failedBatches`
   holds failed CALLS only. The job's final message counts both kinds.
7. Spec D10's flag `reason` is "the model's against-reason or unknown text
   naming it". "Naming it" is read as: the first `against` text, else the
   first `unknowns` text, whose case-folded text contains the field key with
   underscores as spaces (a `landlord:<key>` flag by `<key>`); otherwise the
   default sentence.
8. `matchesWritten` is S2's `{ count, at }` (PR15), set by
   `markMatchesWritten` after the batch's match write.
9. PR3 gives `runDueRankings(...): Promise<void>`. The draft returns a
   `RankingPollSummary` (`{ expired, claimed, tookOver, failedStale }`) that
   the dev tick reports; `void` callers are unaffected.
10. AGENTS.md "new automated user-facing copy goes through the message
    catalog": the catalog holds messages SENT to people
    (`app/src/messages/catalog.ts`); the job's messages are staff-facing
    page text, exported constants in `job.ts`.
11. A takeover (S2 `takeOver`) resets the progress fields and `notScored`
    and KEEPS `runIds` (IR23: the dead attempt's runs are real).
12. The progress write carries no `message` (S2 `RankingJobProgress`,
    IR2): the "N tenants could not be read" text reaches the record through
    `finishJob`'s message when the job ends.
13. A thrown `RankingPromptError` (S4: a referenced home missing from
    `homes`) fails its batch with `failure: 'driver'`; no model call was
    made, so no run is written (IR34).
14. `costUsd` (S4) answers 0 for `fake` / `console` and THROWS for an
    unpriced billed model; startup refuses such a model (S2), so the throw
    is unreachable in a booted process (IR35). A throw would surface as the
    batch's `failure: 'error'`.
15. Verified as stated: `CorrelationContext.traceparent`
    (`app/src/lib/context.ts:50-51`); `runWithContext` REPLACES the store with
    a copy of the given context (`app/src/lib/context.ts:56-58`), so a job
    started with `{ requestId, traceparent }` carries no `pollRunId`; the
    logger's ladder `jobRunId ?? pollRunId ?? requestId ?? bootId`
    (`app/src/lib/logger.ts:248`); envelopes take `currentTraceparent()`
    (`app/src/jobs/jobs.ts:192`) and `dispatchJob` restores it
    (`app/src/jobs/jobs.ts:309-316`); `EXTRACTION_DRIVER: 'fake'`
    (`scripts/e2e-session.mjs:258`) inside the `childEnv` both children get
    (`:140-339`, `spawnNode` :388, app :461, worker :464); the dev router is
    mounted ahead of the origin-secret validator only when supplied
    (`app/src/app.ts:131`).
16. The ranking tick takes no body (the extraction tick precedent,
    `app/src/routes/dev.ts:785-791`): a ranking job is due at once.
17. PR36 / R2B5: a generation check whose `getJob` throws is retried
    once, after a 500 ms pause (`deps.sleep`, injectable); a second throw
    finishes the job `failed` (MSG_ERROR) through `finishJob`, which S2
    conditions on `running` AND the generation, and the job stops (its slot
    is released by `startClaimedJob`'s `finally`). There is NO guard read
    before the final `finishJob('done')`: that write is itself
    generation-conditioned, so a guard-read failure after every batch has
    written can never turn a fully scored job into `failed`. A `putRun`
    that throws after the model call is caught: the batch is recorded
    failed with the CALL's own failure kind when the call failed (R2B7),
    `'repo'` only when the call succeeded, and the run's model, usage, cost
    and call failure go to the error log line so the spend is never
    invisible.
18. BA6: `markMatchesWritten` is a write, so it has its own generation
    check (spec D7 "before every ... write").
19. PR37 (S2's shape): `putMatches` returns `{ written, unwritten }` and
    never throws on a DynamoDB failure. The rows that landed stay (they are
    this run's real scores); when `unwritten` is non-empty the batch's
    `failedBatches` entry lists ONLY the candidates whose rows are not
    confirmed written (R2F5: a BatchWrite chunk that threw may still have
    applied, so "unwritten" means "not confirmed written") with failure
    `'repo'` (S2's ruling text; the revision-2 `'match_write'` kind is
    gone). `markMatchesWritten` gets `{ count: written, at }` whenever
    `written > 0` (a count that may read low by the same rule). A
    `putMatches` THROW (S2: a non-schema-2 row, a bug) is caught so the job
    never throws: the whole batch is failed `'repo'` and nothing is
    stamped.
    PR37 departs from spec D8's "its candidates get no new match" and is
    listed for Cameron, with R2F5's "not confirmed written" case.
20. PR38 / PR43: an anchor of EITHER kind whose own reads fail AFTER its
    pool was computed (S3 sets `AnchorUnreadable.candidateIds`: a tenant's
    seen set; a property's landlord read, switch on) finishes `done` with
    every pool candidate in `notScored` (`unreadable`) and the message
    "Could not read this tenant's record. Press Rank again." or "Could not
    read this property's record. Press Rank again.". An `anchor_unreadable`
    with no `candidateIds` (the anchor failed before any pool) still fails
    the job with the gatherer's message.
22. PR42 (R2F4, R2B4): `failedBatches` holds every batch that left
    candidates without a new match through a FAILURE - the model call, the
    run write or the match write - each entry listing exactly the
    candidates that got no match and its kind. A failed batch outcome
    carries `unscored` (that entry's count), `omitted` and `written`, so a
    partially written batch keeps its omitted count. The job message counts
    CANDIDATES: "N tenants could not be scored." (a failed call, a prompt
    that could not be built, an errored batch) and "N scores could not be
    saved." (`'repo'`), beside the unreadable and omitted sentences - never
    "M of K batches". A batch whose call succeeded and some of whose rows
    landed (`written > 0`) is in `batchesDone` AND in `failedBatches` (the
    latter listing only the not-confirmed candidates); a batch with no row
    written is in `failedBatches` only. `finishedBatchCount` (and S7's)
    de-dups indexes, so the event's `batchesDone` never exceeds
    `batchCount`.
23. R2F6: `POST /__dev/ranking/tick` is mounted only when
    `isLocalDynamoTarget(config.dynamodbEndpoint)` (S2.1). The dev router's
    own gate (`app/src/lib/devRoutes.ts:19`) accepts ANY non-empty
    endpoint, and the tick's lazily built deps take S2's real-table
    defaults (the anthropic driver), so without this a laptop with
    `DEV_AUTH_ENABLED` and a non-local endpoint could run the real model on
    real tables. Elsewhere it is absent (404).
21. PR30 (worker side): outside production on REAL tables (no local
    `DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT`) S2's config defaults `RANKING_WORKER_POLL` to off,
    so the worker block below starts no poll there; worker.ts needs no rule
    of its own. Tests that take the fake driver from `loadConfig` pass
    BOTH `DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT: 'http://localhost:8000'` AND
    `RANKING_DRIVER: 'fake'` (S2: `fake` alone now refuses on real
    tables). The hermetic lane is unaffected: `scripts/e2e-session.mjs`
    hands both children a local `DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT` (DynamoDB Local).

```ts
// UnverifiedCandidate values built with every field and no cast, so the

export function assembled(

export type PromptInput = Parameters<typeof buildRankingPrompt>[0];

/** What the stub prompt hands the stub driver: the batch's candidate ids in order. */
export interface StubBatchInput {
  candidateIds: string[];
  batchIndex: number;
  landlordCard: boolean;
}

/** Stands in for prompt.ts's buildRankingPrompt: handles c1..cn in batch order (IR14). */
export function stubBuildPrompt(input: PromptInput): RankingPrompt {
  const handles = input.candidates.map((c, i) => ({ handle: `c${i + 1}`, candidateId: c.candidateId, display: c.display }));
  const batch: StubBatchInput = {
    candidateIds: input.candidates.map((c) => c.candidateId),
    batchIndex: input.batchIndex,
    landlordCard: input.landlordCard,
  };
  return {
    batchInput: batch as unknown as RankingBatchInput,
    userText: JSON.stringify({ candidates: handles }),
    promptFingerprint: 'fp-test',
    handles,
    snapshotOf: (candidateId: string) => ({ candidateId, anchorCard: 'as sent' }) as unknown as RankingPairSnapshot,
  };
}

/** A prompt builder that throws S4's RankingPromptError for a batch holding `candidateId`. */
export function throwingBuildPrompt(candidateId: string): (input: PromptInput) => RankingPrompt {
  return (input) => {
    if (input.candidates.some((c) => c.candidateId === candidateId)) {
      throw new RankingPromptError('stub: a referenced seen home is not in homes');
    }
    return stubBuildPrompt(input);
  };
}

export interface StubDriverOptions {
  /** A failure kind for this batch (by its candidate ids), or undefined to score it. */
  failFor?: (candidateIds: string[]) => 'refusal' | 'parse' | 'truncated' | 'timeout' | 'driver' | undefined;
  /** Candidates the model "does not return". */
  omit?: readonly string[];
  /** The parsed result per candidate; parsed() otherwise. */
  resultFor?: (candidateId: string) => ParsedCandidate;
  /** Awaited before answering (hold a batch in flight). */
  gate?: () => Promise<void>;
  /** A contract break: the driver throws for this batch. */
  throwFor?: (candidateIds: string[]) => boolean;
  model?: string;
}

export interface StubDriver extends RankingDriver {
  calls: string[][];
  inputs: StubBatchInput[];
  inFlight(): number;
  maxInFlight(): number;
}

export function stubDriver(opts: StubDriverOptions = {}): StubDriver {
  const calls: string[][] = [];
  const inputs: StubBatchInput[] = [];
  let inFlight = 0;
  let max = 0;
  return {
    kind: 'fake',
    calls,
    inputs,
    inFlight: () => inFlight,
    maxInFlight: () => max,
    async rankBatch(input) {
      const batch = input as unknown as StubBatchInput;
      const ids = batch.candidateIds;
      calls.push(ids);
      inputs.push(batch);
      inFlight += 1;
      max = Math.max(max, inFlight);
      try {
        if (opts.gate !== undefined) await opts.gate();
        if (opts.throwFor?.(ids) === true) throw new Error('stub driver exploded');
        const meta: RankingCallMeta = {
          driver: 'fake',
          model: opts.model ?? 'fake',
          rawText: '{"candidates":[]}',
          usage: { inputTokens: 1000, outputTokens: 500 },
          latencyMs: 7,
        };
        const failure = opts.failFor?.(ids);
        if (failure !== undefined) return { ok: false, meta, failure, message: `stub ${failure}` };
        const byHandle = new Map<string, ParsedCandidate>();
        ids.forEach((id, i) => {
          if (!(opts.omit ?? []).includes(id)) byHandle.set(`c${i + 1}`, opts.resultFor?.(id) ?? parsed());
        });
        return { ok: true, meta, output: { byHandle, droppedUnlawfulFlags: 0 } };
      } finally {
        inFlight -= 1;
      }
    },
  };
}

export function deferred(): { promise: Promise<void>; resolve: () => void } {
  let resolve: () => void = () => undefined;
  const promise = new Promise<void>((r) => {
    resolve = r;
  });
  return { promise, resolve };
}

/** Let every pending promise continuation run. */
export async function flush(times = 20): Promise<void> {
  for (let i = 0; i < times; i += 1) await new Promise((r) => setImmediate(r));
}

export function queuedJob(over: Partial<RankingJobRecord> = {}): RankingJobRecord {
  const anchorKind = over.anchorKind ?? 'unit';
  const anchorId = over.anchorId ?? (anchorKind === 'unit' ? ANCHOR_UNIT : ANCHOR_TENANT);
  const requestedAt = over.requestedAt ?? T0;
  return {
    itemId: rankingJobItemId(anchorKind, anchorId),
    anchorKind,
    anchorId,
    status: 'queued',
    generation: 'gen-1',
    includeOlder: false,
    requestedBy: 'usr-1',
    requestedAt,
    requestId: PRESS_REQUEST_ID,
    traceparent: PRESS_TRACEPARENT,
    attempts: 0,
    queuedExpiresAt: new Date(Date.parse(requestedAt) + 600_000).toISOString(),
    batchesDone: [],
    failedBatches: [],
    notScored: [],
    runIds: [],
    expires_at: Math.floor(Date.parse(requestedAt) / 1000) + TTL_DAYS * 86_400,
    entityKey: 'rankjobs#queued',
    sortKey: requestedAt,
    ...over,
  };
}

export function runningJob(over: Partial<RankingJobRecord> = {}): RankingJobRecord {
  const leaseExpiresAt = over.leaseExpiresAt ?? isoAt(90_000);
  return queuedJob({
    status: 'running',
    startedAt: T0,
    leaseExpiresAt,
    entityKey: 'rankjobs#running',
    sortKey: leaseExpiresAt,
    ...over,
  });
}

export function matchRow(over: Partial<MatchRow> & { tenantId: string; unitId: string }): MatchRow {
  return {
    schema: 2,
    score: 72,
    for: [],
    against: [],
    missing: [],
    failedRequirements: [],
    fairHousingFlags: [],
    stage: 1,
    rubricVersion: RUBRIC_VERSION,
    examplesVersion: EXAMPLES_VERSION,
    promptFingerprint: 'fp-test',
    model: 'fake',
    runId: 'run-old',
    jobGeneration: 'gen-0',
    computedAt: isoAt(-DAY_MS),
    anchorSide: 'unit',
    fingerprints: { tenantCard: `tc-${over.tenantId}`, unitCard: 'uc-anchor', pairHistory: `ph-${over.tenantId}` },
    inputSnapshot: '',
    expires_at: 0,
    ...over,
  };
}

/** A stored flag record (S2 builds the keys from the input the same way). */
export function flagRecord(input: UnlawfulFlagInput): UnlawfulFlagRecord {
  return {
    ...input,
    itemId: unlawfulFlagItemId(input.unitId, input.field),
    entityKey: unlawfulFlagEntityKey(input.unitId),
    sortKey: input.field,
  };
}

export function rankingRun(over: Partial<RankingRunRecord> = {}): RankingRunRecord {
  const runId = over.runId ?? 'run-1';
  return {
    itemId: rankingRunItemId(runId),
    runId,
    kind: 'ranking',
    anchorKind: 'unit',
    anchorId: ANCHOR_UNIT,
```

```ts
// Unlawful fair-housing flags as PROPERTY records (WP1 B2a spec D10; charter
// 7.2). The ranking job raises them (runBatch.ts); the read (readRanking.ts)
// and the run detail (routes/adminRankings.ts) ask whether each is still
// OPEN. Open is derived on read, never stored: the flagged field is on the
// property's CURRENT card and its trimmed text there still hashes to the
// stored textHash. So no unit writer knows about flags - an edit to the text
// closes one by construction, and a `landlord:<key>` flag closes when the
// landlord default leaves the card (switch off, or the property now records
// its own value). A closed record is replaced if the model raises it again
// (rankingRunsRepo.putFlagIfAbsentOrClosed, conditioned on the hash).
//
// Dismissal (dismissedAt / dismissedBy / textAtDismiss) is B4's and is
// DISPLAY-ONLY (charter 7.2): it never closes a flag here, so the cap stays
// suppressed while the text stands.
//
// Accommodation flags are never property records: they stay on the pair's
// match only.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import type { UnlawfulFlagInput, UnlawfulFlagRecord } from '../../repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import type { ParsedCandidate } from './parse.js';

export const DEFAULT_FLAG_REASON = 'flagged as a requirement fair housing does not allow';

/** sha256 hex of the field's TRIMMED text - the stamp a flag is raised with. */
export function textHashOf(text: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(text.trim(), 'utf8').digest('hex');
}

/** The trimmed card text of a field, or undefined when the card holds none. */
function cardText(freeTextByField: Readonly<Record<string, string>>, field: string): string | undefined {
  const raw = freeTextByField[field];
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return undefined;
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : undefined;
}

/** D10 "open": the field is on the current card and its text still hashes to textHash. */
export function isFlagOpen(
  flag: Pick<UnlawfulFlagRecord, 'field' | 'textHash'>,
  freeTextByField: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
): boolean {
  const text = cardText(freeTextByField, flag.field);
  return text !== undefined && textHashOf(text) === flag.textHash;
}

export function openFlags(
  records: readonly UnlawfulFlagRecord[],
  freeTextByField: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
): UnlawfulFlagRecord[] {
  return records.filter((record) => isFlagOpen(record, freeTextByField));
}

/** The fields of the open records, each once, in record order. */
export function openFlagFields(
  records: readonly UnlawfulFlagRecord[],
  freeTextByField: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
): string[] {
  return [...new Set(openFlags(records, freeTextByField).map((record) => record.field))];
}

function fieldWords(field: string): string {
  const key = field.startsWith('landlord:') ? field.slice('landlord:'.length) : field;
  return key.replace(/_/g, ' ').toLowerCase();
}

function folded(text: string): string {
  return text.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

/**
 * D10's reason: the model's against-reason, else its unknown, whose text names
 * the field (the field key with underscores as spaces, case and spacing
 * folded; a landlord: flag by its plain key), else the default sentence.
 */
export function flagReason(field: string, result: Pick<ParsedCandidate, 'against' | 'unknowns'>): string {
  const words = fieldWords(field);
  const against = result.against.find((reason) => folded(reason.text).includes(words));
  if (against !== undefined) return against.text;
  const unknown = result.unknowns.find((text) => folded(text).includes(words));
  if (unknown !== undefined) return unknown;
  return DEFAULT_FLAG_REASON;
}

/**
 * The job-wide merge (D10: "merged across a job's batches by property and
 * field"). `raised` is the job's map, keyed `${unitId}#${field}`; the FIRST
 * raising run keeps its entry. Returns only the flags this call newly added -
 * the ones the calling batch writes. A field that holds no text on the card is
 * skipped (parse already drops such a flag and counts it; this keeps a record
 * from ever carrying the hash of nothing).
 */
export function mergeRaisedFlags(
  raised: Map<string, UnlawfulFlagInput>,
  scored: Array<{ unitId: string; freeTextByField: Readonly<Record<string, string>>; result: ParsedCandidate }>,
  run: { runId: string; raisedAt: string },
): UnlawfulFlagInput[] {
  const added: UnlawfulFlagInput[] = [];
  for (const { unitId, freeTextByField, result } of scored) {
    for (const flag of result.fairHousingFlags) {
      if (flag.kind !== 'unlawful') continue;
      const key = `${unitId}#${flag.field}`;
      if (raised.has(key)) continue;
      const text = cardText(freeTextByField, flag.field);
      if (text === undefined) continue;
      const entry: UnlawfulFlagInput = {
        unitId,
        field: flag.field,
        textHash: textHashOf(text),
        reason: flagReason(flag.field, result),
        runId: run.runId,
        raisedAt: run.raisedAt,
      };
      raised.set(key, entry);
      added.push(entry);
    }
  }
  return added;
}
```

```ts
// In-memory stand-ins for S2's ranking job store (rankingRunsRepo) and
// matches store (matchesRepo), with S2's SIGNATURES (IR2) and the CONDITIONS
// the real writes carry - status and generation on every job write, the
// expiry on the claim and the mark-failed step, the lease and the attempt
// count on a takeover and a second expiry, the text hash on a flag write -
// because the job's correctness under overlapping ticks rests on exactly
// those conditions. Each method body runs without an await, so a condition
// and its write are atomic here as in DynamoDB. rankingJob.integration.test.ts
// runs the same flows against the real repositories.
import {
  rankingJobItemId,
  rankingRunItemId,
  unlawfulFlagEntityKey,
  unlawfulFlagItemId,
  withRankingRunSizeGuard,
  type RankingJobRecord,
  type RankingJobRef,
  type RankingRunRecord,
  type RankingRunsRepo,
  type UnlawfulFlagRecord,
} from '../../src/repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import {
  matchPairKey,
  type MatchPairKey,
  type MatchRow,
  type MatchesRepo,
} from '../../src/repos/matchesRepo.js';

export type RankingRunsApi = Pick<
  RankingRunsRepo,
  | 'getJob'
  | 'putJobClaim'
  | 'listQueued'
  | 'listExpiredLeases'
  | 'claimQueued'
  | 'takeOver'
  | 'markLeaseFailed'
  | 'renewLease'
  | 'markExpiredQueued'
  | 'updateJobProgress'
  | 'finishJob'
  | 'putRun'
  | 'markMatchesWritten'
  | 'getRun'
  | 'getOpenCandidateFlags'
  | 'putFlagIfAbsentOrClosed'
>;

export interface RankingRunsFake {
  repo: RankingRunsApi;
  jobs: Map<string, RankingJobRecord>;
  runs: Map<string, RankingRunRecord>;
  flags: Map<string, UnlawfulFlagRecord>;
  /** Called first in every getJob - the race seam. */
  onGetJob?: () => void;
  /** Every write, in order, as `<method>:<detail>`. */
  writes: string[];
}

const clone = <T>(value: T): T => structuredClone(value);
const ms = (iso: string): number => Date.parse(iso);

export function createRankingRunsFake(): RankingRunsFake {
  const jobs = new Map<string, RankingJobRecord>();
  const runs = new Map<string, RankingRunRecord>();
  const flags = new Map<string, UnlawfulFlagRecord>();
  const writes: string[] = [];
  const fake = { jobs, runs, flags, writes } as RankingRunsFake;
  const at = (ref: Pick<RankingJobRef, 'anchorKind' | 'anchorId'>): RankingJobRecord | undefined =>
    jobs.get(rankingJobItemId(ref.anchorKind, ref.anchorId));
  const live = (ref: RankingJobRef): RankingJobRecord | undefined => {
    const current = at(ref);
    return current !== undefined && current.status === 'running' && current.generation === ref.generation ? current : undefined;
  };
  const dropIndexKeys = (record: RankingJobRecord): void => {
    delete record.entityKey;
    delete record.sortKey;
  };
  fake.repo = {
    async getJob(anchorKind, anchorId) {
      fake.onGetJob?.();
      const current = jobs.get(rankingJobItemId(anchorKind, anchorId));
      return current === undefined ? undefined : clone(current);
    },
    async putJobClaim(claim) {
      const itemId = rankingJobItemId(claim.anchorKind, claim.anchorId);
      const current = jobs.get(itemId);
      const claimable =
        current === undefined ||
        current.status === 'done' ||
        current.status === 'failed' ||
        (current.status === 'queued' && ms(current.queuedExpiresAt) <= ms(claim.requestedAt));
      if (!claimable) return { ok: false };
      const job: RankingJobRecord = {
        itemId,
        anchorKind: claim.anchorKind,
        anchorId: claim.anchorId,
        status: 'queued',
        generation: claim.generation,
        includeOlder: claim.includeOlder,
        requestedBy: claim.requestedBy,
        requestedAt: claim.requestedAt,
        requestId: claim.requestId,
        ...(claim.traceparent !== undefined && { traceparent: claim.traceparent }),
        attempts: 0,
        queuedExpiresAt: claim.queuedExpiresAt,
        batchesDone: [],
        failedBatches: [],
        notScored: [],
        runIds: [],
        expires_at: claim.expiresAt,
        entityKey: 'rankjobs#queued',
        sortKey: claim.requestedAt,
      };
      jobs.set(itemId, job);
      writes.push(`putJobClaim:${claim.generation}`);
      return { ok: true, job: clone(job) };
    },
    async listQueued(limit) {
      return [...jobs.values()]
        .filter((r) => r.entityKey === 'rankjobs#queued')
        .sort((a, b) => a.requestedAt.localeCompare(b.requestedAt))
        .slice(0, limit)
        .map(clone);
    },
    async listExpiredLeases(nowIso, limit) {
      return [...jobs.values()]
        .filter((r) => r.entityKey === 'rankjobs#running' && r.leaseExpiresAt !== undefined && ms(r.leaseExpiresAt) < ms(nowIso))
        .slice(0, limit)
        .map(clone);
    },
    async claimQueued(ref, opts) {
      const current = at(ref);
      if (
        current === undefined ||
        current.status !== 'queued' ||
        current.generation !== ref.generation ||
        ms(current.queuedExpiresAt) <= ms(opts.nowIso)
      ) {
        return undefined;
      }
      Object.assign(current, {
        status: 'running',
        startedAt: opts.nowIso,
        leaseExpiresAt: opts.leaseExpiresAt,
        entityKey: 'rankjobs#running',
        sortKey: opts.leaseExpiresAt,
      });
      writes.push(`claimQueued:${current.generation}`);
      return clone(current);
    },
    async takeOver(ref, opts) {
      const current = live(ref);
      if (
        current === undefined ||
        current.leaseExpiresAt === undefined ||
        ms(current.leaseExpiresAt) > ms(opts.nowIso) ||
        current.attempts >= 1
      ) {
        return undefined;
      }
      Object.assign(current, {
        generation: opts.newGeneration,
        attempts: current.attempts + 1,
        startedAt: opts.nowIso,
        leaseExpiresAt: opts.leaseExpiresAt,
        sortKey: opts.leaseExpiresAt,
        batchesDone: [],
        failedBatches: [],
        notScored: [],
      });
      // runIds are KEPT (S2: the dead attempt's runs happened, IR23).
      delete current.poolSize;
      delete current.batchCount;
      delete current.message;
      writes.push(`takeOver:${opts.newGeneration}`);
      return clone(current);
    },
    async markLeaseFailed(ref, opts) {
      const current = live(ref);
      if (
        current === undefined ||
        current.leaseExpiresAt === undefined ||
        ms(current.leaseExpiresAt) > ms(opts.nowIso) ||
        current.attempts < 1
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      Object.assign(current, { status: 'failed', message: opts.message, finishedAt: opts.nowIso });
      dropIndexKeys(current);
      writes.push(`markLeaseFailed:${current.generation}`);
      return true;
    },
    async renewLease(ref, leaseExpiresAt) {
      const current = live(ref);
      if (current === undefined) return false;
      current.leaseExpiresAt = leaseExpiresAt;
      current.sortKey = leaseExpiresAt;
      writes.push(`renewLease:${leaseExpiresAt}`);
      return true;
    },
    async markExpiredQueued(ref, opts) {
      const current = at(ref);
      if (
        current === undefined ||
        current.status !== 'queued' ||
        current.generation !== ref.generation ||
        ms(current.queuedExpiresAt) > ms(opts.nowIso)
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      Object.assign(current, { status: 'failed', message: opts.message, finishedAt: opts.nowIso });
      dropIndexKeys(current);
      writes.push(`markExpiredQueued:${current.generation}`);
      return true;
    },
    async updateJobProgress(ref, progress) {
      const current = live(ref);
      if (current === undefined) return undefined;
      if (progress.poolSize !== undefined) current.poolSize = progress.poolSize;
      if (progress.batchCount !== undefined) current.batchCount = progress.batchCount;
      if (progress.batchDone !== undefined) current.batchesDone = [...current.batchesDone, progress.batchDone];
      if (progress.failedBatch !== undefined) current.failedBatches = [...current.failedBatches, progress.failedBatch];
      if (progress.notScored !== undefined) current.notScored = [...current.notScored, ...progress.notScored];
      if (progress.runIds !== undefined) current.runIds = [...current.runIds, ...progress.runIds];
      writes.push(`updateJobProgress:${JSON.stringify(progress)}`);
      return clone(current);
    },
    async finishJob(ref, outcome) {
      const current = live(ref);
      if (current === undefined) return undefined;
      current.status = outcome.status;
      current.finishedAt = outcome.finishedAt;
      if (outcome.message !== undefined) current.message = outcome.message;
      dropIndexKeys(current);
      writes.push(`finishJob:${outcome.status}`);
      return clone(current);
    },
    async putRun(input) {
      const record = withRankingRunSizeGuard({ ...input, itemId: rankingRunItemId(input.runId), kind: 'ranking' });
      runs.set(record.runId, clone(record));
      writes.push(`putRun:${record.runId}`);
      return clone(record);
    },
    async markMatchesWritten(runId, written) {
      const run = runs.get(runId);
      if (run === undefined) return false;
      run.matchesWritten = written;
      writes.push(`markMatchesWritten:${runId}:${written.count}`);
      return true;
    },
    async getRun(runId) {
      const run = runs.get(runId);
      return run === undefined ? undefined : clone(run);
    },
    async getOpenCandidateFlags(unitId) {
      return [...flags.values()].filter((f) => f.unitId === unitId).map(clone);
    },
    async putFlagIfAbsentOrClosed(input) {
      const itemId = unlawfulFlagItemId(input.unitId, input.field);
      const current = flags.get(itemId);
      if (current !== undefined && current.textHash === input.textHash) return false;
      flags.set(itemId, { ...input, itemId, entityKey: unlawfulFlagEntityKey(input.unitId), sortKey: input.field });
      writes.push(`putFlag:${itemId}:${input.runId}`);
      return true;
    },
  };
  return fake;
}

export interface MatchesFake {
  repo: Pick<MatchesRepo, 'putMatches' | 'getPairs'>;
  rows: Map<string, MatchRow>;
  /** Make every putMatches THROW (S2: only a programming error does; S5 still must not throw). */
  failPuts: boolean;
  /** PR37: these pairs (matchPairKey) stay unwritten and are reported in `unwritten`; the rest land. */
  failPairs: Set<string>;
  /** Make every getPairs throw (an unprocessed key under requireComplete). */
  failGets: boolean;
  /** Each putMatches call's LANDED rows, in order. */
  puts: MatchRow[][];
}

export function createMatchesFake(seed: MatchRow[] = []): MatchesFake {
  const rows = new Map<string, MatchRow>(seed.map((row) => [matchPairKey(row.tenantId, row.unitId), clone(row)]));
  const fake = { rows, failPuts: false, failPairs: new Set<string>(), failGets: false, puts: [] } as unknown as MatchesFake;
  fake.repo = {
    async putMatches(batch) {
      if (fake.failPuts) throw new Error('matchesRepo.putMatches writes schema 2 rows only');
      // S2 PR37 shape: never throws on a DynamoDB failure; reports what did not land.
      const unwritten: MatchPairKey[] = batch
        .filter((row) => fake.failPairs.has(matchPairKey(row.tenantId, row.unitId)))
        .map((row) => ({ tenantId: row.tenantId, unitId: row.unitId }));
      const landed = batch.filter((row) => !fake.failPairs.has(matchPairKey(row.tenantId, row.unitId)));
      fake.puts.push(clone(landed));
      for (const row of landed) rows.set(matchPairKey(row.tenantId, row.unitId), clone(row));
      return { written: landed.length, unwritten };
    },
    async getPairs(keys) {
      if (fake.failGets) throw new Error('matches batch read incomplete');
      const out = new Map<string, MatchRow>();
      for (const key of keys) {
        const row = rows.get(matchPairKey(key.tenantId, key.unitId));
        if (row !== undefined && row.schema === 2) out.set(matchPairKey(key.tenantId, key.unitId), clone(row));
      }
      return out;
    },
  };
  return fake;
}
```
