```ts
// The ranking job (WP1 B2a spec D7; charter 10.2): the press's claim, the
// ranking poll (runDueRankings) with its queue expiry, lease, renewal and
// one takeover, and the run of one anchor (rankAnchor). Ranking runs on its
// OWN worker poll over job records in the AI runs table, never on the SQS
// jobs queue: that consumer awaits a whole receive batch, so a
// one-to-two-minute ranking there would hold up group-text fan-out and sends
// (charter 10.2, the extraction precedent).
//
// One record per anchor, `rjob#<anchorKind>#<anchorId>` (rankingRunsRepo.ts).
// Every state change is a CONDITIONAL write on the record's status and
// generation (S2's primitives). Poll ticks overlap (jobs/pollLoop.ts never
// awaits a tick), so those conditions - and the in-process job slots below -
// are the only things that keep one anchor from running twice.
//
// The messages here are staff-facing page text (the Rankings page shows
// them), not automated messages to a tenant or landlord, so they are not in
// the message catalog. PII: log ids and counts only - never a name, a card,
// a reason or a score.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { AppConfig } from '../../lib/config.js';
import type { EventBus } from '../../lib/events.js';
import type { Logger } from '../../lib/logger.js';
import { rankingExpiresAt, type MatchesRepo } from '../../repos/matchesRepo.js';
import type {
  RankingFailedBatch,
  RankingJobClaim,
  RankingJobRecord,
  RankingJobStatus,
  RankingNotScored,
  RankingRunsRepo,
} from '../../repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import type { AssembleResult, AssembledCandidate, VerifiedCandidate } from './assemble.js';
import type { RankingDriver } from './driverTypes.js';
import type { buildRankingPrompt, RankingPrompt } from './prompt.js';
import type { AnchorKind, AnchorRef } from './types.js';

export const MSG_RUNNING = 'A ranking is running for this record. Try again when it finishes.';
export const MSG_NOT_PICKED_UP = 'The ranking was not picked up. Press Rank again.';
export const MSG_STOPPED = 'The ranking stopped before it finished. Press Rank again.';
export const MSG_ERROR = 'The ranking could not finish. Press Rank again.';

function noun(count: number, kind: AnchorKind): string {
  return kind === 'unit' ? (count === 1 ? 'tenant' : 'tenants') : count === 1 ? 'property' : 'properties';
}

/** D2.3: "2 tenants could not be read and were not scored. Press Rank again." */
export function unreadableMessage(count: number, kind: AnchorKind): string {
  return `${count} ${noun(count, kind)} could not be read and ${count === 1 ? 'was' : 'were'} not scored. Press Rank again.`;
}

/** PR13: candidates the model did not return. */
export function omittedMessage(count: number, kind: AnchorKind): string {
  return `${count} ${noun(count, kind)} ${count === 1 ? 'was' : 'were'} not scored by the model. Press Rank again.`;
}

/** PR42: candidates a failed model call (or an unbuildable prompt, or an errored batch) left unscored. */
export function unscoredMessage(count: number, kind: AnchorKind): string {
  return `${count} ${noun(count, kind)} could not be scored. Press Rank again.`;
}

/** PR42: candidates whose score was not confirmed saved (a run or match write, 'repo'). */
export function unsavedMessage(count: number): string {
  return `${count} ${count === 1 ? 'score' : 'scores'} could not be saved. Press Rank again.`;
}

/** Narrows S3's candidate union (IR6). */
export function isVerified(candidate: AssembledCandidate): candidate is VerifiedCandidate {
  return !candidate.unverified;
}

/**
 * The in-process job limit (RANKING_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS). ONE per process:
 * ticks overlap, so the poll RESERVES a slot before its conditional claim and
 * releases it when the claim loses or the job ends. A release is idempotent.
 */
export interface RankingSlots {
  tryAcquire(): (() => void) | undefined;
  inUse(): number;
}

export function createRankingSlots(max: number): RankingSlots {
  let inUse = 0;
  return {
    tryAcquire() {
      if (inUse >= max) return undefined;
      inUse += 1;
      let released = false;
      return () => {
        if (released) return;
        released = true;
        inUse -= 1;
      };
    },
    inUse: () => inUse,
  };
}

/** Lease-renewal timer seam (tests capture the callback). */
export interface LeaseTimers {
  setInterval(fn: () => void, ms: number): unknown;
  clearInterval(handle: unknown): void;
}

export interface RankingJobDeps {
  jobs: Pick<
    RankingRunsRepo,
    | 'getJob'
    | 'listQueued'
    | 'listExpiredLeases'
    | 'claimQueued'
    | 'takeOver'
    | 'markLeaseFailed'
    | 'renewLease'
    | 'markExpiredQueued'
    | 'updateJobProgress'
    | 'finishJob'
    | 'putRun'
    | 'markMatchesWritten'
    | 'getOpenCandidateFlags'
    | 'putFlagIfAbsentOrClosed'
  >;
  matches: Pick<MatchesRepo, 'putMatches'>;
  driver: RankingDriver;
  /** assembleRanking bound to its deps (jobWiring.ts); a stub in the job's tests. */
  assemble(anchor: AnchorRef, opts: { includeOlder: boolean; now: Date }): Promise<AssembleResult>;
  /** Test seam (IR14); prompt.ts's buildRankingPrompt otherwise. */
  buildPrompt?: (input: Parameters<typeof buildRankingPrompt>[0]) => RankingPrompt;
  events: Pick<EventBus, 'emit'>;
  /** ONE per process. */
  slots: RankingSlots;
  config: Pick<
    AppConfig,
    | 'rankingBatchSize'
    | 'rankingBatchConcurrency'
    | 'rankingLeaseMs'
    | 'rankingPairTtlDays'
    | 'rankingLandlordCard'
    | 'aiPriceTable'
    | 'appEnv'
  >;
  logger: Logger;
  /** Real wall clock, ISO; injected so tests pin it. */
  now(): string;
  /** Run ids and takeover generations; randomUUID otherwise. */
  newId?(): string;
  /** An unref'd setInterval otherwise. */
  timers?: LeaseTimers;
  /** R2B5: the guard's retry pause; a setTimeout promise otherwise. */
  sleep?(ms: number): Promise<void>;
}

// --- the claim (POST .../rank) -------------------------------------------

export interface RankingPress {
  includeOlder: boolean;
  requestedBy: string;
  requestId: string;
  traceparent?: string;
}

export type ClaimResult =
  | { status: 202; job: RankingJobRecord; joined: boolean }
  | { status: 409; error: 'ranking_running' }
  | { status: 404 };

export interface ClaimDeps {
  jobs: Pick<RankingRunsRepo, 'getJob' | 'putJobClaim'>;
  /** S3's one anchor-exists rule (PR21), bound to the repos by the route. */
  anchorExists(anchor: AnchorRef): Promise<boolean>;
  config: Pick<AppConfig, 'rankingQueueExpiryMs' | 'rankingPairTtlDays'>;
  now(): string;
  newGeneration?(): string;
}

/** A record a new press may overwrite: finished, or queued past its expiry. */
function isClaimable(record: RankingJobRecord, nowIso: string): boolean {
  return (
    record.status === 'done' ||
    record.status === 'failed' ||
    (record.status === 'queued' && Date.parse(record.queuedExpiresAt) <= Date.parse(nowIso))
  );
}

function claimOf(anchor: AnchorRef, press: RankingPress, nowIso: string, deps: ClaimDeps): RankingJobClaim {
  return {
    anchorKind: anchor.kind,
    anchorId: anchor.id,
    generation: (deps.newGeneration ?? randomUUID)(),
    includeOlder: press.includeOlder,
    requestedBy: press.requestedBy,
    requestedAt: nowIso,
    requestId: press.requestId,
    ...(press.traceparent !== undefined && { traceparent: press.traceparent }),
    queuedExpiresAt: new Date(Date.parse(nowIso) + deps.config.rankingQueueExpiryMs).toISOString(),
    // The job record outlives every match its lists flag (charter 10.2).
    expiresAt: rankingExpiresAt(nowIso, deps.config.rankingPairTtlDays),
  };
}

/**
 * D7's claim: ONE conditional put (S2 putJobClaim) that wins on no record, a
 * done or failed record, or a queued record past its expiry. A press that
 * loses reads the record (consistent): finished in between -> retry the claim
 * ONCE; live with the same window -> JOIN it (202, joined); live with another
 * window -> 409. A tenant anchor ignores the window (claimed false), so it
 * always joins.
 */
export async function claimRanking(anchor: AnchorRef, press: RankingPress, deps: ClaimDeps): Promise<ClaimResult> {
  if (!(await deps.anchorExists(anchor))) return { status: 404 };
  const effective: RankingPress = { ...press, includeOlder: anchor.kind === 'unit' ? press.includeOlder : false };
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt += 1) {
    const won = await deps.jobs.putJobClaim(claimOf(anchor, effective, deps.now(), deps));
    if (won.ok) return { status: 202, job: won.job, joined: false };
    const current = await deps.jobs.getJob(anchor.kind, anchor.id, { consistent: true });
    if (current === undefined || isClaimable(current, deps.now())) continue;
    if (current.includeOlder === effective.includeOlder) return { status: 202, job: current, joined: true };
    return { status: 409, error: 'ranking_running' };
  }
  return { status: 409, error: 'ranking_running' };
}

// --- the job view (GET .../job and the read's job block) -----------------

export type RankingJobViewStatus = RankingJobStatus | 'expired';

export interface RankingJobView {
  status: RankingJobViewStatus;
  generation: string;
  includeOlder: boolean;
  requestedAt: string;
  startedAt?: string;
  finishedAt?: string;
  poolSize?: number;
  batchCount: number;
  batchesDone: number[];
  failedBatches: RankingFailedBatch[];
  /** PR13: candidates with no new match outside a failed call. */
  notScored: RankingNotScored[];
  message?: string;
}

/**
 * The record as the page reads it. `expired` is DERIVED for an unclaimed
 * queued record past queuedExpiresAt (D7, D9): between the expiry and the
 * poll's mark-failed step the page reads the same message and stops polling,
 * and a press reclaims the record.
 */
export function jobView(record: RankingJobRecord, nowIso: string): RankingJobView {
  const expired = record.status === 'queued' && Date.parse(record.queuedExpiresAt) <= Date.parse(nowIso);
  const message = expired ? MSG_NOT_PICKED_UP : record.message;
  return {
    status: expired ? 'expired' : record.status,
    generation: record.generation,
    includeOlder: record.includeOlder,
    requestedAt: record.requestedAt,
    ...(record.startedAt !== undefined && { startedAt: record.startedAt }),
    ...(record.finishedAt !== undefined && { finishedAt: record.finishedAt }),
    ...(record.poolSize !== undefined && { poolSize: record.poolSize }),
    batchCount: record.batchCount ?? 0,
    batchesDone: record.batchesDone ?? [],
    failedBatches: record.failedBatches ?? [],
    notScored: record.notScored ?? [],
    ...(message !== undefined && { message }),
  };
}
```

```ts
// The ranking run (WP1 B2a spec D11; charter 11). Every model call - one per
// batch - is a run in the AI runs table under its OWN key family. This module
// builds the run's INPUT; rankingRunsRepo.putRun adds `rrun#<runId>`, the
// kind, the two pointers (rankings#global and the anchor's) and the 350 KB
// guard (spec D11 inputOmitted), so the guard lives with the stored item.
//
// results[] is what THIS run said: its parsed output per candidate, the
// pair's merged missing list (code flags then the model's unknowns, spec D3 -
// the same value the match row gets; PR14), and cappedAtRun, the cap computed
// when the run finished from that output and the unlawful flags open then
// (the same capOf the read uses - one cap, PR7). The matches store holds one
// row per pair that any later press may rewrite, so the run detail renders
// results[], never the current row, as the run's.
//
// matchesWritten is NOT set here: the batch sets it after its match write by
// S2's second conditional update (absent means the write did not finish).
import type { AppConfig } from '../../lib/config.js';
import { gzipBase64, rankingExpiresAt, type MatchMissing } from '../../repos/matchesRepo.js';
import type { RankingJobRecord, RankingRunRecordInput, RankingRunResult } from '../../repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import type { AssembledAnchor, VerifiedCandidate } from './assemble.js';
import { capOf, flagFieldsOfKind } from './cap.js';
import { mergeMissing } from './completeness.js';
import { costUsd } from './cost.js';
import type { RankingCall } from './driverTypes.js';
import { EXAMPLES_VERSION } from './examples.js';
import type { ParsedCandidate } from './parse.js';
import type { RankingPrompt } from './prompt.js';
import { RUBRIC_VERSION } from './rubric.js';
import type { Direction } from './types.js';

export interface BuildRunInput {
  runId: string;
  job: RankingJobRecord;
  anchor: AssembledAnchor;
  direction: Direction;
  batchIndex: number;
  candidates: VerifiedCandidate[];
  prompt: RankingPrompt;
  call: RankingCall;
  /** The parsed result per candidate id (empty for a failed call). */
  byCandidate: ReadonlyMap<string, ParsedCandidate>;
  /** Per property: the unlawful fields open when the run finished. */
  openByUnit: ReadonlyMap<string, string[]>;
  startedAt: string;
  finishedAt: string;
  config: Pick<AppConfig, 'aiPriceTable' | 'appEnv' | 'rankingPairTtlDays'>;
}

/** The pair's missing list (spec D3): the anchor's and the candidate's code flags, then the model's own unknowns. */
export function pairMissing(anchor: AssembledAnchor, candidate: VerifiedCandidate, result: ParsedCandidate): MatchMissing[] {
  return mergeMissing([...anchor.missing, ...candidate.missing], result.unknowns);
}

function runResults(input: BuildRunInput): RankingRunResult[] {
  const byId = new Map(input.candidates.map((candidate) => [candidate.candidateId, candidate]));
  return input.prompt.handles.map((h) => {
    const result = input.byCandidate.get(h.candidateId);
    const candidate = byId.get(h.candidateId);
    if (result === undefined || candidate === undefined) {
      return { handle: h.handle, candidateId: h.candidateId, display: h.display, returned: false };
    }
    return {
      handle: h.handle,
      candidateId: h.candidateId,
      display: h.display,
      returned: true,
      score: result.score,
      for: result.for,
      against: result.against,
      unknowns: result.unknowns,
      failedRequirements: result.failedRequirements,
      fairHousingFlags: result.fairHousingFlags,
      missing: pairMissing(input.anchor, candidate, result),
      cappedAtRun: capOf({
        failedRequirements: result.failedRequirements,
        accommodationFields: flagFieldsOfKind(result.fairHousingFlags, 'accommodation'),
        recordedRequirementKeys: candidate.propertyFacts.recordedRequirementKeys,
        openUnlawfulFields: input.openByUnit.get(candidate.unitId) ?? [],
      }),
    };
  });
}

export function buildRankingRun(input: BuildRunInput): RankingRunRecordInput {
  const { call, prompt, job } = input;
  const usage = call.meta.usage;
  return {
    runId: input.runId,
    anchorKind: job.anchorKind,
    anchorId: job.anchorId,
    direction: input.direction,
    jobGeneration: job.generation,
    batchIndex: input.batchIndex,
    candidateCount: input.candidates.length,
    driver: call.meta.driver,
    model: call.meta.model,
    rubricVersion: RUBRIC_VERSION,
    examplesVersion: EXAMPLES_VERSION,
    promptFingerprint: prompt.promptFingerprint,
    usage: {
      inputTokens: usage?.inputTokens ?? 0,
      outputTokens: usage?.outputTokens ?? 0,
      ...(usage?.cacheReadInputTokens !== undefined && { cacheReadInputTokens: usage.cacheReadInputTokens }),
    },
    // 0 for fake / console / no usage; an unpriced billed model is refused at
    // startup (S2), so S4's throw is unreachable in a booted process (IR35).
    costUsd: costUsd(call.meta.model, usage, input.config.aiPriceTable),
    latencyMs: call.meta.latencyMs,
    startedAt: input.startedAt,
    finishedAt: input.finishedAt,
    outcome: call.ok ? 'scored' : 'failed',
    ...(!call.ok && { failure: call.failure, message: call.message }),
    ...(call.meta.rawText !== undefined && { rawText: call.meta.rawText }),
    inputGzip: gzipBase64(prompt.userText),
    handles: prompt.handles.map((h) => ({ handle: h.handle, candidateId: h.candidateId, display: h.display })),
    results: runResults(input),
    droppedUnlawfulFlags: call.ok ? call.output.droppedUnlawfulFlags : 0,
    environment: input.config.appEnv,
    expires_at: rankingExpiresAt(input.startedAt, input.config.rankingPairTtlDays),
  };
}
```

```ts
// check before the call and before every write; then the run, the matches
// (with the gzipped input snapshot), matchesWritten by a second update, the
// newly raised unlawful flags, and the progress write with its event. A failed
// call writes no match; a candidate the model did not return gets none and is
// listed in notScored; a failed match write is the batch's failure; a prompt

function harness(driverOpts: StubDriverOptions = {}, landlordCard = false) {

    matches: matches.repo,

    now: () => isoAt(1_000),
    newId: () => `run-${++ids}`,
  };
  let current = true;
  let guardCalls = 0;
  /** Supersede the job from this guard call on (1-based); Infinity = never. */
  let supersedeFromCall = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  const ctx: BatchContext = {
    job,
    anchor: unitAnchor({ missing: [{ key: 'payment_standard', label: 'Payment standard' }] }),
    direction: 'tenants_for_property',
    homes: new Map(),
    raised: new Map<string, UnlawfulFlagInput>(),
    storedFlags: new Map(),
    guard: async () => {
      guardCalls += 1;
      return current && guardCalls < supersedeFromCall;
    },
  };
  return {
    runs, matches, driver, emitted, deps, ctx, job, capture,
    supersede: () => { current = false; },
    supersedeFromGuardCall: (n: number) => { supersedeFromCall = n; },
  };
}

describe('finishedBatchCount / toRankingEvent', () => {

    expect(Object.keys(event).sort()).toEqual(['anchorId', 'anchorKind', 'batchCount', 'batchesDone', 'generation', 'status']);
    expect(event).toEqual({ anchorKind: 'unit', anchorId: ANCHOR_UNIT, generation: 'gen-1', status: 'running', batchesDone: 1, batchCount: 3 });
```

```ts
// One batch of a ranking job (WP1 B2a spec D7, D8, D8.1, D10, D11).
//
// Order, as D7 sets it: the generation check, the prompt and the model call
// (one per batch, with the driver's per-call timeout), then - each behind its
// own generation check - the run (runLog.ts; S2's putRun adds key, kind,
// pointers and the 350 KB guard), the batch's matches (one BatchWrite; a
// write still unprocessed after the repo's retries throws, which is this
// batch's failure: its candidates get no new match and read as out of date),
// matchesWritten (a second conditional update of the run), the unlawful flags
// this batch newly raised, and finally the progress write (batchesDone, or
// failedBatches for a failed call; notScored for the candidates the model
// did not return, PR13) with the ranking.updated event.
//
// The generation check is not atomic with the write after it: a superseded
// job can still write the batch it had in flight, and the newer job rewrites
// every pair (accepted, charter 10.2).
//
// A default or guessed score is never written (charter 7.4): a candidate the
// model did not return, and every candidate of a failed call, gets NO row.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { RankingUpdatedEvent } from '../../lib/events.js';
import { encodeSnapshot, matchPairKey, rankingExpiresAt, type MatchRow } from '../../repos/matchesRepo.js';
import type {
  RankingFailedBatch,
  RankingJobProgress,
  RankingJobRecord,
  UnlawfulFlagInput,
  UnlawfulFlagRecord,
} from '../../repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import type { AssembledAnchor, AssembledRanking, VerifiedCandidate } from './assemble.js';
import { EXAMPLES_VERSION } from './examples.js';
import { mergeRaisedFlags, openFlagFields } from './flags.js';
import type { RankingJobDeps } from './job.js';
import type { ParsedCandidate } from './parse.js';
import { buildRankingPrompt, RankingPromptError, type RankingPrompt } from './prompt.js';
import { RUBRIC_VERSION } from './rubric.js';
import { buildRankingRun, pairMissing } from './runLog.js';
import type { Direction } from './types.js';

export interface BatchContext {
  /** The job record as this run holds it (its generation is the guard's). */
  job: RankingJobRecord;
  anchor: AssembledAnchor;
  direction: Direction;
  homes: AssembledRanking['homes'];
  /** The job-wide unlawful-flag merge (D10), keyed `${unitId}#${field}`. */
  raised: Map<string, UnlawfulFlagInput>;
  /** Each property's stored flag records, read once per job. */
  storedFlags: Map<string, Promise<UnlawfulFlagRecord[]>>;
  /** The generation check (D7): false once this job is superseded or stopped. */
  guard(): Promise<boolean>;
}

export type BatchOutcome =
  | { kind: 'scored'; omitted: number; written: number }
  /**
   * PR42: `unscored` = the candidates this batch's failedBatches entry lists
   * (no match through a failure); `omitted` = the model left out (notScored);
   * `written` = rows confirmed written.
   */
  | { kind: 'failed'; failure: string; unscored: number; omitted: number; written: number }
  | { kind: 'stopped' };

const STOPPED: BatchOutcome = { kind: 'stopped' };

/** Finished batches - scored or failed - as distinct indexes. */
export function finishedBatchCount(record: Pick<RankingJobRecord, 'batchesDone' | 'failedBatches'>): number {
  const indexes = new Set<number>();
  for (const index of record.batchesDone ?? []) indexes.add(index);
  for (const failed of record.failedBatches ?? []) indexes.add(failed.index);
  return indexes.size;
}

/** D12's payload: ids, the status and two counts - never a score or a name. */
export function toRankingEvent(record: RankingJobRecord): RankingUpdatedEvent {
  return {
    anchorKind: record.anchorKind,
    anchorId: record.anchorId,
    generation: record.generation,
    status: record.status,
    batchesDone: finishedBatchCount(record),
    batchCount: record.batchCount ?? 0,
  };
}

export function emitRankingEvent(deps: Pick<RankingJobDeps, 'events' | 'logger'>, record: RankingJobRecord): void {
  try {
    deps.events.emit('ranking.updated', toRankingEvent(record));
  } catch (err) {
    deps.logger.warn({ err, anchorKind: record.anchorKind, anchorId: record.anchorId }, 'ranking.updated emit failed');
  }
}

function idsOf(candidates: readonly VerifiedCandidate[]): string[] {
  return candidates.map((candidate) => candidate.candidateId);
}

async function progress(ctx: BatchContext, deps: RankingJobDeps, patch: RankingJobProgress): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!(await ctx.guard())) return false;
  const updated = await deps.jobs.updateJobProgress(ctx.job, patch);
  if (updated === undefined) return false;
  emitRankingEvent(deps, updated);
  return true;
}

/** One stored-flags read per property per job; a failed read reads as none (it only informs cappedAtRun). */
function storedFlagsOf(ctx: BatchContext, deps: RankingJobDeps, unitId: string): Promise<UnlawfulFlagRecord[]> {
  let pending = ctx.storedFlags.get(unitId);
  if (pending === undefined) {
    pending = deps.jobs.getOpenCandidateFlags(unitId).catch((err: unknown) => {
      deps.logger.warn({ err, unitId }, "ranking batch: stored flag read failed - cappedAtRun uses this job's flags only");
      return [];
    });
    ctx.storedFlags.set(unitId, pending);
  }
  return pending;
}

function matchRowOf(
  candidate: VerifiedCandidate,
  result: ParsedCandidate,
  m: { ctx: BatchContext; prompt: RankingPrompt; runId: string; model: string; computedAt: string; ttlDays: number },
): MatchRow {
  return {
    tenantId: candidate.tenantId,
    unitId: candidate.unitId,
    schema: 2,
    score: result.score,
    for: result.for,
    against: result.against,
    missing: pairMissing(m.ctx.anchor, candidate, result),
    failedRequirements: result.failedRequirements,
    fairHousingFlags: result.fairHousingFlags,
    stage: 1,
    rubricVersion: RUBRIC_VERSION,
    examplesVersion: EXAMPLES_VERSION,
    promptFingerprint: m.prompt.promptFingerprint,
    model: m.model,
    runId: m.runId,
    jobGeneration: m.ctx.job.generation,
    computedAt: m.computedAt,
    anchorSide: m.ctx.job.anchorKind,
    fingerprints: candidate.fingerprints,
    inputSnapshot: encodeSnapshot(m.prompt.snapshotOf(candidate.candidateId)),
    expires_at: rankingExpiresAt(m.computedAt, m.ttlDays),
  };
}

export async function runBatch(
  batch: VerifiedCandidate[],
  index: number,
  ctx: BatchContext,
  deps: RankingJobDeps,
): Promise<BatchOutcome> {
  const { job } = ctx;
  const log = deps.logger;
  const where = { anchorKind: job.anchorKind, anchorId: job.anchorId, batchIndex: index, candidates: batch.length };

  if (!(await ctx.guard())) return STOPPED;
  let prompt: RankingPrompt;
  try {
    prompt = (deps.buildPrompt ?? buildRankingPrompt)({
      direction: ctx.direction,
      batchIndex: index,
      landlordCard: deps.config.rankingLandlordCard,
      anchor: { card: ctx.anchor.card, missing: ctx.anchor.missing },
      candidates: batch,
      homes: ctx.homes,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    if (!(err instanceof RankingPromptError)) throw err;
    // IR34: no model call was made, so no run; the batch failed as 'driver'.
    log.error({ ...where, err }, 'ranking batch: the prompt could not be built');
    const failedBatch: RankingFailedBatch = { index, candidateIds: idsOf(batch), failure: 'driver' };
    return (await progress(ctx, deps, { failedBatch }))
      ? { kind: 'failed', failure: 'driver', unscored: batch.length, omitted: 0, written: 0 }
      : STOPPED;
  }
  const runId = (deps.newId ?? randomUUID)();
  const startedAt = deps.now();
  const call = await deps.driver.rankBatch(prompt.batchInput);
  const finishedAt = deps.now();

  const byCandidate = new Map<string, ParsedCandidate>();
  if (call.ok) {
    for (const h of prompt.handles) {
      const result = call.output.byHandle.get(h.handle);
      if (result !== undefined) byCandidate.set(h.candidateId, result);
    }
  }
  const scored = batch.filter((candidate) => byCandidate.has(candidate.candidateId));
  const omitted = call.ok ? batch.filter((candidate) => !byCandidate.has(candidate.candidateId)) : [];

  // D10: merge this batch's raises into the job's map FIRST, so cappedAtRun
  // sees the flags open when this run finished, its own included.
  const newlyRaised = mergeRaisedFlags(
    ctx.raised,
    scored.map((candidate) => ({
      unitId: candidate.unitId,
      freeTextByField: candidate.propertyFacts.freeTextByField,
      result: byCandidate.get(candidate.candidateId) as ParsedCandidate,
    })),
    { runId, raisedAt: finishedAt },
  );
  const openByUnit = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const candidate of scored) {
    if (openByUnit.has(candidate.unitId)) continue;
    const stored = await storedFlagsOf(ctx, deps, candidate.unitId);
    const fields = new Set(openFlagFields(stored, candidate.propertyFacts.freeTextByField));
    for (const flag of ctx.raised.values()) if (flag.unitId === candidate.unitId) fields.add(flag.field);
    openByUnit.set(candidate.unitId, [...fields]);
  }

  const run = buildRankingRun({
    runId,
    job,
    anchor: ctx.anchor,
    direction: ctx.direction,
    batchIndex: index,
    candidates: batch,
    prompt,
    call,
    byCandidate,
    openByUnit,
    startedAt,
    finishedAt,
    config: deps.config,
  });
  if (!(await ctx.guard())) return STOPPED;
  try {
    await deps.jobs.putRun(run);
  } catch (err) {
    // PR36: the call is paid for; a lost run must never hide the spend.
    // R2B7: a FAILED call keeps its own failure kind; 'repo' only when it succeeded.
    const failure = call.ok ? 'repo' : call.failure;
    log.error(
      {
        ...where,
        err,
        runId,
        model: run.model,
        usage: run.usage,
        costUsd: run.costUsd,
        ...(!call.ok && { callFailure: call.failure }),
      },
      'ranking run write failed - usage and cost logged here',
    );
    const failedBatch: RankingFailedBatch = { index, candidateIds: idsOf(batch), failure };
    return (await progress(ctx, deps, { failedBatch }))
      ? { kind: 'failed', failure, unscored: batch.length, omitted: 0, written: 0 }
      : STOPPED;
  }

  if (!call.ok) {
    log.warn({ ...where, runId, failure: call.failure }, 'ranking batch failed');
    const failedBatch: RankingFailedBatch = { index, candidateIds: idsOf(batch), failure: call.failure };
    return (await progress(ctx, deps, { failedBatch, runIds: [runId] }))
      ? { kind: 'failed', failure: call.failure, unscored: batch.length, omitted: 0, written: 0 }
      : STOPPED;
  }

  const rows = scored.map((candidate) =>
    matchRowOf(candidate, byCandidate.get(candidate.candidateId) as ParsedCandidate, {
      ctx,
      prompt,
      runId,
      model: call.meta.model,
      computedAt: finishedAt,
      ttlDays: deps.config.rankingPairTtlDays,
    }),
  );
  // PR37: the candidates whose match is not confirmed written (R2F5; none when every row landed).
  let unwrittenIds: string[] = [];
  let written = 0;
  if (rows.length > 0) {
    if (!(await ctx.guard())) return STOPPED;
    try {
      const result = await deps.matches.putMatches(rows);
      written = result.written;
      const unwrittenPairs = new Set(result.unwritten.map((key) => matchPairKey(key.tenantId, key.unitId)));
      unwrittenIds = scored
        .filter((candidate, i) => unwrittenPairs.has(matchPairKey(rows[i]!.tenantId, rows[i]!.unitId)))
        .map((candidate) => candidate.candidateId);
      if (unwrittenIds.length > 0) {
        log.error({ ...where, runId, written, unwritten: unwrittenIds.length }, 'ranking batch match write: rows not confirmed written');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // S2: putMatches throws only on a programming error. Caught so the job never throws.
      unwrittenIds = idsOf(scored);
      log.error({ ...where, runId, err, rows: rows.length }, 'ranking batch match write threw');
    }
    if (written > 0) {
      // BA6: markMatchesWritten is a write, so it has its own generation check.
      if (!(await ctx.guard())) return STOPPED;
      try {
        const marked = await deps.jobs.markMatchesWritten(runId, { count: written, at: deps.now() });
        if (!marked) log.warn({ ...where, runId }, 'ranking run matchesWritten update found no run');
      } catch (err) {
        log.warn({ ...where, runId, err }, 'ranking run matchesWritten update failed');
      }
    }
  }

  for (const flag of newlyRaised) {
    if (!(await ctx.guard())) return STOPPED;
    try {
      await deps.jobs.putFlagIfAbsentOrClosed(flag);
    } catch (err) {
      log.error({ ...where, runId, err, unitId: flag.unitId, field: flag.field }, 'ranking unlawful flag write failed');
    }
  }

  if (omitted.length > 0) log.warn({ ...where, runId, omitted: omitted.length }, 'ranking batch: candidates not returned');
  const notScored =
    omitted.length > 0
      ? { notScored: omitted.map((candidate) => ({ candidateId: candidate.candidateId, reason: 'omitted' as const })) }
      : {};
  if (unwrittenIds.length > 0) {
    // PR37 / PR42: only the not-confirmed-written candidates are the batch's failure; the landed rows stay.
    // A batch whose call succeeded and some of whose rows landed is ALSO in
    // batchesDone (its index then appears in both lists; finishedBatchCount
    // de-dups indexes). A batch with no row written is in failedBatches only.
    const failedBatch: RankingFailedBatch = { index, candidateIds: unwrittenIds, failure: 'repo' };
    return (await progress(ctx, deps, { ...(written > 0 && { batchDone: index }), failedBatch, runIds: [runId], ...notScored }))
      ? { kind: 'failed', failure: 'repo', unscored: unwrittenIds.length, omitted: omitted.length, written }
      : STOPPED;
  }
  const patch: RankingJobProgress = { batchDone: index, runIds: [runId], ...notScored };
  return (await progress(ctx, deps, patch)) ? { kind: 'scored', omitted: omitted.length, written: rows.length } : STOPPED;
}
```

```ts
// --- the run of one anchor ------------------------------------------------

/** PR38: the tenant anchor's own card could not be read (the job is done, nothing scored). */
export const MSG_TENANT_UNREADABLE = "Could not read this tenant's record. Press Rank again.";
/** PR43: the property anchor's own reads failed after its pool (the job is done, nothing scored). */
export const MSG_PROPERTY_UNREADABLE = "Could not read this property's record. Press Rank again.";
/** R2B5: the pause before the guard's one retry. */
export const GUARD_RETRY_MS = 500;

const defaultSleep = (ms: number): Promise<void> =>
  new Promise((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(resolve, ms).unref();
  });

const DEFAULT_TIMERS: LeaseTimers = {
  setInterval(fn, ms) {
    const handle = setInterval(fn, ms);
    handle.unref();
    return handle;
  },
  clearInterval(handle) {
    clearInterval(handle as ReturnType<typeof setInterval>);
  },
};

function chunk<T>(items: readonly T[], size: number): T[][] {
  const out: T[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += size) out.push(items.slice(i, i + size));
  return out;
}

async function finishJob(
  job: RankingJobRecord,
  deps: RankingJobDeps,
  status: 'done' | 'failed',
  message: string | undefined,
): Promise<void> {
  const updated = await deps.jobs.finishJob(job, {
    status,
    finishedAt: deps.now(),
    ...(message !== undefined && { message }),
  });
  if (updated === undefined) return;
  emitRankingEvent(deps, updated);
  deps.logger.info(
    { anchorKind: job.anchorKind, anchorId: job.anchorId, generation: job.generation, status },
    `ranking job ${status}`,
  );
}

async function runBatchSafely(
  batch: VerifiedCandidate[],
  index: number,
  ctx: BatchContext,
  deps: RankingJobDeps,
): Promise<BatchOutcome> {
  try {
    return await runBatch(batch, index, ctx, deps);
  } catch (err) {
    const { job } = ctx;
    deps.logger.error({ anchorKind: job.anchorKind, anchorId: job.anchorId, batchIndex: index, err }, 'ranking batch errored');
    try {
      if (!(await ctx.guard())) return { kind: 'stopped' };
      const updated = await deps.jobs.updateJobProgress(job, {
        failedBatch: { index, candidateIds: batch.map((candidate) => candidate.candidateId), failure: 'error' },
      });
      if (updated !== undefined) emitRankingEvent(deps, updated);
    } catch (progressErr) {
      deps.logger.error(
        { anchorKind: job.anchorKind, anchorId: job.anchorId, batchIndex: index, err: progressErr },
        'ranking batch failure could not be recorded',
      );
    }
    return { kind: 'failed', failure: 'error', unscored: batch.length, omitted: 0, written: 0 };
  }
}

async function runJob(
  job: RankingJobRecord,
  deps: RankingJobDeps,
  guard: () => Promise<boolean>,
  isStopped: () => boolean,
): Promise<void> {
  const where = { anchorKind: job.anchorKind, anchorId: job.anchorId, generation: job.generation };
  const result = await deps.assemble(
    { kind: job.anchorKind, id: job.anchorId },
    { includeOlder: job.includeOlder, now: new Date(deps.now()) },
  );
  if (!result.ok) {
    if (result.reason === 'anchor_unreadable' && result.candidateIds !== undefined) {
      // PR38 (spec D2.3) / PR43: the anchor's own card could not be read
      // after its pool was computed, so no candidate is scored - the job is
      // DONE with every pool candidate listed not scored ("not scored -
      // retry" rows on the read) and the anchor kind's message.
      const ids = result.candidateIds;
      deps.logger.warn({ ...where, poolSize: ids.length }, 'ranking job: the anchor could not be read');
      if (!(await guard())) return;
      const listed = await deps.jobs.updateJobProgress(job, {
        poolSize: ids.length,
        batchCount: 0,
        ...(ids.length > 0 && {
          notScored: ids.map((candidateId) => ({ candidateId, reason: 'unreadable' as const })),
        }),
      });
      if (listed === undefined) return;
      emitRankingEvent(deps, listed);
      // R2B5: no guard read before the finish - S2 conditions it on the generation.
      await finishJob(job, deps, 'done', job.anchorKind === 'tenant' ? MSG_TENANT_UNREADABLE : MSG_PROPERTY_UNREADABLE);
      return;
    }
    deps.logger.warn(
      { ...where, reason: result.reason, ...('size' in result && result.size !== undefined && { size: result.size }) },
      'ranking job could not build its pool',
    );
    if (await guard()) await finishJob(job, deps, 'failed', result.message);
    return;
  }

  // D2.3 / PR13: a candidate whose card needed an incomplete read is left out
  // of the call and listed in notScored ("not scored - retry").
  const unreadable = result.candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate.unverified);
  const readable = result.candidates.filter(isVerified);
  const batches = chunk(readable, Math.max(1, deps.config.rankingBatchSize));

  if (!(await guard())) return;
  const started = await deps.jobs.updateJobProgress(job, {
    poolSize: result.candidates.length,
    batchCount: batches.length,
    ...(unreadable.length > 0 && {
      notScored: unreadable.map((candidate) => ({ candidateId: candidate.candidateId, reason: 'unreadable' as const })),
    }),
  });
  if (started === undefined) return;
  emitRankingEvent(deps, started);
  deps.logger.info(
    { ...where, poolSize: result.candidates.length, batchCount: batches.length, unreadable: unreadable.length },
    'ranking job pool built',
  );

  const ctx: BatchContext = {
    job,
    anchor: result.anchor,
    direction: result.direction,
    homes: result.homes,
    raised: new Map(),
    storedFlags: new Map(),
    guard,
  };
  const outcomes = await mapWithConcurrency(batches, Math.max(1, deps.config.rankingBatchConcurrency), (batch, index) =>
    runBatchSafely(batch, index, ctx, deps),
  );
  if (isStopped() || outcomes.some((outcome) => outcome.kind === 'stopped')) return;

  // PR42: the message counts CANDIDATES (failedBatches + notScored), never batches.
  let omitted = 0;
  let unscored = 0;
  let unsaved = 0;
  for (const outcome of outcomes) {
    if (outcome.kind === 'scored') omitted += outcome.omitted;
    if (outcome.kind === 'failed') {
      omitted += outcome.omitted;
      if (outcome.failure === 'repo') unsaved += outcome.unscored;
      else unscored += outcome.unscored;
    }
  }
  const messages: string[] = [];
  if (unreadable.length > 0) messages.push(unreadableMessage(unreadable.length, job.anchorKind));
  if (omitted > 0) messages.push(omittedMessage(omitted, job.anchorKind));
  if (unscored > 0) messages.push(unscoredMessage(unscored, job.anchorKind));
  if (unsaved > 0) messages.push(unsavedMessage(unsaved));
  // R2B5: NO guard read here. finishJob is conditioned on running AND this
  // generation (S2), so a superseded job's finish is refused, and a guard
  // read that fails now can never turn a fully scored job into failed.
  await finishJob(job, deps, 'done', messages.length > 0 ? messages.join(' ') : undefined);
}

/**
 * Run one claimed job to its end (D7). NEVER throws: a model, batch, pool or
 * organization-list failure is recorded on the record and the job finishes.
 * Before every model call and every write it re-reads the record
 * (consistent) and exits quietly once the generation is not its own; a lease
 * renewal every RANKING_LEASE_MS / 3 extends the lease on that generation, and
 * a refused or failed renewal stops the job the same way.
 *
 * `rankAnchor(job, deps)` is the one entry point, so a later scheduled caller
 * is configuration, not a redesign (charter 10.2).
 */
export async function rankAnchor(job: RankingJobRecord, deps: RankingJobDeps): Promise<void> {
  const log = deps.logger;
  const where = { anchorKind: job.anchorKind, anchorId: job.anchorId, generation: job.generation };
  let stopped = false;

  const readJob = () => deps.jobs.getJob(job.anchorKind, job.anchorId, { consistent: true });
  const guard = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (stopped) return false;
    let current: RankingJobRecord | undefined;
    try {
      current = await readJob();
    } catch (first) {
      // PR36 / R2B5: a transient read error (throttling, usually) is retried once, after a pause.
      log.warn({ ...where, err: first }, 'ranking job generation check failed - retrying once');
      try {
        await (deps.sleep ?? defaultSleep)(GUARD_RETRY_MS);
        current = await readJob();
      } catch (err) {
        if (stopped) return false;
        stopped = true;
        // PR36: still failing - finish the job failed by S2's generation-
        // conditioned write (a newer generation is never touched); the slot
        // is released by startClaimedJob's finally.
        log.error({ ...where, err }, 'ranking job generation check failed twice - failing the job');
        try {
          await finishJob(job, deps, 'failed', MSG_ERROR);
        } catch (finishErr) {
          log.error({ ...where, err: finishErr }, 'ranking job failure could not be recorded');
        }
        return false;
      }
    }
    if (stopped) return false;
    if (current === undefined || current.generation !== job.generation || current.status !== 'running') {
      stopped = true;
      log.info(where, 'ranking job superseded - exiting quietly');
    }
    return !stopped;
  };

  const leaseMs = deps.config.rankingLeaseMs;
  const renew = async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (stopped) return;
    try {
      const leaseExpiresAt = new Date(Date.parse(deps.now()) + leaseMs).toISOString();
      if (!(await deps.jobs.renewLease(job, leaseExpiresAt))) {
        stopped = true;
        log.warn(where, 'ranking job lease renewal refused - stopping');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      stopped = true;
      log.error({ ...where, err }, 'ranking job lease renewal failed - stopping');
    }
  };
  const timers = deps.timers ?? DEFAULT_TIMERS;
  const handle = timers.setInterval(() => {
    void renew();
  }, Math.max(1, Math.floor(leaseMs / 3)));

  try {
    log.info({ ...where, attempts: job.attempts }, 'ranking job started');
    await runJob(job, deps, guard, () => stopped);
  } catch (err) {
    log.error({ ...where, err }, 'ranking job failed unexpectedly');
    try {
      if (await guard()) await finishJob(job, deps, 'failed', MSG_ERROR);
    } catch (finishErr) {
      log.error({ ...where, err: finishErr }, 'ranking job failure could not be recorded');
    }
  } finally {
    timers.clearInterval(handle);
  }
}
```

```ts
// --- the ranking poll ------------------------------------------------------

/** Records read per index family per tick. */
export const RANKING_POLL_LIST_LIMIT = 25;

export interface RankingPollSummary {
  expired: number;
  claimed: number;
  tookOver: number;
  failedStale: number;
}

/**
 * Start one claimed job in a FRESH context (D7): not nested in the tick's -
 * runWithContext replaces the store - so the job's lines carry no pollRunId
 * and no jobRunId, and the logger's correlation id
 * (`jobRunId ?? pollRunId ?? requestId ?? bootId`, lib/logger.ts) is the
 * press's requestId. The traceparent is restored the way dispatchJob restores
 * an envelope's (jobs/jobs.ts); whether OTel spans parent on it is that path's
 * behavior, not a B2a claim. The slot is released when the job ends.
 */
function startClaimedJob(record: RankingJobRecord, release: () => void, deps: RankingJobDeps): Promise<void> {
  const ctx: CorrelationContext = {
    requestId: record.requestId,
    ...(record.traceparent !== undefined && { traceparent: record.traceparent }),
  };
  return runWithContext(ctx, () => rankAnchor(record, deps)).finally(release);
}

/**
 * ONE ranking poll pass (worker.ts's poll every tick; POST /__dev/ranking/tick
 * on the hermetic lane). Resolves when every job it claimed has finished.
 *
 * 1. Every listed queued record past its expiry is marked failed ("The
 *    ranking was not picked up") by S2's markExpiredQueued, conditioned on
 *    status, the listed generation and the expiry, so it can never fail a
 *    record another tick has just claimed.
 * 2. Queued records, oldest first, are claimed while a slot is free: the slot
 *    is RESERVED before the conditional claim and released when the claim
 *    loses, so overlapping ticks cannot exceed RANKING_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.
 * 3. Running records past their lease: attempts < 1 is taken over (a new
 *    generation, attempts + 1, run from the start - enough to cover a
 *    redeploy); otherwise S2's markLeaseFailed fails it with "The ranking
 *    stopped before it finished". A new press clears either.
 */
export async function runDueRankings(nowIso: string, deps: RankingJobDeps): Promise<RankingPollSummary> {
  const log = deps.logger;
  const summary: RankingPollSummary = { expired: 0, claimed: 0, tookOver: 0, failedStale: 0 };
  const nowMs = Date.parse(nowIso);
  const leaseExpiresAt = new Date(nowMs + deps.config.rankingLeaseMs).toISOString();
  const started: Promise<void>[] = [];

  const queued = await deps.jobs.listQueued(RANKING_POLL_LIST_LIMIT);
  const due: RankingJobRecord[] = [];
  for (const record of queued) {
    if (Date.parse(record.queuedExpiresAt) > nowMs) {
      due.push(record);
      continue;
    }
    try {
      if (await deps.jobs.markExpiredQueued(record, { nowIso, message: MSG_NOT_PICKED_UP })) {
        summary.expired += 1;
        emitRankingEvent(deps, { ...record, status: 'failed' });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      log.error({ anchorKind: record.anchorKind, anchorId: record.anchorId, err }, 'ranking poll: expiry mark failed');
    }
  }

  for (const record of due) {
    const release = deps.slots.tryAcquire();
    if (release === undefined) break;
    try {
      const claimed = await deps.jobs.claimQueued(record, { nowIso, leaseExpiresAt });
      if (claimed === undefined) {
        release();
        continue;
      }
      summary.claimed += 1;
      started.push(startClaimedJob(claimed, release, deps));
    } catch (err) {
      release();
      log.error({ anchorKind: record.anchorKind, anchorId: record.anchorId, err }, 'ranking poll: claim failed');
    }
  }

  const stale = await deps.jobs.listExpiredLeases(nowIso, RANKING_POLL_LIST_LIMIT);
  for (const record of stale) {
    try {
      if (record.attempts >= 1) {
        if (await deps.jobs.markLeaseFailed(record, { nowIso, message: MSG_STOPPED })) {
          summary.failedStale += 1;
          emitRankingEvent(deps, { ...record, status: 'failed' });
        }
        continue;
      }
      const release = deps.slots.tryAcquire();
      if (release === undefined) continue;
      const taken = await deps.jobs.takeOver(record, {
        nowIso,
        newGeneration: (deps.newId ?? randomUUID)(),
        leaseExpiresAt,
      });
      if (taken === undefined) {
        release();
        continue;
      }
      summary.tookOver += 1;
      started.push(startClaimedJob(taken, release, deps));
    } catch (err) {
      log.error({ anchorKind: record.anchorKind, anchorId: record.anchorId, err }, 'ranking poll: stale lease step failed');
    }
  }

  if (summary.expired + summary.claimed + summary.tookOver + summary.failedStale > 0) {
    log.info({ ...summary }, 'ranking poll pass');
  }
  await Promise.all(started);
  return summary;
}
```

```ts
import { createMatchesFake, createRankingRunsFake } from './helpers/rankingRunsFake.js';

const SECRET = 'test-origin-secret';
// R2F6: the tick mounts only on a LOCAL DynamoDB target.
const cfg = (endpoint = 'http://localhost:8000') =>
  loadConfig({ NODE_ENV: 'test', DEV_AUTH_ENABLED: '1', CF_ORIGIN_SECRET: SECRET, DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT: endpoint });

function tickDeps() {
  const runs = createRankingRunsFake();
  // The tick runs on the wall clock: the record must not have expired.
  const record = queuedJob({ queuedExpiresAt: '2999-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' });
  runs.jobs.set(record.itemId, record);
  const driver = stubDriver();
  const deps: RankingJobDeps = {
    jobs: runs.repo,
    matches: createMatchesFake().repo,
    driver,
    assemble: async () => assembled(unitAnchor(), [tenantCandidate('t-1')]),
    buildPrompt: stubBuildPrompt,
    events: { emit: () => undefined },
    slots: createRankingSlots(2),
    config: {
      rankingBatchSize: 40,
      rankingBatchConcurrency: 4,
      rankingLeaseMs: 90_000,
      rankingPairTtlDays: 180,
      rankingLandlordCard: false,
      aiPriceTable: {},
      appEnv: 'local',
    },
    logger: createLogger({ destination: createLogCapture().stream }),
    now: () => new Date().toISOString(),
    timers: { setInterval: () => 0, clearInterval: () => undefined },
  };
  return { runs, driver, deps };
}

describe('POST /__dev/ranking/tick', () => {
  it('is absent (404) when the dev router is not mounted', async () => {
    const app = buildApp({ config: loadConfig({ NODE_ENV: 'test', CF_ORIGIN_SECRET: SECRET }) });
    expect((await request(app).post('/__dev/ranking/tick').set('x-origin-verify', SECRET).send()).status).toBe(404);
  });

  it('R2F6: is absent (404) when the dev router is mounted but DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT is not a local target, even with deps injected', async () => {
    const { driver, deps } = tickDeps();
    const config = cfg('http://dynamodb-local:8000');
    const app = buildApp({ config, devRouter: createDevRouter({ config, rankingTickDeps: deps }) });
    expect((await request(app).post('/__dev/ranking/tick').send()).status).toBe(404);
    expect(driver.calls).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('runs one poll pass to completion and reports the summary', async () => {
    const { runs, driver, deps } = tickDeps();
    const config = cfg();
    const app = buildApp({ config, devRouter: createDevRouter({ config, rankingTickDeps: deps }) });
    const res = await request(app).post('/__dev/ranking/tick').send();
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ ok: true, expired: 0, claimed: 1, tookOver: 0, failedStale: 0 });
    expect(driver.calls).toEqual([['t-1']]);
    // Answered only after the job finished.
    expect(runs.jobs.get(rankingJobItemId('unit', ANCHOR_UNIT))?.status).toBe('done');
  });

  it('a second tick with nothing due claims nothing', async () => {
    const { deps } = tickDeps();
    const config = cfg();
    const app = buildApp({ config, devRouter: createDevRouter({ config, rankingTickDeps: deps }) });
    await request(app).post('/__dev/ranking/tick').send();
    expect((await request(app).post('/__dev/ranking/tick').send()).body).toEqual({ ok: true, expired: 0, claimed: 0, tookOver: 0, failedStale: 0 });
  });
});
```

Step 3 - implementation. New file `app/src/services/ranking/jobWiring.ts`:

```ts
// The ONE construction of the ranking job's deps (WP1 B2a spec D7; PR27),
// shared by the worker's ranking poll (worker.ts) and the hermetic dev tick
// (routes/dev.ts POST /__dev/ranking/tick), so the two runners cannot drift -
// the drift the extraction tick's "mirrors worker.ts exactly" comment can
// only warn about. Each call builds its OWN slots: the in-process job limit
// (RANKING_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS) is per process, and the worker and the app
// each call this once. Construction opens no connection: the repositories and
// the driver are client objects until first used.
import { createRankingDriver } from '../../adapters/ranking.js';
import type { AppConfig } from '../../lib/config.js';
import type { EventBus } from '../../lib/events.js';
import type { Logger } from '../../lib/logger.js';
import { createMatchesRepo } from '../../repos/matchesRepo.js';
import { createRankingRunsRepo } from '../../repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import { assembleRanking, createAssembleDeps } from './assemble.js';
import { createRankingSlots, type RankingJobDeps } from './job.js';

export interface RankingJobWiringOptions {
  config: AppConfig;
  logger: Logger;
  /** The process's bus: the worker's (bridged to the app) or the app's own (dev tick). */
  events: Pick<EventBus, 'emit'>;
}

export function createRankingJobDeps(opts: RankingJobWiringOptions): RankingJobDeps {
  const { config, logger } = opts;
  const assembleDeps = createAssembleDeps({ config, logger });
  return {
    jobs: createRankingRunsRepo({ logger }),
    matches: createMatchesRepo({ logger }),
    driver: createRankingDriver(config, logger),
    assemble: (anchor, assembleOpts) => assembleRanking(anchor, assembleOpts, assembleDeps),
    events: opts.events,
    slots: createRankingSlots(config.rankingMaxConcurrentJobs),
    config,
    logger,
    now: () => new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}
```

```ts
  startPoll('extraction', (now) => runDueExtractions(now, extractionDeps));
}

// Ranking poll (WP1 B2a spec D7; charter 10.2): its OWN poll over due
// ranking-job records in the AI runs table - never the SQS jobs queue, whose
// consumer awaits a whole receive batch, so a one-to-two-minute ranking there
// would hold up group-text fan-out and sends (the extraction precedent).
// There is no ranking feature switch (charter section 20 item 12): in
// production the poll always runs (RANKING_WORKER_POLL=off is refused there,
// lib/config.ts). It is OFF when RANKING_WORKER_POLL=off (the hermetic lane,
// so jobs run only through POST /__dev/ranking/tick) and, by S2's PR30
// default, outside production on REAL tables (no local DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT),
// so a laptop's live-mode worker never claims hosted dev's jobs; an explicit
// RANKING_WORKER_POLL=on is honored. worker.ts reads only the resolved flag. The deps come from the same
// createRankingJobDeps the dev tick uses, so the two runners cannot drift;
// `events` is this worker's bus, forwarded to the app's SSE clients by the
// event bridge when EVENT_BRIDGE_URL is set. The job slots in those deps are
// this process's RANKING_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS limit: ticks overlap (pollLoop.ts
// never awaits), so the limit lives in-process, not per tick.
if (config.rankingWorkerPoll) {
  const { appEvents } = await import('./lib/events.js');
  const { createRankingJobDeps } = await import('./services/ranking/jobWiring.js');
  const { runDueRankings } = await import('./services/ranking/job.js');

  const rankingDeps = createRankingJobDeps({ config, logger, events: appEvents });

  startPoll('ranking', (now) => runDueRankings(now, rankingDeps));
} else {
  runWithContext(bootContext, () => {
    logger.info('ranking poll not started - RANKING_WORKER_POLL is off (the hermetic lane, or real tables outside production)');
  });
}
```

```ts
  router.post('/__dev/extraction/tick', json(), async (_req, res) => {
    // tests need not wait out the debounce - jump the clock past a just-slid dueAt.
    const nowIso = new Date(Date.now() + config.aiExtractionDebounceMs + 1000).toISOString();
    const { processed, failed } = await runDueExtractions(nowIso, extractionDeps());
    log.info({ now: nowIso, processed, failed }, 'dev extraction tick ran');
```

```ts
  // POST /__dev/ranking/tick - the hermetic lane's ONLY ranking runner (WP1
  // B2a spec D7). A queued ranking job is due at once, so the lane's real
  // worker would race any seam; the lane therefore sets RANKING_WORKER_POLL=off
  // (refused under NODE_ENV=production) and jobs run only here. One POST runs
  // ONE runDueRankings pass on the wall clock and answers when every job it
  // claimed has finished. Same triple-gate/hermetic-LOCAL-only construction as
  // the ticks above. The deps - and so this process's job slots - are built
  // once, lazily, by the same createRankingJobDeps the worker uses; `events` is
  // the app's own bus, so ranking.updated reaches SSE clients with no bridge hop.
  //
  // R2F6: mounted ONLY on a LOCAL DynamoDB target (S2's isLocalDynamoTarget).
  // The dev router's own gate (lib/devRoutes.ts) accepts any non-empty
  // endpoint, and these lazily built deps take S2's real-table defaults (the
  // anthropic driver) - so without this check a laptop with DEV_AUTH_ENABLED
  // and a non-local endpoint could run the real model on real tables.
  if (isLocalDynamoTarget(config.dynamodbEndpoint)) {
    let rankingDeps = deps.rankingTickDeps;
    const rankingTickDeps = (): RankingJobDeps => {
      rankingDeps ??= createRankingJobDeps({ config, logger: log, events: appEvents });
      return rankingDeps;
    };
    router.post('/__dev/ranking/tick', json(), async (_req, res) => {
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      const summary = await runDueRankings(nowIso, rankingTickDeps());
      log.info({ now: nowIso, ...summary }, 'dev ranking tick ran');
      res.status(200).json({ ok: true, ...summary });
    });
  } else {
    log.info('dev ranking tick not mounted - DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT is not a local DynamoDB target');
  }
```

### 9.4 Coverage

| Spec test bullet (spec 6) / watch item | Proved by |
|---|---|
| Job: claim fresh | S5.3 "a fresh press hands S2 the claim" |
| Job: claim on done, failed, expired queued | S5.3 `it.each` re-claims; S5.8 "a later press claims afresh" |
| Job: join | S5.3 "JOINS a live queued job", "JOINS a running job"; S5.8 concurrent presses |
| Job: a losing press that reads a finished job re-claims | S5.3 "retries the claim once and wins" |
| Job: 409 on a different window, never for a tenant anchor | S5.3 "refuses 409", "never refuses a tenant anchor" |
| Job: poll claim race (two pollers, one wins) | S5.7 "two pollers"; S5.8 "two pollers racing" |

### 10.0 Scope

S6 builds the READ side and the HTTP surface of the engine:

- `app/src/services/ranking/readRanking.ts` (spec D9): the anchor block
  (display, anchor notes, missing, `cardChanged` against the anchor's own
  fingerprint), the job block (S5's `jobView`: `expired` derived,
  `notScored` carried), `poolWindowDays` (PR26), one row per pool member
  (`notRankedYet` / `notScored` / the match with derived `band`, `capped`,
  `capReason` and every `outOfDate` reason: `card`, `pairHistory`, `age`,
  `version`, `failedBatch` - the computedAt-vs-startedAt rule applied to the
  last job's `failedBatches` AND `notScored` (PR13) - and `unverified`), the
  sort for both directions with the three priority strengths, the ceiling
  answering `poolTooLarge` with the anchor block kept (PR16), a 503 only
  from the anchor's own reads (PR17; three more cases are listed as kept,
  contradiction 6), and the open unlawful flags for the properties in view.
- `app/src/routes/rankings.ts` (spec D12): `POST .../rank`, `GET ...`,
  `GET .../job` - admin AND va (plain `requireAuth` via the `/api` mount),
  the rank POST rate limited by `RATE_LIMIT_RANK_PER_MIN` through
  `createUserRateLimit`, mounted the way the broadcast send limiter is; the
  claim's 404 is S3's `rankingAnchorExists` (PR21).
- `app/src/routes/adminRankings.ts` (spec D12, D18 data): the runs list
  (`anchorDisplay` always present, IR21), the run detail (S7's field names:
  top-level `anchorDisplay`, each pair's `missing`, `cappedAtRun`,
  `currentRunId`, band computed with `bandOf`; PR14, IR19), the cost by ISO
  week and by environment in S7's shape (IR20) - admin only.
- Their mount in `app/src/routes/api.ts` (route stage of the locked chain;
  re-read after S5, which edits the SSE block of the same file, IR33).
- WI18: the 150-tenant property read measured on DynamoDB Local (PR24), and
  the WI11 fingerprint invariants proved end to end through the real
  gatherer and the read.

S6 does NOT build: the job, the claim and the poll (S5 - S6 calls
`claimRanking`, `jobView`, the flag helpers); the gatherer, cards,
fingerprints, the display rule, the recency rule, the anchor-exists rule and
`mapWithConcurrency` (S3); bands / cap (S4); the repositories (S2); the
dashboard Rankings tab, its API client types and `EventStreamProvider`
(S7); any e2e spec (S7).

### 10.1 Contradictions (spec or plan head vs the tree) and the resolution used

1. Spec D12 "rate limited ... mounted as the broadcast send limiter is":
   the broadcast limiter is ONE `createUserRateLimit` instance created with
   the router and placed ahead of the send POST alone
   (`app/src/routes/broadcasts.ts:1159-1164`), the shape of the manual send
   limiter too (`app/src/routes/api.ts:1377-1383`). The draft does exactly
   that inside `createRankingsRouter`; reads and the job poll are unmetered.
2. Roles: admin and va routes are plain `requireAuth()` from the `/api`
   mount (`app/src/app.ts:243`); admin-only routers call
   `router.use(requireRole('admin'))` (`app/src/routes/aiRuns.ts:137`). The
   rankings router adds NO role gate; the admin rankings router gates every
   route. Verified.
3. Spec D12's admin paths sit under `/api/admin/rankings`; the tree has no
   `/admin` mount in `app/src/routes/api.ts` today. The draft mounts
   `router.use('/admin/rankings', ...)` beside `/ai-runs`; CloudFront's
   `/api/*` behavior already admits it (`EDGE_MUTATING_PREFIXES`,
   `app/src/app.ts:79`), and all three admin routes are GETs.
4. The press's correlation: `requestId` is the correlation middleware's
   (`app/src/middleware/correlation.ts`); the traceparent is
   `currentTraceparent()` - the inbound one when valid, else a fresh one -
   the rule job envelopes use (`app/src/jobs/jobs.ts:192`).
5. Spec D9 "answers `poolTooLarge` with no rows" (PR16): 200 with the
   anchor block present (display by S3's `propertyDisplay` /
   `tenantDisplay` from `PoolFailure.anchorRecord`, `anchorNotes`,
   `missing` from S3's `poolTooLargeMissing(failure, deps)` (FB4 / BA5; a
   throw there is the anchor's own landlord read, so 503 per PR17),
   `cardChanged: false`), `rows: []`, `flags: []`,
   `poolTooLarge: { size, message }` - `message` is the pool's own
   `POOL_MESSAGES.poolTooLarge(size)` text (BA3), S7 shows it verbatim.
6. PR17: "A 503 comes ONLY from the anchor's own reads (its card, its seen
   set, and for a property anchor its own flag read)." Applied: a
   candidate's incomplete reads (card, sends, tours - S3's `unverified`; a
   candidate property's flag read) mark only its row `unverified`, and its
   cap follows PR17's rule. NOT a candidate read and so still a 503 here,
   for the planner to confirm (IR25's open half): an organization-list
   failure (`org_list_failed`: no pool can be computed), an incomplete
   matches read (`getPairs` cannot say WHICH pair went unread, and an
   unread pair must never read "not ranked yet"), and a failed job read
   (the `notScored` / `failedBatch` rule needs it). See the reply to the
   planner.
7. PR14 / IR19: the run detail's pairs use S7's names: `missing` (the
   merged list S5 now stores on each `results[]` entry), `cappedAtRun`
   (boolean, from the stored `{ capped }`), `currentRunId` (the current
   match's `runId`, or null), `anchorDisplay` at the top level (falling back
   to `run.anchorId`, IR21); `returned`, `capReason`, `unknowns` and
   `sinceRescored` ride along as extra fields. Band is `bandOf(score)`
   server side, Weak when capped.
8. IR20: the cost response is S7's: `{ environment: config.appEnv, weeks:
   [{ week, environment, runs, inputTokens, outputTokens, costUsd }] }`
   grouped by ISO week AND environment, plus `totalUsd` and `truncated`.
   PR34 / R2B6: a missing `to` is today (UTC); a missing `from` is the
   Monday 11 weeks before the Monday of `to`'s ISO week (12 ISO weeks
   ending with `to`'s); so with neither, the last 12 ISO weeks
   (`costRange(given, now)`; `defaultCostRange(now)` is its no-bounds
   case). A lone `to` therefore never reads all time. Both the cost
   and the runs list read S2's summary-only `listRuns` and answer
   `incomplete: true` when any page they read says so; an unread run's row
   in the list stays `{ runId, expired: true }` (S7's row shape).
11. FB19: the property anchor's tie order (spec D9: "last heard from,
    falling back to created_at") is S3's `sortRecencyAt`, not the pool
    window's `poolRecencyAt` - an imported tenant never heard from sorts by
    its `created_at`, not last.
12. PR38 / PR43 (read side): an anchor of either kind whose own reads fail
    at READ time still answers 503 (PR17). After S5's PR38 / PR43 job (done,
    every candidate in `notScored` as `unreadable`), the next readable read
    shows "not scored - retry" rows and any older match `outOfDate`
    `failedBatch` by the existing PR13 rule - no new read code, one test per
    anchor kind.
13. PR30: the integration test's `loadConfig` names its local
    `DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT`, so S2's config resolves the local-table defaults
    (no `anthropic` driver default) as the lane does.
9. PR24: WI18's 5 s budget is asserted when `RANKING_READ_BUDGET=1` is set,
   in a run of that test file alone; inside `npm test` the same test
   asserts a 20 s ceiling. A miss may be fixed in S3's `assemble.ts`,
   `seenSet.ts` or `pairHistory.ts`; the S6 report names each change.
10. Spec D9's "about ten DynamoDB reads per tenant candidate ... with a
    bounded concurrency (`RANKING_READ_CONCURRENCY`)" are S3's gatherer's
    reads; S6's own are one consistent job read, the matches BatchGet, and
    one flag query per property in view (for a tenant anchor bounded by the
    same `RANKING_READ_CONCURRENCY` through S3's `mapWithConcurrency`, IR29).

### 10.2 Cross-slice notes (for the planner)

Exports S6 adds (S7 consumes the wire shapes):

```ts
// services/ranking/readRanking.ts
export type OutOfDateReason = 'card' | 'pairHistory' | 'age' | 'version' | 'failedBatch' | 'unverified';
export type PriorityStrength = AppConfig['rankingPriorityStrength'];
export const RANKING_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE: string;
export interface RankingReadMatch { score: number; band: Band; capped: boolean; capReason: 'requirement not met' | null; for: MatchRow['for']; against: MatchRow['against']; missing: MatchRow['missing']; failedRequirements: string[]; fairHousingFlags: MatchRow['fairHousingFlags']; computedAt: string; model: string; runId: string; outOfDate: OutOfDateReason[] }
export interface RankingReadRow { candidateId: string; tenantId: string; unitId: string; display: string; hasConsent?: boolean; priority?: boolean; notRankedYet: boolean; notScored: boolean; match: RankingReadMatch | null }
export interface RankingReadFlag { unitId: string; field: string; reason: string; runId: string; raisedAt: string }
export interface RankingReadAnchor { kind: AnchorKind; id: string; display: string; anchorNotes: AnchorNote[]; missing: MissingFlag[]; cardChanged: boolean }
export type RankingRead =
  | { kind: 'ok'; anchor: RankingReadAnchor; job: RankingJobView | null; rows: RankingReadRow[]; flags: RankingReadFlag[]; poolWindowDays: number; poolTooLarge?: { size: number; message: string } }
  | { kind: 'not_found' }
  | { kind: 'unavailable'; message: string };
export interface RowContext { now: Date; maxAgeDays: number; model: string; job: RankingJobRecord | undefined; openFieldsByUnit: ReadonlyMap<string, string[]>; unreadFlagUnits: ReadonlySet<string> }
export function currentRankingModel(config: Pick<AppConfig, 'rankingDriver' | 'aiRankingModel'>): string;
export function inLastJob(job: RankingJobRecord | undefined, candidateId: string): boolean;
export function outOfDateReasons(candidate: AssembledCandidate, row: MatchRow, ctx: RowContext): OutOfDateReason[];
export function buildRow(candidate: AssembledCandidate, row: MatchRow | undefined, ctx: RowContext): RankingReadRow;
export function sortRows(entries: ReadonlyArray<{ row: RankingReadRow; candidate: AssembledCandidate }>, kind: AnchorKind, strength: PriorityStrength): RankingReadRow[];
export interface RankingReadDeps { assemble(anchor: AnchorRef, opts: { includeOlder: boolean; now: Date }): Promise<AssembleResult>; poolTooLargeMissing(failure: PoolFailure): Promise<MissingFlag[]>; jobs: Pick<RankingRunsRepo, 'getJob' | 'getOpenCandidateFlags'>; matches: Pick<MatchesRepo, 'getPairs'>; config: Pick<AppConfig, 'rankingMaxAgeDays' | 'rankingPriorityStrength' | 'rankingDriver' | 'aiRankingModel' | 'rankingReadConcurrency' | 'rankingPoolWindowDays'>; logger: Logger }
export function readRanking(anchor: AnchorRef, opts: { includeOlder: boolean; now: Date }, deps: RankingReadDeps): Promise<RankingRead>;
export function createRankingReadDeps(opts: { config: AppConfig; logger: Logger; env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv; doc?: DynamoDBDocumentClient }): RankingReadDeps;

// routes/rankings.ts
export interface RankingsRouterDeps { config: AppConfig; logger?: Logger; contactsRepo?: Pick<ContactsRepo, 'getById'>; unitsRepo?: Pick<UnitsRepo, 'getById'>; claim?(anchor: AnchorRef, press: RankingPress): Promise<ClaimResult>; read?(anchor: AnchorRef, opts: { includeOlder: boolean; now: Date }): Promise<RankingRead>; getJob?(anchor: AnchorRef): Promise<RankingJobRecord | undefined>; now?(): Date }
export function createRankingsRouter(deps: RankingsRouterDeps): Router;

// routes/adminRankings.ts
export interface AdminRankingsRouterDeps { config: AppConfig; logger?: Logger; runsRepo?: Pick<RankingRunsRepo, 'listRuns' | 'getRun' | 'getOpenCandidateFlags'>; matchesRepo?: Pick<MatchesRepo, 'getPairs'>; contactsRepo?: Pick<ContactsRepo, 'getDisplaysByIds'>; unitsRepo?: Pick<UnitsRepo, 'getDisplaysByIds'>; propertyFacts?(unitIds: string[]): Promise<Map<string, PropertyFacts>>; now?(): Date }
export function createAdminRankingsRouter(deps: AdminRankingsRouterDeps): Router;
export function isoWeekOf(iso: string): string;  // 'YYYY-Www'
export const COST_DEFAULT_WEEKS = 12;
export function costRange(given: { from?: string; to?: string }, now: Date): { from: string; to: string };  // PR34, R2B6
export function defaultCostRange(now: Date): { from: string; to: string };  // costRange({}, now)
```

Wire shapes for S7 (each endpoint's 200 body):

- `GET /api/rankings/:kind/:id` - `{ anchor, job, rows, flags, poolWindowDays, poolTooLarge?: { size, message } }`
  (over the ceiling `anchor.missing` is populated, FB4);
  a row is `RankingReadRow` (S7's `RankingRowView` plus `tenantId`,
  `unitId`, `notRankedYet`); `job` is S5's `RankingJobView` (with
  `notScored`, `batchCount: number`).
- `POST .../rank` - 202 `{ job: RankingJobView, joined }`; 409
  `{ error: 'ranking_running', message }`; 503 bodies use `error:
  'ranking_unavailable'` with `message` (IR32).
- `GET /api/admin/rankings/runs/:runId` - `{ run, anchorDisplay, input,
  pairs, flags, currentUnavailable?, flagsUnavailable? }`; `run` is the
  stored record less `itemId`, `inputGzip`, `handles`, `results`
  (`matchesWritten` is `{ count, at }`, PR15); a pair is `{ candidateId,
  handle, display, returned, score?, band?, cappedAtRun, capReason, for,
  against, missing, unknowns, failedRequirements, fairHousingFlags,
  currentRunId, sinceRescored }`.
- `GET /api/admin/rankings/runs` - `{ runs, nextCursor?, incomplete?: true }`;
  an expired or unread run's row is `{ runId, expired: true }`.
- `GET /api/admin/rankings/cost` - `{ environment, weeks, totalUsd, truncated, incomplete?: true }`;
  a missing `to` = today, a missing `from` = 12 ISO weeks ending with `to`'s week (PR34, R2B6).

```ts
import type { AssembledCandidate } from '../src/services/ranking/assemble.js';
import {

function ctx(over: Partial<RowContext> = {}): RowContext {

const tenant = (id = 't-1', over: Parameters<typeof tenantCandidate>[1] = {}) => tenantCandidate(id, over);
const row = (over: Partial<Parameters<typeof matchRow>[0]> = {}) => matchRow({ tenantId: 't-1', unitId: ANCHOR_UNIT, ...over });

describe('band and cap', () => {
  it.each([
    [100, 'strong'], [80, 'strong'], [79, 'good'], [60, 'good'], [59, 'possible'], [40, 'possible'], [39, 'weak'], [0, 'weak'],
  ])('score %i reads %s', (score, band) => {
    expect(buildRow(tenant(), row({ score }), ctx()).match?.band).toBe(band);
  });

  it('a cap-eligible key, recorded on the property, failed, with no accommodation and no open flag, caps at Weak', () => {
    expect(buildRow(tenant(), row({ score: 92, failedRequirements: ['no_pets'] }), ctx()).match).toMatchObject({
      score: 92, band: 'weak', capped: true, capReason: 'requirement not met',
    });

    expect(buildRow(c, row({ score: 92, failedRequirements: ['no_pets'] }), ctx()).match).toMatchObject({ band: 'strong', capped: false, capReason: null });
  });

  it('a key that is not cap-eligible never caps', () => {
    const c = tenant('t-1', { propertyFacts: facts({ recordedRequirementKeys: ['deposit_one_month'] }) });
    expect(buildRow(c, row({ score: 92, failedRequirements: ['deposit_one_month'] }), ctx()).match?.capped).toBe(false);
  });

  });

    const r = row({ score: 92, failedRequirements: ['qualifications'] });
    expect(buildRow(tenant(), r, ctx({ openFieldsByUnit: new Map([[ANCHOR_UNIT, ['qualifications']]]) })).match?.capped).toBe(false);

    expect(buildRow(tenant(), r, ctx()).match?.capped).toBe(true);
    // An open flag on ANOTHER property does not reach this pair.
    expect(buildRow(tenant(), r, ctx({ openFieldsByUnit: new Map([['unit-other', ['qualifications']]]) })).match?.capped).toBe(true);
  });

  it('a landlord: flag is treated as a flag on its plain key, and a landlord default counts as recorded', () => {
    const c = tenant('t-1', {

    });
    const r = row({ score: 92, failedRequirements: ['qualifications'] });
    expect(buildRow(c, r, ctx()).match?.capped).toBe(true);
    expect(buildRow(c, r, ctx({ openFieldsByUnit: new Map([[ANCHOR_UNIT, ['landlord:qualifications']]]) })).match?.capped).toBe(false);
  });

  it('PR17: with no property facts, every failed cap-eligible key counts as recorded and no flag as open', () => {
    const c = unverifiedProperty('u-1');
    const r = matchRow({ tenantId: ANCHOR_TENANT, unitId: 'u-1', score: 88, failedRequirements: ['no_pets'] });
    const m = buildRow(c, r, ctx({ openFieldsByUnit: new Map([['u-1', ['no_pets']]]) })).match!;
    expect(m).toMatchObject({ capped: true, band: 'weak' });
    expect(m.outOfDate).toEqual(['unverified']);
  });

  it("PR17: a candidate property whose flag read failed: recorded keys from its facts, no flag open, row unverified", () => {
    const c = propertyCandidate('u-1');
    const r = matchRow({ tenantId: ANCHOR_TENANT, unitId: 'u-1', score: 88, failedRequirements: ['qualifications'], fingerprints: c.fingerprints });
    const m = buildRow(c, r, ctx({ openFieldsByUnit: new Map([['u-1', ['qualifications']]]), unreadFlagUnits: new Set(['u-1']) })).match!;
    expect(m.capped).toBe(true);
    expect(m.outOfDate).toEqual(['unverified']);
  });
});

describe('out of date', () => {
  it('a current, fresh, same-version match is not out of date', () => {
    expect(outOfDateReasons(tenant(), row(), ctx())).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('card: the tenant card or the unit card fingerprint differs', () => {
    expect(outOfDateReasons(tenant('t-1', { fingerprints: { tenantCard: 'tc-new', unitCard: 'uc-anchor', pairHistory: 'ph-t-1' } }), row(), ctx())).toEqual(['card']);
    expect(outOfDateReasons(tenant('t-1', { fingerprints: { tenantCard: 'tc-t-1', unitCard: 'uc-new', pairHistory: 'ph-t-1' } }), row(), ctx())).toEqual(['card']);
  });

  it('pairHistory: the pair history fingerprint differs', () => {
    expect(outOfDateReasons(tenant('t-1', { fingerprints: { tenantCard: 'tc-t-1', unitCard: 'uc-anchor', pairHistory: 'ph-new' } }), row(), ctx())).toEqual(['pairHistory']);
  });

  it('(PIN) only fingerprints decide card and pair history: a different send list with equal fingerprints changes nothing', () => {
    const c = tenant('t-1', { pairHistory: { sends: [{ at: isoAt(-DAY_MS), kind: 'sent' }], declined: null, tours: [], daysSinceLastSend: 1 } });
    expect(outOfDateReasons(c, row(), ctx())).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('age: older than RANKING_MAX_AGE_DAYS; exactly the limit is still current', () => {
    expect(outOfDateReasons(tenant(), row({ computedAt: isoAt(-7 * DAY_MS - 1) }), ctx())).toEqual(['age']);
    expect(outOfDateReasons(tenant(), row({ computedAt: isoAt(-7 * DAY_MS) }), ctx())).toEqual([]);
  });

  it.each([
    ['rubric', { rubricVersion: 'r0' }],
    ['examples', { examplesVersion: 'e0' }],
    ['model', { model: 'claude-opus-5-5' }],
  ])('version: a %s other than current', (_label, over) => {
    expect(outOfDateReasons(tenant(), row(over), ctx())).toEqual(['version']);
  });

  it('a fake match is out of date wherever a real model is configured', () => {
    expect(outOfDateReasons(tenant(), row({ model: 'fake' }), ctx({ model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' }))).toEqual(['version']);
    expect(row().rubricVersion).toBe(RUBRIC_VERSION);
  });

  it.each([
    ['a failed batch', runningJob({ startedAt: T0, failedBatches: [{ index: 0, candidateIds: ['t-1'], failure: 'timeout' }] })],
    ['notScored (omitted)', runningJob({ startedAt: T0, notScored: [{ candidateId: 't-1', reason: 'omitted' }] })],
    ['notScored (unreadable)', runningJob({ startedAt: T0, notScored: [{ candidateId: 't-1', reason: 'unreadable' }] })],
  ])('failedBatch: listed in %s of the last job and computed before that job started (PR13)', (_label, job) => {
    expect(outOfDateReasons(tenant(), row({ computedAt: isoAt(-60_000) }), ctx({ job }))).toEqual(['failedBatch']);
  });

  it('failedBatch does NOT flag a pair re-scored since (by the other anchor)', () => {
    const job = runningJob({ startedAt: T0, failedBatches: [{ index: 0, candidateIds: ['t-1'], failure: 'timeout' }] });
    expect(outOfDateReasons(tenant(), row({ computedAt: isoAt(60_000) }), ctx({ job, now: new Date(isoAt(120_000)) }))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('unverified: shown with the stored match, the card comparisons skipped', () => {
    expect(outOfDateReasons(unverifiedTenant('t-1'), row(), ctx())).toEqual(['unverified']);
  });

  it('reasons accumulate in a fixed order', () => {
    const job = runningJob({ startedAt: T0, notScored: [{ candidateId: 't-1', reason: 'omitted' }] });
    const c = tenant('t-1', { fingerprints: { tenantCard: 'tc-new', unitCard: 'uc-anchor', pairHistory: 'ph-new' } });
    expect(outOfDateReasons(c, row({ computedAt: isoAt(-8 * DAY_MS), model: 'old' }), ctx({ job }))).toEqual([
      'card', 'pairHistory', 'age', 'version', 'failedBatch',
    ]);
  });
});

describe('not ranked yet / not scored', () => {
  it('no match and not listed by the last job: not ranked yet', () => {
    expect(buildRow(tenant(), undefined, ctx())).toMatchObject({ notRankedYet: true, notScored: false, match: null });
  });

  it("no match and listed in the last job's failedBatches or notScored (PR13): not scored", () => {
    for (const job of [
      runningJob({ failedBatches: [{ index: 2, candidateIds: ['t-1'], failure: 'timeout' }] }),
      runningJob({ notScored: [{ candidateId: 't-1', reason: 'omitted' }] }),

});

describe('currentRankingModel', () => {
```
