```ts
describe('sortRows', () => {
  function entry(candidate: AssembledCandidate, score: number | null, over: { capped?: boolean } = {}) {
    const stored =
      score === null
        ? undefined
        : matchRow({
            tenantId: candidate.tenantId,
            unitId: candidate.unitId,
            score,
            ...(candidate.fingerprints !== null && { fingerprints: candidate.fingerprints }),
            ...(over.capped === true && { failedRequirements: ['no_pets'] }),
          });
    return { row: buildRow(candidate, stored, ctx()), candidate };
  }
  const ids = (rows: RankingReadRow[]) => rows.map((r) => r.candidateId);
  const heard = (id: string, offsetMs: number) => tenant(id, { record: tenantRecord(id, { last_heard_from_at: isoAt(offsetMs) }) });

  it('property anchor: band, then score, then last heard from else created_at (sortRecencyAt; none last); capped last within Weak; unranked last in pool order', () => {
    const never = tenant('good-70-never', {
      record: tenantRecord('good-70-never', { last_heard_from_at: undefined, created_at: undefined }),
    });
    // FB19 (spec D9): an IMPORTED tenant never heard from sorts by created_at -
    // the pool window's import exception (poolRecencyAt) does not apply here.
    const imported = tenant('good-70-imported', {
      record: tenantRecord('good-70-imported', {
        last_heard_from_at: undefined,
        created_at: isoAt(-5 * DAY_MS),
        imported_from: 'quo-airtable-import',
      }),
    });
    const entries = [
      entry(tenant('unranked-1'), null),
      entry(heard('weak-capped', 0), 95, { capped: true }),
      entry(heard('weak-30', -DAY_MS), 30),
      entry(heard('good-70-old', -9 * DAY_MS), 70),
      entry(heard('good-70-new', -DAY_MS), 70),
      entry(never, 70),
      entry(imported, 70),
      entry(tenant('strong-81'), 81),
      entry(tenant('unranked-2'), null),
    ];
    expect(ids(sortRows(entries, 'unit', 'within_band'))).toEqual([
      'strong-81', 'good-70-new', 'good-70-imported', 'good-70-old', 'good-70-never', 'weak-30', 'weak-capped', 'unranked-1', 'unranked-2',
    ]);
  });

  it('property anchor: priority does not apply', () => {
    const entries = [entry(tenant('a'), 70), entry(tenant('b', { priority: true }), 65)];
    expect(ids(sortRows(entries, 'unit', 'always_first'))).toEqual(['a', 'b']);
  });

  const prop = (id: string, priority: boolean, display?: string) =>
    propertyCandidate(id, { priority, ...(display !== undefined && { display }) });

  it('tenant anchor, within_band: band, then priority on before off, then score, then label; no lift for a capped pair', () => {
    const entries = [
      entry(prop('good-plain-75', false), 75),
      entry(prop('good-prio-62', true), 62),
      entry(prop('strong-plain-90', false), 90),
      entry(prop('weak-prio-capped', true), 88, { capped: true }),
      entry(prop('weak-plain-20', false), 20),
      entry(prop('good-plain-75-a', false, 'A Street, Atlanta'), 75),

    expect(ids(sortRows(entries, 'tenant', 'within_band'))).toEqual([
      'strong-plain-90', 'good-prio-62', 'good-plain-75-a', 'good-plain-75', 'weak-plain-20', 'weak-prio-capped',
    ]);
  });

  it('tenant anchor, one_band_up: a priority pair sorts as one band higher (score unchanged); never above Strong; not when capped', () => {
    const entries = [
      entry(prop('strong-plain-85', false), 85),
      entry(prop('good-prio-65', true), 65),
      entry(prop('strong-prio-81', true), 81),
      entry(prop('possible-plain-55', false), 55),
      entry(prop('weak-prio-30', true), 30),
      entry(prop('weak-prio-capped', true), 90, { capped: true }),
    ];
    const sorted = sortRows(entries, 'tenant', 'one_band_up');
    // weak-prio-30 sorts as Possible, then priority on before off puts it
    // ahead of possible-plain-55; the capped priority pair stays last in Weak.
    expect(ids(sorted)).toEqual([
      'strong-prio-81', 'good-prio-65', 'strong-plain-85', 'weak-prio-30', 'possible-plain-55', 'weak-prio-capped',
    ]);
    expect(sorted.find((r) => r.candidateId === 'good-prio-65')?.match).toMatchObject({ score: 65, band: 'good' });
  });

  it('tenant anchor, always_first: every non-capped priority pair first, then the rest by band', () => {
    const entries = [
      entry(prop('strong-plain-95', false), 95),
      entry(prop('weak-prio-25', true), 25),
      entry(prop('good-prio-70', true), 70),
      entry(prop('weak-prio-capped', true), 90, { capped: true }),
      entry(prop('unranked-prio', true), null),
    ];
    expect(ids(sortRows(entries, 'tenant', 'always_first'))).toEqual([
      'good-prio-70', 'weak-prio-25', 'strong-plain-95', 'weak-prio-capped', 'unranked-prio',
    ]);
  });
});
```

The label tiebreak in the `within_band` case compares `'A Street, Atlanta'`
with the default `'good-plain-75 Elm St, Atlanta'`; "A" sorts first under
`localeCompare`.

Step 3 - implementation. New file `app/src/services/ranking/readRanking.ts`:

```ts
// Reading a ranking (WP1 B2a spec D9; charter 10.3, 8, 9): what the Rankings
// page (and later B3's composer) shows for one anchor, derived on read from
// the stored matches, the CURRENT pool and cards, the anchor's last job and
// the open unlawful flags. Opening a page calls no model; only a press of
// Rank does (services/ranking/job.ts claimRanking).
//
// Nothing here is stored: band, cap state, priority effect and sort position
// are derived on every read, so a threshold or setting change needs no
// re-rank (charter 10.1). One band (bandOf), one cap (capOf), one open check
// (flags.ts) - the job's cappedAtRun and the counterfactual check call the
// same functions (PR7).
//
// Pairs are read BY KEY from the base table for every pool member
// (matchesRepo.getPairs, requireComplete), never through the eventually
// consistent byUnit index.
//
// PR17: a 503 comes from the anchor's own reads; a candidate whose reads are
// incomplete is a row marked `unverified` showing its stored match, and the
// read never throws on one.
import type { DynamoDBDocumentClient } from '@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb';
import type { AppConfig } from '../../lib/config.js';
import type { Logger } from '../../lib/logger.js';
import type { ContactItem } from '../../repos/contactsRepo.js';
import { createMatchesRepo, matchPairKey, type MatchRow, type MatchesRepo } from '../../repos/matchesRepo.js';
import {
  createRankingRunsRepo,
  type RankingJobRecord,
  type RankingRunsRepo,
  type UnlawfulFlagRecord,
} from '../../repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import type { UnitItem } from '../../repos/unitsRepo.js';
import {
  assembleRanking,
  createAssembleDeps,
  poolTooLargeMissing,
  propertyDisplay,
  tenantDisplay,
  type AssembleResult,
  type AssembledCandidate,
} from './assemble.js';
import { bandOf, type Band } from './bands.js';
import { capOf, flagFieldsOfKind } from './cap.js';
import { EXAMPLES_VERSION } from './examples.js';
import { openFlags } from './flags.js';
import { jobView, type RankingJobView } from './job.js';
import { mapWithConcurrency, sortRecencyAt, type PoolFailure } from './pool.js';
import { RUBRIC_VERSION } from './rubric.js';
import type { AnchorKind, AnchorNote, AnchorRef, MissingFlag } from './types.js';

export type OutOfDateReason = 'card' | 'pairHistory' | 'age' | 'version' | 'failedBatch' | 'unverified';
export type PriorityStrength = AppConfig['rankingPriorityStrength'];

export const RANKING_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE = 'The ranking could not be read. Try again.';

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
const BAND_RANK: Record<Band, number> = { strong: 3, good: 2, possible: 1, weak: 0 };

export interface RankingReadMatch {
  score: number;
  band: Band;
  capped: boolean;
  capReason: 'requirement not met' | null;
  for: MatchRow['for'];
  against: MatchRow['against'];
  missing: MatchRow['missing'];
  failedRequirements: string[];
  fairHousingFlags: MatchRow['fairHousingFlags'];
  computedAt: string;
  model: string;
  runId: string;
  outOfDate: OutOfDateReason[];
}

export interface RankingReadRow {
  candidateId: string;
  tenantId: string;
  unitId: string;
  display: string;
  /** Tenants (a property anchor): SMS consent, a flag only - never a pool rule (D1). */
  hasConsent?: boolean;
  /** Properties (a tenant anchor): read here, never sent to the model (charter 9.2). */
  priority?: boolean;
  notRankedYet: boolean;
  /** No match, and the anchor's last job listed this candidate (failedBatches or notScored, PR13). */
  notScored: boolean;
  match: RankingReadMatch | null;
}

export interface RankingReadFlag {
  unitId: string;
  field: string;
  reason: string;
  runId: string;
  raisedAt: string;
}

export interface RankingReadAnchor {
  kind: AnchorKind;
  id: string;
  display: string;
  anchorNotes: AnchorNote[];
  missing: MissingFlag[];
  /** Some stored match's anchor-side fingerprint differs from the current anchor card. */
  cardChanged: boolean;
}

export type RankingRead =
  | {
      kind: 'ok';
      anchor: RankingReadAnchor;
      job: RankingJobView | null;
      rows: RankingReadRow[];
      flags: RankingReadFlag[];
      /** RANKING_POOL_WINDOW_DAYS, for the include-older copy (PR26). */
      poolWindowDays: number;
      /** PR16: the pool is over RANKING_MAX_POOL; rows is then empty. BA3: `message` is the pool's POOL_MESSAGES text. */
      poolTooLarge?: { size: number; message: string };
    }
  | { kind: 'not_found' }
  | { kind: 'unavailable'; message: string };

export interface RowContext {
  now: Date;
  maxAgeDays: number;
  /** The model a NEW match would carry (currentRankingModel). */
  model: string;
  /** The anchor's last job record (its lists decide notScored / failedBatch). */
  job: RankingJobRecord | undefined;
  /** Per property: the fields of its OPEN unlawful flags. */
  openFieldsByUnit: ReadonlyMap<string, string[]>;
  /** Properties whose flag read failed: their rows read unverified (PR17). */
  unreadFlagUnits: ReadonlySet<string>;
}

/** D6: matches record the driver actually used - the model id for anthropic, else 'fake' / 'console'. */
export function currentRankingModel(config: Pick<AppConfig, 'rankingDriver' | 'aiRankingModel'>): string {
  return config.rankingDriver === 'anthropic' ? config.aiRankingModel : config.rankingDriver;
}

/** PR13: the last job listed the candidate - a failed call, an omission, or an unreadable card. */
export function inLastJob(job: RankingJobRecord | undefined, candidateId: string): boolean {
  if (job === undefined) return false;
  return (
    (job.failedBatches ?? []).some((failed) => failed.candidateIds.includes(candidateId)) ||
    (job.notScored ?? []).some((entry) => entry.candidateId === candidateId)
  );
}

function isUnverified(candidate: AssembledCandidate, ctx: RowContext): boolean {
  return candidate.unverified || ctx.unreadFlagUnits.has(candidate.unitId);
}

/**
 * D9's out-of-date reasons, in a fixed order. `card` / `pairHistory` compare
 * fingerprints only (D13 decides what moves them); a candidate with no
 * current fingerprints (S3 `unverified`) skips both. `failedBatch`: listed by
 * the anchor's last job AND computed before that job started - a pair
 * re-scored since, from the other anchor, is not flagged. `unverified`: the
 * candidate's reads, or its property's flag read, came back incomplete.
 */
export function outOfDateReasons(candidate: AssembledCandidate, row: MatchRow, ctx: RowContext): OutOfDateReason[] {
  const reasons: OutOfDateReason[] = [];
  if (!candidate.unverified) {
    if (
      row.fingerprints.tenantCard !== candidate.fingerprints.tenantCard ||
      row.fingerprints.unitCard !== candidate.fingerprints.unitCard
    ) {
      reasons.push('card');
    }
    if (row.fingerprints.pairHistory !== candidate.fingerprints.pairHistory) reasons.push('pairHistory');
  }
  const computedMs = Date.parse(row.computedAt);
  if (!Number.isFinite(computedMs) || ctx.now.getTime() - computedMs > ctx.maxAgeDays * DAY_MS) reasons.push('age');
  if (row.rubricVersion !== RUBRIC_VERSION || row.examplesVersion !== EXAMPLES_VERSION || row.model !== ctx.model) {
    reasons.push('version');
  }
  const startedAt = ctx.job?.startedAt;
  if (
    startedAt !== undefined &&
    inLastJob(ctx.job, candidate.candidateId) &&
    Number.isFinite(computedMs) &&
    computedMs < Date.parse(startedAt)
  ) {
    reasons.push('failedBatch');
  }
  if (isUnverified(candidate, ctx)) reasons.push('unverified');
  return reasons;
}

function deriveMatch(candidate: AssembledCandidate, row: MatchRow, ctx: RowContext): RankingReadMatch {
  // PR17: with no facts, every failed cap-eligible key counts as recorded;
  // with no facts or an unread flag list, no flag counts as open.
  const facts = candidate.propertyFacts;
  const flagsKnown = facts !== null && !ctx.unreadFlagUnits.has(candidate.unitId);
  const cap = capOf({
    failedRequirements: row.failedRequirements,
    accommodationFields: flagFieldsOfKind(row.fairHousingFlags, 'accommodation'),
    recordedRequirementKeys: facts === null ? row.failedRequirements : facts.recordedRequirementKeys,
    openUnlawfulFields: flagsKnown ? (ctx.openFieldsByUnit.get(candidate.unitId) ?? []) : [],
  });
  return {
    score: row.score,
    band: cap.capped ? 'weak' : bandOf(row.score),
    capped: cap.capped,
    capReason: cap.capReason,
    for: row.for,
    against: row.against,
    missing: row.missing,
    failedRequirements: row.failedRequirements,
    fairHousingFlags: row.fairHousingFlags,
    computedAt: row.computedAt,
    model: row.model,
    runId: row.runId,
    outOfDate: outOfDateReasons(candidate, row, ctx),
  };
}

export function buildRow(candidate: AssembledCandidate, row: MatchRow | undefined, ctx: RowContext): RankingReadRow {
  const base = {
    candidateId: candidate.candidateId,
    tenantId: candidate.tenantId,
    unitId: candidate.unitId,
    display: candidate.display,
    ...(candidate.hasConsent !== undefined && { hasConsent: candidate.hasConsent }),
    ...(candidate.priority !== undefined && { priority: candidate.priority }),
  };
  if (row === undefined) {
    const notScored = inLastJob(ctx.job, candidate.candidateId);
    return { ...base, notRankedYet: !notScored, notScored, match: null };
  }
  return { ...base, notRankedYet: false, notScored: false, match: deriveMatch(candidate, row, ctx) };
}

/**
 * The property anchor's tie order (spec D9, FB19): last heard from, else
 * created_at - S3's sortRecencyAt, NOT the pool window's poolRecencyAt (whose
 * import exception would sort a never-heard imported tenant last). Its
 * candidates are tenants.
 */
function recencyMs(candidate: AssembledCandidate): number | null {
  const at = sortRecencyAt(candidate.record as ContactItem);
  if (at === null) return null;
  const ms = Date.parse(at);
  return Number.isFinite(ms) ? ms : null;
}

/** Newest first; a candidate with no instant sorts after every one with one. */
function compareRecency(a: number | null, b: number | null): number {
  if (a === null && b === null) return 0;
  if (a === null) return 1;
  if (b === null) return -1;
  return b - a;
}

interface SortItem {
  row: RankingReadRow;
  candidate: AssembledCandidate;
  poolIndex: number;
}

function compareMatched(a: SortItem, b: SortItem, kind: AnchorKind, strength: PriorityStrength): number {
  const ma = a.row.match as RankingReadMatch;
  const mb = b.row.match as RankingReadMatch;
  if (kind === 'unit') {
    // Property anchor (candidates are tenants): band, then score, then last
    // heard from. Priority is the anchor's own attribute and does not apply.
    // A capped pair reads Weak and sorts last within it (charter 7.4).
    return (
      BAND_RANK[mb.band] - BAND_RANK[ma.band] ||
      Number(ma.capped) - Number(mb.capped) ||
      mb.score - ma.score ||
      compareRecency(recencyMs(a.candidate), recencyMs(b.candidate))
    );
  }
  // Tenant anchor (candidates are properties): band after the priority
  // strength, then priority on before off, then score, then property label.
  // A capped pair gets no lift and no priority tie preference.
  const liftA = a.row.priority === true && !ma.capped;
  const liftB = b.row.priority === true && !mb.capped;
  if (strength === 'always_first' && liftA !== liftB) return liftA ? -1 : 1;
  const up = (lift: boolean): number => (strength === 'one_band_up' && lift ? 1 : 0);
  const rankA = Math.min(BAND_RANK.strong, BAND_RANK[ma.band] + up(liftA));
  const rankB = Math.min(BAND_RANK.strong, BAND_RANK[mb.band] + up(liftB));
  return (
    rankB - rankA ||
    Number(ma.capped) - Number(mb.capped) ||
    Number(liftB) - Number(liftA) ||
    mb.score - ma.score ||
    a.row.display.localeCompare(b.row.display)
  );
}

/**
 * Charter 9.2's sort. Members with no match sort last, in pool order, in both
 * directions. Ties beyond every key keep pool order (the sort is stable).
 */
export function sortRows(
  entries: ReadonlyArray<{ row: RankingReadRow; candidate: AssembledCandidate }>,
  kind: AnchorKind,
  strength: PriorityStrength,
): RankingReadRow[] {
  const items: SortItem[] = entries.map((entry, poolIndex) => ({ ...entry, poolIndex }));
  items.sort((a, b) => {
    const aMatched = a.row.match !== null;
    const bMatched = b.row.match !== null;
    if (aMatched !== bMatched) return aMatched ? -1 : 1;
    if (!aMatched) return a.poolIndex - b.poolIndex;
    return compareMatched(a, b, kind, strength) || a.poolIndex - b.poolIndex;
  });
  return items.map((item) => item.row);
}

/** S3's display rule for a record the pool failure hands back (PR16). */
export function anchorDisplayOf(anchor: AnchorRef, record: ContactItem | UnitItem | undefined): string {
  if (record === undefined) return anchor.id;
  return anchor.kind === 'unit' ? propertyDisplay(record as UnitItem) : tenantDisplay(record as ContactItem);
}
```

Step 3 - implementation. Append at the END of

```ts
// --- the read --------------------------------------------------------------

export interface RankingReadDeps {
  /** assembleRanking bound to its deps (createRankingReadDeps); a stub in tests. */
  assemble(anchor: AnchorRef, opts: { includeOlder: boolean; now: Date }): Promise<AssembleResult>;
  /**
   * FB4: S3's poolTooLargeMissing bound to the same deps - the anchor's
   * missing flags over the ceiling. A throw is the anchor's own landlord read
   * failing (503, PR17).
   */
  poolTooLargeMissing(failure: PoolFailure): Promise<MissingFlag[]>;
  jobs: Pick<RankingRunsRepo, 'getJob' | 'getOpenCandidateFlags'>;
  matches: Pick<MatchesRepo, 'getPairs'>;
  config: Pick<
    AppConfig,
    | 'rankingMaxAgeDays'
    | 'rankingPriorityStrength'
    | 'rankingDriver'
    | 'aiRankingModel'
    | 'rankingReadConcurrency'
    | 'rankingPoolWindowDays'
  >;
  logger: Logger;
}

const UNAVAILABLE: RankingRead = { kind: 'unavailable', message: RANKING_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE };

export async function readRanking(
  anchor: AnchorRef,
  opts: { includeOlder: boolean; now: Date },
  deps: RankingReadDeps,
): Promise<RankingRead> {
  const log = deps.logger;
  const where = { anchorKind: anchor.kind, anchorId: anchor.id };
  const poolWindowDays = deps.config.rankingPoolWindowDays;

  let result: AssembleResult;
  try {
    result = await deps.assemble(anchor, opts);
  } catch (err) {
    log.error({ ...where, err }, 'ranking read: the pool and cards could not be gathered');
    return UNAVAILABLE;
  }

  let job: RankingJobRecord | undefined;
  try {
    job = await deps.jobs.getJob(anchor.kind, anchor.id, { consistent: true });
  } catch (err) {
    log.error({ ...where, err }, 'ranking read: job read failed');
    return UNAVAILABLE;
  }
  const view = job === undefined ? null : jobView(job, opts.now.toISOString());

  if (!result.ok) {
    if (result.reason === 'anchor_not_found') return { kind: 'not_found' };
    if (result.reason === 'pool_too_large') {
      // PR16: the anchor block stays; no row is computed. FB4: its missing
      // flags come from S3's poolTooLargeMissing; a throw there is the
      // anchor's own landlord read (PR17: 503).
      let missing: MissingFlag[];
      try {
        missing = await deps.poolTooLargeMissing(result);
      } catch (err) {
        log.error({ ...where, err }, "ranking read: the over-ceiling anchor's own read failed");
        return UNAVAILABLE;
      }
      return {
        kind: 'ok',
        anchor: {
          kind: anchor.kind,
          id: anchor.id,
          display: anchorDisplayOf(anchor, result.anchorRecord),
          anchorNotes: result.anchorNotes ?? [],
          missing,
          cardChanged: false,
        },
        job: view,
        rows: [],
        flags: [],
        poolWindowDays,
        // BA3: the pool's own POOL_MESSAGES text, shown as is by S7.
        poolTooLarge: { size: result.size ?? 0, message: result.message },
      };
    }
    log.warn({ ...where, reason: result.reason }, 'ranking read unavailable');
    return { kind: 'unavailable', message: result.message };
  }

  const { candidates } = result;
  let pairs: Map<string, MatchRow>;
  try {
    pairs =
      candidates.length === 0
        ? new Map()
        : await deps.matches.getPairs(
            candidates.map((candidate) => ({ tenantId: candidate.tenantId, unitId: candidate.unitId })),
            { requireComplete: true },
          );
  } catch (err) {
    log.error({ ...where, err, keys: candidates.length }, 'ranking read: matches read incomplete');
    return UNAVAILABLE;
  }

  // The open flags of the properties in view. A property anchor's own read
  // failing is the anchor's read (503, PR17); a candidate property's failing
  // marks only its rows unverified.
  const openByUnit = new Map<string, UnlawfulFlagRecord[]>();
  const unreadFlagUnits = new Set<string>();
  if (anchor.kind === 'unit') {
    const anchorFacts = result.anchor.propertyFacts;
    if (anchorFacts !== null) {
      try {
        openByUnit.set(anchor.id, openFlags(await deps.jobs.getOpenCandidateFlags(anchor.id), anchorFacts.freeTextByField));
      } catch (err) {
        log.error({ ...where, err }, "ranking read: the anchor property's flag read failed");
        return UNAVAILABLE;
      }
    }
  } else {
    const units = new Map<string, Readonly<Record<string, string>>>();
    for (const candidate of candidates) {
      if (candidate.propertyFacts !== null && !units.has(candidate.unitId)) {
        units.set(candidate.unitId, candidate.propertyFacts.freeTextByField);
      }
    }
    await mapWithConcurrency([...units.entries()], deps.config.rankingReadConcurrency, async ([unitId, freeText]) => {
      try {
        openByUnit.set(unitId, openFlags(await deps.jobs.getOpenCandidateFlags(unitId), freeText));
      } catch (err) {
        unreadFlagUnits.add(unitId);
        log.warn({ ...where, unitId, err }, 'ranking read: a candidate property flag read failed - its row reads unverified');
      }
    });
  }
  const openFieldsByUnit = new Map<string, string[]>(
    [...openByUnit.entries()].map(([unitId, records]) => [unitId, [...new Set(records.map((r) => r.field))]]),
  );

  const ctx: RowContext = {
    now: opts.now,
    maxAgeDays: deps.config.rankingMaxAgeDays,
    model: currentRankingModel(deps.config),
    job,
    openFieldsByUnit,
    unreadFlagUnits,
  };
  const entries = candidates.map((candidate) => ({
    candidate,
    row: buildRow(candidate, pairs.get(matchPairKey(candidate.tenantId, candidate.unitId)), ctx),
  }));
  // D9 cardChanged: a stored match whose anchor-side fingerprint is not the anchor's current one.
  const cardChanged = candidates.some((candidate) => {
    const stored = pairs.get(matchPairKey(candidate.tenantId, candidate.unitId));
    if (stored === undefined) return false;
    const storedAnchorSide = anchor.kind === 'unit' ? stored.fingerprints.unitCard : stored.fingerprints.tenantCard;
    return storedAnchorSide !== result.anchor.fingerprint;
  });
  const flags: RankingReadFlag[] = [...openByUnit.values()].flat().map((record) => ({
    unitId: record.unitId,
    field: record.field,
    reason: record.reason,
    runId: record.runId,
    raisedAt: record.raisedAt,
  }));

  return {
    kind: 'ok',
    anchor: {
      kind: anchor.kind,
      id: anchor.id,
      display: result.anchor.display,
      anchorNotes: result.anchor.anchorNotes,
      missing: result.anchor.missing,
      cardChanged,
    },
    job: view,
    rows: sortRows(entries, anchor.kind, deps.config.rankingPriorityStrength),
    flags,
    poolWindowDays,
  };
}

/** The production wiring (routes/rankings.ts default; the WI18 measurement). */
export function createRankingReadDeps(opts: {
  config: AppConfig;
  logger: Logger;
  env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
  doc?: DynamoDBDocumentClient;
}): RankingReadDeps {
  const repoDeps = { logger: opts.logger, env: opts.env, doc: opts.doc };
  const assembleDeps = createAssembleDeps({ config: opts.config, logger: opts.logger, env: opts.env, doc: opts.doc });
  return {
    assemble: (anchor, assembleOpts) => assembleRanking(anchor, assembleOpts, assembleDeps),
    poolTooLargeMissing: (failure) => poolTooLargeMissing(failure, assembleDeps),
    jobs: createRankingRunsRepo(repoDeps),
    matches: createMatchesRepo(repoDeps),
    config: opts.config,
    logger: opts.logger,
  };
}
```

```ts
// Rankings API (WP1 B2a spec D12; charter 10.2) - admin AND va: these routes
// sit behind the /api mount's requireAuth only, as the composer does
// (routes/broadcasts.ts header). Only /api/admin/rankings is admin-only.
//
//   POST /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId/rank  { includeOlder?: boolean }
//        -> 202 { job, joined } | 400 | 404 anchor_not_found | 409 ranking_running | 429 rate_limited
//   GET  /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId?includeOlder=true|false
//        -> 200 { anchor, job, rows, flags, poolWindowDays[, poolTooLarge] } | 400 | 404 | 503 ranking_unavailable
//   GET  /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId/job
//        -> 200 { job: RankingJobView | null } | 400        (what the page polls)
//
// The rank POST - and only it - sits behind a per-USER sliding-window limiter
// (RATE_LIMIT_RANK_PER_MIN): ONE createUserRateLimit instance created with the
// router and placed ahead of the handler, exactly as the broadcast send
// limiter is (routes/broadcasts.ts), so a limited press writes nothing. Reads
// and the job poll stay unmetered (the page polls the job every 5 s).
//
// The press carries its correlation into the job record: the request's
// requestId (middleware/correlation.ts) and currentTraceparent() - the rule
// job envelopes use (jobs/jobs.ts) - so the job's log lines, run later in a
// fresh context carrying both (services/ranking/job.ts), correlate to this
// request. The 404 is S3's one anchor-exists rule (PR21). PII: log ids only.
import { Router, type Request } from 'express';
import type { AppConfig } from '../lib/config.js';
import { currentTraceparent, getContext, newRequestId } from '../lib/context.js';
import { logger as defaultLogger, type Logger } from '../lib/logger.js';
import type { AuthedRequest } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { createUserRateLimit } from '../middleware/rateLimit.js';
import { createContactsRepo, type ContactsRepo } from '../repos/contactsRepo.js';
import { createRankingRunsRepo, type RankingJobRecord } from '../repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import { createUnitsRepo, type UnitsRepo } from '../repos/unitsRepo.js';
import { claimRanking, jobView, MSG_RUNNING, type ClaimResult, type RankingPress } from '../services/ranking/job.js';
import { rankingAnchorExists } from '../services/ranking/pool.js';
import {
  createRankingReadDeps,
  readRanking,
  type RankingRead,
  type RankingReadDeps,
} from '../services/ranking/readRanking.js';
import type { AnchorRef } from '../services/ranking/types.js';

export interface RankingsRouterDeps {
  config: AppConfig;
  logger?: Logger;
  /** The /api mount's shared repos (default wiring for the 404 check). */
  contactsRepo?: Pick<ContactsRepo, 'getById'>;
  unitsRepo?: Pick<UnitsRepo, 'getById'>;
  /** Test seams; the real claim / read / job read otherwise. */
  claim?(anchor: AnchorRef, press: RankingPress): Promise<ClaimResult>;
  read?(anchor: AnchorRef, opts: { includeOlder: boolean; now: Date }): Promise<RankingRead>;
  getJob?(anchor: AnchorRef): Promise<RankingJobRecord | undefined>;
  now?(): Date;
}

type AnchorParse = { ok: true; anchor: AnchorRef } | { ok: false; error: 'invalid_anchor_kind' | 'invalid_anchor_id' };

function parseAnchor(req: Request): AnchorParse {
  const kind = String(req.params['anchorKind'] ?? '');
  // Typed input is trimmed before store or compare (Cameron's standing rule).
  const id = String(req.params['anchorId'] ?? '').trim();
  if (kind !== 'unit' && kind !== 'tenant') return { ok: false, error: 'invalid_anchor_kind' };
  if (id.length === 0) return { ok: false, error: 'invalid_anchor_id' };
  return { ok: true, anchor: { kind, id } };
}

function parseIncludeOlderQuery(raw: unknown): boolean | undefined {
  if (raw === undefined || raw === '') return false;
  if (raw === 'true') return true;
  if (raw === 'false') return false;
  return undefined;
}

export function createRankingsRouter(deps: RankingsRouterDeps): Router {
  const { config } = deps;
  const log = deps.logger ?? defaultLogger;
  const now = deps.now ?? ((): Date => new Date());
  const contacts = deps.contactsRepo ?? createContactsRepo({ logger: deps.logger });
  const units = deps.unitsRepo ?? createUnitsRepo({ logger: deps.logger });
  // A client object only; no request is made until a route reads it.
  const jobs = createRankingRunsRepo({ logger: deps.logger });
  let readDeps: RankingReadDeps | undefined;

  const claim =
    deps.claim ??
    ((anchor: AnchorRef, press: RankingPress): Promise<ClaimResult> =>
      claimRanking(anchor, press, {
        jobs,
        anchorExists: (a) => rankingAnchorExists(a, { contacts, units }),
        config,
        now: () => now().toISOString(),
      }));
  const read =
    deps.read ??
    ((anchor: AnchorRef, opts: { includeOlder: boolean; now: Date }): Promise<RankingRead> => {
      readDeps ??= createRankingReadDeps({ config, logger: log });
      return readRanking(anchor, opts, readDeps);
    });
  const getJob =
    deps.getJob ??
    ((anchor: AnchorRef): Promise<RankingJobRecord | undefined> =>
      jobs.getJob(anchor.kind, anchor.id, { consistent: true }));

  const router = Router();

  const rankLimiter = createUserRateLimit({
    routeKey: 'ranking_rank',
    max: config.rateLimitRankPerMin,
    windowMs: 60_000,
    logger: log,
  });

  router.post('/:anchorKind/:anchorId/rank', rankLimiter, async (req, res) => {
    const parsed = parseAnchor(req);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error });
      return;
    }
    const body = (req.body ?? {}) as { includeOlder?: unknown };
    if (body.includeOlder !== undefined && typeof body.includeOlder !== 'boolean') {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'invalid_include_older' });
      return;
    }
    const press: RankingPress = {
      includeOlder: body.includeOlder === true,
      requestedBy: (req as AuthedRequest).user?.userId ?? 'unknown',
      requestId: getContext()?.requestId ?? newRequestId(),
      traceparent: currentTraceparent(),
    };
    const result = await claim(parsed.anchor, press);
    if (result.status === 404) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'anchor_not_found' });
      return;
    }
    if (result.status === 409) {
      res.status(409).json({ error: 'ranking_running', message: MSG_RUNNING });
      return;
    }
    log.info(
      { anchorKind: parsed.anchor.kind, anchorId: parsed.anchor.id, joined: result.joined, generation: result.job.generation },
      'ranking press',
    );
    res.status(202).json({ job: jobView(result.job, now().toISOString()), joined: result.joined });
  });

  router.get('/:anchorKind/:anchorId/job', async (req, res) => {
    const parsed = parseAnchor(req);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error });
      return;
    }
    const record = await getJob(parsed.anchor);
    res.json({ job: record === undefined ? null : jobView(record, now().toISOString()) });
  });

  router.get('/:anchorKind/:anchorId', async (req, res) => {
    const parsed = parseAnchor(req);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error });
      return;
    }
    const includeOlder = parseIncludeOlderQuery(req.query['includeOlder']);
    if (includeOlder === undefined) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'invalid_include_older' });
      return;
    }
    const result = await read(parsed.anchor, { includeOlder, now: now() });
    switch (result.kind) {
      case 'ok':
        res.json({
          anchor: result.anchor,
          job: result.job,
          rows: result.rows,
          flags: result.flags,
          poolWindowDays: result.poolWindowDays,
          ...(result.poolTooLarge !== undefined && { poolTooLarge: result.poolTooLarge }),
        });
        return;
      case 'not_found':
        res.status(404).json({ error: 'anchor_not_found' });
        return;
      case 'unavailable':
        res.status(503).json({ error: 'ranking_unavailable', message: result.message });
        return;
    }
```

Step 3 - implementation. New file `app/src/routes/adminRankings.ts`:

```ts
// The Rankings page API (WP1 B2a spec D12, D18; charter 11) - ADMIN ONLY on
// the server: requireRole('admin') on every route, as routes/aiRuns.ts; the
// dashboard's AdminRoute is not authorization. Wire names are S7's (PR14).
//
//   GET /api/admin/rankings/runs?from&to&anchorKind&anchorId&cursor&limit
//       -> { runs: [...], nextCursor?, incomplete? }      newest first, by pointer
//   GET /api/admin/rankings/runs/:runId
//       -> { run, anchorDisplay, input, pairs, flags[, currentUnavailable][, flagsUnavailable] } | 404 run_not_found
//   GET /api/admin/rankings/cost?from&to
//       -> { environment, weeks, totalUsd, truncated, incomplete? }
//
// PR34: the list and the cost read S2's listRuns, whose live entries are the
// run SUMMARY only (RANKING_RUN_SUMMARY_FIELDS - never rawText, inputGzip,
// handles or results); only the run detail reads a whole item (getRun). A run
// S2 could not read after its retries comes back expired + unavailable and
// the page `incomplete: true`; both routes pass that on as `incomplete: true`
// (the row itself stays `{ runId, expired: true }`, S7's shape), never a
// silent drop. The cost fills a missing bound (R2B6): to = today (UTC),
// from = the Monday 11 weeks before to's ISO week Monday - 12 ISO weeks.
//
// Ranking runs live under their OWN key family (rrun#, with ptr#rankings#...
// pointers) and are read through rankingRunsRepo, never aiRunsRepo, whose
// list renders every ranking pointer as expired (spec D11).
//
// The run detail renders what THIS run said - its own results[] (with the
// merged missing list and cappedAtRun) - and links each pair to the CURRENT
// match's run (`currentRunId`); `sinceRescored` is that run being another
// one: the matches store holds one row per pair that any later press, from
// either anchor, rewrites.
import { Router } from 'express';
import type { AppConfig } from '../lib/config.js';
import { contactDisplayName } from '../lib/contactName.js';
import { logger as defaultLogger, type Logger } from '../lib/logger.js';
import { propertyLabel } from '../lib/propertyLabel.js';
import { requireRole } from '../middleware/auth.js';
import { createContactsRepo, type ContactsRepo } from '../repos/contactsRepo.js';
import { createMatchesRepo, gunzipBase64, matchPairKey, type MatchRow, type MatchesRepo } from '../repos/matchesRepo.js';
import {
  createRankingRunsRepo,
  rankingRunEntityKey,
  type RankingRunRecord,
  type RankingRunsRepo,
} from '../repos/rankingRunsRepo.js';
import { createUnitsRepo, type UnitsRepo } from '../repos/unitsRepo.js';
import { createAssembleDeps, loadPropertyFacts } from '../services/ranking/assemble.js';
import { bandOf } from '../services/ranking/bands.js';
import type { PropertyFacts } from '../services/ranking/cards.js';
import { openFlags } from '../services/ranking/flags.js';
import type { RankingReadFlag } from '../services/ranking/readRanking.js';

export interface AdminRankingsRouterDeps {
  /** appEnv for the cost totals; the default property-facts reader. */
  config: AppConfig;
  logger?: Logger;
  runsRepo?: Pick<RankingRunsRepo, 'listRuns' | 'getRun' | 'getOpenCandidateFlags'>;
  matchesRepo?: Pick<MatchesRepo, 'getPairs'>;
  contactsRepo?: Pick<ContactsRepo, 'getDisplaysByIds'>;
  unitsRepo?: Pick<UnitsRepo, 'getDisplaysByIds'>;
  /** Each property's current-card facts (the open-flag check); assemble.ts's loadPropertyFacts otherwise. */
  propertyFacts?(unitIds: string[]): Promise<Map<string, PropertyFacts>>;
  /** The clock for the cost's default range (PR34); the wall clock otherwise. */
  now?(): Date;
}

const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 25;
const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100;
const MAX_COST_PAGES = 50;
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
const DATE_PATTERN = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

/** Shape AND a real calendar date, by canonical round trip (routes/aiRuns.ts's rule). */
function isCalendarDate(value: string): boolean {
  if (!DATE_PATTERN.test(value)) return false;
  const parsed = Date.parse(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && new Date(parsed).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value;
}

function parseLimit(raw: unknown): number {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;
  const n = Number(raw);
  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) return DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;
  return Math.min(MAX_PAGE_SIZE, n);
}

function optionalString(raw: unknown): string | undefined {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return undefined;
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : undefined;
}

/** from / to as validated calendar dates; an error key when one is malformed. */
function dateRange(query: Record<string, unknown>): { from?: string; to?: string } | { error: string } {
  const out: { from?: string; to?: string } = {};
  for (const name of ['from', 'to'] as const) {
    const raw = query[name];
    if (raw !== undefined && typeof raw !== 'string') return { error: `invalid_${name}` };
    const value = optionalString(raw);
    if (value === undefined) continue;
    if (!isCalendarDate(value)) return { error: `invalid_${name}` };
    out[name] = value;
  }
  return out;
}

const round6 = (value: number): number => Math.round(value * 1e6) / 1e6;

/** PR34: the cost's default span - 12 ISO weeks, the `to` date's week included. */
export const COST_DEFAULT_WEEKS = 12;

/**
 * PR34 / R2B6: the cost range the server reads. A missing `to` is today
 * (UTC); a missing `from` is the Monday 11 weeks before the Monday of
 * `to`'s ISO week. So no bound at all is the last 12 ISO weeks, and a lone
 * `to` never reads all time. `given` dates are already validated.
 */
export function costRange(given: { from?: string; to?: string }, now: Date): { from: string; to: string } {
  const to = given.to ?? new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate())).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  if (given.from !== undefined) return { from: given.from, to };
  const toMs = Date.parse(`${to}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  const fromMonday = (new Date(toMs).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7;
  const from = toMs - fromMonday * DAY_MS - (COST_DEFAULT_WEEKS - 1) * 7 * DAY_MS;
  return { from: new Date(from).toISOString().slice(0, 10), to };
}

/** The no-bounds case: the last 12 ISO weeks. */
export function defaultCostRange(now: Date): { from: string; to: string } {
  return costRange({}, now);
}

/** ISO 8601 week, 'YYYY-Www' (weeks start Monday; week 1 holds the year's first Thursday). */
export function isoWeekOf(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const fromMonday = (d.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7;
  const thursday = Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), d.getUTCMonth(), d.getUTCDate() - fromMonday + 3);
  const year = new Date(thursday).getUTCFullYear();
  const jan4 = Date.UTC(year, 0, 4);
  const jan4FromMonday = (new Date(jan4).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7;
  const firstThursday = jan4 - jan4FromMonday * DAY_MS + 3 * DAY_MS;
  const week = 1 + Math.round((thursday - firstThursday) / (7 * DAY_MS));
  return `${year}-W${String(week).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function createAdminRankingsRouter(deps: AdminRankingsRouterDeps): Router {
  const log = deps.logger ?? defaultLogger;
  const runs = deps.runsRepo ?? createRankingRunsRepo({ logger: deps.logger });
  const matches = deps.matchesRepo ?? createMatchesRepo({ logger: deps.logger });
  const contacts = deps.contactsRepo ?? createContactsRepo({ logger: deps.logger });
  const units = deps.unitsRepo ?? createUnitsRepo({ logger: deps.logger });
  let assembleDeps: ReturnType<typeof createAssembleDeps> | undefined;
  const propertyFacts =
    deps.propertyFacts ??
    ((unitIds: string[]): Promise<Map<string, PropertyFacts>> => {
      assembleDeps ??= createAssembleDeps({ config: deps.config, logger: log });
      return loadPropertyFacts(unitIds, assembleDeps);
    });

  /** Anchor names / labels, best-effort; IR21: always a string, the id when nothing resolves. */
  async function anchorDisplays(list: ReadonlyArray<Pick<RankingRunRecord, 'anchorKind' | 'anchorId'>>): Promise<(run: Pick<RankingRunRecord, 'anchorKind' | 'anchorId'>) => string> {
    const found = new Map<string, string>();
    const tenantIds = [...new Set(list.filter((r) => r.anchorKind === 'tenant').map((r) => r.anchorId))];
    const unitIds = [...new Set(list.filter((r) => r.anchorKind === 'unit').map((r) => r.anchorId))];
    try {
      if (tenantIds.length > 0) {
        for (const [id, contact] of await contacts.getDisplaysByIds(tenantIds)) {
          const name = contactDisplayName(contact);
          if (name !== undefined) found.set(`tenant#${id}`, name);
        }
      }
      if (unitIds.length > 0) {
        for (const [id, unit] of await units.getDisplaysByIds(unitIds)) {
          const label = propertyLabel(unit);
          if (label !== undefined) found.set(`unit#${id}`, label);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      log.warn({ err, tenants: tenantIds.length, units: unitIds.length }, 'rankings admin: anchor display read failed');
    }
    return (run) => found.get(`${run.anchorKind}#${run.anchorId}`) ?? run.anchorId;
  }

  const router = Router();
  router.use(requireRole('admin'));

  router.get('/runs', async (req, res) => {
    const range = dateRange(req.query as Record<string, unknown>);
    if ('error' in range) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: range.error });
      return;
    }
    const anchorKind = optionalString(req.query['anchorKind']);
    const anchorId = optionalString(req.query['anchorId']);
    if (
      (anchorKind === undefined) !== (anchorId === undefined) ||
      (anchorKind !== undefined && anchorKind !== 'unit' && anchorKind !== 'tenant')
    ) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'invalid_anchor' });
      return;
    }
    const cursor = optionalString(req.query['cursor']);
    const page = await runs.listRuns({
      entityKey:
        anchorKind === undefined || anchorId === undefined
          ? rankingRunEntityKey()
          : rankingRunEntityKey({ kind: anchorKind, id: anchorId }),
      ...(range.from !== undefined && { from: range.from }),
      ...(range.to !== undefined && { to: range.to }),
      ...(cursor !== undefined && { cursor }),
      limit: parseLimit(req.query['limit']),
    });
    const displayOf = await anchorDisplays(page.entries.flatMap((entry) => (entry.expired ? [] : [entry.run])));
    res.json({
      runs: page.entries.map((entry) => {
        if (entry.expired) return { runId: entry.runId, expired: true as const };
        const run = entry.run;
        return {
          runId: run.runId,
          expired: false as const,
          startedAt: run.startedAt,
          finishedAt: run.finishedAt,
          anchorKind: run.anchorKind,
          anchorId: run.anchorId,
          anchorDisplay: displayOf(run),
          direction: run.direction,
          batchIndex: run.batchIndex,
          candidateCount: run.candidateCount,
          driver: run.driver,
          model: run.model,
          costUsd: run.costUsd,
          latencyMs: run.latencyMs,
          outcome: run.outcome,
          ...(run.failure !== undefined && { failure: run.failure }),
          environment: run.environment,
        };
      }),
      ...(page.nextCursor !== undefined && { nextCursor: page.nextCursor }),
      // PR34: a run on this page stayed unread after S2's retries.
      ...(page.incomplete === true && { incomplete: true as const }),
    });
  });

  router.get('/runs/:runId', async (req, res) => {
    const runId = String(req.params['runId'] ?? '').trim();
    const run = runId.length === 0 ? undefined : await runs.getRun(runId);
    if (run === undefined) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'run_not_found' });
      return;
    }
    const keyOf = (candidateId: string): { tenantId: string; unitId: string } =>
      run.anchorKind === 'unit'
        ? { tenantId: candidateId, unitId: run.anchorId }
        : { tenantId: run.anchorId, unitId: candidateId };

    let current: Map<string, MatchRow> | undefined;
    try {
      current =
        run.results.length === 0
          ? new Map()
          : await matches.getPairs(run.results.map((r) => keyOf(r.candidateId)), { requireComplete: true });
    } catch (err) {
      log.warn({ runId, err }, 'rankings admin: current match read incomplete');
      current = undefined;
    }

    const unitIds = [...new Set(run.anchorKind === 'unit' ? [run.anchorId] : run.results.map((r) => r.candidateId))];
    let flags: RankingReadFlag[] = [];
    let flagsUnavailable = false;
    try {
      const factsByUnit = await propertyFacts(unitIds);
      for (const unitId of unitIds) {
        const unitFacts = factsByUnit.get(unitId);
        if (unitFacts === undefined) continue;
        const open = openFlags(await runs.getOpenCandidateFlags(unitId), unitFacts.freeTextByField);
        flags = flags.concat(open.map((r) => ({ unitId: r.unitId, field: r.field, reason: r.reason, runId: r.runId, raisedAt: r.raisedAt })));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      log.warn({ runId, err }, 'rankings admin: open flag read failed');
      flagsUnavailable = true;
      flags = [];
    }

    const pairs = run.results.map((result) => {
      const key = keyOf(result.candidateId);
      const match = current?.get(matchPairKey(key.tenantId, key.unitId));
      const currentRunId = match === undefined ? null : match.runId;
      const capped = result.cappedAtRun?.capped === true;
      const scored = result.returned && result.score !== undefined;
      return {
        candidateId: result.candidateId,
        handle: result.handle,
        display: result.display,
        returned: result.returned,
        ...(scored && { score: result.score, band: capped ? ('weak' as const) : bandOf(result.score as number) }),
        cappedAtRun: capped,
        capReason: result.cappedAtRun?.capReason ?? null,
        for: result.for ?? [],
        against: result.against ?? [],
        missing: result.missing ?? [],
        unknowns: result.unknowns ?? [],
        failedRequirements: result.failedRequirements ?? [],
        fairHousingFlags: result.fairHousingFlags ?? [],
        currentRunId,
        sinceRescored: currentRunId !== null && currentRunId !== run.runId,
      };
    });

    let input: string | null = null;
    if (run.inputGzip !== undefined) {
      try {
        input = gunzipBase64(run.inputGzip);
      } catch (err) {
        log.warn({ runId, err }, 'rankings admin: run input could not be decompressed');
      }
    }
    const displayOf = await anchorDisplays([run]);
    const { inputGzip: _input, itemId: _itemId, handles: _handles, results: _results, ...fields } = run;
    res.json({
      run: fields,
      anchorDisplay: displayOf(run),
      input,
      pairs,
      flags,
      ...(current === undefined && { currentUnavailable: true }),
      ...(flagsUnavailable && { flagsUnavailable: true }),
    });
  });

  router.get('/cost', async (req, res) => {
    const given = dateRange(req.query as Record<string, unknown>);
    if ('error' in given) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: given.error });
      return;
    }
    // PR34 / R2B6: a missing bound is filled (to = today; from = 12 ISO weeks before to).
    const range = costRange(given, deps.now?.() ?? new Date());
    let incomplete = false;
    const groups = new Map<string, { week: string; environment: string; runs: number; inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number; costUsd: number }>();
    let totalUsd = 0;
    let cursor: string | undefined;
    let pages = 0;
    let truncated = false;
    do {
      const page = await runs.listRuns({
        entityKey: rankingRunEntityKey(),
        ...(range.from !== undefined && { from: range.from }),
        ...(range.to !== undefined && { to: range.to }),
        limit: MAX_PAGE_SIZE,
        ...(cursor !== undefined && { cursor }),
      });
      if (page.incomplete === true) incomplete = true;
      for (const entry of page.entries) {
        if (entry.expired) continue;
        const { run } = entry;
        const week = isoWeekOf(run.startedAt);
        const key = `${week}#${run.environment}`;
        const group = groups.get(key) ?? { week, environment: run.environment, runs: 0, inputTokens: 0, outputTokens: 0, costUsd: 0 };
        group.runs += 1;
        group.inputTokens += run.usage?.inputTokens ?? 0;
        group.outputTokens += run.usage?.outputTokens ?? 0;
        group.costUsd += run.costUsd;
        groups.set(key, group);
        totalUsd += run.costUsd;
      }
      cursor = page.nextCursor;
      pages += 1;
      if (cursor !== undefined && pages >= MAX_COST_PAGES) {
        truncated = true;
        log.warn({ pages }, 'rankings admin: cost totals truncated at the page cap');
        break;
      }
    } while (cursor !== undefined);
    res.json({
      environment: deps.config.appEnv,
      weeks: [...groups.values()]
        .sort((a, b) => b.week.localeCompare(a.week) || a.environment.localeCompare(b.environment))
        .map((group) => ({ ...group, costUsd: round6(group.costUsd) })),
      totalUsd: round6(totalUsd),
      truncated,
      // PR34: a run in range stayed unread after S2's retries - the totals may be low.
      ...(incomplete && { incomplete: true as const }),
    });
  });

  return router;
}
```

```ts
const endpoint = process.env.DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT ?? 'http://localhost:8000';

async function endpointReachable(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await fetch(endpoint, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1_500) });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

const reachable = await endpointReachable();
if (!reachable) {
  console.warn(`[rankingRead.integration] DynamoDB Local is required at ${endpoint}`);
}

const TABLES = ['contacts', 'units', 'listing_sends', 'tours', 'placements', 'settings', 'matches', 'ai_runs'] as const;
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
const daysAgo = (n: number): string => new Date(Date.now() - n * DAY_MS).toISOString();

async function batchPut(doc: DynamoDBDocumentClient, table: string, items: Record<string, unknown>[]): Promise<void> {
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 25) {
    let pending: NonNullable<BatchWriteCommandInput['RequestItems']> = {
      [table]: items.slice(i, i + 25).map((Item) => ({ PutRequest: { Item } })),
    };
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 10; attempt += 1) {
      const out = await doc.send(new BatchWriteCommand({ RequestItems: pending }));
      const left = out.UnprocessedItems?.[table];
      if (left === undefined || left.length === 0) break;
      pending = { [table]: left } as NonNullable<BatchWriteCommandInput['RequestItems']>;
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50 * (attempt + 1)));
    }
  }
}

function harness(label: string) {
  const env = { TABLE_PREFIX: `hc-rkread-${label}-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}-` };
  const client = createDynamoClient({ endpoint });
  const doc = createDocumentClient({ endpoint });
  const logger = createLogger({ destination: createLogCapture().stream });
  // PR30: name the local endpoint, so S2's config resolves the local-table
  // defaults (outside production on real tables the driver would default to
  // anthropic and the worker poll to off).
  const config = loadConfig({ NODE_ENV: 'test', DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT: endpoint, ...env });
  const t = (base: (typeof TABLES)[number]): string => tableName(base, env);
  return {
    env, client, doc, logger, config, t,
    async setup() {
      for (const base of TABLES) await ensureTable(client, getTableSpec(base), t(base));
    },
    async teardown() {
      for (const base of TABLES) await deleteTableIfExists(client, t(base));
      doc.destroy();
      client.destroy();
    },
  };
}

}

function currentRow(config: ReturnType<typeof loadConfig>, tenantId: string, unitId: string, fingerprints: MatchRow['fingerprints'], score: number): MatchRow {

    tenantId, unitId, schema: 2, score, for: [], against: [], missing: [], failedRequirements: [], fairHousingFlags: [],

    anchorSide: 'unit', fingerprints, inputSnapshot: '', expires_at: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 180 * 86_400,
  };
}

    await batchPut(
      h.doc,
      h.t('listing_sends'),
      tenants.flatMap((_, i) => [0, 1, 2].map((k) => send(`budget-seen-${((i + k) % 5) + 1}`, `budget-t-${i}`, daysAgo(10 - k)))),
    );
    await batchPut(
      h.doc,
      h.t('tours'),
      tenants.filter((_, i) => i % 4 === 0).map((_, j) => tour(`budget-t-${j * 4}`, 'budget-seen-1')),
    );
    const matches = createMatchesRepo({ doc: h.doc, env: h.env, logger: h.logger });
    await matches.putMatches(
      tenants.map((_, i) => currentRow(h.config, `budget-t-${i}`, anchor.id, { tenantCard: 'x', unitCard: 'y', pairHistory: 'z' }, 40 + (i % 60))),
    );
  }, 300_000);

  afterAll(async () => h.teardown(), 120_000);

  it('reads all 150 rows (each with its match) and prints the time', async () => {
    const deps = createRankingReadDeps({ config: h.config, logger: h.logger, env: h.env, doc: h.doc });
    const timings: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
      const started = performance.now();
      const read = await readRanking(anchor, { includeOlder: false, now: new Date() }, deps);
      timings.push(performance.now() - started);
      if (read.kind !== 'ok') throw new Error(`read failed: ${read.kind}`);
      expect(read.rows).toHaveLength(150);
      expect(read.rows.every((r) => r.match !== null)).toBe(true);
    }
    console.info(`[WI18] 150-tenant property read, ms: ${timings.map((t) => Math.round(t)).join(', ')}`);
    const ceiling = process.env.RANKING_READ_BUDGET === '1' ? 5_000 : 20_000;
    expect(Math.max(...timings)).toBeLessThan(ceiling);
  }, 120_000);
});

describe.skipIf(!reachable)('WI11: fingerprint invariants through the real gatherer and the read', () => {
  const h = harness('wi11');
  const anchor = { kind: 'unit' as const, id: 'wi11-anchor' };
  const home = (n: number): string => `wi11-h${n}`;
  const labelOf = (n: number): string => `${n} Seen St, Atlanta`;
  const reasons = new Map<string, string[] | undefined>();

  // Each case: its own tenant; the seed writes the before state, the mutation the change.
  const T = {
    bare: 'wi11-bare', resend: 'wi11-resend', ninth: 'wi11-ninth', named: 'wi11-named', roster: 'wi11-roster',
    feedbackOnlyEdit: 'wi11-fbo', decline: 'wi11-decline', tour: 'wi11-tour', feedback: 'wi11-feedback',

  } as const;
  const rosterTourId = `tour-roster-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;

  beforeAll(async () => {

    ]);
    await batchPut(h.doc, h.t('contacts'), [

    ]);

      send(home(1), T.named, daysAgo(10)),
      send(home(1), T.roster, daysAgo(10)),
      send(home(10), T.feedbackOnlyEdit, daysAgo(10)),
      send(home(1), T.decline, daysAgo(10)),
      send(home(1), T.tour, daysAgo(10)),
      send(home(1), T.feedback, daysAgo(10)),

    await h.doc.send(new PutCommand({ TableName: sends, Item: send(home(3), T.named, now) }));
    await h.doc.send(new UpdateCommand({

    }));
```

## 11. S7 - Dashboard and e2e: the Rankings page, its API client, the event, every new e2e spec

### Scope

S7 builds (spec D18, D12 dashboard side, spec 6 e2e; PR2, PR9):

- The dashboard wire types and endpoint functions for every S6 endpoint:
  `POST /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId/rank`,
  `GET /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId`,
  `GET /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId/job`,
  `GET /api/admin/rankings/runs`, `GET /api/admin/rankings/runs/:runId`,
  `GET /api/admin/rankings/cost` (S7.1).
- `RankingUpdatedEvent`, the `onRankingUpdated` handler and the
  `ranking.updated` listener in `EventStreamProvider` (S7.2).
- The admin-only Rankings settings tab
  `{ id: 'rankings', label: 'Rankings', path: '/settings/rankings', adminOnly: true }`
  beside the AI run log, routed inside `AdminRoute` (S7.11), and its
  components under `dashboard/src/routes/settings/rankings/` (S7.3-S7.9):
  - "Rank this anchor": Property / Tenant choice, the existing
    `UnitSearchField` / `ContactSearchField`, the "Include tenants not heard
    from in N days" checkbox (property anchor only; N from the read's
    `poolWindowDays`, PR26), Rank, the job status
    per batch (the `ranking.updated` event plus a 5 s poll of the job read),
    and the ranking read as a plain table (candidate, band, score, capped,
    out of date, reasons, missing, "not ranked yet" / "not scored - retry");
    the anchor's notes, missing flags, card change and open unlawful flags
    as text; the pool ceiling message.
  - The runs list: newest first, cursor paged, filtered by date range and
    by anchor (the panel's "Show runs for this anchor"), one row per run
    with anchor, direction, model, candidates, cost, latency, time and
    outcome; the weekly cost totals with the environment name above it.
  - The run detail: the run's fields, the raw output (collapsed), the input
    (collapsed, decompressed by the server), and the run's OWN pairs from
    its `results[]` with the "since re-scored" mark.
- Every new e2e spec (PR9): `e2e/tests/dashboard-next/rankings.spec.ts`
  (the ranking flows) and `e2e/tests/dashboard-next/contact-notes-conflict.spec.ts`
  (the edit form's Notes conflict, modeled on tenant-staff-notes.spec.ts),
  and their helper `e2e/fixtures/ranking.ts` (S7.10, S7.12).

S7 does NOT build:

- Any server route, the read, the job, the cap, the band or the event
  emitter (S5, S6). The dashboard never computes a band, a cap or an
  out-of-date reason: every one arrives derived from the server (PR7, WI13).
- The `POST /__dev/ranking/tick` route and the hermetic lane env
  (`RANKING_DRIVER=fake`, `RANKING_WORKER_POLL=off` in
  `scripts/e2e-session.mjs`) - S5 (PR9). S7's specs depend on both.
- The contact edit form's Notes stamp, the 409 `notes_stale` handling and
  the conflict panel - S1 builds and unit-tests them; S7.12 only drives
  them end to end (PR9).
- The run detail's extraction `notesDuplicate` count (S1), B3's ranked
  row, chips and banners, B4's flag display and Dismiss (spec 4).
- The full e2e suite and the other gates (S9).

### Contradictions

C1. The brief names `e2e/support/steps.ts`; the sequence-diagram vocabulary
lives at `e2e/scenarios/steps.ts` (e2e/README.md:769). S7 needs none of its
steps; the specs use their own small helpers, as
`e2e/tests/dashboard-next/matching-blast-rules.spec.ts:83-158` does.

C2. "The dashboard event type map" does not exist as a type. The dashboard's
event surface is the `EventStreamHandlers` interface plus one
`addEventListener` per event name (dashboard/src/api/EventStreamProvider.tsx:38-70,
:173-226) and one payload interface per event in
dashboard/src/api/types.ts (:2153-2260). Resolution: S7.2 adds
`RankingUpdatedEvent` to types.ts, `onRankingUpdated` to
`EventStreamHandlers`, and a `ranking.updated` listener.

C3. "The existing contact and unit search" is a client-side filter, not a
server search: `ContactSearchField` / `UnitSearchField`
(dashboard/src/routes/contact/ContactSearchField.tsx:64-80,
UnitSearchField.tsx:43-55) filter a `candidates` array the caller loads.
Resolution: the panel loads every unit (`getAllUnits({})`) and every tenant
(`getAllContacts({ type: 'tenant' })`) on mount, exactly as
dashboard/src/routes/placements/PlacementCreateForm.tsx:117-152 does
(`useRankCandidates`, S7.6). Any record can be the anchor (spec D1), so
neither list is filtered by status.

C4. The AI run log precedent uses the two-pane shell
(dashboard/src/ui/twoPaneShell.module.css:11-16, `height: 100%`), which
assumes the section is the whole page. The Rankings tab stacks the Rank
panel and the cost totals ABOVE the runs, so it uses its own module
(`RankingsSection.module.css`): a full-width column with a two-column
list | detail grid that stacks below 860 px (the shell's breakpoint,
twoPaneShell.ts:17). No page width cap (Cameron's full-width rule); only
the search field gets a max width.

`POST /__dev/reseed` wipes every local table and reseeds lean
(app/src/routes/dev.ts:350-363). Resolution: rankings.spec.ts reseeds once
in `beforeAll` and each test still gives its pool a run-unique housing

### Cross-slice notes (for the planner)

N1. THE S6 WIRE CONTRACT - SETTLED (S7-F1 by PR12-PR16 and IR4, IR18-IR22,
IR27, IR31, IR32, IR35). S7.1 types exactly these; S5 / S6 produce them:

- `POST /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId/rank`, body
  `{ includeOlder?: boolean }` -> 202 `{ job: RankingJobView, joined: boolean }`;
  409 `{ error: 'ranking_running' }`; 404; 429.
- `GET /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId?includeOlder=true` (the client
  sends the parameter only when it is on; S6 reads `=== 'true'`) -> 200
  `RankingReadResponse`; 404 anchor not found (PR21); 503
  `{ error: 'ranking_unavailable', message }` only from the anchor's own
  reads (PR17, IR32) - the page shows the server's `message` when present.
- `GET /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId/job` -> 200
  `{ job: RankingJobView | null }`.
- `RankingJobView` (IR31, PR13): `status`
  (`queued|running|done|failed|expired`), `generation`, `includeOlder`,
  `requestedAt`, `startedAt?`, `finishedAt?`, `poolSize?`, `batchCount:
  number` (0 until the pool is built), `batchesDone: number[]` (indexes of
  SCORED batches), `failedBatches: { index, candidateIds, failure }[]`
  (failed CALLS only), `notScored: { candidateId, reason: 'omitted' |
  'unreadable' }[]`, `message?`. No `anchorKind` / `anchorId`; never
  `requestedBy`, `requestId` or `traceparent`.
- `RankingReadResponse`: `anchor: { kind, id, display, anchorNotes,
  missing: { key, label }[], cardChanged }` - ALWAYS present, also over the
  ceiling (PR16) -, `job: RankingJobView | null`, `poolWindowDays: number`
  (PR26, the configured `RANKING_POOL_WINDOW_DAYS`), `poolTooLarge?:
  { size: number; message: string }` (then `rows: []`; the page checks it
  FIRST, PR16), `rows: RankingRowView[]` (ALREADY SORTED by spec D9; the
  client never re-sorts), `flags: { unitId, field, reason, raisedAt,
  runId }[]` (open only).
- `RankingRowView`: `candidateId`, `display`, `hasConsent?`, `priority?`,
  `notScored: boolean` (the last job's `failedBatches` OR `notScored`,
  PR13), `match: null | { score, band, capped, capReason: 'requirement not
  met' | null, for, against, missing: { key?, text }[], failedRequirements,
  fairHousingFlags: { kind, field }[], outOfDate:
  ('card'|'pairHistory'|'age'|'version'|'failedBatch'|'unverified')[],
  computedAt, runId, model }`. `match: null` with `notScored: false` is
  "not ranked yet".
- `GET /api/admin/rankings/runs?from&to&anchorKind&anchorId&cursor&limit`
  -> `{ runs: RankingRunListRow[], nextCursor?: string }`; a live row is
  `{ runId, expired: false, startedAt, finishedAt, anchorKind, anchorId,
  anchorDisplay (always sent, falling back to the id - IR21), direction,
  batchIndex (0-based), candidateCount, driver, model, costUsd, latencyMs,
  outcome: 'scored'|'failed', environment }`; a pointer whose run is gone
  is `{ runId, expired: true }`.
- `GET /api/admin/rankings/runs/:runId` -> `{ run: RankingRunView,
  anchorDisplay (top level, PR14), input: string | null, pairs:
  RankingRunPair[], flags }`. `run` is the stored record minus
  `inputGzip`, `handles` and `results`; `usage?` may be absent (IR35, the
  page guards it); `matchesWritten?: { count: number; at: string }`
  (PR15, IR4 - absent = the write did not finish; the page reads `count`).
  Each pair (PR14, IR19) is one entry of the run's OWN `results[]` with its
  handle's display: `{ candidateId, handle, display, returned: boolean,
  score?, band? (bandOf server side, cap applied; absent when not
  returned), cappedAtRun: boolean, capReason?, for, against, unknowns?,
  missing (the stored MERGED list, PR14), failedRequirements,
  fairHousingFlags, currentRunId: string | null }`.
- `GET /api/admin/rankings/cost?from&to` -> `{ environment: string
  (this deployment's), weeks: { week ('YYYY-Www'), environment, runs,
  inputTokens, outputTokens, costUsd }[], totalUsd, truncated,
  incomplete?: true }` (IR20: S7's shape plus S6's two totals, not shown).
  With no bound the server totals the last 12 ISO weeks; a lone `to`, the
  12 ISO weeks ending with `to`'s week; a lone `from`, through today (PR34,
  plan review R2B6, S6 round 2). It echoes no range, so the page derives
  the note from what it sent (`costRangeNote`): "The last 12 weeks.", "The
  12 weeks ending the week of <to>.", "From <from> through today.".
- Plan review round 2 (PR42, PR43): `failedBatches` holds every batch that
  left candidates without a new match (call, run write or match write),
  each listing exactly those candidates; the status line counts finished
  BATCHES for progress and CANDIDATES not scored for a loss (distinct ids
  over `failedBatches` and `notScored`, `notScoredCount`), e.g. "Done: 3
  batches; 4 candidates not scored. Press Rank again." - never "a batch
  failed". The job's message, when present, replaces "Press Rank again."
  (S5 round 2's copy: "N tenants|properties could not be scored. Press
  Rank again.", "N score(s) could not be saved. Press Rank again.", the
  unreadable and omitted sentences, "Could not read this tenant's|
  property's record. Press Rank again."; S7 quotes no other job text).
  PR43's "Could not read this property's record. Press Rank again." shows
  as the tenant one does.
- Plan review round 1 (PR34, BA3, BB5, PR38): the runs page and the cost
  carry `incomplete: true` when a run stays unread after a retry - the
  cost shows "Some runs could not be read; totals may be low", the list
  "Some runs could not be read; this list may be missing some.";
  `poolTooLarge.message` is the pool's own text and the page shows it
  verbatim; the page re-reads the ranking when the FINISHED batch count
  (scored or failed, distinct indexes) grows; after an unreadable tenant
  anchor the job is `done` with `batchCount` 0 and every candidate in
  `notScored`, and the status line reads "Done: N candidates not scored.
  <job message>". The run detail also reads S6's `currentUnavailable` /
  `flagsUnavailable` and says so. Matched against S6's round-1 revision

  `failedBatches[].failure` may be `'repo'` (S5 round 2: only after a

```ts

// --- Rankings (/api/rankings, /api/admin/rankings) ---------------------------
// WP1 B2a spec D7, D9, D11, D12, D18. Mirrors the S6 route responses
// (app/src/routes/rankings.ts, app/src/routes/adminRankings.ts) and the
// records in app/src/repos/rankingRunsRepo.ts and matchesRepo.ts. This
// package cannot import server types, so keep this wire contract in sync by
// hand. Code says `unit`; staff copy says "property". The band, the cap and
// every out-of-date reason arrive derived from the server - the dashboard
// never computes one (one band, one cap: plan PR7).

export type RankingAnchorKind = 'unit' | 'tenant';
export interface RankingAnchorRef {
  kind: RankingAnchorKind;
  id: string;
}
export type RankingDirection = 'tenants_for_property' | 'properties_for_tenant';
export type RankingBand = 'strong' | 'good' | 'possible' | 'weak';
/** `expired` is derived on read for an unclaimed queued record (spec D7). */
export type RankingJobStatus = 'queued' | 'running' | 'done' | 'failed' | 'expired';
export type RankingAnchorNote = 'not_searching' | 'not_sendable' | 'not_available';
export type RankingOutOfDateReason = 'card' | 'pairHistory' | 'age' | 'version' | 'failedBatch' | 'unverified';
/** The reason source enum (spec D5). */
export type RankingReasonSource =
  | 'voucher_size' | 'authority' | 'rent' | 'area' | 'pets' | 'evictions'
  | 'accessibility' | 'requirements' | 'preferences' | 'notes' | 'staff_notes'
  | 'feedback' | 'history' | 'recency' | 'property_details' | 'other';
export type RankingDriverKind = 'anthropic' | 'console' | 'fake';

export interface RankingReason {
  text: string;
  source: RankingReasonSource;
}

/** A completeness flag (spec D3): a stable key and its staff label. */
export interface RankingMissingFlag {
  key: string;
  label: string;
}

/** One entry of a match's `missing[]` (spec D8): a code flag carries its
 *  key; a model unknown has none. */
export interface RankingMissingItem {
  key?: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface RankingFairHousingFlag {
  kind: 'unlawful' | 'accommodation';
  field: string;
}

export interface RankingFailedBatch {
  index: number;
  candidateIds: string[];
  failure: string;
}

/** A candidate the job did not score outside a failed call (plan PR13). */
export interface RankingNotScored {
  candidateId: string;
  reason: 'omitted' | 'unreadable';
}

/** The job record as the press, the read and the job read return it. */
export interface RankingJobView {
  status: RankingJobStatus;
  generation: string;
  includeOlder: boolean;
  requestedAt: string;
  startedAt?: string;
  finishedAt?: string;
  poolSize?: number;
  /** 0 until the pool is built (plan IR31). */
  batchCount: number;
  /** Indexes of the batches that SCORED; a failed call is in failedBatches. */
  batchesDone: number[];
  /** Failed CALLS only (plan PR13). */
  failedBatches: RankingFailedBatch[];
  /** Candidates left unscored outside a failed call (plan PR13). */
  notScored: RankingNotScored[];
  message?: string;
}

/** POST .../rank - 202. `joined` = the press joined a live job. */
export interface RankJobResponse {
  job: RankingJobView;
  joined: boolean;
}

/** GET .../job - the job record only (one key read). */
export interface RankingJobResponse {
  job: RankingJobView | null;
}

export interface RankingMatchView {
  score: number;
  band: RankingBand;
  capped: boolean;
  capReason: 'requirement not met' | null;
  for: RankingReason[];
  against: RankingReason[];
  missing: RankingMissingItem[];
  failedRequirements: string[];
  fairHousingFlags: RankingFairHousingFlag[];
  /** Empty = current. */
  outOfDate: RankingOutOfDateReason[];
  computedAt: string;
  runId: string;
  model: string;
}

/** One pool member, in the server's sort order (spec D9). */
export interface RankingRowView {
  /** The tenant's contactId (property anchor) or the unitId (tenant anchor). */
  candidateId: string;
  display: string;
  hasConsent?: boolean;
  priority?: boolean;
  /** No match, and the anchor's last job listed this candidate in a failed
   *  batch or in its notScored list ("not scored - retry", plan PR13).
   *  `match: null` with this false reads "not ranked yet". */
  notScored: boolean;
  match: RankingMatchView | null;
  /** S6 also sends these (RankingReadRow); the page does not read them. */
  tenantId?: string;
  unitId?: string;
  notRankedYet?: boolean;
}

/** An OPEN unlawful flag on a property in view (spec D10). */
export interface RankingUnlawfulFlagView {
  unitId: string;
  field: string;
  reason: string;
  raisedAt: string;
  runId: string;
}

export interface RankingAnchorView {
  kind: RankingAnchorKind;
  id: string;
  display: string;
  anchorNotes: RankingAnchorNote[];
  missing: RankingMissingFlag[];
  cardChanged: boolean;
}

/** GET /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId (spec D9). The anchor block is
 *  always present, also over the pool ceiling (plan PR16). */
export interface RankingReadResponse {
  anchor: RankingAnchorView;
  job: RankingJobView | null;
  /** The configured RANKING_POOL_WINDOW_DAYS (plan PR26). */
  poolWindowDays: number;
  /** Present when the pool is above RANKING_MAX_POOL; rows is then empty.
   *  The page checks it FIRST (plan PR16) and shows `message`, the pool's
   *  own text, which S6 sends (plan review BA3). */
  poolTooLarge?: { size: number; message: string };
  rows: RankingRowView[];
  flags: RankingUnlawfulFlagView[];
}

export interface RankingRunListRowLive {
  runId: string;
  expired: false;
  startedAt: string;
  finishedAt: string;
  anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind;
  anchorId: string;
  /** Name or property label, resolved by the route; always sent, falling
   *  back to the id (plan IR21). */
  anchorDisplay: string;
  direction: RankingDirection;
  /** 0-based. */
  batchIndex: number;
  candidateCount: number;
  driver: RankingDriverKind;
  model: string;
  costUsd: number;
  latencyMs: number;
  outcome: 'scored' | 'failed';
  environment: string;
}

/** A pointer whose run is gone reads as expired (the aiRunsRepo precedent). */
export type RankingRunListRow = RankingRunListRowLive | { runId: string; expired: true };

/** GET /api/admin/rankings/runs - newest first, cursor paged. `incomplete`
 *  = a run on this page could not be read even after a retry (plan PR34);
 *  never a silent drop. */
export interface RankingRunListPage {
  runs: RankingRunListRow[];
  nextCursor?: string;
  incomplete?: true;
}

/** The stored ranking run (spec D11) less inputGzip, handles and results. */
export interface RankingRunView {
  runId: string;
  anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind;
  anchorId: string;
  direction: RankingDirection;
  jobGeneration: string;
  batchIndex: number;
  candidateCount: number;
  driver: RankingDriverKind;
  model: string;
  rubricVersion: string;
  examplesVersion: string;
  promptFingerprint: string;
  /** May be absent (plan IR35); the page guards it. */
  usage?: { inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number; cacheReadInputTokens?: number };
  costUsd: number;
  latencyMs: number;
  startedAt: string;
  finishedAt: string;
  outcome: 'scored' | 'failed';
  failure?: string;
  message?: string;
  rawText?: string;
  inputOmitted?: boolean;
  /** Absent = the batch's match write did not finish (plan PR15). */
  matchesWritten?: { count: number; at: string };
  droppedUnlawfulFlags?: number;
  environment: string;
}

/** One of the run's OWN results[] (what THIS run said), with its handle's
 *  display and the current match's runId for the "since re-scored" mark
 *  (plan PR14, IR19). A candidate the model did not return has
 *  `returned: false` and no score or band. */
export interface RankingRunPair {
  candidateId: string;
  handle: string;
  display: string;
  returned: boolean;
  score?: number;
  /** bandOf on the server, the run's own cap applied (plan PR7, PR14). */
  band?: RankingBand;
  cappedAtRun: boolean;
  capReason?: 'requirement not met' | null;
  for: RankingReason[];
  against: RankingReason[];
  unknowns?: string[];
  /** The stored MERGED list: code flags, then the model's unknowns (PR14). */
  missing: RankingMissingItem[];
  failedRequirements: string[];
  fairHousingFlags: RankingFairHousingFlag[];
  /** The current match's runId; null when the pair has no match row. */
  currentRunId: string | null;
  /** S6 also sends it; the page derives the mark from currentRunId. */
  sinceRescored?: boolean;
}

/** GET /api/admin/rankings/runs/:runId. `input` is the user message as sent,
 *  decompressed by the server; null when it was omitted or not recorded. */
export interface RankingRunDetailResponse {
  run: RankingRunView;
  anchorDisplay: string;
  input: string | null;
  pairs: RankingRunPair[];
  flags: RankingUnlawfulFlagView[];
  /** The current-match read was incomplete: every currentRunId is null. */
  currentUnavailable?: true;
  /** The property's open-flag read failed: `flags` is empty for that reason. */
  flagsUnavailable?: true;
}

export interface RankingCostWeek {
  /** ISO week, e.g. 2026-W44. */
  week: string;
  environment: string;
  runs: number;
  inputTokens: number;
  outputTokens: number;
  costUsd: number;
}

/** GET /api/admin/rankings/cost - totals by ISO week and environment. With
 *  no from / to the server totals the last 12 ISO weeks (plan PR34). */
export interface RankingCostResponse {
  /** This deployment's environment name. */
  environment: string;
  weeks: RankingCostWeek[];
  /** S6 always sends both; the page does not show them. */
  totalUsd: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  /** A run in range could not be read even after a retry (plan PR34). */
  incomplete?: true;
}

/** GET /api/events 'ranking.updated' (spec D12). Ids, status and batch
 *  progress only - never a score, a name or a card field (the stream reaches
 *  every dashboard). A HINT: the Rankings page also polls the job read and
 *  never reads the counts here. Mirrors app/src/lib/events.ts
 *  RankingUpdatedEvent. */
export interface RankingUpdatedEvent {
  anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind;
  anchorId: string;
  generation: string;
  status: 'queued' | 'running' | 'done' | 'failed';
  /** The COUNT of finished batches, scored or failed (plan IR27). */
  batchesDone: number;
  batchCount: number;
}
```
