```ts
// --- Rankings (/api/rankings, /api/admin/rankings) --------------------------
// WP1 B2a spec D9, D11, D12, D18. The press, the read and the job read are
// admin AND va (requireAuth); the run log and the cost totals are admin only
// (requireRole('admin')). `kind` is 'unit' or 'tenant' and needs no encoding.

/** POST /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId/rank - 202 { job, joined }; 409
 *  ranking_running (a live job with a different window); 404 anchor not
 *  found; 429 over RATE_LIMIT_RANK_PER_MIN. */
export function startRanking(
  kind: RankingAnchorKind,
  anchorId: string,
  body: { includeOlder: boolean },
): Promise<RankJobResponse> {
  return request<RankJobResponse>(`/api/rankings/${kind}/${encodeURIComponent(anchorId)}/rank`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: { includeOlder: body.includeOlder },
  });
}

/** GET /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId - the ranking read (spec D9).
 *  `includeOlder` is sent only when on (the server ignores it for a tenant
 *  anchor). 404 anchor not found; 503 the anchor's own card could not be read. */
export function getRanking(
  kind: RankingAnchorKind,
  anchorId: string,
  params: { includeOlder: boolean },
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RankingReadResponse> {
  return request<RankingReadResponse>(`/api/rankings/${kind}/${encodeURIComponent(anchorId)}`, {
    query: params.includeOlder ? { includeOlder: 'true' } : {},
    ...(signal !== undefined && { signal }),
  });
}

/** GET /api/rankings/:anchorKind/:anchorId/job - the job record only; what
 *  the page polls every 5 s while a job is queued or running (spec D12). */
export function getRankingJob(
  kind: RankingAnchorKind,
  anchorId: string,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RankingJobResponse> {
  return request<RankingJobResponse>(`/api/rankings/${kind}/${encodeURIComponent(anchorId)}/job`, {
    ...(signal !== undefined && { signal }),
  });
}

/** GET /api/admin/rankings/runs - one page of ranking runs, newest first. */
export function listRankingRuns(
  params: {
    from?: string;
    to?: string;
    anchorKind?: RankingAnchorKind;
    anchorId?: string;
    cursor?: string;
    limit?: number;
  } = {},
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RankingRunListPage> {
  return request<RankingRunListPage>('/api/admin/rankings/runs', {
    query: {
      from: params.from,
      to: params.to,
      anchorKind: params.anchorKind,
      anchorId: params.anchorId,
      cursor: params.cursor,
      limit: params.limit,
    },
    ...(signal !== undefined && { signal }),
  });
}

/** GET /api/admin/rankings/runs/:runId - the run, its decompressed input and
 *  its OWN pairs (spec D11). */
export function getRankingRun(runId: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<RankingRunDetailResponse> {
  return request<RankingRunDetailResponse>(`/api/admin/rankings/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`, {
    ...(signal !== undefined && { signal }),
  });
}

/** GET /api/admin/rankings/cost - totals by ISO week and environment. With
 *  neither bound the server totals the last 12 ISO weeks (plan PR34), so the
 *  page sends a bound only when the staff member set one. */
export function getRankingCost(
  params: { from?: string; to?: string } = {},
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RankingCostResponse> {
  return request<RankingCostResponse>('/api/admin/rankings/cost', {
    query: { from: params.from, to: params.to },
    ...(signal !== undefined && { signal }),
  });
}
```

#### Step 3 - implementation

Create `dashboard/src/routes/settings/rankings/rankingFormat.ts`:

```ts
// rankingFormat - every label and status line the Rankings page shows (WP1
// B2a spec D18), in one place so the components and the e2e assert one
// copy. Display only: bands, caps and out-of-date reasons arrive derived from
// the server, never computed here (plan PR7). Staff copy says "property".
import type {
  RankingAnchorNote,
  RankingAnchorRef,
  RankingBand,
  RankingDirection,
  RankingJobStatus,
  RankingJobView,
  RankingOutOfDateReason,
  RankingReason,
} from '../../../api/index.js';

export const NOT_RANKED_YET = 'not ranked yet';
export const NOT_SCORED = 'not scored - retry';

const BAND_LABELS: Readonly<Record<RankingBand, string>> = {
  strong: 'Strong',
  good: 'Good',
  possible: 'Possible',
  weak: 'Weak',
};

export function bandLabel(band: RankingBand): string {
  return BAND_LABELS[band];
}

/** The read's cap has one reason (spec D9). */
export function cappedText(capped: boolean): string {
  return capped ? 'Capped: requirement not met' : 'No';
}

const OUT_OF_DATE_LABELS: Readonly<Record<RankingOutOfDateReason, string>> = {
  card: 'a card changed',
  pairHistory: 'their history changed',
  age: 'too old',
  version: 'the rubric or model changed',
  failedBatch: 'the last ranking failed for it',
  unverified: 'could not check whether this match is current',
};

export function outOfDateText(reasons: readonly RankingOutOfDateReason[]): string {
  if (reasons.length === 0) return '-';
  return `Out of date: ${reasons.map((reason) => OUT_OF_DATE_LABELS[reason]).join(', ')}`;
}

/** Reasons with their sources: "Rent fits (rent); Said no stairs (staff notes)". */
export function reasonsText(reasons: readonly RankingReason[]): string {
  if (reasons.length === 0) return '-';
  return reasons.map((reason) => `${reason.text} (${reason.source.replaceAll('_', ' ')})`).join('; ');
}

export const ANCHOR_NOTE_TEXT: Readonly<Record<RankingAnchorNote, string>> = {
  not_searching: 'This tenant is not searching.',
  not_sendable: 'This tenant cannot be texted.',
  not_available: 'This property is not available.',
};

export function directionLabel(direction: RankingDirection): string {
  return direction === 'tenants_for_property' ? 'Tenants for property' : 'Properties for tenant';
}

export function formatCost(usd: number): string {
  return `$${usd.toFixed(4)}`;
}

export function isJobLive(status: RankingJobStatus): boolean {
  return status === 'queued' || status === 'running';
}

/** Distinct CANDIDATES the job left without a new match (plan PR42): every
 *  candidate listed in a failedBatches entry (a failed call, run write or
 *  match write lists exactly the candidates that got no match) plus every
 *  notScored entry. */
export function notScoredCount(job: RankingJobView): number {
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  for (const batch of job.failedBatches) for (const id of batch.candidateIds) ids.add(id);
  for (const entry of job.notScored) ids.add(entry.candidateId);
  return ids.size;
}

function candidatesText(n: number): string {
  return `${n} candidate${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} not scored`;
}

/** Distinct indexes of the batches that failed and did NOT score. A partial
 *  match write (failure 'repo', which S5 records only after a successful
 *  call) has its index in BOTH batchesDone and failedBatches; the filter
 *  keeps such a batch from being counted twice as finished. */
function failedBatchIndexes(job: RankingJobView): Set<number> {
  const scored = new Set(job.batchesDone);
  return new Set(job.failedBatches.map((batch) => batch.index).filter((index) => !scored.has(index)));
}

/** FINISHED batches, scored or failed, by distinct index - what the page
 *  re-reads the ranking on (spec D12; plan review BB5) and the same count
 *  S5's event carries as `batchesDone`. */
export function finishedBatchCount(job: RankingJobView): number {
  return new Set(job.batchesDone).size + failedBatchIndexes(job).size;
}

/** The job's status (spec D7, D12; plan PR13, PR42). Progress is counted in
 *  FINISHED batches; what was lost is counted in CANDIDATES not scored -
 *  never "a batch failed", since a batch whose match write half-landed is a
 *  failedBatches entry too. The job's own message (the PR38 / PR43 "could
 *  not read" text, or S5's count) follows; with none, a loss ends "Press
 *  Rank again.". */
export function jobStatusText(job: RankingJobView): string {
  const count = job.batchCount;
  const lost = notScoredCount(job);
  switch (job.status) {
    case 'queued':
      return 'Waiting for a free slot';
    case 'running': {
      if (count === 0) return 'Ranking...';
      const base = `Ranking: ${finishedBatchCount(job)} of ${count} batches finished`;
      return lost > 0 ? `${base}; ${candidatesText(lost)}` : base;
    }
    case 'done': {
      // PR38 / PR43: an anchor whose own reads failed after the pool was
      // computed finishes with no batch and every candidate not scored.
      const base =
        count === 0
          ? lost > 0
            ? `Done: ${candidatesText(lost)}`
            : 'Done: no candidates to rank'
          : `Done: ${count} batch${count === 1 ? '' : 'es'}${lost > 0 ? `; ${candidatesText(lost)}` : ''}`;
      if (job.message !== undefined && job.message !== '') return `${base}. ${job.message}`;
      return lost > 0 ? `${base}. Press Rank again.` : base;
    }
    case 'failed':
      return job.message ?? 'The ranking failed. Press Rank again.';
    case 'expired':
      return job.message ?? 'The ranking was not picked up. Press Rank again.';
  }
}

/** The run detail's "since re-scored" mark (spec D11). */
export function currentMatchText(currentRunId: string | null, runId: string): string {
  if (currentRunId === null) return 'No current match';
  return currentRunId === runId ? 'This run' : 'Since re-scored';
}

/** An anchor in the URL: `<kind>:<id>` (the id may itself hold a colon). */
export function anchorParam(anchor: RankingAnchorRef): string {
  return `${anchor.kind}:${anchor.id}`;
}

export function parseAnchorParam(value: string | null): RankingAnchorRef | undefined {
  if (value === null) return undefined;
  const at = value.indexOf(':');
  if (at <= 0) return undefined;
  const kind = value.slice(0, at);
  const id = value.slice(at + 1);
  if (id === '') return undefined;
  if (kind === 'unit' || kind === 'tenant') return { kind, id };
  return undefined;
}
```

#### Step 3 - implementation

Create `dashboard/src/routes/settings/rankings/useAnchorRanking.ts`:

```ts
// useAnchorRanking - the "Rank this anchor" panel's data (WP1 B2a spec D9,
// D12, D18): the ranking read for the picked anchor, the Rank press, and the
// job status. While a job is queued or running the job read (one key read)
// is polled every 5 s, and a ranking.updated event for this anchor reads it
// at once - the event is only a hint, the worker-to-app bridge is
// best-effort. The FULL ranking (about ten DynamoDB reads per candidate) is
// read again only when the FINISHED batch count (scored or failed) grows and
// once when the job ends.
//
// State is keyed by the anchor and window it answers, so a new pick reads
// "loading" without a reset inside an effect; a response for an old key is
// dropped (its controller is aborted and the current key is checked).
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ApiError,
  getRanking,
  getRankingJob,
  startRanking,
  useEventStream,
  type RankingAnchorKind,
  type RankingAnchorRef,
  type RankingJobView,
  type RankingReadResponse,
} from '../../../api/index.js';
import { finishedBatchCount, isJobLive } from './rankingFormat.js';

/** The job read's poll interval while a job is queued or running (spec D12). */
export const JOB_POLL_MS = 5_000;

export type RankingReadStatus = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';

export interface AnchorRankingState {
  read: RankingReadResponse | undefined;
  readStatus: RankingReadStatus;
  readError: string | null;
  /** The last read's pool window (plan PR26); kept across reads so the
   *  checkbox does not vanish while a toggle re-reads. null before any read. */
  poolWindowDays: number | null;
  job: RankingJobView | null;
  /** The last press joined a job that was already live. */
  joined: boolean;
  /** A press is in flight. */
  ranking: boolean;
  rankError: string | null;
  rank: () => void;
  retryRead: () => void;
}

interface Slice {
  key: string;
  read: RankingReadResponse | undefined;
  readStatus: 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';
  readError: string | null;
  job: RankingJobView | null;
  joined: boolean;
  ranking: boolean;
  rankError: string | null;
}

interface Current {
  key: string;
  kind: RankingAnchorKind;
  id: string;
  includeOlder: boolean;
  controller: AbortController;
}

function blank(key: string): Slice {
  return {
    key,
    read: undefined,
    readStatus: 'loading',
    readError: null,
    job: null,
    joined: false,
    ranking: false,
    rankError: null,
  };
}

function isAbort(err: unknown): boolean {
  return err instanceof DOMException && err.name === 'AbortError';
}

function serverMessage(err: ApiError): string | undefined {
  const body = err.body;
  if (body === null || typeof body !== 'object') return undefined;
  const message = (body as Record<string, unknown>)['message'];
  return typeof message === 'string' && message.trim() !== '' ? message.trim() : undefined;
}

function readErrorText(err: unknown): string {
  if (err instanceof ApiError) {
    if (err.status === 404) return 'This record was not found.';
    // S6 answers 503 ranking_unavailable with a message (plan IR32, PR17).
    if (err.status === 503) return serverMessage(err) ?? 'This record could not be read. Try again.';
  }
  return 'We could not load this ranking.';
}

function rankErrorText(err: unknown): string {
  if (err instanceof ApiError) {
    if (err.code === 'ranking_running') return 'A ranking is running for this record. Try again when it finishes.';
    if (err.status === 429) return 'Too many rankings. Wait a minute and try again.';
    if (err.status === 404) return 'This record was not found.';
  }
  return 'The ranking could not be started. Try again.';
}

export function useAnchorRanking(anchor: RankingAnchorRef | undefined, includeOlder: boolean): AnchorRankingState {
  const kind = anchor?.kind;
  const id = anchor?.id;
  const key = kind === undefined || id === undefined ? undefined : `${kind}:${id}:${includeOlder ? 'older' : 'window'}`;
  const [slice, setSlice] = useState<Slice | null>(null);
  const [poolWindowDays, setPoolWindowDays] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const currentRef = useRef<Current | null>(null);
  // Job progress as last seen, for "the finished batches grew" and "the job ended".
  const seenBatchesRef = useRef(0);
  const wasLiveRef = useRef(false);

  const update = useCallback((forKey: string, change: (s: Slice) => Slice): void => {
    setSlice((prev) => change(prev !== null && prev.key === forKey ? prev : blank(forKey)));
  }, []);

  const loadRead = useCallback(
    async (cur: Current, adoptJob: boolean): Promise<void> => {
      try {
        const next = await getRanking(cur.kind, cur.id, { includeOlder: cur.includeOlder }, cur.controller.signal);
        if (cur.controller.signal.aborted || currentRef.current !== cur) return;
        if (adoptJob) {
          seenBatchesRef.current = next.job === null ? 0 : finishedBatchCount(next.job);
          wasLiveRef.current = next.job !== null && isJobLive(next.job.status);
        }
        setPoolWindowDays(next.poolWindowDays);
        update(cur.key, (s) => ({
          ...s,
          read: next,
          readStatus: 'ready',
          readError: null,
          ...(adoptJob && { job: next.job }),
        }));
      } catch (err) {
        if (cur.controller.signal.aborted || isAbort(err) || currentRef.current !== cur) return;
        update(cur.key, (s) => ({ ...s, readStatus: 'error', readError: readErrorText(err) }));
      }
    },
    [update],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (key === undefined || kind === undefined || id === undefined) {
      currentRef.current = null;
      return undefined;
    }
    const cur: Current = { key, kind, id, includeOlder, controller: new AbortController() };
    currentRef.current = cur;
    seenBatchesRef.current = 0;
    wasLiveRef.current = false;
    void loadRead(cur, true);
    return () => {
      cur.controller.abort();
      if (currentRef.current === cur) currentRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [id, includeOlder, key, kind, loadRead]);

  const refreshJob = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
    const cur = currentRef.current;
    if (cur === null) return;
    try {
      const res = await getRankingJob(cur.kind, cur.id, cur.controller.signal);
      if (cur.controller.signal.aborted || currentRef.current !== cur) return;
      const next = res.job;
      // FINISHED batches, scored or failed (spec D12; plan review BB5).
      const finished = next === null ? 0 : finishedBatchCount(next);
      const grew = finished > seenBatchesRef.current;
      const ended = wasLiveRef.current && (next === null || !isJobLive(next.status));
      seenBatchesRef.current = finished;
      wasLiveRef.current = next !== null && isJobLive(next.status);
      update(cur.key, (s) => ({ ...s, job: next }));
      if (grew || ended) await loadRead(cur, false);
    } catch {
      // A failed job read is not shown: the next poll or event reads it again.
    }
  }, [loadRead, update]);

  const live = slice !== null && key !== undefined && slice.key === key ? slice : null;
  const jobLive = live !== null && live.job !== null && isJobLive(live.job.status);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!jobLive) return undefined;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      void refreshJob();
    }, JOB_POLL_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [jobLive, key, refreshJob]);

  useEventStream({
    onRankingUpdated: (event) => {
      if (event.anchorKind === kind && event.anchorId === id) void refreshJob();
    },
  });

  const rank = useCallback((): void => {
    const cur = currentRef.current;
    if (cur === null) return;
    update(cur.key, (s) => ({ ...s, ranking: true, rankError: null, joined: false }));
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await startRanking(cur.kind, cur.id, { includeOlder: cur.includeOlder });
        if (currentRef.current !== cur) return;
        seenBatchesRef.current = finishedBatchCount(res.job);
        wasLiveRef.current = isJobLive(res.job.status);
        update(cur.key, (s) => ({ ...s, ranking: false, job: res.job, joined: res.joined }));
      } catch (err) {
        if (currentRef.current !== cur) return;
        update(cur.key, (s) => ({ ...s, ranking: false, rankError: rankErrorText(err) }));
        // Refused for a live job: follow it, so the page shows it finishing.
        if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'ranking_running') void refreshJob();
      }
    })();
  }, [refreshJob, update]);

  const retryRead = useCallback((): void => {
    const cur = currentRef.current;
    if (cur === null) return;
    update(cur.key, (s) => ({ ...s, readStatus: 'loading', readError: null }));
    void loadRead(cur, true);
  }, [loadRead, update]);

  if (key === undefined) {
    return {
      read: undefined,
      readStatus: 'idle',
      readError: null,
      poolWindowDays,
      job: null,
      joined: false,
      ranking: false,
      rankError: null,
      rank,
      retryRead,
    };
  }
  const s = live ?? blank(key);
  return {
    read: s.read,
    readStatus: s.readStatus,
    readError: s.readError,
    poolWindowDays,
    job: s.job,
    joined: s.joined,
    ranking: s.ranking,
    rankError: s.rankError,
    rank,
    retryRead,
  };
}
```

Create `dashboard/src/routes/settings/rankings/RankingTable.tsx`:

```tsx
// RankingTable - the ranking read (WP1 B2a spec D9) as a plain table: a test
// surface for the engine (spec D18); B3 builds the real ranked row. Rows are
// in the server's order (band, score, ... spec D9) and are never re-sorted.
import type { RankingAnchorKind, RankingReason, RankingRowView } from '../../../api/index.js';
import { NOT_RANKED_YET, NOT_SCORED, bandLabel, cappedText, outOfDateText, reasonsText } from './rankingFormat.js';
import styles from './RankingsSection.module.css';

function Reasons({ label, reasons }: { label: string; reasons: RankingReason[] }): React.JSX.Element | null {
  if (reasons.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <p className={styles.reasons}>
      <span className={styles.reasonLabel}>{label}:</span> {reasonsText(reasons)}
    </p>
  );
}

function RankingRow({ row }: { row: RankingRowView }): React.JSX.Element {
  const match = row.match;
  if (match === null) {
    return (
      <tr>
        <th scope="row">{row.display}</th>
        <td colSpan={6}>{row.notScored ? NOT_SCORED : NOT_RANKED_YET}</td>
      </tr>
    );
  }
  return (
    <tr>
      <th scope="row">{row.display}</th>
      <td>{bandLabel(match.band)}</td>
      <td>{match.score}</td>
      <td>{cappedText(match.capped)}</td>
      <td>{outOfDateText(match.outOfDate)}</td>
      <td>
        <Reasons label="For" reasons={match.for} />
        <Reasons label="Against" reasons={match.against} />
      </td>
      <td>{match.missing.length === 0 ? '-' : match.missing.map((item) => item.text).join(', ')}</td>
    </tr>
  );
}

export function RankingTable({ rows, anchorKind }: { rows: RankingRowView[]; anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind }): React.JSX.Element {
  if (rows.length === 0) return <p className={styles.empty}>No candidates are in this pool.</p>;
  return (
    <div className={styles.tableWrap}>
      <table className={styles.table} aria-label="Ranking">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col">{anchorKind === 'unit' ? 'Tenant' : 'Property'}</th>
            <th scope="col">Band</th>
            <th scope="col">Score</th>
            <th scope="col">Capped</th>
            <th scope="col">Out of date</th>
            <th scope="col">Reasons</th>
            <th scope="col">Missing</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <RankingRow key={row.candidateId} row={row} />
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

(The Reasons cell renders "For: ..." then "Against: ..." as two `<p>`s; the
test's `textContent` reads them joined with no separator, as written.)

#### Step 3 - implementation

Create `dashboard/src/routes/settings/rankings/useRankCandidates.ts`:

```ts
// useRankCandidates - the lists the Rank panel's search fields filter (WP1
// B2a spec D18 "the existing contact and unit search"). ContactSearchField
// and UnitSearchField filter a candidate array client side, so the panel
// loads EVERY page of both, as PlacementCreateForm does. Any record can be
// the anchor (spec D1), so neither list is narrowed by status.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { getAllContacts, getAllUnits, type Contact, type UnitItem } from '../../../api/index.js';

export interface RankCandidates {
  units: UnitItem[];
  tenants: Contact[];
  status: 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';
}

export function useRankCandidates(): RankCandidates {
  const [state, setState] = useState<RankCandidates>({ units: [], tenants: [], status: 'loading' });

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const [units, tenants] = await Promise.all([
          getAllUnits({}, controller.signal),
          getAllContacts({ type: 'tenant' }, controller.signal),
        ]);
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setState({ units, tenants, status: 'ready' });
      } catch (err) {
        if (controller.signal.aborted || (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === 'AbortError')) return;
        setState({ units: [], tenants: [], status: 'error' });
      }
    })();
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  return state;
}
```

Create `dashboard/src/routes/settings/rankings/RankAnchorPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// RankAnchorPanel - "Rank this anchor" (WP1 B2a spec D18): pick a property or
// a tenant with the existing search fields, choose the window for a
// property, press Rank, then follow the job per batch and read the ranking
// as a plain table. A test surface for the engine; B3 builds the real row.
// The anchor and the window live in the URL (RankingsSection owns them), so
// a reload reads the same ranking again.
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { RankingAnchorKind, RankingAnchorRef, RankingReadResponse } from '../../../api/index.js';
import { Button, Spinner } from '../../../ui/index.js';
import { ContactSearchField, type ContactSearchValue } from '../../contact/ContactSearchField.js';
import { UnitSearchField, type UnitSearchValue } from '../../contact/UnitSearchField.js';
import { RankingTable } from './RankingTable.js';
import { ANCHOR_NOTE_TEXT, isJobLive, jobStatusText } from './rankingFormat.js';
import { useAnchorRanking } from './useAnchorRanking.js';
import { useRankCandidates } from './useRankCandidates.js';
import styles from './RankingsSection.module.css';

export interface RankAnchorPanelProps {
  anchor: RankingAnchorRef | undefined;
  includeOlder: boolean;
  onAnchorChange: (next: RankingAnchorRef | undefined) => void;
  onIncludeOlderChange: (next: boolean) => void;
  onShowRuns: (anchor: RankingAnchorRef) => void;
}

function AnchorRead({ read, anchorKind }: { read: RankingReadResponse; anchorKind: RankingAnchorKind }): React.JSX.Element {
  // Checked FIRST (plan PR16): over the ceiling the read carries the anchor
  // block but no rows; the page states the pool size instead of a table.
  const tooLarge = read.poolTooLarge;
  const placeOf = (unitId: string): string =>
    unitId === read.anchor.id
      ? read.anchor.display
      : read.rows.find((row) => row.candidateId === unitId)?.display ?? unitId;
  const facts: string[] = [
    ...read.anchor.anchorNotes.map((note) => ANCHOR_NOTE_TEXT[note]),
    ...(read.anchor.missing.length > 0
      ? [`Missing on this record: ${read.anchor.missing.map((flag) => flag.label).join(', ')}`]
      : []),
    ...(read.anchor.cardChanged ? ['This record changed since it was last ranked.'] : []),
    ...read.flags.map((flag) => `Fair-housing flag on ${placeOf(flag.unitId)}, ${flag.field}: ${flag.reason}`),
  ];
  return (
    <>
      {facts.length > 0 ? (
        // Explicit role: `list-style: none` makes WebKit drop the list role
        // its aria-label rides on (AiRunsSection.tsx's note).
        <ul className={styles.facts} role="list" aria-label="About this anchor">
          {facts.map((fact, index) => (
            <li key={`${index}-${fact}`}>{fact}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
      {tooLarge !== undefined ? (
        <p className={styles.note}>{tooLarge.message}</p>
      ) : (
        <RankingTable rows={read.rows} anchorKind={anchorKind} />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export function RankAnchorPanel({
  anchor,
  includeOlder,
  onAnchorChange,
  onIncludeOlderChange,
  onShowRuns,
}: RankAnchorPanelProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [chosenKind, setChosenKind] = useState<RankingAnchorKind>('unit');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<{ id: string; label: string } | null>(null);
  const kind: RankingAnchorKind = anchor?.kind ?? chosenKind;
  // The window applies to a property anchor only (spec D1).
  const older = kind === 'unit' && includeOlder;
  const candidates = useRankCandidates();
  const ranking = useAnchorRanking(anchor, older);
  const jobLive = ranking.job !== null && isJobLive(ranking.job.status);

  // A hand pick keeps its own label; an anchor from the URL reads its display
  // from the ranking read, then falls back to the id.
  const committedLabel =
    anchor === undefined
      ? ''
      : picked !== null && picked.id === anchor.id
        ? picked.label
        : ranking.read?.anchor.display ?? anchor.id;

  const chooseKind = (next: RankingAnchorKind): void => {
    setChosenKind(next);
    setQuery('');
    setPicked(null);
    if (anchor !== undefined && anchor.kind !== next) onAnchorChange(undefined);
  };
  const pick = (next: RankingAnchorRef, label: string): void => {
    setPicked({ id: next.id, label });
    setQuery('');
    onAnchorChange(next);
  };
  const typeQuery = (text: string): void => {
    setQuery(text);
    if (anchor !== undefined) onAnchorChange(undefined);
  };

  const unitValue: UnitSearchValue =
    anchor !== undefined && anchor.kind === 'unit' ? { label: committedLabel, unitId: anchor.id } : { label: query };
  const contactValue: ContactSearchValue =
    anchor !== undefined && anchor.kind === 'tenant' ? { name: committedLabel, contactId: anchor.id } : { name: query };

  return (
    <section className={styles.panel} aria-label="Rank this anchor">
      <h3 className={styles.panelHeading}>Rank this anchor</h3>
      <div role="radiogroup" aria-label="Anchor type" className={styles.kindOptions}>
        <label className={styles.radioLabel}>
          <input type="radio" name="rank-anchor-kind" value="unit" checked={kind === 'unit'} onChange={() => chooseKind('unit')} />
          Property
        </label>
        <label className={styles.radioLabel}>
          <input type="radio" name="rank-anchor-kind" value="tenant" checked={kind === 'tenant'} onChange={() => chooseKind('tenant')} />
          Tenant
        </label>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.pickRow}>
        <div className={styles.pickField}>
          {kind === 'unit' ? (
            <UnitSearchField
              value={unitValue}
              onChange={(next) => {
                if (next.unitId !== undefined) pick({ kind: 'unit', id: next.unitId }, next.label);
                else typeQuery(next.label);
              }}
              candidates={candidates.units}
              inputLabel="Property to rank"
            />
          ) : (
            <ContactSearchField
              value={contactValue}
              onChange={(next) => {
                if (next.contactId !== undefined) pick({ kind: 'tenant', id: next.contactId }, next.name);
                else typeQuery(next.name);
              }}
              candidates={candidates.tenants}
              inputLabel="Tenant to rank"
            />
          )}
        </div>
        {/* The window is the configured RANKING_POOL_WINDOW_DAYS, known only
            from a read (plan PR26), so the checkbox shows once one answered. */}
        {kind === 'unit' && ranking.poolWindowDays !== null ? (
          <label className={styles.checkLabel}>
            <input type="checkbox" checked={includeOlder} onChange={(event) => onIncludeOlderChange(event.target.checked)} />
            Include tenants not heard from in {ranking.poolWindowDays} days
          </label>
        ) : null}
        <Button
          variant="primary"
          size="sm"
          type="button"
          disabled={anchor === undefined || ranking.ranking || jobLive}
          onClick={ranking.rank}
        >
          {ranking.ranking ? 'Starting...' : 'Rank'}
        </Button>
        {anchor !== undefined ? (
          <button type="button" className={styles.linkButton} onClick={() => onShowRuns(anchor)}>
            Show runs for this anchor
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {candidates.status === 'error' ? (
        <p className={styles.error} role="alert">
          We could not load the properties and tenants to search. Reload the page to try again.
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {ranking.rankError !== null ? (
        <p className={styles.error} role="alert">
          {ranking.rankError}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {ranking.job !== null ? (
        <p className={styles.jobStatus} role="status" aria-label="Ranking job">
          {jobStatusText(ranking.job)}
          {ranking.joined ? ' (joined the ranking already running)' : ''}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {anchor === undefined ? <p className={styles.note}>Pick a property or a tenant to see its ranking.</p> : null}
      {anchor !== undefined && ranking.readStatus === 'loading' ? <Spinner center label="Loading the ranking" /> : null}
      {ranking.readStatus === 'error' ? (
        <div className={styles.error} role="alert">
          <p>{ranking.readError}</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={ranking.retryRead}>
            Retry
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {anchor !== undefined && ranking.readStatus === 'ready' && ranking.read !== undefined ? (
        <AnchorRead read={ranking.read} anchorKind={anchor.kind} />
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
}

function DetailProbe({ runId }: { runId?: string }): React.JSX.Element {
  const state = useRankingRun(runId);
  return createElement(
    'div',
    undefined,
    createElement('span', { 'data-testid': 'detail-status' }, state.status),
    createElement('span', { 'data-testid': 'detail-run' }, state.detail?.run.runId ?? ''),
  );
}

function CostProbe({ from, to }: { from?: string; to?: string }): React.JSX.Element {
  const state = useRankingCost({ from, to });
  return createElement(
    'div',
    undefined,
    createElement('span', { 'data-testid': 'cost-status' }, state.status),
    createElement('span', { 'data-testid': 'cost-env' }, state.cost?.environment ?? ''),
    createElement('button', { type: 'button', onClick: state.retry }, 'retry cost'),
  );
}
```

#### Step 3 - implementation

Create `dashboard/src/routes/settings/rankings/useRankingRuns.ts`:

```ts
// useRankingRuns - the Rankings page's run log reads (WP1 B2a spec D11, D12,
// D18): one cursor-paged list (newest first, filtered by date range and
// anchor), one run detail, and the weekly cost totals. Admin only on the
// server (requireRole('admin')). Each state is keyed by the request it
// answers, so a filter change reads "loading" without a reset inside an
// effect, and `retry` bumps a counter that is part of the key.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  getRankingCost,
  getRankingRun,
  listRankingRuns,
  type RankingAnchorRef,
  type RankingCostResponse,
  type RankingRunDetailResponse,
  type RankingRunListRow,
} from '../../../api/index.js';

export type RankingFetchStatus = 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';

function isAbort(err: unknown): boolean {
  return err instanceof DOMException && err.name === 'AbortError';
}

export interface RankingRunListState {
  rows: RankingRunListRow[];
  status: RankingFetchStatus;
  hasMore: boolean;
  loadingMore: boolean;
  /** The last Load more failed; the rows and the cursor are still good. */
  loadMoreFailed: boolean;
  /** A page said a run could not be read (plan PR34). */
  incomplete: boolean;
  loadMore: () => void;
  retry: () => void;
}

interface ListSlice {
  key: string;
  rows: RankingRunListRow[];
  status: 'ready' | 'error';
  cursor: string | undefined;
  incomplete: boolean;
  loadingMore: boolean;
  loadMoreFailed: boolean;
}

export function useRankingRunList(params: { from?: string; to?: string; anchor?: RankingAnchorRef }): RankingRunListState {
  const { from, to } = params;
  const anchorKind = params.anchor?.kind;
  const anchorId = params.anchor?.id;
  const [reload, setReload] = useState(0);
  const key = [from ?? '', to ?? '', anchorKind ?? '', anchorId ?? '', String(reload)].join('|');
  const [slice, setSlice] = useState<ListSlice | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const page = await listRankingRuns({ from, to, anchorKind, anchorId }, controller.signal);
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setSlice({
          key,
          rows: page.runs,
          status: 'ready',
          cursor: page.nextCursor,
          incomplete: page.incomplete === true,
          loadingMore: false,
          loadMoreFailed: false,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        if (controller.signal.aborted || isAbort(err)) return;
        setSlice({ key, rows: [], status: 'error', cursor: undefined, incomplete: false, loadingMore: false, loadMoreFailed: false });
      }
    })();
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [anchorId, anchorKind, from, key, to]);

  const live = slice !== null && slice.key === key ? slice : null;

  const loadMore = useCallback((): void => {
    if (live === null || live.status !== 'ready' || live.cursor === undefined || live.loadingMore) return;
    const cursor = live.cursor;
    const forKey = live.key;
    setSlice((prev) => (prev !== null && prev.key === forKey ? { ...prev, loadingMore: true, loadMoreFailed: false } : prev));
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const page = await listRankingRuns({ from, to, anchorKind, anchorId, cursor });
        setSlice((prev) =>
          prev !== null && prev.key === forKey
            ? {
                ...prev,
                rows: [...prev.rows, ...page.runs],
                cursor: page.nextCursor,
                incomplete: prev.incomplete || page.incomplete === true,
                loadingMore: false,
                loadMoreFailed: false,
              }
            : prev,
        );
      } catch {
        // The cursor stays: the next page still exists, this attempt failed.
        setSlice((prev) => (prev !== null && prev.key === forKey ? { ...prev, loadingMore: false, loadMoreFailed: true } : prev));
      }
    })();
  }, [anchorId, anchorKind, from, live, to]);

  const retry = useCallback((): void => {
    setReload((n) => n + 1);
  }, []);

  return {
    rows: live?.rows ?? [],
    status: live?.status ?? 'loading',
    hasMore: live !== null && live.cursor !== undefined,
    loadingMore: live?.loadingMore ?? false,
    loadMoreFailed: live?.loadMoreFailed ?? false,
    incomplete: live?.incomplete ?? false,
    loadMore,
    retry,
  };
}

export interface RankingRunState {
  detail: RankingRunDetailResponse | undefined;
  status: 'idle' | RankingFetchStatus;
  retry: () => void;
}

interface DetailSlice {
  key: string;
  detail: RankingRunDetailResponse | undefined;
  status: 'ready' | 'error';
}

export function useRankingRun(runId: string | undefined): RankingRunState {
  const [reload, setReload] = useState(0);
  const key = runId === undefined ? undefined : `${runId}|${reload}`;
  const [slice, setSlice] = useState<DetailSlice | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (runId === undefined || key === undefined) return undefined;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const detail = await getRankingRun(runId, controller.signal);
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setSlice({ key, detail, status: 'ready' });
      } catch (err) {
        if (controller.signal.aborted || isAbort(err)) return;
        setSlice({ key, detail: undefined, status: 'error' });
      }
    })();
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [key, runId]);

  const retry = useCallback((): void => {
    setReload((n) => n + 1);
  }, []);

  if (key === undefined) return { detail: undefined, status: 'idle', retry };
  const live = slice !== null && slice.key === key ? slice : null;
  return { detail: live?.detail, status: live?.status ?? 'loading', retry };
}

export interface RankingCostState {
  cost: RankingCostResponse | undefined;
  status: RankingFetchStatus;
  retry: () => void;
}

interface CostSlice {
  key: string;
  cost: RankingCostResponse | undefined;
  status: 'ready' | 'error';
}

export function useRankingCost(params: { from?: string; to?: string }): RankingCostState {
  const { from, to } = params;
  const [reload, setReload] = useState(0);
  const key = [from ?? '', to ?? '', String(reload)].join('|');
  const [slice, setSlice] = useState<CostSlice | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const cost = await getRankingCost({ from, to }, controller.signal);
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setSlice({ key, cost, status: 'ready' });
      } catch (err) {
        if (controller.signal.aborted || isAbort(err)) return;
        setSlice({ key, cost: undefined, status: 'error' });
      }
    })();
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [from, key, to]);

  const retry = useCallback((): void => {
    setReload((n) => n + 1);
  }, []);

  const live = slice !== null && slice.key === key ? slice : null;
  return { cost: live?.cost, status: live?.status ?? 'loading', retry };
}
```

```tsx
  it('notes the range the server used whenever a bound is missing (plan review R2B6)', () => {
    expect(costRangeNote(undefined, undefined)).toBe('The last 12 weeks.');
    expect(costRangeNote(undefined, '2026-07-31')).toBe('The 12 weeks ending the week of 2026-07-31.');
    expect(costRangeNote('2026-07-01', undefined)).toBe('From 2026-07-01 through today.');
    expect(costRangeNote('2026-07-01', '2026-07-31')).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('names the default range, and says when runs could not be read (plan PR34)', () => {
    render(
      <RankingCostTotals

    expect(screen.getByText('Some runs could not be read; totals may be low')).toBeInTheDocument();

});

    expect(within(fourth).getAllByRole('cell').map((td) => td.textContent)).toEqual([

      />,

    const failure = screen.getByRole('region', { name: 'Run failure' });
    expect(failure).toHaveTextContent('Failed: timeout');
    expect(failure).toHaveTextContent('The call took too long.');
    expect(screen.queryByRole('table', { name: 'Run pairs' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    const { matchesWritten: _unused, ...unwritten } = DETAIL.run;
    rerender(<RankingRunDetail detail={{ ...DETAIL, run: unwritten }} status="ready" onRetry={vi.fn()} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('region', { name: 'Ranking run detail' })).toHaveTextContent('Matches: not written');

  it('asks for a pick when idle and offers Retry on an error', async () => {

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }));
    expect(onRetry).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
```

```tsx
// RankingRunList - the ranking run log (WP1 B2a spec D11, D18): one row per
// model call, newest first, cursor paged, filtered by date range and by
// anchor (the anchor filter is set from the Rank panel). An expired pointer
// reads as such, as the AI run log does.
import type { RankingRunListRow } from '../../../api/index.js';
import { Spinner } from '../../../ui/index.js';
import { directionLabel, formatCost } from './rankingFormat.js';
import styles from './RankingsSection.module.css';

export interface RankingRunListProps {
  rows: RankingRunListRow[];
  status: 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';
  hasMore: boolean;
  loadingMore: boolean;
  loadMoreFailed: boolean;
  /** A page said a run could not be read (plan PR34). */
  incomplete: boolean;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  anchorFilter: { label: string } | undefined;
  onFromChange: (value: string) => void;
  onToChange: (value: string) => void;
  onClearAnchor: () => void;
  onOpen: (runId: string) => void;
  onLoadMore: () => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onRefresh: () => void;
}

export function RankingRunList({
  rows,
  status,
  hasMore,
  loadingMore,
  loadMoreFailed,
  incomplete,
  from,
  to,
  anchorFilter,
  onFromChange,
  onToChange,
  onClearAnchor,
  onOpen,
  onLoadMore,
  onRetry,
  onRefresh,
}: RankingRunListProps): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <section className={styles.listPane} aria-label="Ranking run list">
      <div className={styles.listHeader}>
        <h3 className={styles.panelHeading}>Runs</h3>
        <button type="button" className={styles.linkButton} onClick={onRefresh}>
          Refresh
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.filters}>
        <label className={styles.dateLabel}>
          From
          <input className={styles.dateInput} type="date" value={from} onChange={(event) => onFromChange(event.target.value)} />
        </label>
        <label className={styles.dateLabel}>
          To
          <input className={styles.dateInput} type="date" value={to} onChange={(event) => onToChange(event.target.value)} />
        </label>
        {anchorFilter !== undefined ? (
          <p className={styles.filterChip}>
            Anchor: {anchorFilter.label}{' '}
            <button type="button" className={styles.linkButton} onClick={onClearAnchor}>
              All anchors
            </button>
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {status === 'loading' ? <Spinner center label="Loading runs" /> : null}
      {status === 'error' ? (
        <div className={styles.error} role="alert">
          <p>We could not load the ranking runs.</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={onRetry}>
            Retry
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {status === 'ready' && incomplete ? <p className={styles.note}>Some runs could not be read; this list may be missing some.</p> : null}
      {status === 'ready' && rows.length === 0 ? <p className={styles.empty}>No ranking runs match these filters.</p> : null}
      {status === 'ready' && rows.length > 0 ? (
        <>
          {/* Explicit role: `list-style: none` makes WebKit drop the list
              role this aria-label (the e2e anchor) rides on. */}
          <ul className={styles.rows} role="list" aria-label="Ranking runs">
            {rows.map((row) =>
              row.expired ? (
                <li key={row.runId} className={styles.expired}>
                  Expired run {row.runId}
                </li>
              ) : (
                <li key={row.runId}>
                  <button type="button" className={styles.runRow} onClick={() => onOpen(row.runId)}>
                    <span className={styles.runTime}>{new Date(row.startedAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
                    <span>{row.anchorDisplay}</span>
                    <span>
                      {directionLabel(row.direction)}, batch {row.batchIndex + 1}
                    </span>
                    <span>{row.model}</span>
                    <span>{row.candidateCount} candidates</span>
                    <span>{formatCost(row.costUsd)}</span>
                    <span>{row.latencyMs} ms</span>
                    <span className={styles.outcome}>{row.outcome}</span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ),
            )}
          </ul>
          {loadMoreFailed ? (
            <div className={styles.error} role="alert">
              <p>We could not load more runs.</p>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {hasMore ? (
            <button type="button" className={styles.loadMore} disabled={loadingMore} onClick={onLoadMore}>
              {loadingMore ? 'Loading...' : 'Load more'}
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

Create `dashboard/src/routes/settings/rankings/RankingCostTotals.tsx`:

```tsx
// RankingCostTotals - ranking spend by ISO week and environment (WP1 B2a
// spec D11, D18), with this deployment's environment name above the list.
import type { RankingCostResponse } from '../../../api/index.js';
import { Spinner } from '../../../ui/index.js';
import { formatCost } from './rankingFormat.js';
import styles from './RankingsSection.module.css';

/** The range the server totals when a bound is missing (plan PR34, plan
 *  review R2B6; S6 round 2): no bound is the last 12 ISO weeks; `to` alone
 *  is the 12 ISO weeks ending with `to`'s week; `from` alone reads through
 *  today. Both bounds set: no note (the inputs say it). */
export function costRangeNote(from: string | undefined, to: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (from !== undefined && to !== undefined) return undefined;
  if (from !== undefined) return `From ${from} through today.`;
  return to === undefined ? 'The last 12 weeks.' : `The 12 weeks ending the week of ${to}.`;
}

export function RankingCostTotals({
  cost,
  status,
  rangeNote,
  onRetry,
}: {
  cost: RankingCostResponse | undefined;
  status: 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';
  /** costRangeNote's text, or undefined when the staff member set `from`. */
  rangeNote: string | undefined;
  onRetry: () => void;
}): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <section className={styles.panel} aria-label="Cost by week">
      <h3 className={styles.panelHeading}>Cost by week</h3>
      {status === 'loading' ? <Spinner center label="Loading cost totals" /> : null}
      {status === 'error' ? (
        <div className={styles.error} role="alert">
          <p>We could not load the cost totals.</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={onRetry}>
            Retry
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {status === 'ready' && cost !== undefined ? (
        <>
          <p className={styles.note}>Environment: {cost.environment}</p>
          {rangeNote !== undefined ? <p className={styles.note}>{rangeNote}</p> : null}
          {cost.incomplete === true ? <p className={styles.note}>Some runs could not be read; totals may be low</p> : null}
          {cost.weeks.length === 0 ? (
            <p className={styles.empty}>No ranking cost in this range.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className={styles.tableWrap}>
              <table className={styles.table} aria-label="Weekly ranking cost">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col">Week</th>
                    <th scope="col">Environment</th>
                    <th scope="col">Runs</th>
                    <th scope="col">Cost</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {cost.weeks.map((week) => (
                    <tr key={`${week.week}#${week.environment}`}>
                      <td>{week.week}</td>
                      <td>{week.environment}</td>
                      <td>{week.runs}</td>
                      <td>{formatCost(week.costUsd)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

Create `dashboard/src/routes/settings/rankings/RankingRunDetail.tsx`:

```tsx
// RankingRunDetail - one ranking run (WP1 B2a spec D11, D18): its fields, the
// raw output and the input (both collapsed; the server decompresses the
// input), and its pairs from the run's OWN results[] - what THIS run said.
// The matches store holds one row per pair, rewritten by later presses from
// either anchor, so each pair is marked against the current match's runId:
// "This run", "Since re-scored" or "No current match".
import type { RankingFairHousingFlag, RankingRunDetailResponse } from '../../../api/index.js';
import { Spinner } from '../../../ui/index.js';
import { bandLabel, currentMatchText, directionLabel, formatCost, reasonsText } from './rankingFormat.js';
import styles from './RankingsSection.module.css';

function prettyInput(input: string): string {
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(input) as unknown, null, 2);
  } catch {
    return input;
  }
}

function flagsText(flags: readonly RankingFairHousingFlag[]): string {
  if (flags.length === 0) return '-';
  return flags.map((flag) => `${flag.kind} on ${flag.field}`).join(', ');
}

export function RankingRunDetail({
  detail,
  status,
  onRetry,
}: {
  detail: RankingRunDetailResponse | undefined;
  status: 'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';
  onRetry: () => void;
}): React.JSX.Element {
  if (status === 'loading') return <Spinner center label="Loading the run" />;
  if (status === 'error') {
    return (
      <div className={styles.error} role="alert">
        <p>We could not load this ranking run.</p>
        <button type="button" onClick={onRetry}>
          Retry
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (status === 'idle' || detail === undefined) return <p className={styles.empty}>Select a run to see its pairs.</p>;
  const { run, anchorDisplay, input, pairs, flags, currentUnavailable, flagsUnavailable } = detail;
  const dropped = run.droppedUnlawfulFlags ?? 0;
  // `usage` may be absent on a stored run (plan IR35).
  const usage = run.usage;
  const usageText =
    usage === undefined
      ? 'no usage recorded'
      : `${usage.inputTokens} input tokens - ${usage.outputTokens} output tokens${
          usage.cacheReadInputTokens !== undefined ? ` - ${usage.cacheReadInputTokens} cache read tokens` : ''
        }`;
  // `matchesWritten` is { count, at }; absent = the write did not finish (PR15).
  const written = run.matchesWritten;
  return (
    <section className={styles.detailPane} aria-label="Ranking run detail">
      <header className={styles.detailHeader}>
        <h3>Run {run.runId}</h3>
        <p>
          {anchorDisplay} - {directionLabel(run.direction)} - batch {run.batchIndex + 1}
        </p>
        <p>
          {new Date(run.startedAt).toLocaleString()} - {run.outcome} - {run.driver} / {run.model} - {run.latencyMs} ms
        </p>
        <p>
          {run.candidateCount} candidates - {usageText} - {formatCost(run.costUsd)}
        </p>
        <p>
          Rubric {run.rubricVersion} - examples {run.examplesVersion} - prompt fingerprint {run.promptFingerprint}
        </p>
        <p>
          Environment: {run.environment}
          {dropped > 0 ? ` - ${dropped} unlawful flag${dropped === 1 ? '' : 's'} dropped` : ''}
          {run.outcome === 'scored'
            ? written === undefined
              ? ' - Matches: not written'
              : ` - ${written.count} match${written.count === 1 ? '' : 'es'} written`
            : ''}
        </p>
      </header>
      {run.outcome === 'failed' ? (
        <section className={styles.failure} aria-label="Run failure">
          <h4>Failed: {(run.failure ?? 'unknown').replaceAll('_', ' ')}</h4>
          {run.message !== undefined ? <p>{run.message}</p> : null}
        </section>
      ) : null}
      {pairs.length > 0 ? (
        <section className={styles.block}>
          <h4>Pairs</h4>
          <div className={styles.tableWrap}>
            <table className={styles.table} aria-label="Run pairs">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th scope="col">Candidate</th>
                  <th scope="col">Score</th>
                  <th scope="col">Band</th>
                  <th scope="col">Cap</th>
                  <th scope="col">For</th>
                  <th scope="col">Against</th>
                  <th scope="col">Missing</th>
                  <th scope="col">Flags</th>
                  <th scope="col">Current match</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {pairs.map((pair) => (
                  <tr key={pair.candidateId}>
                    <th scope="row">{pair.display}</th>
                    <td>{pair.returned && pair.score !== undefined ? pair.score : '-'}</td>
                    <td>{pair.returned && pair.band !== undefined ? bandLabel(pair.band) : 'not returned'}</td>
                    <td>{pair.returned ? (pair.cappedAtRun ? 'Capped' : 'No') : '-'}</td>
                    <td>{reasonsText(pair.for)}</td>
                    <td>{reasonsText(pair.against)}</td>
                    <td>{pair.missing.length === 0 ? '-' : pair.missing.map((item) => item.text).join(', ')}</td>
                    <td>{flagsText(pair.fairHousingFlags)}</td>
                    <td>{currentMatchText(pair.currentRunId, run.runId)}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : null}
      {currentUnavailable === true ? (
        <p className={styles.note}>Could not check the current matches; the Current match column may be wrong.</p>
      ) : null}
      {flagsUnavailable === true ? <p className={styles.note}>Could not read the open fair-housing flags.</p> : null}
      {flags.length > 0 ? (
        <section className={styles.block} aria-label="Open fair-housing flags">
          <h4>Open fair-housing flags</h4>
          <ul>
            {flags.map((flag) => (
              <li key={`${flag.unitId}#${flag.field}`}>
                {flag.field}: {flag.reason}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      ) : null}
      {run.rawText !== undefined ? (
        <details className={styles.raw}>
          <summary>Raw model output</summary>
          <pre>{run.rawText}</pre>
        </details>
      ) : null}
      <details className={styles.raw}>
        <summary>Input sent</summary>
        {input === null ? (
          <p>{run.inputOmitted === true ? 'The input was too large to keep.' : 'No input recorded.'}</p>
        ) : (
          <pre>{prettyInput(input)}</pre>
        )}
      </details>
    </section>
  );
}
```

Note for the builder: the not-returned row's For / Against / Missing /
Flags cells read "-" through `reasonsText([])`, the empty `missing` and
`flagsText([])`; a not-returned pair carries empty lists (plan IR19).

Create `dashboard/src/routes/settings/rankings/RankingsSection.tsx`:

```tsx
// RankingsSection - the admin Rankings tab (WP1 B2a spec D18; charter 11):
// "Rank this anchor", the weekly cost totals, and the run log (list |
// detail). Admin only: the tab is adminOnly and the route sits inside
// AdminRoute (App.tsx); the run log's API is requireRole('admin'). Every
// choice lives in the URL so a reload reads the same page again:
//   rank   the panel's anchor, `<kind>:<id>`    older  `1` = include older tenants
//   from / to  the date range                   anchor the run list's anchor filter
//   run    the opened run
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { RankingRunListRow, RankingRunListRowLive } from '../../../api/index.js';
import { RankAnchorPanel } from './RankAnchorPanel.js';
import { RankingCostTotals, costRangeNote } from './RankingCostTotals.js';
import { RankingRunDetail } from './RankingRunDetail.js';
import { RankingRunList } from './RankingRunList.js';
import { anchorParam, parseAnchorParam } from './rankingFormat.js';
import { useRankingCost, useRankingRun, useRankingRunList } from './useRankingRuns.js';
import styles from './RankingsSection.module.css';

type Param = 'rank' | 'older' | 'from' | 'to' | 'anchor' | 'run';

function isLive(row: RankingRunListRow): row is RankingRunListRowLive {
  return !row.expired;
}

export function RankingsSection(): React.JSX.Element {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const rankAnchor = parseAnchorParam(searchParams.get('rank'));
  const includeOlder = searchParams.get('older') === '1';
  const filterAnchor = parseAnchorParam(searchParams.get('anchor'));
  const from = searchParams.get('from') ?? undefined;
  const to = searchParams.get('to') ?? undefined;
  const runId = searchParams.get('run') ?? undefined;

  const list = useRankingRunList({ from, to, anchor: filterAnchor });
  const detail = useRankingRun(runId);
  const cost = useRankingCost({ from, to });

  const setParams = (changes: Partial<Record<Param, string | undefined>>): void => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(changes)) {
      if (value === undefined || value === '') next.delete(name);
      else next.set(name, value);
    }
    setSearchParams(next);
  };

  const filterLabel =
    filterAnchor === undefined
      ? undefined
      : list.rows.filter(isLive).find((row) => row.anchorKind === filterAnchor.kind && row.anchorId === filterAnchor.id)
          ?.anchorDisplay ?? filterAnchor.id;

  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <h2 className={styles.heading}>Rankings</h2>
        <p className={styles.lede}>Rank a property or a tenant, then check every model call, its cost and its pairs.</p>
      </header>
      <RankAnchorPanel
        anchor={rankAnchor}
        includeOlder={includeOlder}
        onAnchorChange={(next) => setParams({ rank: next === undefined ? undefined : anchorParam(next) })}
        onIncludeOlderChange={(next) => setParams({ older: next ? '1' : undefined })}
        onShowRuns={(next) => setParams({ anchor: anchorParam(next), run: undefined })}
      />
      <RankingCostTotals
        cost={cost.cost}
        status={cost.status}
        rangeNote={costRangeNote(from, to)}
        onRetry={cost.retry}
      />
      <div className={styles.runs}>
        <RankingRunList
          rows={list.rows}
          status={list.status}
          hasMore={list.hasMore}
          loadingMore={list.loadingMore}
          loadMoreFailed={list.loadMoreFailed}
          incomplete={list.incomplete}
          from={from ?? ''}
          to={to ?? ''}
          anchorFilter={filterLabel === undefined ? undefined : { label: filterLabel }}
          onFromChange={(value) => setParams({ from: value })}
          onToChange={(value) => setParams({ to: value })}
          onClearAnchor={() => setParams({ anchor: undefined })}
          onOpen={(id) => setParams({ run: id })}
          onLoadMore={list.loadMore}
          onRetry={list.retry}
          onRefresh={() => {
            list.retry();
            cost.retry();
          }}
        />
        <RankingRunDetail detail={detail.detail} status={detail.status} onRetry={detail.retry} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
// e2e/fixtures/ranking.ts
//
// Control-plane helpers for the ranking e2e specs (WP1 B2a spec section 6).
// The hermetic lane runs RANKING_DRIVER=fake and RANKING_WORKER_POLL=off
// (scripts/e2e-session.mjs), so a ranking job runs ONLY when a spec calls
// `rankingTick`. The lean world has no available property and one searching
// tenant, so every spec builds its fixtures through the real API here:
//   - a RUN-UNIQUE housing authority (through POST /api/organizations), so
//     the pool holds only the spec's own records - a property that records
//     authorities is limited to the mapped ones, from either side (spec D1);
//   - available properties that accept only it;
//   - searching, textable tenants that hold it.
// Pass `page.request` after a dev-login: the API needs the session cookie.
// The tick is a dev route and needs none (as /__dev/extraction/tick).
import { expect, type APIRequestContext } from '@playwright/test';
import { addOrg } from './orgFixture.js';

const NEXT = process.env['E2E_DASHBOARD_URL'] ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:5174';

/** The lean world's landlord of record (app/src/lib/seed/lean.ts IDS.landlord). */
const LEAN_LANDLORD = 'contact-landlord-0001';

/** Run ONE ranking poll pass to completion (spec D7): it returns when the
 *  jobs it claimed have finished. */
export async function rankingTick(request: APIRequestContext): Promise<void> {
  const res = await request.post(`${NEXT}/__dev/ranking/tick`);
  expect(res.ok(), `/__dev/ranking/tick failed: ${res.status()} ${await res.text()}`).toBeTruthy();
}

/** A run-unique housing authority on the organization list; returns its name. */
export async function runUniqueAuthority(api: APIRequestContext, name: string): Promise<string> {
  const entry = await addOrg(api, { kind: 'housing_authority', name });
  return entry.name;
}

let phoneSeq = 0;
/** A run-unique, well-formed NANP number (+1555 + 5 stamp digits + 2 seq digits). */
function uniquePhone(): string {
  phoneSeq += 1;
  return `+1555${`${Date.now()}`.slice(-5)}${String(phoneSeq).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export interface RankingTenant {
  contactId: string;
  /** The display the ranking shows: "<firstName> Rankcand". */
  name: string;
}

/** A searching 2-BR tenant with a phone (so sendable, spec D1) holding the
 *  run-unique authority. The create ignores `housingAuthority`; the PATCH
 *  applies the organization-list check. */
export async function createSearchingTenant(
  api: APIRequestContext,
  opts: { firstName: string; authority: string; pets?: string; notes?: string; areaPreference?: string },
): Promise<RankingTenant> {
  const lastName = 'Rankcand';
  const res = await api.post(`${NEXT}/api/contacts`, {
    data: {
      type: 'tenant',
      firstName: opts.firstName,
      lastName,
      phone: uniquePhone(),
      voucherSize: 2,
      status: 'searching',
      ...(opts.pets !== undefined && { pets: opts.pets }),
      ...(opts.notes !== undefined && { notes: opts.notes }),
      ...(opts.areaPreference !== undefined && { area_preference: opts.areaPreference }),
    },
  });
  expect(res.status(), await res.text()).toBe(201);
  const contactId = ((await res.json()) as { contact: { contactId: string } }).contact.contactId;
  const patch = await api.patch(`${NEXT}/api/contacts/${contactId}`, { data: { housingAuthority: opts.authority } });
  expect(patch.ok(), await patch.text()).toBeTruthy();
  return { contactId, name: `${opts.firstName} ${lastName}` };
}

/** An AVAILABLE 2-BR property that accepts a 2-BR voucher and only the given
 *  authority. New units start in Setup; the transition route publishes it. */
export async function createAvailableProperty(
  api: APIRequestContext,
  opts: { line1: string; authority: string; area?: string; noPets?: boolean },
): Promise<string> {
  const res = await api.post(`${NEXT}/api/units`, {
    data: {
      landlordId: LEAN_LANDLORD,
      beds: 2,
      voucher_size_accepted: [2],
      accepted_authorities: [opts.authority],
      address: { line1: opts.line1, city: 'Atlanta', state: 'GA', zip: '30314' },
      rent_min: 1500,
      rent_max: 1600,
      ...(opts.area !== undefined && { area: opts.area }),
      ...(opts.noPets === true && { no_pets: true }),
    },
  });
  expect(res.ok(), await res.text()).toBeTruthy();
  const unitId = ((await res.json()) as { unit: { unitId: string } }).unit.unitId;
  const flip = await api.patch(`${NEXT}/api/units/${unitId}/listing-status`, {
    data: { toStatus: 'available', source: 'manual' },
  });
  expect(flip.ok(), await flip.text()).toBeTruthy();
  return unitId;
}
```

Create `e2e/tests/dashboard-next/rankings.spec.ts`:

```ts
// e2e/tests/dashboard-next/rankings.spec.ts
//
// The admin Rankings page (WP1 B2a spec D18; spec section 6 e2e) end to end
// on the hermetic lane. RANKING_DRIVER=fake and RANKING_WORKER_POLL=off
// (scripts/e2e-session.mjs): a queued job runs ONLY when this spec calls
// POST /__dev/ranking/tick (fixtures/ranking.ts rankingTick), so "not ranked
// yet" before the tick and the ranked table after it are both deterministic.
//
// ISOLATION: one reseed in beforeAll wipes every local table to the lean
// world (routes/dev.ts reseed). Each test then builds its own records through
// the API with run-unique names and its OWN run-unique housing authority on
// both sides, so its pool holds exactly its own tenants or properties.
//
// The fake driver's rules (app/src/adapters/rankingFake.ts, spec D6): every
// pair starts at 70; minus 25 for a recorded No pets against tenant pets text
// (failed requirement no_pets - cap-eligible and recorded, so the read caps
// the pair to Weak and sorts it last); plus 10 when the tenant's area
// preference appears in the property's area. So: area match 80 Strong, plain
// 70 Good, pets against No pets capped Weak. `[fake:fail-batch]` in a
// tenant's notes fails every batch holding that tenant.
//
// getByRole name matching is a SUBSTRING match, so labels that are prefixes
// of others pass `exact: true`.
import { test, expect, type Locator, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  createAvailableProperty,
  createSearchingTenant,
  rankingTick,
  runUniqueAuthority,
} from '../../fixtures/ranking.js';
import { reseed } from '../../fixtures/reseed.js';
import { expectTodayReady } from '../../support/today.js';

const NEXT = process.env['E2E_DASHBOARD_URL'] ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:5174';

async function devLoginAs(page: Page, email: string): Promise<void> {
  const res = await page.request.post(`${NEXT}/auth/dev-login`, { data: { email } });
  expect(res.ok(), `dev-login failed: ${res.status()} ${await res.text()}`).toBeTruthy();
  await page.goto(`${NEXT}/`);
  await expectTodayReady(page);
}

function escapeRegExp(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}

function stamp(): string {
  return `${Date.now()}`.slice(-6);
}

async function openRankings(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.goto(`${NEXT}/settings/rankings`);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Rankings', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
}

function rankPanel(page: Page): Locator {
  return page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Rank this anchor' });
}

function rankingTable(page: Page): Locator {
  return rankPanel(page).getByRole('table', { name: 'Ranking' });
}

/** Every row of the ranking table; nth(0) is the header row. */
function rankingRows(page: Page): Locator {
  return rankingTable(page).getByRole('row');
}

function rankingRow(page: Page, name: string): Locator {
  return rankingTable(page).getByRole('row', { name: new RegExp(escapeRegExp(name)) });
}

function jobStatus(page: Page): Locator {
  return rankPanel(page).getByRole('status', { name: 'Ranking job' });
}

async function pickProperty(page: Page, line1: string): Promise<void> {
  const panel = rankPanel(page);
  await panel.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Property', exact: true }).check();
  await panel.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Property to rank', exact: true }).fill(line1);
  // The suggestion list is portaled to document.body (UnitSearchField).
  await page.getByRole('option', { name: new RegExp(escapeRegExp(line1)) }).click();
}

async function pickTenant(page: Page, name: string): Promise<void> {
  const panel = rankPanel(page);
  await panel.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Tenant', exact: true }).check();
  await panel.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Tenant to rank', exact: true }).fill(name);
  await page.getByRole('option', { name: new RegExp(escapeRegExp(name)) }).click();
}

async function pressRank(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await rankPanel(page).getByRole('button', { name: 'Rank', exact: true }).click();
  // Queued, and nothing runs it: the worker's ranking poll is off here.
  await expect(jobStatus(page)).toHaveText('Waiting for a free slot');
}

test.beforeAll(async ({ request }) => {
  await reseed(request);
});

test('an admin ranks a property: not ranked yet before the tick, ranked after, the capped pair last; the run lists with its cost and opens to its own results', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  test.slow();
  await devLoginAs(page, 'founder@example.com');
  const api = page.request;
  const s = stamp();
  const authority = await runUniqueAuthority(api, `Rankprop Authority ${s}`);
  const line1 = `${s} Rankprop Ave`;
  await createAvailableProperty(api, { line1, authority, area: 'Westview', noPets: true });
  const strong = await createSearchingTenant(api, { firstName: `Strong${s}`, authority, areaPreference: 'Westview' });
  const good = await createSearchingTenant(api, { firstName: `Good${s}`, authority });
  const capped = await createSearchingTenant(api, { firstName: `Capped${s}`, authority, pets: 'Two large dogs' });

  await openRankings(page);
  await pickProperty(page, line1);
  // The pool is read at once: three tenants, none ranked yet.
  await expect(rankingRows(page)).toHaveCount(4);
  for (const tenant of [strong, good, capped]) {
    await expect(rankingRow(page, tenant.name)).toContainText('not ranked yet');
  }

  await pressRank(page);
  await expect(rankingTable(page)).toContainText('not ranked yet');

  await rankingTick(api);
  // The event (or the 5 s job poll) reports the end; the page reads again.
  await expect(jobStatus(page)).toContainText('Done: 1 batch');
  await expect(jobStatus(page)).not.toContainText('not scored');
  const rows = rankingRows(page);
  await expect(rows.nth(1)).toContainText(strong.name);
  await expect(rows.nth(1)).toContainText('Strong');
  await expect(rows.nth(2)).toContainText(good.name);
  await expect(rows.nth(2)).toContainText('Good');
  // The capped pair sorts last, in Weak.
  await expect(rows.nth(3)).toContainText(capped.name);
  await expect(rows.nth(3)).toContainText('Weak');
  await expect(rows.nth(3)).toContainText('Capped: requirement not met');
  await expect(rankingTable(page)).not.toContainText('not ranked yet');

  // The run log, filtered to this property: one run (one batch of three).
  await rankPanel(page).getByRole('button', { name: 'Show runs for this anchor', exact: true }).click();
  const runRow = page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Ranking runs' }).getByRole('button');
  await expect(runRow).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(runRow).toContainText(line1);
  await expect(runRow).toContainText('Tenants for property');
  await expect(runRow).toContainText('3 candidates');
  await expect(runRow).toContainText('fake');
  await expect(runRow).toContainText(/\$\d+\.\d{4}/);
  await expect(runRow).toContainText('scored');
  await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Cost by week' })).toContainText(/Environment: \S+/);

  // It opens to its OWN results.
  await runRow.click();
  const detail = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Ranking run detail' });
  await expect(detail).toBeVisible();
  const pairs = detail.getByRole('table', { name: 'Run pairs' });
  await expect(pairs.getByRole('row')).toHaveCount(4);
  await expect(pairs.getByRole('row', { name: new RegExp(escapeRegExp(strong.name)) })).toContainText('80');
  await expect(pairs.getByRole('row', { name: new RegExp(escapeRegExp(capped.name)) })).toContainText('Capped');
  await expect(pairs).toContainText('This run');
  await expect(detail.getByText('Raw model output', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(detail.getByText('Input sent', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
});

test('a failed batch reads "not scored - retry"', async ({ page }) => {
  await devLoginAs(page, 'founder@example.com');
  const api = page.request;
  const s = stamp();
  const authority = await runUniqueAuthority(api, `Rankfail Authority ${s}`);
  const line1 = `${s} Rankfail Ct`;
  await createAvailableProperty(api, { line1, authority });
  const failing = await createSearchingTenant(api, { firstName: `Failing${s}`, authority, notes: '[fake:fail-batch]' });
  const beside = await createSearchingTenant(api, { firstName: `Beside${s}`, authority });

  await openRankings(page);
  await pickProperty(page, line1);
  await expect(rankingRows(page)).toHaveCount(3);
  await pressRank(page);
  await rankingTick(api);

  // Counted in CANDIDATES not scored, never "a batch failed" (plan PR42).
  await expect(jobStatus(page)).toContainText('Done: 1 batch; 2 candidates not scored');
  // Both sat in the one failed batch: neither has a match, and both say so.
  for (const tenant of [failing, beside]) {
    await expect(rankingRow(page, tenant.name)).toContainText('not scored - retry');
  }
});
```
